布理有個走私販，出錢打聽我的巡邏隊經過各處路口的時辰。我收了，後來越收越多；路太長，隊長的餉錢卻太少。一個跟我不對付的軍官算出了巡邏的空當，報給了駐地長官。
A Broadbeam hewer of Belegost who swings a great mattock in both hands, breaking shields and the orcs behind them.
來自貝烈戈斯特的寬梁族劈砍手，雙手揮舞巨鎬，擊碎盾牌，連同盾後的奧克一併打垮。
A Broadbeam of the old school, dismissed for brawling with an Elf of the Havens. I want work for my hammer.
我是守老規矩的寬梁族矮人，跟一個灰港精靈打架，被開除了。我想給錘子找點活幹。
A Firebeard engineer-warrior of Nogrod who wields masterwork crossbows of great stopping power, each bolt forged in the furnaces of the Blue Mountains.
諾格羅德的火須族工程戰士，使用威力強勁的大師級重弩，每支弩矢都在藍色山脈的熔爐中鍛成。

A Free People's tournament seats no lord, wanderer or troop of the Shadow, and a tournament of the Shadow seats none of the Free Peoples; each is replaced by one of the town's own troops. A town's side is its owner's, so a captured town follows its conqueror, and a town held by a neutral realm bars nobody. Neutral lords and wanderers, the troops the town itself recruits, you and your clan always compete. Fewer lords in the field means a lesser prize. Default: on.
自由人民的競技大會不接納暗影陣營的領主、流浪者或士兵，反之亦然；他們的位置由城鎮自己的士兵補上。城鎮陣營由所有者決定，所以被攻佔後會跟隨征服者；中立國家的城鎮不限制陣營。中立領主和流浪者、城鎮本來招募的士兵，以及你和你的家族始終可以參賽。參賽領主越少，獎品價值越低。默認：開啓。

A Gundabad raiding party burned a farm that belonged to my wife's kin and left nothing standing. I pulled my company off the line to hunt them and found them camped. We killed them all, wounded and captive alike, and I did not stop my hand.
一夥貢達巴德劫掠者燒了我妻子親戚的農莊，什麼也沒留下。我把隊伍從防線上拉走，追到了他們的營地。我們把他們殺了個乾淨，傷兵、俘虜都沒放過，我也始終沒停手。
一位哈拉德藝術家？這倒出乎意料。
A Host in Need of Provender
A House captain of Gorazehan, cast out for sparing prisoners his lord would have slain.
戈拉澤汗家族的隊長，因放過領主本想屠殺的俘虜而被驅逐。
A House forger of Artaxshâsan, fled one step ahead of the questioners, selling his cunning.
阿塔克沙桑家族的僞造者，搶在審問者前一步逃走，如今出售自己的狡智。
A House man who serves whoever pays is cold comfort.
一個誰給錢就爲誰效力的家族人，聽着可不踏實。
A House physician of Hoshêdharma, who fled rather than share a poisoner's secret.
霍謝達爾瑪家族的醫師，寧願逃走也不願背上毒殺者的祕密。
A Knight of the Golden Flower? That order has a legendary history.
金花騎士？這個騎士團有着傳奇般的歷史。

A Lindon patrol with grey-feathered arrows came out of the mist by the Gulf. They killed my band in the time it takes to cough. I survived with a stolen shield and three arrow-wounds. The Craig council said I should have run, and also that I should have died.
一支用灰羽箭的林頓巡邏隊，從海灣的霧裏殺出來。咳一聲的工夫，我的手下就死光了。我靠搶來的盾活下來，中了三箭。藍巖議會說，我早該逃，又說我早該死。
A Lord in Want of Horses
A Lore-Grandmaster? You must know secrets lost to time itself.
學識大宗師？你一定知道許多失落在時間裏的祕密。

A Northman horse-lord of the plains south of Mirkwood who rides with the thunder of generations of herdsmen, inspiring allies with a warcry that rolls across the grass and scattering enemies under the hooves of heavy cavalry.
來自黑森林以南平原的北方人馭馬領主，承襲世代牧民雷霆般的騎戰傳統。他的戰吼響徹草原，鼓舞盟友，重騎兵的鐵蹄則將敵軍衝散。

A Postern Gate (a Hidden Door, Culvert, Sally Port, Hidden Way or Bolt-Hole, by culture) in a besieged fief cuts the troops lost breaking into or out of the siege there: by default 50, 67 and 75 percent by building level (postern_gate.json). When off, the building still exists but the cut does not apply. Takes effect at the next break-in or break-out. Default: on.
被圍封地建有暗門時，可以減少部隊突入或逃離圍城時的兵力損失。不同文化下，建築可能叫隱蔽門、涵洞、出擊門、隱祕通道或逃生洞；默認隨建築等級分別減少50%、67%和75%，詳見postern_gate.json。關閉後，建築仍然存在，但不再減免損失。下次突入或逃離圍城時生效。默認：開啓。
A Ranger? The Bree-folk have hard words for your kind.
遊俠？布理人可沒少說你們的壞話。
A Silvan craftsman? Your people are legendary for their artistry.
一位西爾凡工匠？你們族人的技藝可是傳說級的。
A Spartan who fights with XML? That's an unusual battlefield.
一個用標記文檔作戰的斯巴達人？這戰場可真特別。
A Woodman bowman of the Vales who shoots from the eaves of Mirkwood and the banks of the Gladden, carrying on a tradition of unerring marksmanship.
河谷的林中居民弓手，從黑森林邊緣與金鳶尾河岸放箭，傳承着百發百中的射術。
A Woodman out of the forest, and no use in the open. Try not to laugh, I have heard it all.
林中居民離了森林，到了空地上一無是處。別笑，該聽的我都聽過了。
A anchor smith from the Haven of Umbar, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自烏姆巴爾港的船錨鐵匠，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A axe-brother from the hills of Dunland, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自黑蠻地丘陵的斧頭兄弟，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A bad bargain, but you lived.
買賣虧了，好在人還活着。
A band of deserters extorts {ISSUE_SETTLEMENT} and has killed those who refused.
一夥逃兵正在勒索{ISSUE_SETTLEMENT}的居民，還殺害了拒絕交錢的人。
A band of sellswords hired to harass a lord must be driven off.
一羣僱傭兵受僱騷擾一位領主，需要有人將他們趕走。

A barge smuggler offered coin for the hours my patrols passed each crossing. I took it, then took more; the road was long and a captain's pay was short. A rival officer counted the gaps and carried them to the lord warden.
一個跑駁船的走私販，出錢打聽我的巡邏隊經過各處路口的時辰。我收了，後來越收越多；路太長，隊長的餉錢卻太少。一個跟我不對付的軍官算出了巡邏的空當，報給了守將。

A battle-hardened infantry officer who commands Gondor's frontline defense at the ruins of Osgiliath, forging order from chaos in brutal urban combat. The Captain holds the line where others would break, rallying soldiers through sheer force of will.
久經戰火的步兵軍官，統領剛鐸在歐斯吉利亞斯廢墟中的前線防務。他能在殘酷的巷戰裏穩住秩序，在旁人崩潰之處堅守陣線，並用意志鼓舞士兵。

A battle-hardened infantry officer who holds the tower of Cameth Brin against the mountains, forging order from chaos when the fells burn. The Captain holds the line where others would break, rallying soldiers through sheer force of will.
久經沙場的步兵軍官，守住卡梅斯布林的高塔，抵禦山中來敵。高地陷入戰火時，他能在混亂中重整秩序。在別人將要潰退之處，他仍能守住陣線，憑堅定的意志讓士兵重新振作。

A battle-hardened infantry officer who holds the walls of Fornost against the hosts of Angmar, forging order from chaos when the North Downs burn. The Warden holds the line where others would break, rallying soldiers through sheer force of will.
久經沙場的步兵軍官，堅守佛諾斯特城牆，抵禦安格瑪大軍。北崗陷入戰火時，他能在混亂中重整秩序。在別人將要潰退之處，他仍能守住陣線，憑堅定的意志讓士兵重新振作。

A battle-hardened infantry officer who keeps the barrows of Tyrn Gorthad and the walls of Caras Gorthad, forging order from chaos when the downs burn. The Warden holds the line where others would break, rallying soldiers through sheer force of will.
久經沙場的步兵軍官，守護提殞戈沙德的古冢與卡拉斯戈沙德的城牆。丘崗陷入戰火時，他能在混亂中重整秩序。在別人將要潰退之處，他仍能守住陣線，憑堅定的意志讓士兵重新振作。
A battle-sage from the Golden Wood, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自金色森林的戰鬥賢者，正在尋找目標和冒險。

A beast is loyal as no man is, and I came to value that loyalty too highly for my masters. When the House drove a tusker to its death in a reckless charge for a lord's glory, and meant to do the same to the rest, I would not lead them to slaughter. A handler who will not spend his beasts is no use to a House that sees them only as engines.
野獸有一種人類沒有的忠誠，而我對這種忠誠看得太重，讓主人們不喜歡。有一次，家族爲了領主的榮耀，把一頭公象趕進魯莽衝鋒，害它死去，還打算對其餘巨獸也這麼做。我不肯把它們帶去屠宰場。一個不願消耗自己巨獸的馭手，對把它們只當攻城器械的家族來說沒有用處。
A beast-master's eye for command is a rare thing indeed.
馴獸大師看待指揮的眼光，確實難得。

A beautiful landscape means nothing if you cannot navigate it. I ensure that every soul, from veteran to newcomer, can find their way with grace and ease. This is my art - making the complex feel simple.
再美的風景，若無法辨路，也毫無意義。我確保每一個人，無論老手還是新人，都能從容而輕鬆地找到方向。我的藝術，就是讓複雜之物變得簡單。
A bitter feud has turned to bloodshed and a lord wants the rival faction's armed men broken.
一場積怨已演變成流血衝突，一位領主希望有人擊潰敵對勢力的武裝人員。
A blade captain from the Haven of Umbar, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自烏姆巴爾港的刀鋒船長，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A blade of the wood from the Woodland Realm, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自林地王國的林中之刃，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A blade smith from the eastern steppes, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自東方草原的刀匠，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A blade-singer from Imladris, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自幽谷的劍歌者，正在尋找目標和冒險。

A blood-painted skirmisher of the Avanc-lúth clan who charges into melee with reckless aggression, trading surgical precision for raw savage force that overwhelms opponents through sheer relentless pressure.
阿萬克盧斯氏族的血塗散兵，帶着不顧一切的兇狠衝入近戰。他不追求精巧招式，而是用原始的蠻力和持續不斷的壓迫擊垮對手。
A boon is on offer: press B.
A boon is taken between waves.
只能在兩波之間選擇祝福。
A border smuggler of clan Shakar, selling his hidden roads to whoever pays.
沙卡爾氏族的邊境走私者，把自己的隱祕道路賣給付錢的人。
A bow, two kinds of arrow and a sword for when they close in.
一把弓、兩種箭，以及一把應付近身敵人的劍。
A bow-master from Imladris, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自幽谷的弓術大師，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A bowman of the Redwater who shoots from the walls of Seagate and the reed-beds of the river, carrying on a tradition of unerring marksmanship.
紅水河弓手，從海門城牆與河邊蘆葦叢中放箭，傳承着百發百中的射術。
A boy lost his hand, and you still call it his choice.
那孩子丟了一隻手，你還說是他自己選的。
A bronze smith from the lands of Harad, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自哈拉德諸地的青銅匠，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A brutal orc chieftain of Blue Craig who commands cave trolls in battle, driving them forward with whip and cunning.
一位殘暴的藍巖半獸人酋長，在戰場上指揮洞穴食人妖，用鞭子和計謀驅使它們前進。
A brutal orc chieftain of Goblin-town who commands cave trolls in battle, driving them forward with whip and cunning.
一位殘暴的半獸人鎮酋長，在戰場上指揮洞穴食人妖，用鞭子和計謀驅使它們前進。
A brutal orc chieftain of Gundabad who commands cave trolls in battle, driving them forward with whip and cunning.
貢達巴德的一名兇狠奧克首領，靠鞭子和計謀驅使洞穴食人妖衝鋒作戰。
A brutal orc chieftain of Moria who commands cave trolls in battle, driving them forward with whip and cunning.
一位殘暴的墨瑞亞半獸人酋長，在戰場上指揮洞穴食人妖，用鞭子和計謀驅使它們前進。
A builder who sold one wall's secret will sell another's.
賣過一面牆祕密的建造者，也會賣另一面牆的祕密。
A builder's skills are worth more than a warrior's in these dark times.
在這樣的黑暗時代，建造者的本事比戰士更值錢。
A calm answer in a dark place. We respect that. Name an offer, and keep your hands where we can see them.[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
在這種黑地方還能這麼鎮定，值得敬重。開個價，手放在我們看得見的地方。[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
A captain of Dolmed Hold who kept his oath to the hill-folk against his lord's orders. My word still holds.
我原是多米德山要塞的隊長，違背領主命令，守住了對山民的誓言。我的話仍然算數。
A captain of the guard from the Woodland Realm, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自林地王國的守衛隊長，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A captain of the northern marches who gave up a gate to win a quarrel with the council. Exiled, but I still win.
我原是北方邊境的隊長，爲了跟議事會爭出個結果，放棄過一座城門。我雖被流放，打仗照樣贏。
A captain who disobeys once will disobey again.
違過一次命的隊長，還會再違命。
A captain who lives can plan again.
隊長活着，才能再做計劃。
A captain who lives to avenge is worth more than a dead one.
活着能報仇的隊長，比死了的更有用。

A captain who'd never seen real combat tried to claim credit for my victories. When I objected, he pulled rank. So I challenged him, ritual combat, traditional. I won. His allies called it murder, ignored that he'd accepted the challenge. They wanted me executed as an example.
一個從沒見過真正戰鬥的隊長想搶走我的戰功。我反對，他就拿軍銜壓我。於是我向他發起挑戰，儀式決鬥，照傳統來。我贏了。他的盟友卻叫這是謀殺，全不管他已經接受挑戰。他們想處決我，拿我做榜樣。

A caravan master offered coin for the hours my patrols passed each crossing. I took it, then took more; the road was long and a captain's pay was short. A rival officer counted the gaps and carried them to the commander of the bridge.
一個商隊首領，出錢打聽我的巡邏隊經過各處路口的時辰。我收了，後來越收越多；路太長，隊長的餉錢卻太少。一個跟我不對付的軍官算出了巡邏的空當，報給了守橋長官。
A careful mind is worth more than a loud one.
腦子細緻，比嗓門大更有用。
A cast-off tax-master of the House of Phaxsharân, selling his ledger-craft to a new master.
法克沙蘭家族被拋棄的稅務官，把賬冊本事賣給新的主人。
A cast-out scout-master of clan Uzharês, trading the steppe's secrets for silver.
烏扎雷斯氏族被逐出的斥候長，用草原的祕密換取銀子。

A castle with a built Guard House fields one patrol party of its owner's culture at a time, as a town does: stronger at each Guard House level. A lost patrol is replaced after 10, 8 or 6 days. While a castle's patrol is alive, the castle also gains security each day: 1, 1.5 or 2 by Guard House level (both in castle_patrols.json). When off, no new castle patrol is queued, and the game's daily check removes the castle patrols already out. Default: on.
城堡建成衛兵營房後，會像城鎮一樣派出一支所屬文化的巡邏隊，同時只維持一支；衛兵營房等級越高，巡邏隊越強。巡邏隊損失後，分別在10、8或6天后補充。只要城堡巡邏隊仍在，城堡每天還會增加治安，隨衛兵營房等級分別爲1、1.5或2點。這兩項設在castle_patrols.json中。關閉後，不再籌備新的城堡巡邏隊，每日結算時也會移除已在外巡邏的城堡隊伍。默認：開啓。
A cave-in sorts the living from the dead faster than any healer. I learned to keep pace with it...
塌方分出生死，比任何醫者都快。我也只好學着跟它搶時間……
A champion thrown out for winning. That is an insult.
贏了還被趕走，這不是侮辱人嗎？

A clan dispute changed everything. My family backed the wrong side in a quarrel over mining rights. Though King Dáin is just, politics run deep. We lost our position, our workshop, our standing. Rather than live in shame, I chose exile.
一場氏族糾紛改變了一切。我的家族在一場採礦權爭執中站錯了邊。戴因國王雖然公正，但政治的根扎得很深。我們失去了職位、工坊和地位。與其在羞辱中活着，我選擇了流放。
A clever thief knows when to run. You lived to tell it.
聰明的賊知道什麼時候該跑。你活着把故事講出來了。
A clever trade, if you live through it.
買賣很聰明，前提是你能活下來。
A coder? That's powerful magic in these lands.
寫代碼的人？在這片土地上，那可是強大的魔法。
A commander who remembers their dead is worth more than a lucky one.
會記住死者的指揮官，比運氣好的更有用。
A commander who values truth over position, rare quality.
重視真相勝過職位的指揮官，確實少見。

A company of foot soldiers with riders under a tenth of its soldiers keeps the spacing limits of a foot company, as it already keeps their spacing, instead of the limits of cavalry. A change takes a restart of the game, and it applies only if Enable Marshal's Word is on when the game starts. It stays off in a co-op session and on a dedicated server, so that two machines never compute different widths. Default: on.
步兵編隊中，騎乘單位不足總人數十分之一時，間距上下限也按步兵編隊計算，不再套用騎兵限制，與其實際採用的步兵間距一致。修改後需要重啓遊戲，而且啓動時必須開啓“啓用元帥軍令”纔會生效。合作聯機和專用服務器中停用，避免兩臺機器算出不同的編隊寬度。默認：開啓。
A conscripted herder of clan Acammes, deserted after a raid he could not bear.
阿卡梅斯氏族被徵召的牧人，因無法忍受一場突襲而逃離。

A corsair fleet put in under a truce flag, and I judged the truce a lie. I fired the ships at anchor with their crews still sleeping below, and I was right about the lie. The council did not thank me; they asked how many I had not needed to burn.
一支海盜艦隊掛着休戰旗進港，我判斷是假議和。船拋錨後，船員還睡在艙裏，我就放火燒了它們。休戰確實是假的，我沒判斷錯。議會卻不謝我，反問我有多少人原本不必燒死。

A count such as {MEMORY_EXAMPLE} is remembered from an earlier sighting, not read now. Remembered counts lose digits as the hours pass, more slowly with a better scout; hover the host to see how long ago it was counted. A host you meet, speak with or share a settlement with is counted exactly. Reading an enemy host's count from afar trains your scout's Scouting.
像{MEMORY_EXAMPLE}這樣的數字，來自先前觀察的記憶，並非當前所見。隨着時間過去，記住的位數會逐漸減少，斥候越出色，遺忘越慢。將鼠標移到軍隊上，可查看距上次清點過了多久。與你遭遇、交談，或與你同處一個定居點的軍隊，人數會準確顯示。遠距離觀察敵軍人數，能鍛鍊斥候的偵察技能。
A craft shared freely does more good than one locked away.
手藝肯拿出來幫人，比鎖着藏着更有用。
A craftsman of principle is rare and precious.
有原則的工匠少見，也珍貴。
A craftsman who refuses to make chains still makes the world better.
不肯造鎖鏈的工匠，同樣能讓世道好一點。
A crawl-tunnel dug in the dark and shored with scrap, used by whoever is quick enough to squeeze through. In a siege, parties slip into or out of this fief with fewer losses.
在黑暗中挖掘、用廢料支撐的低矮地道，身手夠快的人都能擠過去。圍城時，部隊經此潛入或撤出封地，損失更少。
A crossbow ace from the Haven of Umbar, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自烏姆巴爾港的弩術高手，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A cunning Uruk rider mounted on a swift warg, scouting ahead of the armies of Isengard and running down fleeing prey.
狡詐的烏魯克騎手，騎乘迅捷座狼，爲艾森加德大軍探路，並追殺逃竄的獵物。
A cursed one. I will keep my back to the wall.
原來是個受詛咒的，我可得背靠着牆。
A cutlass-wielding sea reaver who storms enemy decks with ruthless ferocity, taking what the Corsairs desire.
揮舞彎刀的海上掠奪者，以無情兇悍之勢衝上敵船甲板，奪取烏姆巴爾海盜想要的一切。
A cutthroat from the Haven of Umbar, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自烏姆巴爾港的割喉客，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A dark champion of Dol Guldur empowered by the Necromancer's sorcery, draining the life of all who stand before them.
受死靈法師巫術強化的多古爾都黑暗勇士，能吸取擋在面前之人的生命。
A deep archery line, from the Woodman Bowman to the Master Woodman Archer
從林中居民弓手到林中居民弓箭大師，弓兵種類豐富
A deep bow line, from the Vintner Bowman to the Master of the Vine-bow
從酒商弓手到葡萄園弓術大師，弓兵種類豐富

A descendant of the ancient Eothéod horsemasters who rides with the thunder of generations of legend, inspiring allies with a warcry that echoes Eorl the Young and scattering enemies under hooves of unstoppable heavy cavalry.
古老伊奧希奧德馭馬者的後裔，馳騁時彷彿帶着世代傳說的雷聲。他的戰吼呼應年少的埃奧爾，鼓舞盟友，也讓敵人在重騎兵的鐵蹄下四散奔逃。
A desert tracker from the lands of Harad, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自哈拉德諸地的沙漠追蹤者，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A desolate eastern region overrun by Orc tribes. These savage bands raid the borderlands and serve as scouts for the forces of darkness.
納拉格爾是一片荒涼的東方地區，已被奧克部族侵佔。這些野蠻戰幫劫掠邊境地帶，也爲黑暗勢力充當斥候。
A disciplined Uruk marksman wielding Saruman's iron crossbows, delivering devastating volleys from Orthanc's forges.
紀律嚴明的烏魯克射手，使用薩茹曼打造的鐵弩，把來自歐爾桑克熔爐的毀滅性齊射送向敵人。
A disciplined captain is the backbone of any host.
有紀律的隊長，是任何軍隊的骨架。
A disciplined shieldwall soldier of the Côdya formations who excels in defensive cohesion, soaking punishment while the line holds firm.
科迪亞陣列中紀律嚴明的盾牆士兵，擅長穩固防線，在陣線不崩時替同伴承受重壓。
A disgraced tribute-keeper of clan Kûmaraknis, selling his reckoning to the highest bidder.
庫馬拉克尼斯氏族失勢的貢賦官，把自己的算賬本事賣給出價最高的人。

A distinct goblin host of the Blue Mountains (Ered Luin) in the far west, hard by the Grey Havens of Lindon — a realm apart from their Misty Mountains cousins of Goblin Town. Same numberless, ill-armed swarms: weak alone, overwhelming in the mass, and ravenous on the march. They trouble the Elves of the western shore.
藍色山脈，也就是埃瑞德路因極西一帶，有一支獨立的半獸人大軍，靠近林頓的灰港。他們與迷霧山脈半獸人鎮的同族不同，但同樣數量龐大、裝備低劣：單個很弱，聚成大羣就能淹沒敵人，行軍時又永遠飢餓。他們不斷騷擾西岸的精靈。
A door cut into the living stone, its seam hidden from any eye that does not know the rune. In a siege, parties slip into or out of this fief with fewer losses.
直接鑿入天然岩石的門，不認識符文的人看不出它的縫隙。圍城時，部隊經此潛入或撤出封地，損失更少。
A drain under the earthen wall, wide enough for a rider who leads his horse. In a siege, parties slip into or out of this fief with fewer losses.
土牆下方的排水道，寬度足夠騎手牽馬通過。圍城時，部隊經此潛入或撤出封地，損失更少。
A dread horseman of the shadow host who spreads fear with every charge, their mount wreathed in dark mist.
暗影大軍中的可怖騎手，每一次衝鋒都散播恐懼，坐騎周身纏繞着黑霧。
A dwarf warrior far from the mountains? What brings you here?
一位遠離羣山的矮人戰士？是什麼把你帶到這裏？
A dwarf's word, once given, is harder than any stone in the Blue Mountains...
矮人說出口的承諾，比藍色山脈任何石頭都硬……

A dwarf-hunt went down the old shaft and I led it. They knew the walls better than we did. Their axes came out of the dark, and the shaft took twenty-six of mine. The Great Goblin said the fault was the leader's. I was the leader.
有次追殺矮人，我帶隊下了老豎井。矮人比我們更熟悉巖壁，他們的斧頭從黑暗裏殺了出來，我的二十六個手下死在井裏。半獸人王說，錯在領隊。我就是領隊。
A dwarven cavalry warrior mounted on a great war-ram, charging through tight mountain passes where horses cannot tread.
騎乘巨大戰羊的矮人騎兵，能在戰馬無法通行的狹窄山道中發起衝鋒。
A dwarven engineer-warrior who wields masterwork crossbows of incredible stopping power, each bolt precision-crafted.
矮人工程師兼戰士，使用威力驚人的精工弩作戰，每一支弩矢都經過精密打造。
A elk-rider from the Woodland Realm, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自林地王國的麋鹿騎手，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A eye-poker from Dol Guldur, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自多古爾都的刺眼射手，正在尋找目標和機會。
A fair bargain. May your road be short and your skin stay cool. We will remember your face.[ib:closed]
這買賣公道。願你早些走完這趟路，也少挨些烈日。你的臉，我們記住了。[ib:closed]
A fair shot for a fair price.
好箭法，就該有個好價錢。
A fair toll, honestly paid. The mountain remembers it. Go on, and keep clear of our halls.[ib:closed][rf:convo_bemused]
過路錢交得公道，也沒耍花樣。大山會記住的。走吧，別靠近我們的廳堂。[ib:closed][rf:convo_bemused]
A fallen beast is a heavy loss of gold.
巨獸倒下會造成鉅額金錢損失。

A fanatical devotee of the One Ring's whispered promises who channels the terror of Sauron's voice to shatter enemy resolve, blending cursed archery with a maddening presence that erodes the will to fight.
狂熱信奉至尊魔戒低語承諾的信徒，借索隆之聲散播恐懼、擊垮敵軍意志。他將受詛咒的箭術與令人發狂的壓迫感結合在一起，慢慢瓦解敵人的戰意。
A fast-moving skirmisher of Chatâk who screens cavalry with a hail of javelins before withdrawing beyond reach of retaliation.
一位行動迅速的查塔克散兵，用密集的標槍投射掩護騎兵，然後撤到敵人無法還擊的地方。
A fast-moving skirmisher of Jîret who screens cavalry with a hail of javelins before withdrawing beyond reach of retaliation.
一位行動迅速的吉雷特散兵，用密集的標槍投射掩護騎兵，然後撤到敵人無法還擊的地方。
A fast-moving skirmisher of Pezarsan who screens cavalry with a hail of javelins before withdrawing beyond reach of retaliation.
佩扎爾桑的快速散兵，先用密集標槍爲騎兵掩護，再撤到敵人無法反擊的距離之外。

A fast-raiding clan cavalryman who harasses enemy flanks with swift hit-and-run assaults, using superior speed and pack coordination to disrupt formations before the clan's infantry close in for the kill.
行動迅捷的黑蠻地氏族騎兵，擅長用打了就走的突擊騷擾敵軍側翼。他依靠速度和戰羣配合打亂陣型，爲氏族步兵的最後衝殺創造機會。
A feared orc alpha who rides the largest warg of the pack, leading savage hunts through the Ered Luin.
一位令人畏懼的半獸人首領，騎着狼羣中最大的座狼，率領兇猛的狩獵隊穿行在埃瑞德路因。
A feared orc alpha who rides the largest warg of the pack, leading savage hunts through the Misty Mountains.
令人畏懼的奧克頭領，騎着狼羣中最大的座狼，帶領野蠻狩獵穿過迷霧山脈。
A fearsome rider of the Far Harad who drives great beasts into the enemy, breaking lines with shock and primal terror.
遠哈拉德令人畏懼的騎手，驅使巨獸衝入敵陣，以衝擊和原始恐懼撕開防線。
A fell sorcerer who channels dark energies to weaken enemies from afar, sowing terror and decay across the battlefield.
邪惡的巫術施法者，引導黑暗能量從遠處削弱敵人，在戰場上散播恐懼與腐敗。
A fierce spear is still a spear. It only needs a hand to steer it.
矛再兇，終究還是矛，有人掌着方向就行。
A fine day for a trade. Is it not? Is it always?
真是做買賣的好日子，是吧？哪天不都是？
A fine grudge. I hope you finish it.
這仇結得好，祝你報到底。
A fine sword at the bottom of the sea helps nobody.
好劍沉在海底，對誰都沒用。
A fleet commander from the Haven of Umbar, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自烏姆巴爾港的艦隊指揮官，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A foe must be dealt with.
A foolish young cousin of mine fell among thieves and now they hold him against his debts. Break the gang and free him.
我有個不成器的年輕親戚，跟一羣盜賊混在一起，如今那夥人因爲他欠債把他扣住了。打垮他們，把人救出來。
A forest sage from the Woodland Realm, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自林地王國的森林賢者，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A forge-master from Imladris, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自幽谷的鍛爐大師，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A forger's cunning can win a war without a battle.
僞造者的狡智，能不打一仗就贏下一場戰爭。

A forger's whole life is one good seal away from the executioner. Mine came when a rival House caught a writ I had made and traced the hand to me. My own masters disowned the work the instant it was dangerous, and I had a single night to vanish before the questioners came.
僞造者的一生，只差一個好印章就會落到劊子手手裏。我的那一刻，是敵對家族抓到我做的一份文書，並把筆跡追到了我身上。我的主人們在事情變危險的瞬間就否認了那件事，而我只有一夜時間，在審問者到來之前消失。
A former lawspeaker of clan Banûgand, offering hard-won counsel to those who will hear it.
巴努甘德氏族昔日的律法代言人，把苦心換來的建議獻給願意聽的人。

A frame that takes this many milliseconds or more writes one [Hitch] line naming where the frame went, for the first 100 such frames of a mission; later ones are only counted. Below the battle's usual frame time, nearly every frame is a hitch. Default 250. Read at each mission start.
一幀達到此毫秒數時，寫一條 [Hitch]，記錄時間花在何處。每次任務前100個這樣的幀會詳細記錄，之後只計數。低於戰鬥通常幀耗時時，幾乎每幀都會被判爲卡頓。默認250，每次任務開始時讀取。
A free-handed horse-thief of clan Selarkes, more at home in the saddle than the law.
塞拉克斯氏族出手大方的盜馬賊，比起法律，他更適合待在馬背上。
A frenzied Uruk-hai who charges headlong into battle, growing stronger as wounds fuel an unstoppable rage.
狂怒的烏魯克，迎着戰鬥正面衝鋒。傷口會進一步點燃他的怒火，讓他變得更難阻擋。
A frightened farm boy who already deserted once? No.
一個害怕的農家小子，還已經逃過一次？不行。
A full cavalry ladder, from the Northman Youth to the Horse-lord
從北方人青年到馭馬領主，騎兵晉升路線完整

A fungal blight spread through the upper orchards and threatened the lower terraces. You identified the affected trees early, imposed a quarantine the Elves considered excessive, and kept the blight from spreading. The harvest that year was smaller but whole.
真菌枯萎病在上層果園蔓延，並威脅到下層梯田。你早早識別出受害樹木，實行精靈們都覺得過度的隔離措施，阻止病害擴散。那年的收成少了些，但保住了。
A galley master from the Haven of Umbar, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自烏姆巴爾港的槳帆船船主，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A games-champion of clan Alâranin, selling his unbeaten lance to the highest bidder.
阿拉拉寧氏族的競技冠軍，把自己不敗的騎槍賣給出價最高的人。
A gang is only as strong as its numbers, and mine are thin. Bring me captives, whoever they are, and I'll make use of them.
幫派人多才有力量，可我這裏缺人。不管是什麼人，只要是俘虜就給我帶來，我自有用處。
A gang leader has bet heavily on the tourney and needs a fighter to make his wager pay.
一個幫派頭目在競技大賽上下了重注，需要一名鬥士幫他贏下賭注。
A gang leader has stolen goods to shift and needs a quiet hand to carry them.
一個幫派頭目需要轉移一批贓物，正在找能悄悄運走它們的人。
A gang leader wants a band of grasping rivals lured into a trap and destroyed.
一個幫派頭目想將一夥貪婪的對手誘入陷阱，再消滅他們。
A gang leader wants a rival's weapon cache seized by force.
一個幫派頭目想用武力奪取對手藏匿的武器。
A gang leader wants captives pressed into his service.
一個幫派頭目想強迫俘虜爲他效力。
A gang leader wants fine iron brought to forge a set of special blades.
一個幫派頭目需要上好的鐵料，來鍛造一批特製刀劍。
A gang leader's people were taken by bounty hunters and he wants them freed.
一個幫派頭目的手下被賞金獵人抓走了，他想把他們救出來。
A gap in the horde invites doom, treason!
獸羣裏出現缺口就會招來毀滅，這是背叛！
A generations-deep woodland upbringing: 50% less forest speed penalty + 15% sight, and +20% chance for veteran militia in towns; -10% construction speed.
世代在林地長大：森林減速懲罰降低50%，視野範圍增加15%，城鎮民兵成爲老兵的概率增加20%；建築施工速度降低10%。

A goblin raid burned the hall one winter night. The lord died on the stair and I carried his reeve's children out. The survivors of the village, nearly forty, followed me to Caras Gorthad, where the king's officers found them a corner of a warehouse and little else.
一個冬夜，半獸人來襲，燒了廳堂。領主死在樓梯上，我把他管事的孩子們背了出來。村裏將近四十個倖存者跟我到了卡拉斯戈沙德，國王的官員們給他們在倉庫裏騰了個角落，除此之外也沒幫上多少。
A goblin raid from Blue Craig took a steading and everyone in it. We caught the raiders at the ford and I let no one yield. The Havens call that murder; the steading's dead have no opinion.
藍巖的半獸人襲擊了一座農莊，裏面的人一個也沒留下。我們在渡口截住劫掠者，求降的我也一個沒饒。港口的人說那是謀殺，農莊裏的死人卻再也沒法說話。
A goblin who burns steadings has no claim on anyone's word.
燒農莊的半獸人，沒資格要別人對它守信。
A god complex for a dwarf? That's new.
一個矮人有了神明情結？這倒新鮮。
A golden archer from the Golden Wood, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自金色森林的金林弓手，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A good mount is hard to replace. I understand.
好坐騎很難再找一頭，我明白。
A good plan is a weapon too. Use it for me.
好計劃也是武器，替我用上它吧。
A graceful elven warrior who weaves through battle like flowing water, striking with ancient blades forged in the First Age.
優雅的精靈戰士，能像流水一樣穿梭於戰場，以第一紀元鍛造的古老利刃出擊。
A great company of riders rides at your back. +5 party size.
一支龐大的騎兵隊追隨在你身後。部隊人數上限+5。
A great eored rides at your back. +5 party size.
一支強大的伊奧雷德跟隨在你身後。+5 部隊規模。

A grizzled river-warden of Stangard who patrols the Anduin crossings by flatboat and on foot, guarding Rohan's eastern flank through endurance, local knowledge, and a boatswain's tenacious grip on contested ground.
斯坦加德經驗老到的河道守衛，乘平底船或徒步巡查安都因河渡口。他靠耐力、地利和水手般的頑強，守住洛汗的東翼。

A grizzled spear-warden of Wainwatch who patrols the eastern plain on foot and by pony, guarding the realm's eastern flank against the Wainriders through endurance, local knowledge and a tenacious grip on contested ground.
飽經風霜的持矛守望者，來自戰車哨站。他時而徒步，時而騎小馬，巡邏東部平原，憑耐力、對當地的熟悉與寸土不讓的堅韌，抵禦戰車民，守護王國東翼。

A group of nobles conspired to hoard grain while common folk starved, claiming future shortage. When I reported this to my captain, he revealed he was part of the scheme. He offered me a share to forget what I knew.
一羣貴族密謀囤積糧食，而平民卻在捱餓，他們聲稱未來會有短缺。當我向我的隊長報告此事時，他透露自己也是這個計劃的一部分。他提出給我一份好處讓我忘記我知道的事情。
A guardsman who failed his last lord may fail me.
沒能保護上一任領主的衛兵，也可能辜負我。
A guide for the digital realm. That's valuable indeed.
數字領域的嚮導。這確實很有價值。
A guide of the Dwarf-road, cast out for selling caravan routes to Bree-land thieves. I still know every road in Eriador.
我原是矮人路的嚮導，因爲向布理鄉的賊出售商隊路線，被逐了出來。埃利阿多的每條路，我還是都認得。
A guide who knows both sides of the road could be useful.
路上黑白兩道都熟的嚮導，倒也用得上。
A half-troll berserker of the deepest Far Harad jungles who absorbs punishment that would kill lesser warriors and retaliates with vile brutality.
遠哈拉德密林深處的半食人妖狂戰士，能承受足以殺死尋常戰士的傷害，並以惡毒的蠻力還擊。
A handler with no beasts is just an old soldier now.
沒有巨獸的馭手，如今也只是個老兵。
A harder enemy commander decides faster, makes fewer mistakes and earns more gold.
難度越高，敵方指揮官決策越快，失誤越少，獲得的金錢也越多。
A hawk-eye from the lands of Harad, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自哈拉德諸地的鷹眼射手，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A healer from Imladris, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自幽谷的醫者，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A healer is worth ten swords on a long campaign.
在漫長戰役中，一名醫者抵得上十把劍。
A healer who abandons the dying is no healer.
把垂死的人丟下不管，還叫什麼醫者。
A healer who leaves the dying is no healer.
把垂死的人丟下不管，還叫什麼醫者。
A healer who sees the darkness coming, valuable indeed.
一個看見黑暗將至的醫者，確實很有價值。
A healer who walks away from the dying has forgotten the trade.
醫者若丟下垂死的人不管，就是忘了自己的本分。
A healer's compassion is a rare gift.
醫者的憐憫是少見的禮物。

A heavy archer of the Aldburg garrison who has mastered the art of loosing light, high-velocity arrows with lethal precision, capable of penetrating armour at distances that leave enemies no safe quarter.
奧德堡衛戍軍中的重裝弓手，精通射出輕快高速的箭矢，能在很遠的距離上穿透盔甲，讓敵人無處躲藏。

A heavy archer of the Westmark garrison who has mastered the art of loosing light, high-velocity arrows with lethal precision, capable of penetrating armour at distances that leave enemies no safe quarter.
西境駐軍的重裝弓手，精通輕箭疾射，箭法精準致命。即使相隔很遠，箭矢依然能穿透鎧甲，讓敵人無處安心躲藏。
A heavy cavalry commander of the Balchoth who leads unstoppable mounted charges, maintaining iron morale no matter the odds.
巴爾寇斯的重騎兵指揮官，能率領騎兵發起勢不可擋的衝鋒，無論戰況多麼不利都維持鐵一般的士氣。
A herb-speaker from the Woodland Realm, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自林地王國的草藥師，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A herb-woman from the hills of Dunland, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自黑蠻地丘陵的草藥女，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A hero of the Annúminas road, at your service, or so the dispatches said...
安努米那斯大道上的英雄，聽候差遣。至少戰報是這麼寫的……
A hero of the Tharbad road, at your service, or so the dispatches said...
沙巴德大道上的英雄，聽候差遣。至少戰報是這麼寫的……
A hero of the Trollshaws, at your service, or so the dispatches said...
食人妖森林的英雄，聽候差遣。至少戰報是這麼寫的……

A high-ranking prisoner died before revealing critical intelligence, a miscalculation on my part. The lieutenant blamed me for the loss, though he'd demanded haste over care. Rather than face the consequences of his failure becoming mine, I departed during the confusion of a slave revolt.
一名高級囚犯還沒吐出關鍵情報就死了，這是我的誤判。副官把損失怪到我頭上，儘管正是他催着我快點動手，不許我細審。與其替他的失敗承擔後果，我趁一場奴隸暴動的混亂離開了。
A hill sage from the hills of Dunland, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自黑蠻地丘陵的山地賢者，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A hill-rider from the hills of Dunland, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自黑蠻地丘陵的山地騎手，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A horse thief from the eastern steppes, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自東方草原的盜馬者，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A host that needs a smith, and does not mind blood on the anvil, I am ready.
哪支軍隊缺鐵匠，又不介意鐵砧上沾血，我隨時能幹。
A host that wants a hammer on its side, I am here.
哪支大軍缺個掄錘子的，我就在這兒。
A hothead who rides off without leave gets men killed.
不聽號令就衝出去的莽撞人，會害死別人的。
A iron champion from the eastern steppes, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自東方草原的鐵血勇士，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A iron-bender from Dol Guldur, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自多古爾都的彎鐵匠，正在尋找目標和機會。
A iron-worker from the hills of Dunland, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自黑蠻地丘陵的鐵匠，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A jewel-trader from the Golden Wood, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自金色森林的寶石商人，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A jungle pathfinder of House Phaxim, exiled for selling a secret route, now scouting for hire.
法克西姆家族的叢林探路者，因出售祕密路線而被流放，如今受僱偵察。
A keen-eye from the hills of Dunland, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自黑蠻地丘陵的銳眼射手，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A keen-eyed hunter of the Woodland Realm who strikes from the treetops with lethal precision.
幽林王國目光銳利的獵手，擅長從樹冠上以致命精準發動攻擊。
A keeper of lore from the Golden Wood, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自金色森林的傳識守護者，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A knight of the King's guard had heard of your work and commissioned a sword for the day he took his oath. When he drew it before the assembled guard and it rang true, you knew your name was made.
國王衛隊的一名騎士聽說了你的手藝，委託你爲他的宣誓之日鑄劍。他在全體衛士面前拔出長劍，劍身發出清亮的鳴響，那一刻你知道自己出名了。

A knight of the King's riders had heard of your work and commissioned a lance for the day he took his oath. When he couched it before the assembled companies and it ran true, you knew your name was made.
國王騎兵隊的一名騎士聽說了你的手藝，委託你爲他的宣誓之日打造騎槍。他當着列隊士兵夾起騎槍，槍尖穩穩地指向前方。那一刻，你知道自己出名了。
A knight who makes maps? That's an unusual combination.
會繪製地圖的騎士？這組合可不常見。
A knot of green recruits stands idle, waiting for someone to put them through their paces.
一羣缺乏經驗的新兵閒站着，等人來帶他們操練。
A landowner is owed a tithe in grain that the outlying farms have not paid.
偏遠的農場拖欠了一位地主的什一稅，需要以糧食繳納。
A landowner needs strong backs for hard labor and will take any captives you have taken.
一位地主需要強壯的人手乾重活，願意接收你抓到的任何俘虜。
A landowner wants his green retainers blooded against real foes in the field.
一位地主想讓缺乏經驗的扈從在實戰中接受磨鍊。
A large band of poachers is ruining a merchant's hunting trade.
一大羣偷獵者正在毀掉一位商人的狩獵生意。
A leader betrayed by those he served, bitter lesson.
一位被自己效忠對象背叛的領袖，代價慘痛。
A leader learns more from one loss than from ten wins.
當首領的，輸一次學到的，比贏十次還多。
A legendary bowman of Dale whose ancestors slew Smaug, carrying on the tradition of unerring marksmanship.
河谷城的傳奇弓手。他的先祖曾射殺斯毛格，而他繼承了百發百中的箭術傳統。
A lesser noble has raised the peasants in revolt and must be put down.
一個小貴族煽動農民起義，需要有人將其鎮壓。
A lettered man is rare and quietly invaluable.
識字懂學問的人很少見，也安靜地有價值。
A light from the shadows shall spring.
A list of names can save lives, and you made one.
一份名單也能救命，而你把它列出來了。
A little polish on one page would have saved you a great deal.
報告裏稍微圓滑一點，你就不用受這些罪。
一位當地居民需要有人送來貨物。
A loot-keeper from Dol Guldur, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自多古爾都的戰利品看守，正在尋找目標和機會。
A lord has lost mounts to war and attrition and needs fresh horses for his riders.
一位領主的坐騎因戰鬥和日常損耗而減少，需要爲騎兵補充馬匹。
A lord mustering for war needs grain to feed the gathered host before it marches.
一位領主正在集結軍隊準備出征，需要糧食供養集結的士兵。
A lord needs the enemy's patrols broken so his scouts can see the borderlands clear.
一位領主需要有人擊潰敵軍巡邏隊，讓他的斥候能夠查明邊境的情況。
A lord of a Free realm will not take a gift from a player who sides with the Shadow. The lord refuses with no penalty. Realms and cultures that side with neither never refuse. Default: on.
自由人民國家的領主不會接受暗影陣營玩家的禮物。拒絕不會帶來懲罰。不屬於雙方陣營的國家和文化從不因此拒收。默認：開啓。
A lord of the Angle had heard of your work and commissioned a war-axe for the day he took his oath. When he raised it before the assembled guard and it rang true, you knew your name was made.
河角地的一位領主聽說了你的手藝，委託你爲他的宣誓之日打造戰斧。他當着全體衛士舉起斧頭，斧身發出清亮的鳴響，那一刻你知道自己出名了。
A lord planning a conquest needs the enemy's field forces broken before he marches.
一位領主準備出兵征服敵土，需要先擊潰敵人的野戰部隊。
A lord suspects an enemy agent moves against him and wants the spy's party hunted down.
一位領主懷疑敵方密探正圖謀對付他，希望有人追蹤並消滅密探的隊伍。
A lord wants a rival lord taken alive in battle.
一位領主想讓人在戰鬥中活捉他的敵對領主。
A lord wants fine cloth and goods brought to outfit his heir's education in proper style.
一位領主需要精美布料和其他物品，爲繼承人的求學生活備齊體面的衣裝與用具。
A lord wants the enemy's lands harried and their raiding parties destroyed.
一位領主希望有人襲擾敵人的領地，並消滅敵軍的劫掠隊。
A lord's garrison is hard-pressed and needs the enemies harrying it driven off.
一位領主的駐軍處境艱難，需要有人擊退不斷騷擾他們的敵軍。

A lord's helm is forged for a name that other lords fear. Strike down enemies with your own hand, take an enemy lord captive and win battles, or bring the armourer your people's lord's materials instead; then a master armourer will fit you with it.
領主頭盔是爲令其他領主畏懼的人打造的。親手擊倒敵人、俘獲敵方領主、贏得戰鬥，或者向鑄甲師交付你所屬文化的領主級材料，大師便會爲你打造頭盔。

A lord's mantle marks one who stands where the fighting is thickest. Strike down enemies with your own hand and win battles, or bring the armourer your people's lord's materials instead; then a master armourer will fit you with it.
領主披肩屬於敢於衝進最激烈戰鬥的人。親手擊倒敵人、贏得戰鬥，或者向鑄甲師交付你所屬文化的領主級材料，大師便會爲你打造披肩。
A lord's son left to die by his own healer. I would not forgive it either.
領主的兒子被自家的醫者放任等死，換我也不會原諒。
A lord's young kinsman has fallen in with a gang that holds him for his debts.
一位領主的年輕親戚和幫派混在一起，欠了債，如今被他們扣押。
A lore-keeper from the eastern steppes, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自東方草原的傳承守護者，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A loremaster from Imladris, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自幽谷的博學者，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A man cannot be in two places. You did what duty asked.
人沒法同時待在兩個地方。你盡了自己的職責。
A man of Lake-town on dry land. Try not to laugh, I have heard it all.
長湖鎮的人上了旱地。別笑，該聽的我都聽過了。
A man of Redwater on dry land. Try not to laugh, I have heard it all.
紅水的人上了旱地。別笑，該聽的我都聽過了。
A man of the Old Ford, far from his river. Try not to laugh, I have heard it all.
老渡口的人，離自家的河可遠了。別笑，該聽的我都聽過了。
A man should be paid for his craft.
憑本事喫飯，就該拿應得的工錢。
A man too proud to follow orders is a danger in a fight.
一個驕傲到不願聽命令的人，在戰鬥中很危險。
A man was hurt at the work.
一名士兵幹活時受傷了。
A man who breaks from the line is no use to me.
臨陣退縮的人，對我沒用。
A man who can break walls is worth more than a man who only climbs them.
會破牆的人，比只會爬牆的人值錢。
A man who can make a profit from nothing is useful to any cause.
白手起家也能賺錢的人，替誰辦事都有用。

A man who counts coin all day learns where coin goes missing, and learns the trick of it himself. When the discrepancy was found, the elders wanted my hands. I left with the contents of one strongbox and the clothes I stood in.
一個整天數錢的人，總會學會錢從哪裏消失，也會學會自己動手的門道。等虧空被發現時，長老們想砍掉我的雙手。我帶着一個保險箱裏的東西和身上的衣服離開了。
A man who cuts his rival's string deserves the ban.
割斷對手弓弦的人，就活該禁賽。
A man who fled a poisoning may have brewed it.
一個從毒殺案裏逃出來的人，也許就是配毒的人。
A man who flinches from killing will flinch when I need him.
一個下不了殺手的人，在我需要他時也會退縮。
A man who gambled away one fortune may gamble mine.
一個賭光過一份財富的人，也可能賭掉我的。
A man who hoards his winnings will not spend himself for me.
一個攥着獎金不放的人，也不會爲我拼盡全力。
A man who keeps his word to those who hire him is worth more than any chief's gold.
對僱主守信的人，比酋長的金子還貴重。
A man who knows every hidden road is worth his weight.
一個知道所有隱祕道路的人，值他的分量。
A man who knows horses is worth keeping close.
懂馬的人值得留在身邊。

A man who knows how a fortress is built knows exactly how it falls, and rival Houses pay dearly for such knowledge. When mine was found to have sold the weak point of a wall, though I will not say I did, the House could not be seen to keep me. Better an old builder exiled than a dynasty disgraced.
一個知道堡壘如何建成的人，也就清楚它會怎樣陷落，而敵對家族願意爲這種知識付出高價。當人們發現我的家族把一段城牆的弱點賣了出去時，雖然我不會說那是我做的，家族也不能繼續留下我。流放一個老建造者，總比讓一個王朝蒙羞好。
A man whose whole craft is lies will lie to me first.
一個全靠謊言喫飯的人，會先騙我。
A map in the head is worth more than a sword.
腦子裏有張地圖，比手裏有把劍還值錢。
A marchwarden from the Golden Wood, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自金色森林的邊境守衛，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A mark is only a mark. Your hands decide the rest.
記號只是記號，剩下的靠你自己。

A master armourer forges a lord's gauntlets only for hands that have proved themselves in battle. Strike down enemies with your own hand and win battles, or bring the armourer your people's lord's materials instead; then a master armourer will fit you with them.
鑄甲大師只爲在戰場上證明自己的人打造領主護手。親手擊倒敵人、贏得戰鬥，或者向鑄甲師交付你所屬文化的領主級材料，大師便會爲你打造護手。
A master armourer has come to {TOWN}. For the next {DAYS} days its armoury stocks and forges as a finer one would.
一位鑄甲大師來到{TOWN}。接下來{DAYS}天裏，這裏的軍械庫將按更高等級備貨和打造裝備。
A master smith of Nogrod, barred from the forges after an apprentice was maimed chasing Telchar's lost craft.
我曾是諾格羅德的鑄造大師，追尋鐵爾哈失傳技藝時，一個學徒傷殘，我也被禁用鍛爐。
A master smith seeking new methods, valuable despite the risks.
尋找新方法的鐵匠大師，雖有風險，卻仍有價值。
A master's craft should not be chained by the guild's caution.
大師的技藝，不該被行會的膽小鎖住。
A merchant who can supply an army is gold itself.
能供養軍隊的商人，本身就像黃金一樣有價值。
A merchant who sees the storm clouds gathering.
一個看見風暴正在聚集的商人。
A merchant's caravan cannot pass until the raiding bands on the road are broken.
只有擊敗商路上的劫掠團伙，一位商人的商隊才能通行。
A messenger from {HERO_NAME} has arrived. Do you wish to speak with them?
{HERO_NAME} 派來的信使已經抵達。你要和他們交談嗎？
A messenger has already been dispatched to this person.
已經派出一名信使去找此人了。
A messenger has been dispatched to {HERO_NAME} and will arrive within {DAYS} days.
信使已被派往 {HERO_NAME} 處，將在 {DAYS} 天內抵達。

A miller from the Shire came to Thorin's Halls to ask how to keep his mill-race from flooding. I drew him a sluice and a pump and thought no more of it. When the guild heard I had given dwarf-craft to a hobbit for nothing, they struck my name from the engineers' rolls. Our crafts are not for outsiders, they said.
一個夏爾的磨坊主來梭林大廳，問我怎麼防止磨坊水渠氾濫。我給他畫了道水閘和一臺水泵，就沒再多想。行會聽說我把矮人技藝白送給霍比特人，就把我從工程師名冊裏劃掉了。他們說，我們的手藝不傳外人。
A mirror-smith from the Golden Wood, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自金色森林的鏡匠，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A mobile archer of the Khand plains who harasses enemy lines with relentless volleys, never standing still long enough to be caught.
可汗德平原上的機動弓手，以連綿不斷的箭雨騷擾敵軍陣線，從不停留到足以被敵人抓住。
A moor-runner from the hills of Dunland, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自黑蠻地丘陵的荒原奔行者，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A mounted guardian who patrols the borders of Lorien, riding swift and silent under the golden eaves.
巡守洛絲羅瑞恩邊境的騎乘守衛，在金色林蔭下迅捷而無聲地行動。
A mounted patrol of the Redwater shore who rides the vineyard ways and the road to Seagate, safeguarding wine caravans from raiders out of the east.
紅水河岸的騎馬巡邏者，巡行於葡萄園道路與通往海門的路上，守護運酒商隊，抵禦東方來襲的劫掠者。
A mounted patrol of the Vales who rides the Old Ford road and the foot of the Misty Mountains, safeguarding farms and caravans from goblin raiders.
河谷的騎馬巡邏者，巡行於老渡口道路與迷霧山脈腳下，守護農場和商隊，抵禦半獸人劫掠者。
A mounted patrol of the northern trade roads who safeguards caravans between Dale and the Lonely Mountain.
北方商道上的騎馬巡衛，負責保護河谷城與孤山之間往來的商隊。
A mounted warrior of Cirdan's household who rides to war on swift elven steeds, a beacon of hope against the shadow.
一位奇爾丹家中的騎馬戰士，騎着迅捷的精靈駿馬奔赴戰場，是對抗陰影的希望之光。
A mounted warrior of Elrond's household who rides to war on swift elven steeds, a beacon of hope against the shadow.
埃爾隆德家族的騎乘戰士，騎着迅捷的精靈戰馬奔赴戰場，是對抗陰影的希望之光。
A mounted warrior of Thranduil's guard who rides great forest elk into battle, crashing through underbrush and foe alike.
瑟蘭杜伊衛隊中的騎乘戰士，騎着巨大的森林麋鹿投入戰鬥，衝破灌木與敵陣。
A mumak handler from the lands of Harad, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自哈拉德諸地的猛獁馭手，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A name cannot contain braces or square brackets.
名稱不能包含花括號或方括號。
A name cannot contain two spaces in a row.
名稱不能包含兩個連續空格。
A name cannot start or end with a space.
名稱不能以空格開頭或結尾。
A name may hold only letters, digits, spaces and punctuation.
名稱只能包含文字、數字、空格和標點。
A name must be 1 to 50 characters long.
名稱長度必須爲1至50個字符。
A navigator from the Haven of Umbar, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自烏姆巴爾港的領航者，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A nest of raiders preys on the roads near {ISSUE_SETTLEMENT}.
一夥劫掠者盤踞在{ISSUE_SETTLEMENT}附近，襲擊道路上的行人。
A new campaign begins with a field camp pitched where the party starts, if the ground allows it; otherwise a message says why and the game goes on as usual. Off by default.
新戰役開始時，如果地形允許，就在部隊起點搭建一處野外營地；否則會提示不能紮營的原因，遊戲照常進行。默認：關閉。
A new region answers the call every 30 seconds. Pay to call one by name.
每30秒會有一個新地區響應召集，也可花錢指定地區。
A night-raider from the hills of Dunland, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自黑蠻地丘陵的夜襲者，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A night-walker from the Golden Wood, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自金色森林的夜行者，正在尋找目標和冒險。

A noble Elf-lord of Lothlórien, born beneath the golden boughs of the mallorn trees. Wise beyond his years, he served as a warden of the Golden Wood and counselor to Lady Galadriel. His keen mind and steadfast heart earned him renown among the Galadhrim. Though he seldom drew his blade, his presence alone inspired calm and courage. Caurmínas was said to walk often beneath moonlit leaves, speaking softly to the trees of ancient days. When the Shadow rose once more, he stood unbroken, a guardian of light and memory, ever faithful to the spirit of Lothlórien.
考爾米納斯是洛絲羅瑞恩一位高貴的精靈領主，生於金色的瑁瓏樹枝下。他年紀不大卻極有智慧，曾擔任金色森林的守衛，也爲加拉德瑞爾夫人出謀劃策。他敏銳的頭腦和堅定的心使他在加拉茲民中贏得名聲。雖然他很少拔劍，但只要他在場，就足以讓衆人鎮定並鼓起勇氣。據說考爾米納斯常在月光下的樹葉間漫步，低聲向樹木講述古老歲月。當陰影再度升起時，他仍不屈服，作爲光明與記憶的守護者，始終忠於洛絲羅瑞恩的精神。
A noble cause. The realm needs protectors in the shadows.
高貴的事業。這個國度需要在陰影中守望的人。
A noblewoman wishes to see her favour carried to victory in the lists.
一位女貴族希望有人佩戴她的信物，在比武場上獲勝。
A notable was cheated of his property by swindlers and wants them taught a hard lesson.
一位當地的顯要人物被騙子騙走了財產，希望有人狠狠教訓他們。
A notable's daughter has been seized by a gang and her family wants her freed.
一位當地顯要人物的女兒被幫派綁走，家人希望有人將她救回。
A oasis healer from the lands of Harad, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自哈拉德諸地的綠洲醫者，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A pack of cheats and sharps took my property with loaded dice and false papers. Break them for me and I may yet hold up my head in this town.
一幫騙子和老千用做過手腳的骰子和假文書騙走了我的財產。替我收拾他們，我或許還能在鎮上抬起頭來做人。
A pack-trader from the hills of Dunland, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自黑蠻地丘陵的馱貨商，正在尋找目標和冒險。

A pale rider from the south paid in silver for my numbers: how many Bolg's sons had left, where the holds stood thin. I sold him all of it. Then a rival read my strings, found the gaps, and counted me among the dead.
一個南邊來的蒼白騎手，拿白銀買我記下的數字：波爾格的兒子走了多少，哪些堡壘兵力空虛。我全賣給他了。後來，一個對頭看懂了我的骨串，發現數目對不上，就把我也算進死人裏。
A partner I trusted sold the whole convoy to Easterling buyers while I slept, and I was left in the dust with the ledgers and an empty purse. The cargo I did not mourn, but the silver I did.
一個我信任的合夥人，趁我睡着，把整支車隊賣給了東夷買家。我被扔在塵土裏，只剩賬本和空錢袋。貨沒了我不難過，銀子沒了才難過。
A path through roots and rock that only the Elves can follow. In a siege, parties slip into or out of this fief with fewer losses.
穿過樹根與岩石、只有精靈認得的道路。圍城時，部隊經此潛入或撤出封地，損失更少。
A pathfinder from Imladris, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自幽谷的尋路者，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A pathfinder from the Woodland Realm, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自林地王國的尋路者，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A pathfinder who sold his own House's routes is a risk.
把自己家族路線賣出去的探路者，是個風險。

A patient stalker who dresses in wolf-pelts and moves through the Misty Mountain foothills like a ghost, marking prey from concealment before unleashing a precisely aimed shaft that the victim never hears coming.
身披狼皮的耐心獵手，像幽影一樣穿行於迷霧山脈山麓。他會先在隱蔽處鎖定獵物，再射出一支精準的箭，讓目標連破空聲都聽不到。
A peerless marksman of Imladris whose arrows fly true across vast distances, guided by centuries of practice.
伊姆拉綴斯無與倫比的射手，憑藉數百年的練習，即使相隔很遠也能讓箭矢準確命中。
A peerless marksman of Mithlond whose arrows fly true across vast distances, guided by centuries of practice.
一位來自米斯瀧德的無雙神射手，經過數百年的練習，即使相隔遙遠，也能讓箭矢準確命中目標。
A petty lordling stirs the peasants against their betters and gathers armed men. Break his strength before the revolt spreads.
一個小領主煽動農民反抗貴族，還召集了一批武裝人員。趁叛亂還沒蔓延，把他的勢力打垮。

A physician who knows which lord was poisoned, and by whom, holds secrets no House can leave wandering. When my patron died of a sickness I could not prove was natural, his heir wanted no man alive who might have guessed the truth. I was given a purse and a night to be gone.
一個醫師若知道哪位領主中了毒、又是誰下的毒，就握着任何家族都不敢讓他到處走的祕密。我的庇護者死於一場我無法證明是自然發生的疾病之後，他的繼承人不想讓任何可能猜到真相的人活着。我得到一個錢袋和一夜時間，必須離開。
A pit-boss from Dol Guldur, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自多古爾都的坑穴頭目，正在尋找目標和機會。
A pleasure doing business. Mind the road, and mind the sea if you are fool enough to sail it.
這買賣做得痛快。走陸路小心點，要是蠢到跑去航海，就更得當心。
A poison-mixer from Dol Guldur, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自多古爾都的調毒師，正在尋找目標和機會。
A precision duelist from the warrior-courts of Rên who dispatches enemies with calculated, lethal blade work.
來自魯恩戰士宮廷的精準決鬥者，以冷靜判斷和致命劍技迅速解決敵人。
A prince wandering as a common archer? How humble.
一位王子像普通弓手一樣四處漂泊？倒是謙遜。

A private letter from Cirdan's household had gone missing in circumstances that pointed to a guest's pack. You recovered it before anyone knew it was gone, replaced what had been disturbed, and returned the letter without a word spoken about any of it.
奇爾丹家中的一封私信不見了，種種跡象都指向一位客人的行囊。你趁其他人還沒察覺，把信取了回來，將翻動過的東西放回原處，再悄悄歸還了信，始終沒有聲張。

A private letter from Elrond's household had gone missing in circumstances that pointed to a guest's pack. You recovered it before anyone knew it was gone, replaced what had been disturbed, and returned the letter without a word spoken about any of it.
埃爾隆德家中的一封私信失蹤，跡象指向一名客人的行囊。你在無人知道它丟失前取回信件，把被動過的東西復原，並默默交還了信。
A prize merchant from the Haven of Umbar, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自烏姆巴爾港的戰利品商人，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A prophet without honor in his own mountain.
在自己山中不受尊重的預警者。
A proven champion's nerve holds when others fail.
久經證明的冠軍，在別人撐不住時也能穩住。
A pure predator, unfettered by rules.
一個純粹的掠食者，不受規則束縛。

A raid by the goblins of Blue Craig burned the hall one winter night. The lord died on the stair and I carried his steward's children out. The survivors of the village, nearly forty, followed me to Fornost, where the king's stewards found them a corner of a warehouse and little else.
一個冬夜，藍巖的半獸人來襲，燒了廳堂。領主死在樓梯上，我把他總管的孩子們背了出來。村裏將近四十個倖存者跟我到了佛諾斯特，國王的總管們給他們在倉庫裏騰了個角落，除此之外也沒幫上多少。
A raid you lead costs relation with the owner's clan leader and with every notable of the village, in proportion to the damage the raid did. A raid that did none costs nothing. Default: on.
你親自率領的劫掠會降低與村莊所有者家族領袖，以及村內每位要人的關係，損失按劫掠造成的破壞程度計算。沒有造成破壞的劫掠不損失關係。默認：開啓。
A raider cast out by his own blood, but a useful one.
一個被自己血親驅逐的劫掠者，但仍然有用。
A ranger's vigilance is always needed.
遊俠的警惕總是必要的。
A ranger? You seem more than a simple woodsman.
遊俠？你看起來可不只是個普通的林中人。
A refuge already stands here - manage it instead.
這裏已有一座避難所，請直接管理它。
A refuge stands here - dismantle it to pitch a normal camp.
這裏已有一座避難所，拆除後才能搭建普通營地。
A region dominated by savage Orc tribes from the eastern mountains. Fierce raiders who terrorize the borderlands between Khand and Harad.
這是由東方山脈殘暴奧克部族控制的地區。兇悍劫掠者讓可汗德和哈拉德之間的邊境地帶不得安寧。
A rider from Imladris, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自幽谷的騎手，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A rider of the Mark in a rider's armour, with spear, shield and sword, and a horse to carry you into the fight.
一名穿着騎兵盔甲的馬克騎手，配有長矛、盾和劍，還有一匹載你投入戰鬥的馬。
A rider who gives away other men's grain is a poor courier.
拿別人的糧食送人，你這信使可不稱職。
A rider who knows the land is worth ten who only know the charge.
一個懂這片土地的騎手，頂得上十個只會衝鋒的。
A rider who values life over orders has true courage.
把生命看得比命令更重的騎手，纔有真正的勇氣。
A rider with no mount is a thrall in the holds. I will not carry packs. I will take another wolf, or a horse, from a Woodman's stable, and keep what I take.
沒了坐騎，騎手在堡裏就成了奴隸。我可不背行李。我會再弄頭狼，或者去林中居民的馬廄搶匹馬，搶到手的就歸我。
A ring of smugglers floods the market with goods that paid no toll, and honest traders are ruined for it. Break their run and trade will right itself.
一夥走私販把沒交過稅的貨物大量倒進市場，正經商人都快被逼破產了。斷掉他們的運貨路線，生意自然就能恢復正常。

A rival clan paid more than the chiefs. Gold-weight of dwarf silver. I sold them the count of the eagles' watch hours, and they struck at dawn and lost half their host to the birds. They knew where it came from. The Great Goblin has my name on his tally-stick.
敵對氏族給得比酋長多得多，是沉甸甸的矮人白銀。我把大鷹值守的時辰賣給他們，他們天一亮就動手，半數軍隊被那些鳥殺了。消息從哪兒來，他們心裏清楚。半獸人王已經把我的名字刻上記賬木籌了。

A rival discovered my side business selling Isengard weapons to Dunlending tribes. Before he could report me, I arranged an 'accident' in the foundry. Unfortunately, his friends grew suspicious. The investigation was closing in, so I took a shipment of valuable weapons and vanished into the wild.
一個對手發現了我的副業：把艾森加德武器賣給黑蠻地部落。趁他還沒舉報，我在鑄造廠安排了一場“意外”。可惜，他的朋友開始懷疑。調查越逼越近，我就帶上一批值錢武器，消失進荒野。

A rival from Esgaroth shot as well as I did, so the night before the final I cut his string a third of the way through. He drew at the line and it snapped across his cheek. They found the cut ends in my pack.
一個埃斯加洛斯來的對手，射得跟我一樣好。所以決賽前夜，我把他的弓弦割斷了三分之一。他在射箭線上一拉弓，弦就崩斷，抽過他的臉。他們在我包裏找到了割下的弦頭。

A rival from Gladden Hold shot as well as I did, so the night before the final I cut his string a third of the way through. He drew at the line and it snapped across his cheek. They found the cut ends in my pack.
一個金鳶尾堡來的對手，射得跟我一樣好。所以決賽前夜，我把他的弓弦割開了三分之一。他在射箭線上一拉弓，弦就崩斷，抽過他的臉。他們在我包裏找到了割下的弦頭。

A rival from Ironwood Hall shot as well as I did, so the night before the final I cut his string a third of the way through. He drew at the line and it snapped across his cheek. They found the cut ends in my pack.
一個鐵木廳來的對手，射得跟我一樣好。所以決賽前夜，我把他的弓弦割斷了三分之一。他在射箭線上一拉弓，弦就崩斷，抽過他的臉。他們在我包裏找到了割下的弦頭。

A rival from Seagate shot as well as I did, so the night before the final I cut his string a third of the way through. He drew at the line and it snapped across his cheek. They found the cut ends in my pack.
一個海門來的對手，射得跟我一樣好。所以決賽前夜，我把他的弓弦割斷了三分之一。他在射箭線上一拉弓，弦就崩斷，抽過他的臉。他們在我包裏找到了割下的弦頭。
A rival gang is muscling in on a crime boss's turf and must be put down.
一個敵對幫派正在搶佔幫派頭目的地盤，需要有人將他們擊敗。
A rival outfit sits on a fine cache of arms, and my lads fight with rusted knives. Break them and the cache is ours -- and a share is yours.
對頭藏着一批好武器，我的手下卻只能拿生鏽的刀打架。打敗他們，武器就是我們的了，你也能分到一份。

A rival quartermaster grew suspicious of my side ventures. Before he could investigate thoroughly, I arranged for certain records to be destroyed in a warehouse fire. Convenient, but too convenient. Questions were asked. I took what I could carry and disappeared into the wastes.
一個競爭對手軍需官開始懷疑我的副業。趁他還沒查清，我安排人在倉庫裏放了一把火，燒掉了幾份記錄。很方便，但也太方便了。問題隨之而來。我帶上能拿走的東西，消失在荒原裏。
A river trader from the Woodland Realm, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自林地王國的河商，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A round for everyone in the house, on me ({PRICE}{GOLD_ICON}).
在場的每個人都來一輪，我請客（{PRICE}{GOLD_ICON}）。

A routing enemy soldier who has just been hit, with a few of your men right beside him and enough health left, turns and fights instead of running on, and routers close to him turn with him (a few at most). They keep fighting only while one of your men is still near them and some of their side still stand; once the whole side has broken they run again, so the battle still ends in a rout. Soldiers of cultures that never rout, and soldiers ordered to retreat, are not touched. Field battles, sieges and sally-outs. Default: on.
正在潰逃的敵兵如果剛被擊中，身旁有少量你的士兵，且剩餘生命足夠，就會轉身戰鬥，不再繼續逃跑；附近最多幾名潰兵也會跟着反擊。只有附近仍有你的士兵，且其陣營還有人堅守時，他們纔會繼續作戰；全軍潰敗後，他們會再次逃跑，因此戰鬥仍能以潰敗結束。不會影響所屬文化本就不會潰逃的士兵，也不影響奉命撤退的士兵。適用於野戰、攻城和突圍出擊。默認：開啓。
A routing soldier turns to fight only while this many of your men or fewer are within a few steps of him. Default: 3.
潰兵身邊數步之內，你的士兵人數不超過此值時，纔會轉身反擊。默認：3。
A ruined trade-master of the House of Tîrdahanâ, rebuilding by provisioning other men's wars.
提爾達哈納家族破產的貿易主管，靠供給別人的戰爭來重建自己。
A sand scholar from the lands of Harad, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自哈拉德諸地的沙漠學者，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A scimitar master from the lands of Harad, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自哈拉德諸地的彎刀大師，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A scout of Ironcrag who shot a goblin chieftain at a parley. Cast out, but still the best eyes in the fells.
我原是鐵崖斥候，談判時射殺了半獸人酋長。雖然被逐出來，山地裏眼力最好的還是我。
A scout should be paid in full.
A scout who never loses his way is worth an army's eyes.
永遠不會迷路的斥候，抵得上一支軍隊的眼睛。
A scout who sees too much becomes dangerous to the wrong people.
看見太多的斥候，會讓不該被看見的人感到危險。
A scythe-chariot commander of Khand whose brutal shock charges shatter formations and scatter survivors to the winds.
可汗德的鐮刃戰車指揮官，殘酷的衝擊能撕碎陣型，把倖存者衝得四散奔逃。
A sea scout from the Haven of Umbar, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自烏姆巴爾港的海上斥候，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A seasoned fleet commander who leads from the prow, inspiring crews with promises of plunder and glory on the high seas.
經驗老到的艦隊指揮官，站在船首發號施令，以戰利品和海上榮耀鼓舞船員。
A selected company already has twelve orders waiting. The order was not given.
選中的編隊中已有一隊積壓了十二項命令，本次命令未下達。
A sensible answer, for a stranger. Gold speaks every tongue. Show us what you carry, and count it honestly.[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
外鄉人能這麼回答，還算明白事理。金幣說的話，誰都聽得懂。讓我們看看你帶了什麼，老老實實數清楚。[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
A shadow blade from the lands of Harad, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自哈拉德諸地的暗影之刃，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A shadow-scout from Dol Guldur, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自多古爾都的暗影斥候，正在尋找目標和機會。
A shadow-stalker from the Woodland Realm, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自林地王國的暗影潛獵者，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A shadow-walker from Imladris, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自幽谷的暗影行者，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A shadow-worker who serves the light is valuable indeed.
爲光明效力的暗處人手，確實有價值。
A sharp steward keeps an army fed and paid. Useful.
精明的管事能讓軍隊喫飽拿到軍餉。有用。
A sharp-eye from the Woodland Realm, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自林地王國的銳眼射手，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A sharpshooter of the Corsair fleet who picks off helmsmen and officers from the rigging with deadly accuracy.
烏姆巴爾海盜艦隊中的神射手，能從桅索間精準射殺舵手和軍官。

A shield bash or a kick can floor a man. The chance grows with the attacker's Athletics lead over the victim; the victim's race and any race ability that toughens him cut it, a kick is weaker than a bash, and you resist more than a soldier does. Fighters who shrug off blows never fall: trolls while Creature Stagger Immunity is on, a soldier with a live race ability that shrugs off blows, and a hero with a career shrug-off passive. The numbers live in combat_mechanics_config.json.
盾擊或踢擊可以將人擊倒。攻擊者的跑動技能高出目標越多，擊倒概率越大；目標的種族以及增強抗擊打能力的種族技能會降低概率。踢擊比盾擊弱，玩家的抵抗力也高於普通士兵。免疫硬直的戰士不會倒地，包括開啓巨獸硬直免疫時的食人妖、擁有已生效硬直免疫種族技能的士兵，以及擁有對應職業被動的英雄。數值設在combat_mechanics_config.json中。
A ship surgeon from the Haven of Umbar, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自烏姆巴爾港的船醫，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A short purse tempts many officers; the ones who stop are rarer.
不少軍官都受不住缺錢的誘惑，知道收手的卻少。
A shot is a shot. The sea is not choosy.
箭射出去就是箭，大海可不挑人。
A shouting match is drawing a crowd before it turns into something worse.
一場爭吵引來了圍觀，再不制止就要鬧大了。
A siege needs every soldier. Take your place in the assault.
攻城需要每一個士兵，去參加進攻吧。
A siege-master turns months of war into days.
攻城大師能把幾個月的戰爭縮成幾天。
A silent guardian of the Golden Wood who strikes without warning, defending the borders of Lothlorien with ancient resolve.
金色森林沉默的守護者，出手毫無預兆，以古老的決心保衛洛絲羅瑞恩的邊界。
A silk trader from the eastern steppes, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自東方草原的絲綢商人，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A silver healer from the Golden Wood, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自金色森林的銀醫者，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A skilled physician is worth a company of spears.
一個有本事的醫師，抵得上一整隊長矛兵。
A skull-crusher from Dol Guldur, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自多古爾都的碎顱者，正在尋找目標和機會。
A small gate in the curtain wall, kept shut and known to few. In a siege, parties slip into or out of this fief with fewer losses.
幕牆上的一座小門，平時緊閉，只有少數人知道。圍城時，部隊經此潛入或撤出封地，損失更少。

A smiling man from the south offered me gold for the road: where the patrols walked, when the caravans passed. I sold it to him. Then I sold the same road to the Woodmen, for the other half of the gold. Both found out.
南邊來了個滿臉笑的人，拿黃金買道路消息：巡邏隊走哪裏，商隊什麼時候過。我賣給了他，又把同一條路的消息賣給林中居民，賺另一份金子。結果兩邊都知道了。
A smith like you is hard to replace.
你這樣的鐵匠，很難再找一個。
A smith wandering far from the forge? What brings you here?
一個遠離熔爐四處漂泊的鐵匠？你爲何來到這裏？
A smith who forges worlds? That's a rare gift.
能鍛造世界的鐵匠？這可是罕見的天賦。
A smuggler is only a merchant without a council.
走私販，不過是背後沒議會撐腰的商人。

A smuggler survives by selling to all sides and trusting none, and eventually all sides notice. When two clans I had played against each other compared their grievances, the steppe grew too small for me. I took the routes in my head and left the rest behind.
走私者靠把東西賣給各方、同時誰也不信來活命，而各方遲早會注意到這一點。當兩個被我挑動互斗的氏族開始對照彼此的怨賬時，草原對我來說就太小了。我帶走了腦子裏的路線，把其餘一切都丟在身後。
A smuggling ring is undercutting honest trade and a merchant wants it broken.
一個走私團伙正靠低價貨衝擊正經商人的生意，一位商人希望有人剷除他們。

A soldier whose ability is active wears a coloured outline: red for fury, steel blue for a guard, violet for dread; the speed and aim abilities stay unlit. Sparks burst on the soldier who fires and on a few of the kin who join him. Only the soldiers nearest the camera are outlined (visuals.maxGlowing in race_abilities.json). Drawn on this client only, and hidden while Hide Battle UI is on.
能力生效的士兵會出現彩色輪廓：憤怒爲紅色，守護爲鋼藍色，恐懼爲紫色；速度和瞄準能力不發光。觸發者和部分響應者會迸出火花。僅鏡頭附近的士兵顯示輪廓，數量由 race_abilities.json 的 visuals.maxGlowing 控制。只在本客戶端顯示，開啓“隱藏戰鬥界面”時隱藏。
A spice merchant from the lands of Harad, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自哈拉德諸地的香料商人，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A spiteful goblin marksman who lurks in the mountain crags, picking off targets with poisoned darts and crude bows.
惡毒的半獸人射手，潛伏在山崖間，用毒鏢和粗劣短弓獵殺目標。
A spy selling to all sides, trustworthy as a snake.
把消息賣給各方的間諜，像毒蛇一樣不可信。
A spy who betrayed his own lords will betray me as readily.
一個出賣過自己領主的間諜，也會同樣輕易出賣我。
A squad needs a steady hand to drill and ready them for the line.
一支小隊需要沉穩可靠的人來操練，讓他們做好上陣的準備。
A stalwart guardian of Vinewatch who holds the vineyard roads and the walls above the Redwater against raiders and bandits with shield and spear.
葡萄哨站的堅定守護者，手持盾矛守衛葡萄園道路與紅水河上方的城牆，抵禦劫掠者和匪徒。
A stalwart guardian of the Forest Gate who holds the narrow way under the trees against orc, wolf and spider with shield and spear.
森林之門的堅定守護者，手持盾矛守住林間狹道，抵擋奧克、狼羣與蜘蛛。
A stalwart protector of the rebuilt city of Dale who holds the gate against all comers with shield and spear.
重建後的河谷城堅定守衛，手持盾矛守住城門，抵擋一切來犯之敵。
A steppe bonesetter of clan Zayaknûri, who left rather than slay the helpless.
扎亞克努里氏族的草原接骨師，寧願離開也不願屠殺無助者。
A steppe scout from the eastern steppes, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自東方草原的草原斥候，正在尋找目標和冒險。

A steward who serves too well learns where his masters cheat the Châjaphân's levy, and a steward who knows too much is dangerous when the House falls from favor. When a rival dynasty whispered against us at court, I was the first they cut loose, to prove the House had nothing to hide.
一個管事若做得太好，就會知道主人在哪裏瞞報查賈凡的徵賦；而當家族失寵時，知道太多的管事就很危險。一個敵對王朝在宮廷裏散佈對我們的流言時，我第一個被切割出去，用來證明家族沒有任何事需要隱瞞。
A storm archer from the eastern steppes, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自東方草原的風暴弓手，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A stout gate low in the wall, where a company can march out under the eyes of the watch. In a siege, parties slip into or out of this fief with fewer losses.
城牆低處的一座堅固大門，足以讓一隊士兵在守衛注視下出城。圍城時，部隊經此潛入或撤出封地，損失更少。
A strategic mind and a warrior's heart. Impressive.
既有戰略頭腦，也有戰士之心。令人佩服。
A strong axe line, from the Beorning Youth to the Bear-warden
從貝奧恩青年到熊衛，都能組成堅實的斧兵陣線

A superior officer took credit for my victories while assigning me blame for his failures. I confronted him privately, made my position clear. He responded with fabricated charges of cowardice and insubordination. Rather than participate in a rigged tribunal, I demonstrated neither cowardice nor subordination, I left with my best warriors.
一名上級軍官把我的戰功據爲己有，卻把失敗推到我頭上。我私下找他對質，表明了立場。他則用捏造的怯懦和違抗軍令罪名回應。我沒有參加那場早就安排好的審判，而是帶着最好的戰士離開了，證明我既不怯懦，也不會吞下他們的冤罪。
A supply caravan has set out for your party.
一支補給商隊已啓程前往你的部隊。
A supply caravan passes on toward its lord.
一支補給商隊繼續前往領主所在處。
一支補給商隊被消滅了！
A swan-rider from the Golden Wood, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自金色森林的天鵝騎手，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A sword and a shield. Stand in the line and take the blows.
一把劍，一面盾。站進陣線，擋下攻擊。
A tactical withdrawal can be wise.
一次戰術撤退或許是有其道理的。
A temple clerk is little use in a hard fight.
神廟書記在硬仗裏沒什麼用。
A temple scribe of the House of Azadafrozan, exiled for giving away one truth too freely.
阿扎達弗羅贊家族的神廟書記，因太輕易交出一個真相而被流放。
A thief can learn what hunger costs, same as anyone.
賊跟別人一樣，也能明白捱餓是什麼滋味。
A thief is a thief, however freely he gives it away.
賊就是賊，不管他把偷來的東西送得多大方。
A thief who keeps good books is still worth his wage.
一個會做賬的賊，仍然配得上他的薪水。
A thief who robs his own chief. How comforting.
連自家酋長都偷的賊，真讓人放心。
A thin purse tempts many captains; the ones who stop are rarer.
不少隊長都受不住缺錢的誘惑，知道收手的卻少。
A thinking warrior is the most dangerous kind.
會思考的戰士，是最危險的一種。
A throat-cutter from Dol Guldur, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自多古爾都的割喉者，正在尋找目標和機會。
A thunder rider from the eastern steppes, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自東方草原的雷霆騎手，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A towering Olog-Hai war-troll who wades into the thickest fighting as a living battering ram, soaking up tremendous punishment and hammering foes into the ground with devastating overhead blows.
高大的奧洛格族戰爭食人妖，如同活着的攻城槌衝進戰鬥最激烈的地方。他能承受驚人的打擊，再從頭頂猛然砸下重擊，把敵人打倒在地。
A trade, is it? Good. My kin are hungry, and hungry kin are not patient. What are you worth?[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
想談個買賣？行啊。族人都餓着，餓肚子的人可沒什麼耐心。你打算拿多少買命？[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
A trader from Imladris, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自幽谷的商人，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A trader's answer, good. Tell me what you carry, and whether you value your silver or your skin more.[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
這纔像個商人的回答。說說你帶了什麼，還有，你更捨不得錢，還是更捨不得這身皮？[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]

A troll raid broke the hall one winter night and set it ablaze. The lord died on the stair and I carried his reeve's children out. The survivors of the village, nearly forty, followed me to Cameth Brin, where the king's officers found them a corner of a granary and little else.
一個冬夜，食人妖來襲，砸毀廳堂，又放了火。領主死在樓梯上，我把他管事的孩子們背了出來。村裏將近四十個倖存者跟我到了卡梅斯布林，國王的官員們給他們在糧倉裏騰了個角落，除此之外也沒幫上多少。
A truce broken once is never trusted again.
停戰的約定毀過一次，以後就再沒人信了。
A turncoat who'd turn again for the right price.
一個叛徒，只要價錢合適，還會再叛一次。
A two-handed axe. No shield, and a heavy blow.
一把雙手斧，沒有盾牌，出手沉重。
A vast pack rides under your banner. +4 party size.
龐大的狼羣在你的旗幟下奔行。+4 部隊規模。
A veteran seeking purpose beyond guard duty.
一名老兵，在站崗之外尋找目標。
A village passes to another clan only with its town or castle.
村莊只能隨其所屬城鎮或城堡一併轉交其他家族。
A wanderer who sleeps in ditches. What use is that to me?
一個睡在溝裏的流浪漢，能幫得上我什麼？
A war captain from the lands of Harad, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自哈拉德諸地的戰爭隊長，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A war drummer from the eastern steppes, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自東方草原的戰鼓手，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A war-beast handler of the House of Ardâcheran, who left rather than lead his beasts to slaughter.
阿爾達切蘭家族的戰獸馭手，寧願離開也不願帶自己的巨獸去送死。
A war-chief from Dol Guldur, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自多古爾都的戰爭酋長，正在尋找目標和機會。
A war-counselor from Imladris, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自幽谷的戰爭顧問，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A war-host of this size eats greedily — +15% party food consumption.
這種規模的戰羣喫得很貪；部隊食物消耗 +15%。
A war-leader from the hills of Dunland, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自黑蠻地丘陵的戰爭首領，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A warden from the Golden Wood, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自金色森林的守衛，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A warg-rider from Dol Guldur, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自多古爾都的座狼騎手，正在尋找目標和機會。
A warrior in a merchant's age, difficult position.
商人時代裏的戰士，位置確實尷尬。
A warrior of a fighting line, cast out for killing robbers who had surrendered. War is all I know.
我出身代代從軍的家族，因爲殺了投降的強盜，被逐了出來。打仗是我唯一會的事。
A warrior of the Damudûr desert tribes whose attrition-warfare tactics grind enemies down with relentless pressure and poisoned blades.
一位來自達穆杜爾沙漠部族的戰士，擅長消耗戰，用持續的壓迫和淬毒利刃逐漸拖垮敵人。
A warrior of the Jelut desert tribes whose attrition-warfare tactics grind enemies down with relentless pressure and poisoned blades.
傑魯特沙漠部落的戰士，擅長用持續壓迫和塗毒利刃拖垮敵人。
A warrior of the Zajâna desert tribes whose attrition-warfare tactics grind enemies down with relentless pressure and poisoned blades.
一位來自扎賈納沙漠部族的戰士，擅長消耗戰，用持續的壓迫和淬毒利刃逐漸拖垮敵人。
A warrior who fights for honor deserves respect.
爲榮譽而戰的戰士，值得尊重。
A warrior who refuses to be wasted.
一個拒絕被白白浪費的戰士。
A warrior's spirit! We could use such strength.
好一個戰士的氣概！我們正需要這樣的力量。
A watchful eye may save the Mark yet.
一雙警惕的眼睛，也許還能救下馬克。
A watchful eye may save the plains yet.
這份警惕，也許還來得及救下平原。
A watchman who frees thieves has himself to blame.
衛兵放走小偷，怪得了誰。
A weapon seeking a new hand to wield it.
一件正在尋找新主人來揮動的兵器。
A weapon too sharp for its wielder to hold safely.
一把太鋒利的兵器，連握住它的人也會被割傷。
A weaponsmith who fights? Unusual combination.
會戰鬥的武器匠？這組合不常見。

A white gull sat on my shoulder before the last landing and would not leave. The old shaman saw it and spat. A gull on the shoulder, he said, is the sea claiming you. The crew moved their bedrolls away from mine. I talked louder to cover the silence.
最後一次登陸前，一隻白海鷗落在我肩上，不肯走。老薩滿見了就啐，說海鷗落肩，是大海要來收人了。手下把鋪蓋搬得遠遠的，我只好說得更響，填上那片安靜。
A wind healer from the eastern steppes, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自東方草原的風行醫者，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A wiry Snaga cavalry raider who slips behind enemy lines with unnerving silence, striking supply columns and isolated units before vanishing into the smoke of Mordor.
精瘦狡猾的斯那嘎騎兵掠襲者，能悄無聲息地繞到敵軍後方，襲擊補給隊和落單部隊，然後消失在魔多的煙塵中。
A wise answer. Water costs less than blood, and so does passage. Name your price, and make it generous.[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
明智。買水總比流血便宜，買路也一樣。開個價，大方點。[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
A woodland elf who moves unseen through the darkened paths of Mirkwood, dispatching spiders and orcs in silence.
黑森林的林地精靈，能在昏暗林徑中無聲行動，悄然解決蜘蛛和奧克。
A woodward bowman of western Mirkwood who shoots from the platforms of the Forest Gate and the trees of the road, carrying on a tradition of unerring marksmanship.
黑森林西部的護林弓手，從森林之門的平臺和道路旁的樹上射擊，傳承着百發百中的射術。
A woodwright from the Woodland Realm, seeking purpose and adventure.
來自林地王國的木匠，正在尋找目標和冒險。
A would-be trader needs goods brought in to turn a profit and prove the venture sound.
一個想做生意的人需要一批貨物來賺取利潤，證明這門生意行得通。
A young household guardsman of House Vashan, who left rather than serve his master's murderer.
瓦珊家族年輕的家衛，寧願離開也不願侍奉殺害主人的兇手。
A younger son of the Firebeards, passed over for a command. I mean to win a name of my own.
我是火須族的幼子，沒撈到帶兵的職位。我打算憑自己掙個名聲。
AI Lord Party Size Flat Bonus
AI領主部隊人數固定加成

AI dwarves on foot head-butt an enemy right in front of them and drop-kick one a few steps away, each on its own cooldown. The head butt staggers; the drop kick knocks the enemy down unless a shield blocks it. Your own character never does either. Off, no new attack starts. Default: on.
步行的AI矮人會用頭槌攻擊正前方敵人，用飛踢攻擊數步之外的敵人，兩種攻擊各有冷卻。頭槌造成硬直；飛踢會將敵人擊倒，除非被盾牌擋住。你自己的角色絕不會自動使用這兩種攻擊。關閉後，不再發起新的特殊攻擊。默認：開啓。
AI orc/uruk swings can crush through even SHIELD blocks (energy- and skill-gated) — turtling against an orc horde is no longer safe. Never applies to the player's own attacks.
AI半獸人和烏魯克的揮擊，在達到動能和技能要求時，甚至可以擊穿盾牌格擋。面對半獸人羣，一直舉盾不再安全。此效果絕不會應用於玩家自己的攻擊。

AI soldiers fight with a battle ability for their race (or, for men, their culture) on a cooldown, fired when the moment comes and joined by nearby kin: berserkers go berserk when hurt in melee, Uruk-hai fall into bloodlust on a kill, dwarves stand fast against a charge or a crowd, elves quicken, orcs swarm, Rohan's riders spur on, Gondor closes ranks, and more. Your own character never fires one. Switching it on takes effect from the next battle; switching it off stops new abilities at once and lets running ones finish. Numbers live in race_abilities.json; the console command taom.print_race_abilities shows what each ability has done in the battle on screen.

AI 士兵會在合適時機使用各自種族（人類則按文化）的戰鬥能力，具有冷卻時間，附近同族也會一起響應：狂戰士近戰受傷後進入狂暴，烏魯克擊殺後進入嗜血，矮人面對沖鋒或圍攻時堅守，精靈加速，奧克蜂擁進攻，洛汗騎手催馬，剛鐸士兵收緊陣線等。玩家角色不會自行觸發。開啓後從下次戰鬥生效；關閉後立即停止觸發新能力，正在持續的能力會正常結束。參數位於 race_abilities.json；控制台命令 taom.print_race_abilities 可顯示當前戰鬥各項能力的效果。
Abagai is heir to the Arkit holdings.
阿巴蓋是阿爾基特領地的繼承人。
Abandoning your king seems like treachery.
拋下你的國王，聽起來像叛國。
Abrazîn was named for the old Numenorean virtue of steadfastness. In Mordor the word has come to mean something much closer to obedience.
阿布拉辛的名字源於努門諾爾古老的美德：堅定不移。可在魔多，這個詞已經變得更接近“服從”。
未參加攻城的功績係數
Absolute pragmatism, admirable or horrifying, depending on perspective.
徹底的務實，究竟值得佩服還是令人膽寒，就看你站在哪邊。
Achiq of House Vazevian rides at the head of the clan's lancers, a hard-handed kinsman whose banner is feared across the plains of Rhûn.
瓦澤維安家族的阿赤克率領着家族的槍騎兵。他手段強硬，魯恩平原上的人都畏懼他的旗幟。
Activates your career ability during a battle once its energy bar is full. Defaults to V.
戰鬥中，能量條充滿後可用此鍵發動職業技能。默認按鍵爲 V。
Adaltrud was wed to Gríma Grimmóding before his counsel turned to Saruman. She keeps a hall at Edoras that the riders no longer visit.
在格里馬·格里姆莫丁轉而爲薩茹曼效力之前，阿達爾特魯德就已經嫁給了他。她在埃多拉斯照管着一座廳堂，可騎手們再也不來拜訪了。
Adarkidai of House Adekig rides at the head of the clan's lancers, a hard-handed kinsman whose banner is feared across the plains of Rhûn.
阿德基格家族的阿達爾基臺率領着家族的槍騎兵。他手段強硬，魯恩平原上的人都畏懼他的旗幟。
Add up to 10,000 gold to the reserve.
Addas is a Haradrim warrior prince.
阿達斯是哈拉德人的戰士王子。

Added to an AI lord's party size limit AFTER the multiplier, so it is worth exactly this many men. Exists because template spawn size does not scale with clan tier: under a multiplier alone, low-tier lords still shed. Default: 0. Saved values from before November 2026 were reset to this default; if you had chosen your own, set it again.
在倍率計算後，直接加到AI領主部隊人數上限上的固定人數。設置此項是因爲初始部隊模板的人數不會隨家族等級變化；只提高倍率，低等級家族的領主仍會遣散超編士兵。默認：0。2026年11月以前保存的數值已重置爲此默認值；若你曾自行調整，請重新設置。

Adds "I have a gift for you." to the talk with the companions in your party and, on the diplomacy branch, with lords who are not children, not prisoners, not in your own clan and not at war with you. Goods the catalog lists, from your inventory, win relation; companions also take gold purses. A co-op client, or a peer running a co-op mod TAOM cannot probe, sees no gift line. Default: on.
與部隊中的同伴交談時，增加“我有份禮物送給你。”；與不是兒童、沒有被俘、不屬於你自己家族且未與你交戰的領主交談時，也會在外交分支中增加此選項。贈送物品欄中列入禮品目錄的貨物可以增加關係，同伴還接受錢袋。合作聯機客戶端玩家，或運行了TAOM無法識別的合作聯機MOD的玩家，不會看到贈禮選項。默認：開啓。

Adds a Make Tools button to the Refine tab of the smithing screen: one Iron and one Hardwood make one Tools, for smithy stamina and a little Smithing experience. Not shown in a co-op session. Default: on.
在鍛造界面的精煉頁增加“製作工具”按鈕：一份鐵和一份硬木製作一份工具，消耗鍛造耐力，並獲得少量鍛造經驗。合作聯機中不顯示。默認：開啓。

Adds a button beside the reserve's plus button to put gold into the reserve in one click, and one to take a step back out, refunded in full with no penalty. Single-player only. Applies the next time the window opens. Default: on.
在儲備金的加號旁增加一個按鈕，一次存入一筆資金；另加一個按鈕，一次取回一筆資金，全額退還且沒有懲罰。僅限單人模式。下次打開窗口時生效。默認：開啓。

Adds a panel to the character creation face generator listing the existing lords of your chosen culture. Pick one and you play the campaign as that lord, with their face, gear, skills, clan, fiefs and kingdom. The character you build is set aside. Off means the panel never loads and character creation is untouched. When the Themed Faction & Hero Picker (Menus & Loading Screens) is shown, it takes this panel's place for that character creation, and a lord picked there is taken over through this feature, so with this off that picker copies the lord's look, gear and skills onto your own character instead.
在角色創建的捏臉界面增加所選文化現有領主列表。選擇後，你會以該領主開始戰役，繼承其外貌、裝備、技能、家族、領地和王國，自己創建的角色會被擱置。關閉後不加載此面板，不改變角色創建。顯示“主題勢力與英雄選擇器”（菜單與加載畫面）時，它會替代此次創建中的面板，並通過本功能接管所選領主。因此關閉本功能後，選擇器只把領主的外貌、裝備和技能複製給你自己的角色。

Adds an option to a town's arena menu: for a small fee the arena master names the nearest towns holding a tournament now that are not at war with your realm. It marks nothing on the map. When off, the option is hidden. Single-player only. Default: on.
在城鎮競技場菜單中增加一項選擇：支付少量費用，請競技場老闆告知最近有哪些城鎮正在舉辦競技大會，且這些城鎮不與你的國家交戰。不會在地圖上添加標記。關閉後隱藏此選項。僅限單人模式。默認：開啓。
Advance in a wall; square up against horse
以盾牆推進；遇到騎兵時組成方陣

Advanced: how the borders mix with the map beneath. 'Material default' keeps the engine material's own. If the borders glow and their dark ink line is missing, try Modulate (Factor turns blending off).
高級選項：國境線如何與下方地圖混合。“材質默認”保留引擎材質原有設置。如果國境發光且沒有深色墨線，請嘗試“調製”；“因子”會關閉混合。

Advanced: the engine material the borders are drawn from. 'Automatic' tries vertex_color_blend_after_postfx_mat first, which blends normally so the dark ink line shows, then the others in list order. Every choice draws over the parchment map.
高級選項：用於繪製國境的引擎材質。“自動”先嚐試 vertex_color_blend_after_postfx_mat，其正常混合能顯示深色墨線，之後依次嘗試列表中的其他項。所有選項都會繪製在羊皮紙地圖上方。
Aeglossen is counted among the surest bows of the Galadhrim; it is said no shaft of his has ever been found far from a foe.
埃格洛森是加拉茲民中箭術最準的射手之一。據說，他射出的箭從未落在離敵人很遠的地方。
Aeloria is wife to the chieftain, and skilled in the healing arts and herb lore.
艾洛莉婭是酋長的妻子，精通醫術和草藥知識。
Aelwyn Hawkeye commands a company of hill scouts who patrol the borders.
“鷹眼”艾爾溫指揮着一支巡守邊境的山地斥候隊。
Aeron leads warriors of the central steppes.
艾倫率領中部草原的戰士。
After a battle your side wins against an enemy lord, you may rarely find his household's lord harness among the spoils. Needs Armour Acquisition on.
我方戰勝敵方領主後，有小概率在戰利品中發現其家族的領主鎧甲。需要開啓“鎧甲獲取”。

After a battle, the House lord ordered the captured enemy spears put to death rather than ransomed, a waste, and beneath a soldier. I held that a beaten foe who yields is owed his life, and I said so to the lord's face before my men. Discipline, it seems, is only prized when it does not question.
一場戰鬥之後，家族領主下令處死被俘的敵方長矛兵，而不是拿去贖回。這是浪費，也配不上一個士兵。我認爲已經戰敗並投降的敵人應當保住性命，於是當着部下的面，對領主本人說了出來。看來紀律只有在不提出質疑時，纔會被人珍視。

After a brush with some Angmar scouts I sent word to the king that I had routed a host. I had routed four orcs and a goat, but the dispatch was well written. The king granted me land on the strength of it, until a ranger passed through and asked where the bodies were.
跟幾個安格瑪斥候交過手後，我給國王寫信，說自己擊潰了一支大軍。其實我趕跑的只有四個奧克和一隻山羊，不過戰報寫得漂亮。國王看了便賜我土地，直到一個遊民路過，問屍首都在哪兒。

After a brush with some goblin scouts I sent word to the king that I had routed a host. I had routed four goblins and a lame mule, but the dispatch was well written. The king granted me a hill farm on the strength of it, until a ranger passed through and asked where the bodies were.
跟幾個半獸人斥候交過手後，我給國王寫信，說自己擊潰了一支大軍。其實我趕跑的只有四個半獸人和一頭瘸騾，不過戰報寫得漂亮。國王看了便賜我一處山中農莊，直到一個遊民路過，問屍首都在哪兒。

After a brush with some goblin scouts I wrote to the king that I had routed a host. I had routed four goblins and a donkey, but the letter was well written. The king granted me a manor on the strength of it, until a rider passed through and asked where the bodies were.
跟幾個半獸人斥候交過手後，我寫信給國王，說自己擊潰了一支大軍。其實我趕跑的只有四個半獸人和一頭驢，不過信寫得漂亮。國王看了便賜我莊園，直到一個騎士路過，問屍首都在哪兒。

After a fight at the river ford, thirty wounded came in at once and we had herbs for ten. I treated those who could fight again and let the rest go as gently as I could manage. She called it murder and said she would not train a hand that chose.
渡口一場戰鬥後，一下送來三十個傷員，我們的草藥只夠十個人用。我救治了還能再上戰場的人，儘量讓其餘人走得輕鬆些。她說那是謀殺，說她絕不會教一個挑着救人的徒弟。

After a gift, the same hero takes no other for this many days, so goods cannot be turned straight into relation. Whenever Personal Relations is not engaged (switched off, a co-op host, or a save not yet seeded) a clan shares one relation, so the days count for the whole clan. The count is saved with the campaign. Default: 7.
贈禮後，同一英雄在此天數內不再收禮，避免直接用貨物反覆兌換關係。個人關係未生效時，例如關閉功能、作爲合作聯機主機玩家，或存檔尚未完成關係初始化，家族共享同一關係值，因此冷卻時間也由整個家族共享。計時隨戰役保存。默認：7。

After a skirmish on the lake shore, thirty wounded came at once and we had herbs for ten. I treated the ones who could fight again and let the rest die as easily as I could manage. She called it murder and said she would not train a hand that chose.
湖岸一場遭遇戰後，一下送來三十個傷員，我們的草藥只夠十個人用。我救治了還能再上戰場的人，儘量讓其餘人死得輕鬆些。她說那是謀殺，說她絕不會教一個挑着救人的徒弟。

After a skirmish where the two rivers meet, thirty wounded came in at once and we had herbs for ten. I tended the ones who could fight again and let the rest slip away as easily as I could manage. She called it murder and said she would not train a hand that chose.
兩河交匯處一場遭遇戰後，一下送來三十個傷員，我們的草藥只夠十個人用。我照料了還能再上戰場的人，儘量讓其餘人走得輕鬆些。她說那是謀殺，說她絕不會教一個挑着救人的徒弟。
After each wave your defenders mend a further quarter of the health they lost.
每波結束後，守軍額外恢復已損失生命值的四分之一。

After one battle, we found the enemy commander hiding among civilian refugees. I executed them all to be sure. The high command called it 'excessive,' claimed it damaged our reputation in the region. Reputation? We're orcs of Mordor! When did we start caring about reputation? They stripped my command, relegated me to basic infantry.
一場戰鬥後，我們發現敵軍指揮官藏在平民難民中。爲保險起見，我把他們全殺了。高層說這“太過火”，還說會損害我們在當地的名聲。名聲？我們是魔多的奧克！什麼時候開始在乎名聲了？他們剝奪了我的指揮權，把我降成普通步兵。

After one particularly thorough raid, Saruman's messenger said we'd been 'excessive,' that we needed prisoners for interrogation, resources for confiscation. Excessive? We're instruments of war! I told him what I thought of restraint. He tried to have me disciplined. I killed him and his guards, then left before reinforcements arrived.
一次特別徹底的劫掠後，薩茹曼的信使說我們“過火”了，說他們需要俘虜來審問，需要資源來沒收。過火？我們是戰爭的工具！我告訴了他我對剋制的看法。他想讓人懲罰我。我殺了他和他的衛兵，在援軍趕到前離開了。
After the siege he paid me in captives I had no use for and a lame horse. So I sold the plans and two spare rams to a rival clan, and the chief put a price on my head that his riders still chase.
圍城結束，他拿些我根本用不着的俘虜和一匹瘸馬抵工錢。我就把圖紙和兩架備用撞錘賣給了敵對氏族。酋長懸賞我的腦袋，他的騎兵至今還追着這筆賞金跑。

After your hero falls in a battle, the key Take this soldier (Delete unless rebound, under Options > Keybindings > Action) in the Seat takes the soldier at the middle of the screen, or the nearest one of the company you keep to, who then carries your orders. Off, the key does nothing. Not in an online session. Default: on.
英雄在戰鬥中倒下後，可在觀望之椅中按“控制這名士兵”，接管屏幕中央的士兵，或當前跟隨編隊中最近的士兵，由其執行你的命令。默認按鍵Delete，可在“選項→按鍵綁定→動作”中修改。關閉後，此鍵無效。在線聯機中無效。默認：開啓。
Aganuzîr leads the raiding parties that ride west of the Black Gate. His name means Death-Lover, and his mother intended it as a blessing.
阿加努齊爾率領劫掠隊，在黑門以西騎馬出擊。他的名字意爲“熱愛死亡的人”，母親給他取這個名字時，懷着祝福的心意。
隨和的洛絲羅瑞恩長老
隨和的烏魯克前線隊長
隨和的安都因河谷長老
Ah, a new face. Would you like to hear what the White Hand pays?
啊，新面孔。想聽聽白手出什麼價嗎？
Aigiarn of House Kalkian is a proud woman of the Easterlings, mistress of hearth and granary and no stranger to the horse and the bow.
卡爾基安家族的艾吉亞恩是一位驕傲的東夷女子。她掌管家務和糧倉，對騎馬和射箭也不陌生。
Ailinel, spouse to Oropherion, embodies the graceful Sindar nobility, her strategic insights aiding in the clan's ancient rituals and alliances within the Woodland Realm.
愛林妮爾是歐洛斐瑞昂的配偶，體現了辛達貴族的優雅氣質。她的戰略眼光幫助族人維繫古老儀式，也維護林地王國內部的盟約。
Akhôr commands the coastal Haradrim, allied with the Corsairs of Umbar.
阿霍爾統領沿海的哈拉德人，與烏姆巴爾海盜結盟。
Akrdal lies on high ground near Yoldbryn. Its farmers grow rye and barley in the short northern summers.
阿克爾達爾位於約德布林附近的高地。農民利用北方短暫的夏季種植黑麥和大麥。
Akvoth Karmian commands the southern borders of Rhun.
阿克沃斯·卡爾米安負責魯恩南部邊境的防務。
Alagh of House Zorian is a proud woman of the Easterlings, mistress of hearth and granary and no stranger to the horse and the bow.
佐裏安家族的阿拉格是一位驕傲的東夷女子。她掌管家務和糧倉，對騎馬和射箭也不陌生。
Alaqai of House Zorian is a proud woman of the Easterlings, mistress of hearth and granary and no stranger to the horse and the bow.
佐裏安家族的阿剌海是一位驕傲的東夷女子。她掌管家務和糧倉，對騎馬和射箭也不陌生。
阿爾凱婭是梅利迪爾的妻子。
Aldburg archers are the finest in the Mark. +5 health.
奧德堡弓手是洛汗全境最優秀的弓手。+5 生命值。
Aldburg's warriors are tempered by proximity to Fangorn. +6 health.
奧德堡戰士因臨近範貢森林而更加堅韌。+6 生命值。
Aldric holds a hall in the Eastfold and rides in the muster of Edoras. He is a plain horseman of no great house, trusted for it.
阿爾德里克在東伏爾德擁有一座廳堂，隨埃多拉斯的軍隊集結出徵。他只是個沒有顯赫家世的普通騎手，卻也因此受人信任。
Aldwulf has destroyed many good men.
阿爾德伍爾夫已經毀了不少好人。
