Hunt down the spy's party and destroy it. Rid me of this threat and you will be well rewarded.
追上並消滅密探的隊伍。替我除掉這個威脅，你會得到豐厚的獎賞。
Hunted across the plains of Gorgoroth.
橫穿戈堝洛斯平原狩獵。
Hunted along the Greyflood with the Minhiriath bowmen.
隨明希瑞亞斯弓兵沿灰水河狩獵。
Hunted and foraged in the forests of Dunland.
在黑蠻地森林中狩獵和採集。
Hunted deep in the shadowed wood.
Hunted in the Eastfold and watched the horizon.
在東伏爾德狩獵並守望地平線。
Hunted in the Mirkwood borders and forest trails.
在黑森林邊緣和林間小路狩獵。
Hunted spiders and wolves under the Emyn Duir.
在埃敏杜伊爾山下獵殺蜘蛛和狼。
Hunted the Mirkwood borders and the Carrock slopes.
在黑森林邊緣與卡爾巖山坡上狩獵。
Hunted the forest trails beneath the Emyn Duir.
在埃敏杜伊爾山下的林間小徑狩獵。
Hunted the reed-beds of the River Running.
在奔流河的蘆葦叢中狩獵。
Hunted the southern eaves and watched the horizon.
在南部林緣狩獵，留意遠方動靜。
Hunted trespassers in the corrupted Greenwood.
在腐化綠林中獵殺闖入者。
追獵者每小時接近距離上限
Hush. The sea speaks first in the mist, and I am listening.
噓，霧裏的大海先開口，我正聽着。
Húrioneth serves the House of Húrinionath, a steadfast keeper of the lore of Gondor's stewards.
胡瑞昂妮絲侍奉胡林尼昂納斯家族，是剛鐸宰相傳承的堅定守護者。
Hûz-Margôz Huz commands fortress garrisons along the western frontier.
胡茲家族的胡茲·馬戈茲統領西部邊境沿線的要塞守軍。
Hûz-Margôz, lord of House Hûz, holds the saddle-thrones of his Easterling kin east of the Sea of Rhûn and bends the tribes to the will of the Dark Tower.
胡茲·馬戈茲是胡茲家族的領主，統治着魯恩內海以東的東夷騎馬部族，迫使各部族服從邪黑塔的意志。

I accept the king's wisdom but not the corruption it protects. My honor intact, my skills undiminished, I seek those who value truth over politics. The mountain may play its games, but in the wild, integrity and skill matter more than influence.
我接受國王的智慧，但不接受它所保護的腐敗。我的榮譽還在，本事也沒有減弱。我尋找那些重視真相勝過權謀的人。山中可以繼續玩它的遊戲，但在荒野裏，正直和本領比影響力更重要。
I am Balakhôr, the Lore-Grandmaster. Every tale, every battle, every hero of this realm - I have chronicled them all.
我是巴拉霍爾，學識大宗師。這個國度的每個故事、每場戰鬥、每位英雄，我都曾記錄在案。
I am Belecthar, the Spartan. Where others wield spears, I forge worlds through code and structure.
我是貝勒克薩爾，人稱斯巴達人。別人揮舞長矛，而我通過代碼與結構鍛造世界。
I am BlackRose, forge-master of Realms Forgotten. An Uruk-Hai among creators, who builds worlds rather than destroys them.
我是黑玫瑰，被遺忘諸界的鍛造大師。作爲創作者中的烏魯克，我建造世界，而不是摧毀世界。
I am Elegost, a Ranger of the North. My kin keep the roads of Eriador while the folk of Bree sleep and never ask who stood watch.
我叫埃勒戈斯特，是一名北方遊俠。我的族人守着埃利阿多的道路，布理人卻只顧安睡，從不過問是誰替他們守夜。
I am Gimli, son of Glóin, a dwarf of the mountain halls. My axe seeks worthy battles.
我是吉姆利，格羅因之子，來自山中殿堂的矮人。我的斧頭正在尋找配得上的戰鬥。
I am Hatérade, master craftsman and architect of this very realm you walk. Some call me the Creator, though I'm just a dwarf with a vision.
我是哈特雷德，大匠，也是你腳下這片國度的建築師。有些人叫我創造者，不過我只是個有願景的矮人。
I am Igor Fahlun, called the Lost. A Haradrim far from the desert sands, finding purpose in crafting new worlds.
我是伊戈爾·法倫，人稱迷途者。一個遠離沙海的哈拉德人，在塑造新世界的技藝中找到了目標。
I am Leovlas of the Silvans, master craftsman of forms and light. My art breathes life into the digital realm.
我是西爾凡族的萊奧夫拉斯，形體與光影的大匠。我的藝術能讓數字領域獲得生命。
I am Maztog, the Ostler's Dread - though most know me simply as MOD. I guide lost souls through the labyrinth of creation.
我是馬茲托格，馬倌之懼，不過大多數人只知道我是模組管理員。我引導迷路的靈魂穿過創造的迷宮。
I am Rukumazig-khamîz, known as the Smith. I forge not just metal, but entire worlds through my craft.
我是魯庫馬齊格-哈米茲，人稱鐵匠。我鍛造的不只是金屬，也用自己的手藝鍛造整個世界。
I am Skarnûl the Unbroken, elite warrior seeking worthy battles and wiser masters.
我是不破者斯卡努爾，尋找值得一戰的敵人，以及更明智主人的精銳戰士。
I am Solus, the Cairn, Knight of the Golden Flower. My hands have shaped the very weapons that arm this realm.
我是索盧斯，人稱石冢，金花騎士。武裝這個國度的許多兵刃，都曾由我的雙手塑形。
I am Swan, Knight of the Silver Swan. I serve the realm through both sword and cartography.
我是斯旺，銀天鵝騎士。我以刀劍和地圖學爲這個國度效力。
I am Thanor, a weaver of codes and architect of systems. I bring life to ideas through the ancient art of programming.
我是薩諾爾，代碼的編織者，系統的建築師。我以古老的編程技藝，讓想法獲得生命。
I am Thyrell the Golden, Knight of the Golden Flower, sworn defender of Rivendell's ancient halls.
我是金色的泰瑞爾，金花騎士，宣誓守護幽谷古老殿堂。
I am Whitegoat, the Pathfinder. I guide travelers through the most complex journeys - the interface between mind and machine.
我是懷特戈特，人稱探路者。我引導旅人穿過最複雜的旅程，穿過心智與機器之間的界面。
I am a Ranger of the North. Some call me Strider, though that is not my true name.
我是北方遊俠。有人叫我大步佬，不過那並不是我的真名。
I am a Variag swordsman who served a clan chief's household, and I fight best at the front of a charge.
我是個瓦里亞格劍士，曾在氏族酋長家中效力。衝鋒時打頭陣，是我最拿手的。
I am a camp surgeon from the Variag war-hosts, patching up axe wounds and arrow cuts for anyone with coin or kindness.
我是瓦里亞格大軍出身的軍醫，給人治斧傷、箭傷。有錢也好，心善也好，我都肯治。
I am a camp thief and fence out of the Variag war-camps, and I know every back way into a chief's tent.
我是瓦里亞格軍營裏出來的賊，也做銷贓生意。通往酋長帳篷的每條後路，我都知道。
I am a caravan factor out of the Khand markets, and I know how silver moves between the plains and the south.
我是可汗德市場出身的商隊管事，知道平原和南方之間的銀子都是怎麼流動的。
I am a deserter now, with a price on me in the war-camps and a sharp bow I never learned to stop using. Fear has made me careful, and I am still alive.
如今我是逃兵，軍營裏有人懸賞抓我。我還有一張好弓，終究還是離不了它。害怕讓我謹慎，而我到現在還活着。
I am a front-rank axe from the northern holds. You will find my kind wherever the Misty Mountain warbands go to war.
我是北方堡壘的前排斧兵。迷霧山脈的戰團在哪兒打仗，就能在哪兒找到我這樣的人。
I am a horse-breaker and lancer from the plains clans, raised in the saddle among the herds of Khand.
我出身平原氏族，是馴馬師，也是槍騎兵，從小就在可汗德的馬羣中、馬背上長大。
I am a plains scout and horse-archer who walked the caravan roads between Khand and the southern markets.
我是平原斥候，也是騎射手，走過可汗德和南方集市之間的商路。
I am a sergeant of the northern warbands, the sort who keeps a column in order. We are not loved, but we are useful.
我是北方戰團的軍士，負責把隊伍管得服服帖帖。沒人喜歡我們，可我們有用。
I am a siege-builder out of the Variag clans, and I go where the walls are thick and the pay is thicker.
我出身瓦里亞格氏族，是個攻城器械匠。哪裏牆厚、給的錢更厚，我就去哪裏。
I am a smith of the Misty Mountain holds, working iron by the Dimrill gate and in the deeps. Every warband needs one.
我是迷霧山脈堡壘的鐵匠，在黯溪門邊上和地下深處打鐵。每個戰團都缺我這樣的。
I am a young war-band captain of the Variag riders, trained to read a field and break a line.
我是瓦里亞格騎兵的一名年輕戰團隊長，學的就是看準戰局、沖垮陣線。
I am an archer from the Variag battle lines, trained to shoot from behind the axes and stay alive.
我出身瓦里亞格軍陣，是個弓手。學的就是站在斧兵後面放箭，再活下來。
I am an axe-smith out of the Khand camps, and I can make a blade to bite through helm and bone alike.
我是可汗德軍營出身的鑄斧匠，我打的鋒刃，頭盔、骨頭都能砍穿。
I am an elf of the woodland realm, skilled with bow and blade. My people call me Legolas.
我是林地王國的精靈，擅長弓箭與刀劍。我的族人叫我萊戈拉斯。
I am blind to the enemy's movements while his patrols range the border. Break them and clear my sight, and I will know where to strike.
敵人的巡邏隊在邊境來回活動，讓我沒法掌握他的動向。打垮他們，讓我的斥候看清局勢，我才知道該往哪裏進攻。
I am certain. Return to the {TROOP_NAME} ranks.
I am more at home with old scrolls than with swords, but every life turns. Hear mine, if it interests you.
比起刀劍，我更習慣和舊卷軸待在一起，但每個人的人生都會轉彎。若你感興趣，就聽聽我的吧。
I am no great warrior, whatever this scar suggests. But you asked, so I will not hide it.
不管這道傷疤看起來像什麼，我都不是什麼偉大的戰士。但既然你問了，我不會藏着。
I am not asking. Speak, or I will make you.
我不是在問你。開口，不然我就逼你開口。
I am of Azog's line, a cousin's whelp, raised on the stories of Azanulbizar. I took a pike and a shield at Mount Gram, and no son of Bolg ever beat me in the ring.
我有阿佐格的血脈，是他一個親戚的崽子，從小聽阿扎努比扎的故事長大。在格拉姆山，我拿起長槍和盾。波爾格的兒子，沒一個在鬥場贏過我。
I am still alive, which is a poor omen for the bones. If you are the wings, make it quick. If you are not, give me a spear and I will stand in front of you and make the shaman a liar.
我還活着，這對那些占卜骨頭可不是好兆頭。要是你就是那雙翅膀，就痛快點。要是不是，給我一杆矛，我站你前頭，讓那薩滿的話全落空。
I am still dry. Still alive. The gull is gone. If the sea wants me, it can come and collect, and I will have a joke ready. In the meantime, I am for hire.
我還幹着，還活着，海鷗也走了。大海要我，就自己來收，我還會給它準備個笑話。在那之前，我照樣接活。

I am the second son of a Dúnedain house whose lands lie mostly in my grandfather's memory. My elder brother had the title, and I had a sword and a flair for being noticed. At Annúminas I commanded a company of sixty, which sounds finer than it was.
我出身杜內丹的一個家族，是家裏的次子。家族的領地，大半隻存在於祖父的回憶裏。哥哥繼承了頭銜，我只分到一把劍，外加一身出風頭的本事。我在安努米那斯帶過六十人，聽起來倒比實際威風。

I am the second son of a Dúnedain house whose lands lie mostly in my grandfather's memory. My elder brother had the title, and I had a sword and a talent for being noticed. In Caras Gorthad I commanded a company of sixty, which sounds finer than it was.
我出身杜內丹的一個家族，是家裏的次子。家族的領地，大半隻存在於祖父的回憶裏。哥哥繼承了頭銜，我只分到一把劍，外加一身出風頭的本事。我在卡拉斯戈沙德帶過六十人，聽起來倒比實際威風。

I am the second son of a Dúnedain house whose lands lie mostly in my grandfather's memory. My elder brother held the title, and I held a sword and a gift for being noticed. At Egladil I commanded a company of sixty, which sounds finer than it was.
我出身杜內丹的一個家族，是家裏的次子。家族的領地，大半隻存在於祖父的回憶裏。哥哥繼承了頭銜，我只分到一把劍，外加一身出風頭的本事。我在埃格拉迪爾帶過六十人，聽起來倒比實際威風。
I am too old to win your battles, but I can keep you from losing them foolishly.
我太老了，不能替你贏下戰鬥，但我能讓你別愚蠢地輸掉它們。
I am Éohart of the Wold, master of landscapes and shaper of horizons. They say I'm among the finest scene crafters in all the realm.
我是北高原的伊奧哈特，地貌大師，天際線的塑造者。他們說，我是整個國度裏最出色的場景工匠之一。

I arranged for a rival commander's mission to fail, fed him false intelligence, ensured his unit walked into an ambush. Most died, including him. His failure was meant to create an opening for me, but his second survived and grew suspicious. Rather than face investigation, I disappeared with my best scouts.
我安排一個敵對指揮官的任務失敗，給他餵了假情報，確保他的部隊走進埋伏。大多數人死了，包括他。那次失敗本該給我騰出位置，但他的副手活了下來，還起了疑心。與其面對調查，我帶着最好的斥候消失了。
I ask to be released from your service.
我請求退役，離開你的部隊。

I backed the wrong claimant. When the House split over which heir should rule, I poured my fortune into the one I judged the better man. He lost. The victor remembered every coin I had spent against him, and a ruined merchant who chose the losing side is welcome in no House of Âbanissa.
我押錯了繼承人。當家族因誰該繼位而分裂時，我把自己的財富投給了那個我認爲更好的人。他輸了。勝利者記得我花在反對他身上的每一枚錢，而一個選擇了失敗一方的破產商人，在阿巴尼薩沒有任何家族會歡迎。

I bred and broke horses in the clearings below Emyn Duir, where the grass is thin between the trees and the horses are hardy. I rode before I could properly walk, and half the mounts in the eaves carry my training.
我在埃敏杜伊爾下的林間空地養馬、馴馬。樹間草少，馬卻結實。我還沒走穩就會騎馬，林緣的坐騎，有一半都經過我調教。
I bred and broke horses on the downs east of the Redwater, where the grass is thin and the horses are hardy. I rode before I could properly walk, and half the mounts in the valley carry my training.
我在紅水河以東的崗地養馬、馴馬。那裏草少，馬卻結實。我還沒走穩就會騎馬，山谷裏的坐騎，有一半都經過我調教。

I bred and broke horses on the fells east of the Lonely Mountain, where the grass is thin and the horses are hardy. I rode before I could properly walk, and half the mounts in the valley carry my training.
我在孤山東邊的山地養馬、馴馬。那裏草少，馬卻結實。我還沒走穩就會騎馬，山谷裏的坐騎，有一半都經過我調教。
I bred and broke horses on the meadows below the Carrock, where the grass is sweet and the horses are hardy. I rode before I could properly walk, and half the mounts in the valley carry my training.
我在卡爾巖下的草甸養馬、馴馬。那裏草甜，馬也結實。我還沒走穩就會騎馬，山谷裏的坐騎，有一半都經過我調教。
I bring Morgul-trained fury and decades of battle experience, no target too dangerous.
我帶來魔古爾訓練出的狂怒，還有幾十年的戰鬥經驗，沒有哪個目標危險到不能下手。
I bring a hammer, a shield and a back that does not bend. That is enough.
我有一把錘、一面盾，還有一根不會彎的脊樑。夠了。
I bring absolute warfare, no survivors, no witnesses, no mercy. Only results.
我帶來的是戰爭：不留活口，不留目擊者，不施憐憫，只有結果。
I bring battlefield command experience and warriors who followed me from Mordor itself.
我帶來熟練的戰場指揮經驗，還有從魔多追隨我而來的戰士。
I bring berserker strength and the mind to use it strategically, for the right price.
我帶來狂戰士的力量，也有能把它用在戰略上的頭腦，只要價格合適。
I bring four decades of frontier fighting and strategic thinking, invaluable for what's coming.
我帶來四十年的邊境戰鬥經驗和戰略眼光，對即將到來的事極有價值。
I bring noble blood, military training, and the willingness to do what advancement requires.
我有貴族血統，受過軍事訓練，也願爲晉升付出任何代價。
I bring tactical brilliance and Saruman's training, without his leash.
我帶來出色的戰術頭腦和薩茹曼的訓練，卻沒有他的鎖鏈。
I bring the berserker's rage, pure, unstoppable, and finally free.
我帶來狂戰士的怒火，純粹、不可阻擋，而且終於自由。
I bring years of command experience, if you'll use it.
我有着多年的指揮經驗，若您願意任用。
I broke blue stone in the mines under Luinkrag and fought the Longbeards over the seams. A mine fighter goes where the rock and the pay are.
我在路因克拉格地下的礦裏砸藍石，也跟長鬚族爭過礦脈。礦裏打慣了架的人，哪兒有石頭、有錢，就去哪兒。

I broke rock in the blue-stone seams under Luinkrag, and when the Longbeards came up the old tunnels to take the seams back, I broke them, too. A shift-boss gave me a pick-haft for my own and a bone for every dwarf.
我在路因克拉格地下的藍石礦脈砸石頭。長鬚族沿老地道來搶礦，我連他們一起砸。工頭給了我一根鎬柄，歸我自己用，每殺個矮人，再賞一塊骨頭。

I brokered deals for Mordor, trade agreements with corrupt officials, bribes to key figures, establishing spy networks in enemy territory. My mistake was keeping too much profit for myself. When an audit revealed discrepancies, I had advance warning from a contact and used it to vanish with considerable wealth before they could seize my assets.
我爲魔多撮合交易：同腐敗官員達成貿易協議，賄賂關鍵人物，在敵境建立間諜網。我的錯誤是給自己留了太多利潤。一次審計查出賬目不對，但我從一個聯繫人那裏提前得到了風聲，於是在他們沒收我的資產前，帶着大筆財富消失了。
I build engines that pump, lift and shoot. Give me timber, iron and time, and I will build them for you.
抽水的、起重的、發射的機械，我都會造。給我木材、鐵料和時間，我就替你造出來。
I build siege works for the Misty Mountain holds: rams, ladders and sapping tunnels. Every hold sends its engineers out sooner or later.
我替迷霧山脈的堡壘修攻城工事：撞錘、梯子、攻城地道。每座堡壘早晚都會把自己的工程師派出去。
I build weapons others fear to imagine, they'll be grateful when the enemy comes.
我能造出別人連想都害怕的武器；等敵人來了，他們會感謝我。
I built a trading network across Dol Guldur, connecting the uruks of the fortress with goods from distant lands. My caravans brought prosperity and rare supplies that the Necromancer valued highly.
我曾在多古爾都建立起貿易網絡，把要塞烏魯克和遠方土地的貨物連接起來。我的商隊帶來了繁榮，也帶來了死靈法師十分看重的稀有補給。
I built a trading network across Imladris, connecting the Eldar with goods from distant lands. My caravans brought prosperity and rare supplies that Lord Elrond valued highly.
我曾在幽谷建立起貿易網絡，把埃爾達和遠方土地的貨物連接起來。我的商隊帶來了繁榮，也帶來了埃爾隆德大人十分看重的稀有補給。

I built a trading network across the Golden Wood, connecting the Galadhrim with goods from distant lands. My caravans brought prosperity and rare supplies that Lord Celeborn and Lady Galadriel valued highly.
我曾在金色森林建立起貿易網絡，把加拉茲民和遠方土地的貨物連接起來。我的商隊帶來了繁榮，也帶來了凱勒博恩大人和加拉德瑞爾夫人十分看重的稀有補給。

I built a trading network across the Haven of Umbar, connecting the Corsairs of Umbar with goods from distant lands. My caravans brought prosperity and rare supplies that the Corsair Lords valued highly.
我曾在烏姆巴爾港建立起一張貿易網絡，把烏姆巴爾的海盜與遠方貨物連接起來。我的商隊帶來了繁榮，也帶來海盜領主十分看重的稀有補給。
I built a trading network across the Woodland Realm, connecting the Silvan Elves with goods from distant lands. My caravans brought prosperity and rare supplies that King Thranduil valued highly.
我曾在林地王國建立起貿易網絡，把西爾凡精靈和遠方土地的貨物連接起來。我的商隊帶來了繁榮，也帶來了瑟蘭杜伊國王十分看重的稀有補給。
I built a trading network across the eastern steppes, connecting the Easterlings with goods from distant lands. My caravans brought prosperity and rare supplies that the Kagan valued highly.
我曾在東方草原建立起一張貿易網絡，把東夷與遠方貨物連接起來。我的商隊帶來了繁榮，也帶來可汗十分看重的稀有補給。
I built a trading network across the hills of Dunland, connecting the Dunlendings with goods from distant lands. My caravans brought prosperity and rare supplies that the clan chiefs valued highly.
我曾在黑蠻地丘陵中建立起貿易網絡，把黑蠻地人和遠方土地的貨物連接起來。我的商隊帶來了繁榮，也帶來了氏族酋長十分看重的稀有補給。
I built a trading network across the lands of Harad, connecting the Haradrim with goods from distant lands. My caravans brought prosperity and rare supplies that the Serpent Lords valued highly.
我曾在哈拉德諸地建立起一張貿易網絡，把哈拉德人與遠方貨物連接起來。我的商隊帶來了繁榮，也帶來巨蛇領主十分看重的稀有補給。

I built the engines of the Blue Mountains: the great pumps that clear the drowned galleries under Nogrod, the lifts at Hammerdeep and the wheeled arbalests the Firebeards haul up to the walls. I could make water climb a mountain and send a bolt through a door. The guild called me the best engineer of my age.
我造過藍色山脈的各式機械：排幹諾格羅德地下礦道的大水泵、深錘堡的升降機，還有火須族拉上城牆的輪式重弩。我能讓水爬上山，讓弩箭射穿門。行會說我是同輩最好的工程師。
I can be whoever a moment requires. Just now, I am a man telling you the truth, which is rarer for me than you would think.
我可以變成當下需要的任何人。現在，我是個對你說真話的人，而這對我來說比你想的少見。
I can fight, if I am paid well and the line is thick enough to stand behind.
我能打，只要工錢夠好，前面的陣線夠厚，能讓我躲在後面。
I can fight, if the pay is good and there are enough shields beside me.
我能打，只要工錢好，身旁有足夠的盾牌。
I can hold a spear steady on any ground, and I can read your quartermaster's books, for a fair share.
什麼地面上我都能端穩長矛，也看得懂你軍需官的賬，只要給我公道的一份。
I can keep your mounts sound and your accounts honest, and I will not ask more than my share.
我能照看好你的坐騎，也能把賬記得明明白白，不會多拿自己那份以外的錢。
I can make your gold stretch further than you'd believe. Hire me.
我能讓你的金子花得比你想像中更遠。僱我吧。
I can plan your march and your ambushes. My price is plain, and I name it first.
我能替你規劃行軍、安排伏擊。價錢明碼實報，動身前就說清。
I can plan your marches and your ambushes. My price is plain, and I name it first.
我能替你規劃行軍、安排伏擊。價錢明碼實報，動身前就說清。
I can put arrows where you need them, if the pay is steady and honest.
只要工錢按時給、不坑人，你指哪兒，我的箭就射到哪兒。
I can ride. Put me with the horsemen.
我會騎馬。讓我加入騎兵隊吧。
I cannot go home, since I sent three hundred orcs to the wizard, and I cannot go south either. So I sell the same plans to different masters, and wait to see which one trusts me longest.
我把三百個奧克送給了巫師，家回不去，南邊也去不得。只好把同一套計劃賣給不同的主子，等着看誰能信我最久。

I cannot go home; deserters are made examples of. So I look for a captain who fights men who can fight back, and leaves the helpless alone. I know I am green, but I learn fast, and I will not run from an honest battle. Only from a slaughter.
我不能回家，逃兵會被拿來立威。所以我在找一個只和能反擊的人戰鬥、並放過無助者的隊長。我知道自己還嫩，但我學得快，也不會從一場正當戰鬥中逃跑。我只會逃離屠殺。
I cannot match a soldier's arm, but I can read your enemy better than any of them.
我比不上士兵的臂力，但我比他們任何人都更能讀懂你的敵人。

I captained a patrol ship from Pelargir, keeping the great river clear of enemies. We knew every bend and shoal from the Mouths to Cair Andros. My crew could fight on water as well as any could on land.
我曾指揮一艘來自佩拉基爾的巡邏船，確保大河不受敵人侵擾。我們對從河口到凱爾安德洛斯的每一處河灣淺灘都瞭如指掌。我的船員在水上作戰的本領，絲毫不遜於任何陸戰勇士。
I carry my sword, my scar and the shame of a vow that bound me to a butcher. I have no clan, no camp, and no one left who will share a fire with me.
我帶着劍、帶着傷疤，也帶着那場誓言的恥辱，它把我綁在了一個屠夫身邊。如今我沒有氏族、沒有營地，也沒人願意再和我共坐一堆火。

I challenged my superior for his position, ritual combat, perfectly legal. I won. His allies couldn't accept an outsider, an Isengard-spawn, taking their comrade's place. They manufactured charges of theft, claimed I'd stolen from the war-stores. Before I could defend myself properly, I was forced to flee.
我向上級發起挑戰，爭奪他的職位。那是儀式決鬥，完全合規。我贏了。但他的盟友無法接受一個外來者、一個艾森加德造物，取代他們同伴的位置。他們編造盜竊罪名，說我偷了軍庫物資。我還沒來得及好好爲自己辯解，就被迫逃走了。
I chose exile over chains. Now I ride as my grandmother once did, free and fierce. The Mark needs every spear, regardless of who wields it. Let them whisper - I'll be too busy fighting to hear.
我選擇流放，而不是鎖鏈。如今我像祖母當年那樣騎行，自由而兇烈。馬克需要每一支矛，不管握矛的是誰。讓他們低聲議論吧，我忙着戰鬥，沒空聽。
I chose exile over chains. Now I ride as my grandmother once did, free and fierce. The plains need every spear, regardless of who wields it. Let them whisper, I'll be too busy fighting to hear.
比起被拴住，我選擇離鄉。如今我像祖母當年一樣騎馬，自由，也兇猛。平原需要每一支長矛，誰拿着它都一樣。讓他們說閒話去吧，我忙着打仗，沒空聽。

I come from Gondor originally, though don't hold that against me. Captured during a border skirmish, I had a choice, die with my unit or serve my captors. I chose pragmatism over pointless heroism. Proved useful translating, negotiating, handling diplomatic matters with human settlements. The pay was better than Gondor offered anyway.
我原本來自剛鐸，不過別因此看輕我。我在一次邊境衝突中被俘，當時只有兩個選擇：和我的小隊一起死，或爲俘虜我的人效力。我選擇了務實，而不是無意義的英雄主義。後來我證明了自己的用處，負責翻譯、談判，以及處理同人類定居點有關的外交事務。反正報酬也比剛鐸給得更好。
I come from the Emyn Duir Watch riders, who watch the southern roads for the Woodmen. A warning from us is sound, whatever the lords choose to do with it.
我出身埃敏杜伊爾守望隊的騎手，替林中居民看守南方道路。我們發出的警告靠得住，至於領主怎麼處置，那是他們的事。
I come from the Northgate riders, who watch the eastern roads for Dorwinion. A warning from us is sound, whatever the lords choose to do with it.
我出身北門騎手，替多溫尼安看守東邊的道路。我們發出的警告靠得住，至於領主怎麼處置，那是他們的事。
I come from the Ravenhill riders, who watch the eastern roads for Dale. A warning from us is sound, whatever the lords choose to do with it.
我出身渡鴉嶺騎手，替河谷城看守東邊的道路。我們發出的警告靠得住，至於領主怎麼處置，那是他們的事。
I come from the old bloodlines of Mount Gram, raised to the pike and the shield. Blood feuds are common among us.
我出自格拉姆山的古老血脈，從小練長槍和盾。我們那裏，血仇很常見。
I come from the riders of the High Pass Watch, who watch the mountain roads for the Vales. A warning from us is sound, whatever the elders choose to do with it.
我出身高隘口守望隊的騎手，替河谷看守山路。我們發出的警告靠得住，至於長老怎麼處置，那是他們的事。

I commanded a century in the siege battalions, trained to break fortifications and crush defenders. Led from the front, always first through the breach. Earned commendations, battlefield promotions, respect from my soldiers. But advancement in Mordor requires more than battlefield success, it requires political maneuvering I found distasteful.
我曾指揮攻城營的一支百人隊，專精摧毀防禦工事、碾碎守軍。我總是身先士卒，第一個衝進缺口。我得過嘉獎，憑戰功晉升，也贏得了士兵們的尊敬。但在魔多，晉升不只靠戰場功績，還要靠我厭惡的權力手腕。

I commanded a company in Osgiliath, holding the ruined city against constant probes from Mordor. My men trusted me, and I never spent their lives cheaply. We were a sword pointed at the Enemy's throat.
我曾在歐斯吉利亞斯指揮一支部隊，在魔多的頻繁侵襲下堅守這座廢墟。我的手下都很信任我，我也絕不白白犧牲他們的生命。我們是直指敵人咽喉的利劍。

I commanded a company of the finest warriors, earned my rank through valor and fairness. My soldiers would follow me into dragon-fire. But honor demanded I speak when I witnessed corruption, a thane skimming from the war supplies, selling weapons meant for our patrols.
我曾指揮一支最精銳的戰士隊伍，靠勇武和公正贏得軍銜。我的士兵願意跟着我衝進龍焰。但榮譽要求我在看見腐敗時開口：有個領主從戰爭補給裏剋扣物資，把本該給巡邏隊的武器拿去賣。
I commanded a company of the watch on the Ered Luin, where Lindon's last farmsteads lean against the mountains. We held the passes for a hundred winters, and I knew each of my spearmen by their step.
我曾在埃瑞德路因指揮一隊守衛，林頓最遠的農莊就靠在山腳。我們守隘口一百個冬天，每個矛手，我光聽腳步就認得。
I commanded a patrol company at Barad Forn, twelve years a captain on the Greenway. I knew every track from the North Downs to Bree. The men respected me and I let them.
我曾在巴拉德佛恩帶領一支巡邏隊，在綠大道當了十二年隊長。從北崗到布理，每條小路我都熟。手下人敬重我，我也坦然受着。
I commanded a patrol company at Last Bridge, twelve years a captain on the East Road. I knew every track from the Ettenmoors to the Loudwater. The men respected me and I let them.
我曾在最後大橋帶領一支巡邏隊，在東西大道當了十二年隊長。從埃滕荒原到響水河，每條小路我都熟。手下人敬重我，我也坦然受着。

I commanded a patrol company out of Tharbad, twelve years a captain on the Greenway south of the Barrow-downs. I knew every track from the Greyflood to the Brandywine. The men respected me and I let them.
我曾帶着沙巴德的一支巡邏隊，在古冢崗以南的綠大道當了十二年隊長。從灰水河到白蘭地河，每條小路我都熟。手下人敬重我，我也坦然受着。

I commanded forces in Dol Guldur, studying the art of war under the Necromancer's most experienced captains. My tactical innovations won several engagements against the elves and men of the West when we were outnumbered.
我曾在多古爾都指揮部隊，跟隨死靈法師手下最老練的隊長學習戰爭之道。兵力處於劣勢時，我靠戰術創新贏下了數次對西方精靈和人類的交戰。

I commanded forces in Imladris, studying the art of war under Lord Elrond's most experienced captains. My tactical innovations won several engagements against the forces of darkness when we were outnumbered.
我曾在幽谷指揮部隊，跟隨埃爾隆德大人最老練的隊長學習戰爭之道。兵力處於劣勢時，我靠戰術創新贏下了數次對黑暗勢力的交戰。

I commanded forces in the Golden Wood, studying the art of war under Lord Celeborn and Lady Galadriel's most experienced captains. My tactical innovations won several engagements against the Shadow in the East when we were outnumbered.
我曾在金色森林指揮部隊，跟隨凱勒博恩大人和加拉德瑞爾夫人手下最老練的隊長學習戰爭之道。兵力處於劣勢時，我靠戰術創新贏下了數次對東方陰影的交戰。

I commanded forces in the Haven of Umbar, studying the art of war under the Corsair Lords's most experienced captains. My tactical innovations won several engagements against the navy of Gondor when we were outnumbered.
我曾在烏姆巴爾港統率軍隊，在海盜領主手下最老練的隊長那裏學習戰爭之道。即使兵力處於劣勢，我的戰術革新也讓我們數次戰勝剛鐸海軍。

I commanded forces in the Woodland Realm, studying the art of war under King Thranduil's most experienced captains. My tactical innovations won several engagements against the spiders and orcs of Dol Guldur when we were outnumbered.
我曾在林地王國指揮部隊，跟隨瑟蘭杜伊國王最老練的隊長學習戰爭之道。兵力處於劣勢時，我靠戰術創新贏下了數次對多古爾都蜘蛛和奧克的交戰。

I commanded forces in the eastern steppes, studying the art of war under the Kagan's most experienced captains. My tactical innovations won several engagements against the western kingdoms when we were outnumbered.
我曾在東方草原統率軍隊，在可汗手下最老練的隊長那裏學習戰爭之道。即使兵力處於劣勢，我的戰術革新也讓我們數次戰勝西方諸國。

I commanded forces in the hills of Dunland, studying the art of war under the clan chiefs's most experienced captains. My tactical innovations won several engagements against the Horse-lords of Rohan when we were outnumbered.
我曾在黑蠻地丘陵中指揮部隊，跟隨氏族酋長手下最老練的隊長學習戰爭之道。兵力處於劣勢時，我靠戰術創新贏下了數次對洛汗馭馬者的交戰。

I commanded forces in the lands of Harad, studying the art of war under the Serpent Lords's most experienced captains. My tactical innovations won several engagements against the men of Gondor when we were outnumbered.
我曾在哈拉德諸地統率軍隊，在巨蛇領主手下最老練的隊長那裏學習戰爭之道。即使兵力處於劣勢，我的戰術革新也讓我們數次戰勝剛鐸人。

I commanded scouting parties into Rohan, gathering intelligence, eliminating patrols. Good at my work, effective, ruthless, reliable. But I saw how Saruman's favorites advanced while competent warriors like me stagnated. Merit alone doesn't bring promotion when the White Wizard plays favorites.
我曾指揮斥候隊深入洛汗，收集情報，清除巡邏隊。我乾得很好，高效、冷酷、可靠。但我看見薩茹曼的寵信之人不斷晉升，而我這樣有能力的戰士卻停在原地。白袍巫師偏袒自己人時，光有功績並不能帶來晉升。

I commanded the garrison of Dolmed Hold, a company of the best axes in the Wardens' service. I earned that rank by holding my line and keeping my word, and my company would have followed me into a dragon's mouth. We kept the passes and the steadings in the hills below them.
我曾統領多米德山要塞的駐軍，那是守望者麾下最好的斧手隊伍。我靠守住陣線、守住承諾掙到職位，我的隊伍肯跟我闖進龍嘴。我們守着山隘，也守着山隘下的農莊。
I could not stay silent while treachery festered. I left my company and now ride as a masterless warrior, seeking those who still have the courage to face hard truths.
我不能眼看叛賣的勾當越爛越深，卻一聲不吭。我離開隊伍，成了沒有主君的戰士，尋找還有勇氣面對難聽真相的人。
I couldn't guard a border that wasn't truly guarded. Now I range freely, hunting threats wherever I find them. If Gondor won't defend its boundaries, someone must.
我無法守衛一個名存實亡的邊境。現在我自由行動，在任何地方尋找並消滅威脅。如果剛鐸不保衛自己的邊界，總得有人來做這件事。
I couldn't patrol waters where unknown forces moved freely. Either we control the Anduin or we don't. I resigned and now seek employment where orders make sense and enemies are clearly marked.
我無法在未知勢力自由活動的水域巡邏。要麼我們掌控安都因河，要麼就放棄。我已辭職，現在尋求一個軍令明確、敵我分明的職位。
I couldn't serve knowing such treachery existed in our own ranks. I left Dol Amroth's service and now seek honest employment. If Gondor trades with its own enemies, how can we claim moral authority?
在知道我軍也有這些兩面三刀的行徑後我就不想繼續當兵了。我離開了多阿姆洛斯軍隊，現在正想找一份誠實光彩的工作。如果剛鐸自己都跟它的仇敵做交易，我們又哪來的資格稱自己爲道德模範？
I couldn't stay silent while treachery festered. I left my éored and now ride as a masterless warrior, seeking those who still have the courage to face hard truths.
背叛正在滋生，我不能一直沉默。我離開了自己的伊奧雷德騎兵隊，如今成了不再效忠任何領主的戰士，尋找那些仍有勇氣面對殘酷真相的人。
I craft the windows through which all interact with our world. Every button, every menu, every display - I design the paths that lead users to their destinations.
我打造人們與這個世界互動的窗口。每個按鈕、每份菜單、每塊顯示界面，我都在設計通往目的地的道路。
I crawled home and they called me a fool who chose to die alone. I will not be that fool twice. I want a host that charges together, or I will find one.
我爬回去，他們還罵我是個自己找死的蠢貨。這種蠢事我不會幹第二次。我只跟肯一起衝鋒的大軍走，不肯的話，我另找一支。
I crawled out under a cart of ore with my arm hanging off. I will not forgive the stone, the boss, or the beards. Give me a fight and I will not tell you about the rest.
我從一車礦石底下爬出來，胳膊都快掉了。石頭、工頭、那幫鬍子，我一個也不會原諒。給我場仗打，別的我就不提了。
I deal in what men would rather keep hidden. You are certain you want to hear my trade?
我做的是男人們寧願藏起來的生意。你確定想聽我的行當？
I declined all three, and so I now carry my truthful report in my head instead of an archive. It is a lonely sort of virtue, though the bow keeps me company.
三次我都沒答應。所以現在，那份真實的報告沒進檔案，只裝在我腦子裏。堅持這種品德挺孤單，好在弓還陪着我。

I designed mining equipment, water systems, the great lifts that move between levels. But I also studied war machines, catapults, ballistae, devices mentioned in old texts. Started building prototypes in secret, improvements on ancient designs. Some incorporated... unusual elements.
我設計過採礦設備、供水系統，還有穿行各層的大升降機。但我也研究戰爭機械：投石機、弩炮，還有舊書裏提到的各種裝置。我開始祕密製造原型，在古老設計上加以改進。有些還加入了……不太尋常的東西。
I destroy whatever target you designate, thoroughly, brutally, completely.
你指定什麼目標，我就徹底、殘酷、完整地摧毀它。
I did not die. I came down out of the snow with nothing but my name, and I mean to take Mount Gram back, one son of Bolg at a time.
我沒死。我從雪裏下了山，除了名字，一無所有。我要把格拉姆山奪回來，波爾格的兒子，一個一個收拾。

I discovered something I shouldn't have, a conspiracy among certain merchants, selling information about our patrols to unknown buyers. When I reported it, they had influence I didn't. Suddenly I was 'unreliable,' seeing threats that weren't there. Reassigned to gate duty, my reputation ruined.
我發現了不該發現的事：某些商人合謀，把我們的巡邏情報賣給不明買家。我上報後，才發現他們的影響力比我大。突然之間，我就成了“不可靠”的人，被說成看見不存在的威脅。後來我被調去守門，名聲也毀了。
I do not blame the cold, for I know what I did. Since then I give away what coin I earn to the widows of Eastbank, and it is never enough.
我不怪天冷，我知道自己做了什麼。從那以後，掙來的錢我都送給了東岸的寡婦們，可怎麼都不夠。
I do not blame the cold, for I know what I did. Since then I give away what coin I earn to the widows of Esgaroth, and it is never enough.
我不怪天冷，我知道自己做了什麼。從那以後，掙來的錢我都送給了埃斯加洛斯的寡婦們，可怎麼都不夠。
I do not blame the cold, for I know what I did. Since then I give away what coin I earn to the widows of Fellingwick, and it is never enough.
我不怪天冷，我知道自己做了什麼。從那以後，掙來的錢我都送給了伐木村的寡婦們，可怎麼都不夠。
I do not blame the fog, for I know what I did. Since then I give away what coin I earn to the widows of Seagate, and it is never enough.
我不怪霧，我知道自己做了什麼。從那以後，掙來的錢我都送給了海門的寡婦們，可怎麼都不夠。
I do not grieve for the goblins, only for the two who followed me. Since then I walk alone, and a spear needs a line behind it. I would have it be a line worth following.
我不替半獸人難過，只難過那兩個跟着我的人。此後我獨自走路，可長矛後面總得有條陣線，我想找一條值得追隨的。
I do not know you well enough to speak of my house's lands.
我們還沒熟到能談家族領地的地步。
I do not know you well enough to speak of such things.
我們還沒熟到能談這些事的地步。
I do not mourn the orcs, only the two who followed me. Since then I walk alone, and a spear needs a line behind it. I would rather it be a line worth following.
我不替奧克難過，只難過那兩個跟着我的人。從此我獨自走路，可長矛後面總得有條陣線，我想找一條值得追隨的。
I do not regret it. The miller's family eats because of that sluice, and dwarf-craft lost nothing by it. But the guild is the guild, so I build for anyone with honest work for an engineer.
我不後悔。那磨坊主一家靠這道水閘保住了飯碗，矮人技藝也沒因此少了什麼。可行會終歸是行會，我就替任何肯給工程師正當活計的人造東西。
I do not regret the ride. I regret that I rode alone, and that Arthedain's dead had so few of my kin among them. Now I ride where my oath still has a place to go.
我不後悔出征，只遺憾自己獨自前去，阿塞丹的死者身邊，我的同族那麼少。現在，我騎馬去那些仍能履行誓言的地方。

I do not regret the sum, only that it fell to me to make it. His friends found me a post at a far outpost with no walls, which is to say none. Now I sell my reckoning to anyone with the sense to use it.
我不後悔那筆賬，只遺憾得由我來算。他的朋友替我在一個連牆都沒有的偏遠哨站找了份差事，換句話說，什麼差事也沒了。現在，誰明白這本事有用，我就把它賣給誰。
I do not regret the sum, only that it fell to me to make it. His friends found me a post far from the walls, which is to say none. Now I sell my reckoning to anyone with the sense to use it.
我不後悔那筆賬，只遺憾得由我來算。他的朋友替我找了個離城牆很遠的職位，換句話說，什麼職位也沒了。現在，誰明白這本事有用，我就把它賣給誰。

I do not regret the sum, only that it fell to me. His kin found me a clerkship in a village with no granary, which is to say no post at all. Now I sell my reckoning to anyone sensible enough to buy it.
我不後悔那筆賬，只遺憾得由我來算。他的親戚替我在一個連糧倉都沒有的村子找了份文書差事，換句話說，什麼差事也沒了。現在，誰明白這本事有用，我就把它賣給誰。
I do not say I was wrong. A captain lives so another raid can be planned. The chiefs here do not like the sum, so I sell my head for plans, away from the Craig.
我不覺得自己錯了，隊長活着，才能安排下一次劫掠。這裏的酋長算不來這筆賬，我就離開藍巖，賣腦子裏的計劃。
I do not take the road for nothing. My price is {TAOM_OATH_TERMS}. Will you meet it?
我可不會白白跟你上路。我的條件是{TAOM_OATH_TERMS}，你答應嗎？

I dwelled in the deep caves of Gundabad, where the shadows whisper secrets. My dam was a cunning shaman, brewing poisons and curses for the chieftains. I learned her dark arts, binding wounds with foul herbs and invoking spirits of the mountain. Life was a constant struggle, but I endured until the raid.
我住在貢達巴德深處的洞穴裏，那裏的陰影會低聲吐露祕密。我娘是個狡猾的薩滿，替酋長們熬毒藥、下詛咒。我學會了她那些黑暗手藝，用污穢草藥包紮傷口，呼喚山中的靈。日子一直在掙扎裏熬着，直到那場突襲來了。

I earned my first horse at twelve, my first kill at sixteen. I rode with the younger riders of Edoras, eager to prove ourselves worthy of our fathers' legacies. We dreamed of great charges and heroic songs.
我十二歲得到第一匹馬，十六歲第一次殺敵。我曾和埃多拉斯的年輕騎手一同馳騁，急着證明自己配得上父輩的遺產。我們夢想着偉大的衝鋒，也夢想着英雄之歌。

I earned my first horse at twelve, my first kill at sixteen. I rode with the younger riders of Vidugard, eager to prove ourselves worthy of our fathers' legacies. We dreamed of great charges and heroic songs.
我十二歲掙到第一匹馬，十六歲第一次殺敵。我和維杜加德的年輕騎手一起出徵，都想證明自己配得上父輩留下的榮譽。我們夢想着壯烈衝鋒，夢想着被唱進英雄的歌。
I eliminate problems permanently and precisely, no target beyond reach.
我能永久而精準地清除問題，沒有哪個目標遠到夠不着。

I escaped before they could chain me. The strong deserve to fight freely, not rot in darkness for showing initiative. There's war everywhere now, the Age of Men crumbles, and those who can fight will carve out their destiny. I need no master, only worthy enemies.
他們還沒來得及給我上鐐銬，我就逃了。強者應該自由地戰鬥，而不是因爲主動爭勝就爛在黑暗裏。如今處處都有戰爭，人類的時代正在崩塌，能戰鬥的人會親手奪出自己的命運。我不需要主人，只需要配得上的敵人。
I escaped before they could silence me permanently. Now I offer my bow to those who still believe in justice. Every arrow I loose carries the memory of that murdered prisoner.
他們還沒來得及讓我永遠閉嘴，我逃了出來。如今我把弓獻給仍相信正義的人。我射出的每一支箭，都帶着那名被害俘虜的記憶。
I extract information others cannot, through methods they dare not employ.
我能用別人不敢用的手段，挖出別人問不出的情報。
I fear the sea less than I fear a dull evening. Take me.
比起大海，我更怕一整晚無聊。帶上我。
I fight hard and I do not flinch. If that suits you, put me at the front of your line.
我打得狠，也不退縮。你若合意，就把我放在陣線最前頭。
I fight, I kill, I win. What more do you need?
我戰鬥，我殺敵，我勝利。你還想要什麼？
I forge weapons others cannot, though my methods are... unconventional.
我能鍛造別人造不出的武器，雖然我的方法……不太常規。
I forged a long sword for one of Círdan's captains, my finest work. He drew it against a crowd of unarmed raiders who had thrown down their weapons. I did not forget what the edge was for.
我給奇爾丹的一位隊長打過一把長劍，是最好的作品。他卻拿它對着一羣已經扔下武器、手無寸鐵的劫掠者。我可沒忘記，刃口原本該對着誰。
I forged weapons in a Khand camp for twenty years, the curved cutting axes that my people are known for, balanced and hungry. Every blade I made, I tested on a post of iron oak before I sold it.
我在可汗德軍營打了二十年兵器，做的是我們族人出名的彎刃戰斧，分量合手，鋒口兇狠。每把斧頭賣出去前，我都要拿鐵橡木樁試過刃。
I fought in the slave pits under the Front Porch. Pit-fighters who win too often do not last there, so I fight for whoever stands me in front.
我在前門廊下面的奴隸鬥場打過。贏得太多的鬥士，在那兒待不長，所以現在誰肯讓我站前頭，我就替誰打。

I fought in the vanguard of Morgul raids, descended from those who served the Witch-king himself. Twenty battles, never once turned back. My blade has tasted elf-blood, dwarf-blood, the blood of men. The battle-fury runs strong in my veins, I am what orcs were made to be.
我曾作爲魔古爾突襲隊的先鋒作戰，血脈可追溯到侍奉巫王本人的那些人。二十場戰鬥，我從未退縮。我的刀嘗過精靈的血、矮人的血，也嘗過人類的血。戰鬥的狂怒在我血管裏奔湧，我正是奧克被造出來該有的樣子。
I fought the goblins of Blue Craig at Dwarrowgate until I broke an order to chase them home. I want a fight worth having.
我曾在矮人之門對抗藍巖半獸人，後來違令追到它們老巢。我想找場值得打的仗。

I gave away the chief's wound-wine and bandages to anyone who asked, even a captured Haradrim scout, and the chief took the strap to my back for wasting his stores on the enemy. I did not stay to see what he planned next.
誰開口，我就把酋長的傷酒和繃帶給誰，連一個被俘的哈拉德斥候也給了。酋長說我把他的物資浪費在敵人身上，拿皮帶抽了我的背。我沒留下來等他下一招。

I grew too clever. I sold one back-door passage to a rival chief, only one, for a pit of salt-meat and three slaves. A slave talked. The Great Goblin's boys came for my fingers, and I left through a hole they did not know I had.
後來，我聰明過頭了。我把一條後門通道賣給敵對的酋長，就一條，換了滿坑的醃肉和三個奴隸。有個奴隸說漏了嘴，半獸人王的手下就來要我的手指。我從他們不知道的洞裏跑了。
I grew up in the Eastfold, where the wild horses still run free and the Easterlings probe our borders. My father was a herder, not a soldier, but he taught me to read the land and the wind.
我在東伏爾德長大，那裏野馬仍自由奔跑，東夷也不斷試探我們的邊境。我父親是牧人，不是士兵，但他教會我讀懂土地和風。

I grew up in the back alleys of Dol Guldur, learning to survive by wit and quick hands. Eventually, I was recruited by the Necromancer's intelligence network, using my skills for the uruks of the fortress's benefit.
我在多古爾都的後巷長大，靠機敏和快手活下去。後來，死靈法師的情報網招募了我，讓我的本事爲要塞烏魯克效力。
I grew up in the back alleys of Imladris, learning to survive by wit and quick hands. Eventually, I was recruited by Lord Elrond's intelligence network, using my skills for the Eldar's benefit.
我在幽谷的後巷長大，靠機敏和快手活下去。後來，埃爾隆德大人的情報網招募了我，讓我的本事爲埃爾達效力。

I grew up in the back alleys of the Golden Wood, learning to survive by wit and quick hands. Eventually, I was recruited by Lord Celeborn and Lady Galadriel's intelligence network, using my skills for the Galadhrim's benefit.
我在金色森林的後巷長大，靠機敏和快手活下去。後來，凱勒博恩大人和加拉德瑞爾夫人的情報網招募了我，讓我的本事爲加拉茲民效力。

I grew up in the back alleys of the Haven of Umbar, learning to survive by wit and quick hands. Eventually, I was recruited by the Corsair Lords's intelligence network, using my skills for the Corsairs of Umbar's benefit.
我在烏姆巴爾港的後巷里長大，靠機敏和快手活下來。後來，我被海盜領主的情報網招募，把自己的本事用來爲烏姆巴爾的海盜效力。

I grew up in the back alleys of the Woodland Realm, learning to survive by wit and quick hands. Eventually, I was recruited by King Thranduil's intelligence network, using my skills for the Silvan Elves's benefit.
我在林地王國的後巷長大，靠機敏和快手活下去。後來，瑟蘭杜伊國王的情報網招募了我，讓我的本事爲西爾凡精靈效力。

I grew up in the back alleys of the eastern steppes, learning to survive by wit and quick hands. Eventually, I was recruited by the Kagan's intelligence network, using my skills for the Easterlings's benefit.
我在東方草原的後巷里長大，靠機敏和快手活下來。後來，我被可汗的情報網招募，把自己的本事用來爲東夷效力。

I grew up in the back alleys of the hills of Dunland, learning to survive by wit and quick hands. Eventually, I was recruited by the clan chiefs's intelligence network, using my skills for the Dunlendings's benefit.
我在黑蠻地丘陵的後巷長大，靠機敏和快手活下去。後來，氏族酋長的情報網招募了我，讓我的本事爲黑蠻地人效力。

I grew up in the back alleys of the lands of Harad, learning to survive by wit and quick hands. Eventually, I was recruited by the Serpent Lords's intelligence network, using my skills for the Haradrim's benefit.
我在哈拉德諸地的後巷里長大，靠機敏和快手活下來。後來，我被巨蛇領主的情報網招募，把自己的本事用來爲哈拉德人效力。

I grew up in the reed marshes of Swanfleet, where my father hunted wildfowl and my mother salted eels for the barge traders. By fifteen I could put an arrow through a heron in flight. We ate what the marsh gave, and some winters it gave little.
我在天鵝澤的蘆葦沼澤長大，父親獵水鳥，母親醃鰻魚賣給駁船商人。十五歲時，我就能一箭射穿飛過的鷺鳥。沼澤給什麼，我們就喫什麼，有些冬天實在沒多少可喫的。
I grew up in the shadow of a war-camp, picking pockets among the warriors and fencing what they plundered. By the time I was grown, I could empty a chief's tent without waking the dogs.
我在軍營邊上長大，偷戰士的錢袋，替他們銷贓。等我長大，清空一個酋長的帳篷，都不用驚醒狗。

I grew up on the Coldfells, where my father hunted mountain hare and my mother spun fleece for the peddlers who climbed up from the valleys. By fifteen I could put an arrow through a raven on the wing. We lived on what the hunt gave, and some winters it gave little.
我在冷原長大，父親獵山兔，母親紡羊毛，賣給從谷地爬上來的小販。十五歲時，我就能一箭射穿飛過的渡鴉。我們靠打獵過活，有些冬天卻獵不到多少東西。

I grew up on the ice shore of Forochel, where my father hunted seal and my mother cured furs for the Lossoth traders. By fifteen I could put an arrow through a gull on the wing. We lived on what the hunt gave, and some winters it gave little.
我在佛洛赫爾的冰岸長大，父親獵海豹，母親替洛斯索斯商人硝制毛皮。十五歲時，我就能一箭射穿飛過的海鷗。我們靠打獵過活，有些冬天卻獵不到多少東西。

I grew up on the meadows near Wainwatch, where the wild horses still run free and the Wainriders probe our borders. My father was a herder, not a soldier, but he taught me to read the land and the wind.
我在戰車哨站附近的草甸長大，野馬還在那裏自由奔跑，戰車民卻不斷試探我們的邊界。父親是牧人，不是士兵，可他教會我看地形、辨風向。
I guarded a forge-pit. But I caved a skull with my hammer. He was a smith too. Dispute over stolen ore. No intent to slay.
我看守一座鍛爐坑。但我用錘子砸塌了一個頭骨。他也是鐵匠，我們爲被偷的礦石起了爭執。我本沒想殺他。
I guarded the Front Porch from the shelf above the gate. Anything that came up the road I put an arrow through. Dwarf scouts, tinkers, once a grey-cloaked man with a stick who got away.
我站在大門上方的巖臺，守前門廊。沿路上來的，不管什麼，我都射。矮人斥候、補鍋匠，還有一次是個披灰斗篷、拿棍子的人，他跑掉了。

I guided the iron caravans from Thorin's Halls along the Dwarf-road, through the Shire and on to Bree. I know every ford on the Brandywine, every inn that waters its beer and every hedge a hobbit thinks is his. The pay was poor for so much knowing.
我替梭林大廳的運鐵商隊帶路，沿矮人路穿過夏爾，一直到布理。白蘭地河的每處渡口，哪家旅店往啤酒裏摻水，哪道籬笆被哪個霍比特人認作自家的，我全知道。懂得這麼多，工錢卻太少。
I handle problems others lack the stomach for, permanently and quietly.
我能處理別人沒膽量處理的問題，永遠地、安靜地處理掉。
I have a few coins, a sharp blade and a talent for slipping out of trouble that I should not be proud of. I am, and the clans never forget a face.
我有幾個錢、一把快刀，還有一身脫身的本事，本來不該拿這個自豪。可我就是自豪，而那些氏族，見過的臉從來不會忘。
I have a gift for you.
I have a sword, a good horse, and a lesson I have only half learned about what men follow. I do not intend to lose a second command.
我有一把劍、一匹好馬。人爲什麼肯追隨一個首領，這個教訓我只學明白了一半。我不打算再丟第二支隊伍。
I have good friends in every port from the Gulf of Lune to the Misty foothills, which is to say, no friends at all, only buyers. Everything can be sold, even a warband's lunch.
從路恩灣到迷霧山脈山腳，各處港口都有我的好朋友。也就是說，根本沒朋友，只有買家。什麼都能賣，戰團的午飯也能。
I have goods I need sold.
I have kept my coin and lost my place. I still know every buyer from the Vales to the Anduin ford. Anything can be sold, including you, though not today.
錢保住了，位置丟了。從河谷到安都因河渡口的買家，我還是個個都認得。什麼都能賣，包括你，不過今天不賣。
I have made fortunes and lost them, and learned to laugh at both. Pull up a seat for the telling.
我賺過大錢，也賠光過大錢，並學會了對兩者都笑一笑。拉把椅子來聽吧。
I have men to spare for your people.
我有些多餘的人手，可以交給你們。
I have men to spare. Take them into your service, as a gift.
我有多餘的人手，送給你，讓他們爲你效力。
I have need of strong backs, traveller.
我需要一些能幹重活的人，旅人。
I have no house now and no name in the Blue Mountains, and no shame in what I know. The roads of Eriador are full of folk who will pay a guide who sees things as they are.
如今我在藍色山脈沒了家族，也沒了名字，可我不覺得自己知道這些有什麼丟臉。埃利阿多的路上，多的是肯花錢請個看得清世道的嚮導的人。
I have no more news of the holds near here. You know all that I know.
附近據點的消息，我沒有更多可說的了。你知道的已和我一樣多。
I have no mûmak to bring you, but I bring the judgment that kept them alive. Use it.
我沒有猛獁能帶給你，但我帶來了讓它們活下來的判斷力。用它吧。
I have no use for bad luck in my host.
I have not held a command since. The Havens are quiet and I cannot bear quiet, so I take my small lessons out into the larger world.
那以後，我再沒當過指揮官。灰港很安靜，我受不了安靜，就帶着這點教訓，去了更廣大的世界。
I have nothing but a head for sums and a long list of men who owe me. I intend to collect from every one of them before I die.
現在我只剩算賬的腦子，還有一長串欠我錢的人。死之前，我要挨個把賬討回來。
I have nothing more to tell you of the holds around here.
附近的據點，我沒有更多消息可說了。
I have one horse left, the colt I could not bear to part with, and a saddle that is still mine. The plains still call me, but no clan will receive me.
我只剩一匹馬，就是那匹始終捨不得放手的小馬，還有一副仍屬於我的鞍子。平原還在呼喚我，可沒哪個氏族肯收留我。
I have orders for you, Provender-master.
I have seen too many die from wounds that could have been healed...
我見過太多人死於本可治好的傷……
I have set more bones than I have broken, which on the steppe is a strange thing to say. Sit, and I will tell you why I wander.
我接過的骨頭比我打斷的還多，這在草原上算是句怪話。坐下，我告訴你我爲什麼流浪。
I have spent more years among the great beasts than among men, and trust them further. But I will speak plainly with you.
我和巨獸相處的年頭，比和人相處的還多，也更信得過它們。但我會對你直說。
I have stood in the shadow of a fallen king, and I have never quite left it...
我曾站在一位逝去國王的陰影下，從沒真正走出來……
I have tended the dying of great Houses. One learns patience, and the worth of plain speech. Ask what you will.
我照料過許多大家族的垂死之人。人會因此學會耐心，也學會直白的話有多值錢。你想問什麼就問吧。
I have the bags yet. I have no ponies. I will ride whatever you give me, and I will count every coin you pay, twice.
袋子還在，小馬沒了。給我什麼我就騎什麼，你付的每枚錢幣，我都數兩遍。
I have walked many paths and protected these lands from shadows that most folk never see.
我走過許多道路，也曾守護這些土地，抵擋那些大多數人從未見過的陰影。
I have walked the Barrow-downs since I could walk. Do not ask me to be gentle there...
從會走路起，我就在古冢崗轉悠。到了那裏，別指望我手軟……
I have walked the Ettenmoors since I could walk. Do not ask me to be gentle there...
從會走路起，我就在埃滕荒原轉悠。到了那裏，別指望我手軟……
I have walked the Weather Hills since I could walk. Do not ask me to be gentle there...
從會走路起，我就在風雲丘陵轉悠。到了那裏，別指望我手軟……
I have watched this country for thirty years. Ask me anything about the plains and I will tell you who is riding across them.
我看了這片地方三十年。想問平原上的事，儘管問，誰騎馬經過我都知道。
I have word that brigands lie in wait for my caravan on the road ahead. Spring their trap and break them before they bleed me dry.
我得到消息，前面的路上有強盜正埋伏着，等我的商隊經過。將計就計，趁他們還沒把我搶個精光，打垮他們。
I held a bow on the Front Porch for Goblin-town. Anything that comes up the road, I shoot, and I will do it for coin anywhere.
我拿着弓守過半獸人鎮的前門廊。沿路上來的，我就射。只要付錢，在哪兒我都這麼幹。

I held a ford near Thornbrook with thirty spears when a larger band of orcs came through from the south. My captain withdrew in the night and left us the order to hold. I held it, and eleven men died before help arrived.
我帶着三十名矛手守荊棘溪附近的一處渡口，南邊來了一支人數更多的奧克隊伍。我的隊長連夜撤走，只留下命令，讓我們死守。我守住了，可援軍趕到之前，死了十一個人。

I held a ford on the Great River with thirty spears when a larger band of orcs came down from the mountains. My captain withdrew in the night and left us the order to hold. I held it, and eleven men died before help arrived.
我帶着三十名矛手守大河的一處渡口，山裏下來了一支人數更多的奧克隊伍。我的隊長連夜撤走，只留下命令，讓我們死守。我守住了，可援軍趕到之前，死了十一個人。

I held a ford on the Redwater with thirty spears when a larger band came through from the east. My captain withdrew in the night and left us the order to hold. I held it, and eleven men died before help arrived.
我帶着三十名矛手守紅水河的一處渡口，東邊來了一支人數更多的敵軍。我的隊長連夜撤走，只留下命令，讓我們死守。我守住了，可援軍趕到之前，死了十一個人。

I held a ford on the River Running with thirty spears when a larger band came through from the east. My captain withdrew in the night and left us the order to hold. I held it, and eleven men died before help arrived.
我帶着三十名矛手守奔流河的一處渡口，東邊來了一支人數更多的敵軍。我的隊長連夜撤走，只留下命令，讓我們死守。我守住了，可援軍趕到之前，死了十一個人。

I held a place in the Great Goblin's own guard, a post for whoever could crack a skull and not be missed. My company kept the throne-cave and the hot stair. We were thirty. We were the best the tunnels grew.
我曾在半獸人王的親衛裏佔個位子。要幹這活，就得能砸爛別人的腦袋，死了也沒人惦記。我們守着王座洞窟和灼熱的階梯，一共三十個，是那些地道里挑出來的最強者。
I held a rear guard for one of the old captains after the last great defeat. Forty orcs, one pass, a long retreat. I learned how to keep an army alive by deciding who does not get to live.
上次大敗後，我替一位老隊長帶後衛。四十個奧克，一處隘口，掩護大軍一路撤退。我學會了一件事：要讓軍隊活下來，得先決定誰不能活。
I held the Luinkrag road for the Craig and fought the elf patrols of Lindon. A spear-arm is always wanted on the coast, and I carry mine.
我替藍巖守過路因克拉格的道路，也跟林頓的精靈巡邏隊打過。海邊總缺使矛的，我就帶着傢伙來了。

I held the shield-wall at Dwarrowgate for nine winters against the Blue Craig raiders, and I trained the young hewers there in axe-work and in how to keep their feet when the line pushes. We gave the goblins no quarter. They learned to come at night.
我在矮人之門守了九個冬天的盾牆，抵擋藍巖劫掠者，也教年輕開鑿工用斧，教他們在陣線推擠時站穩腳跟。我們不留半獸人的活口，它們也就學會了夜裏來。

I hid my take in a cairn above Luinkrag, and a rival clan found it, and the chief heard from them that I held back. His men came with spears. I left everything: the cairn, the maps, my sleeping fur, with only my knives and three coins.
我把私藏的東西放在路因克拉格上方的一處石冢裏，被敵對氏族找到了。他們告訴酋長，我藏了私。他的手下提着矛來，我把石冢、地圖、睡覺的皮毛全丟下，只帶刀和三枚錢幣跑了。
I hide in the scree and sell what I see. Nothing in the world stays hid from a scout who does not mind a kick. I only ask who pays last, and who pays most.
我藏在碎石坡裏，賣我看見的東西。只要斥候不怕挨踢，這世上就沒有查不到的事。我只問，誰最後給錢，誰給得最多。
I keep a lighter purse now, and no company at all. So here I stand, an honest wanderer at last, for want of better offers. I will admit the grain was not my best work.
現在我的錢袋輕了，一個手下也沒了。這不，因爲沒人給更好的買賣，總算成了個老實流浪漢。我承認，糧食那筆確實做得不太光彩。
I keep a smaller purse now, and a smaller company, which is to say none. Here I am, an honest wanderer at last, if only for lack of opportunity. I will admit the grain was not my finest work.
現在我錢袋小了，隊伍也小了，說白了就是一個手下都沒有。總算成了個老實流浪漢，哪怕只是沒了作惡的機會。我承認，糧食那筆買賣確實不太光彩。
I kept my honor and lost my post, since the elder could not forgive having been wrong. Now I ride where a warning is still welcome. It is a short list.
我保住了名譽，卻丟了差事，因爲長老容不得有人證明他錯了。現在，哪裏肯聽警報，我就往哪裏跑。這樣的地方可不多。
I kept my honor and lost my post, since the lord could not forgive having been wrong. Now I ride where a warning is still welcome. It is a short list.
我保住了名譽，卻丟了差事，因爲領主容不得有人證明他錯了。現在，哪裏肯聽警報，我就往哪裏跑。這樣的地方可不多。

I kept my oath to the king and broke my word to them, and I cannot say which weighs more. I have searched the old trails for the taken ever since, and I will not stop until I know what became of them.
我守住了對國王的誓言，卻違背了對他們的承諾。我說不清哪一個更重。此後我一直沿着古道尋找被擄走的人，不查清他們的下落，我不會停。
I kept my oath to the king and broke my word to them, and I cannot tell which weighs more. I have searched the old roads for the taken ever since. I will not stop until I know what became of them.
我守住了對國王的誓言，卻違背了對他們的承諾。我說不清哪一個更重。此後我一直沿着古道尋找被擄走的人，不查清他們的下落，我不會停。

I kept the harbor watch at Mithlond for three hundred years, planning how the Havens should answer anything that came up the Gulf of Lhûn. Círdan listened to my charts more often than he liked to admit.
我在米斯瀧德守港三百年，籌劃如何應對駛入舒恩灣的一切。奇爾丹聽我海圖的次數，比他願意承認的還多。
I kept the harbor watch at the Grey Havens, planning for every ship that comes up the Gulf. The Havens lean on that watch more than they admit.
我在灰港守過港口，爲每一條駛入海灣的船做好打算。港口對這道守衛的依賴，比他們肯承認的還深。

I kept the plunder for myself and paid my men in promises, and the promises ran out before the winter did. Half of them deserted at the next camp, and the rest followed me like ghosts until I let them go.
我獨吞了戰利品，只拿空話給手下抵餉。冬天還沒過完，那些承諾就撐不住了。到了下一個營地，一半人跑了，其餘人像鬼魂似的跟着我，直到我放他們走。

I kept the stores and the river wharves at Tharbad for the lord warden, who trusted my tally over his own eyes. I knew which bridge piers would stand the spring flood and to the week how long the grain would last. The merchants did not enjoy my company.
我曾替沙巴德守將管理倉庫和河港，他信我的清單，勝過自己的眼睛。哪些橋墩能撐過春汛，糧食還能喫幾個星期，我全知道。商人們可不愛跟我打交道。

I kept the stores and the siege works at Fornost Erain, under a marshal who trusted my reckoning over his own eyes. I knew which towers would hold and which would fall, and to the day how long the grain would last. Few in the capital liked how I spoke of it.
我在佛諾斯特·埃萊因管物資和攻城工事，那位元帥信我的計算，勝過自己的眼睛。哪座塔能撐住、哪座會倒，糧食能喫到哪一天，我全知道。可都城沒幾個人愛聽我說這些。

I kept the stores and the wall-works at Cameth Brin, under a castellan who trusted my tally over his own eyes. I knew which stretches of wall would hold and which would crack, and to the day how long the grain would last. Few in the tower liked how I spoke of it.
我在卡梅斯布林管物資和城牆修繕，堡主信我的計算，勝過自己的眼睛。哪段牆撐得住、哪段會開裂，糧食能喫到哪一天，我全知道。可塔裏沒幾個人愛聽我說這些。

I kept the tribute-ledgers of clan Kûmaraknis. Every head of cattle, every weight of silver the tribes owed the Taskral passed under my reckoning. I knew to the grain what each fortress could pay, and what it tried to hide.
我曾掌管庫馬拉克尼斯氏族的貢賦賬冊。各部族欠塔斯克拉爾的每一頭牛、每一份銀子，都要經我的手覈算。我精確知道每座堡壘能交出多少，又試圖藏起多少。

I killed a superior officer and several guards, made it look like an accident during a training melee. Then systematically eliminated witnesses, quietly, carefully. Took their possessions, their rations, their weapons. When suspicion finally turned my way, I'd already accumulated enough resources to flee comfortably.
我殺了一名上級軍官和幾名守衛，把現場僞裝成訓練混戰中的意外。之後又有條不紊地清除目擊者，安靜，小心。再拿走他們的財物、口糧和武器。等懷疑終於轉向我時，我已經攢夠了能舒舒服服逃走的資源。

I know Saruman's plans, his weaknesses, his network of agents and allies. That information is worth fortunes to his enemies, or his potential partners. I trade in secrets now, selling to all sides. In the coming war, intelligence will be as valuable as armies.
我知道薩茹曼的計劃、弱點，以及他的密探和盟友網絡。這些情報對他的敵人值一大筆錢，對他潛在的合作伙伴也一樣。現在我做祕密買賣，賣給各方。在即將到來的戰爭裏，情報會和軍隊一樣值錢。
I know every back way and every liar between here and the sea; hire me, and watch me.
從這裏到海邊，每條偏僻小路、每個騙子，我都熟。僱我吧，也盯着我。
I know every ford between the Greyflood and the Hoarwell, and my bow does not miss in the dark. Ride with me, and you will not walk into an ambush anywhere in Eriador.
灰水河與蒼泉河之間的每一處渡口，我都瞭如指掌。我的箭在黑夜中也不會落空。帶上我，在埃利阿多的任何地方，你都不會一頭撞進埋伏。
I know every trade route and every threat upon them, information worth its weight in gold.
我知道每一條商路，也知道路上的每一種威脅，這些情報價值等同黃金。

I know every trade route, every bandit camp, every corrupt official from here to Gondor. That knowledge has value to those who operate outside the law. I've already lost my honor, might as well profit from its absence.
我知道每一條商路、每一個強盜營地，也知道從這裏到剛鐸有哪些腐敗官員。對那些在法律之外做事的人來說，這些知識很值錢。我已經失去了榮譽，倒不如從沒有榮譽這件事裏賺點錢。
I know every trail and ford in Rhovanion, and my horse has never failed me. That is what I bring.
羅瓦尼安每條小路、每處渡口我都熟，我的馬也從沒讓我失望。這就是我的本事。
I know every trail and ford in the Riddermark, and my horse has never failed me. That is what I bring.
我熟悉裏德馬克每一條小路和每一處渡口，我的馬也從未讓我失望。這就是我能帶來的東西。
I know the eastern roads and the minds of men who ignore warnings. I will ride ahead for you.
我熟悉東邊的道路，也知道不聽警告的人都是什麼心思。我可以替你在前頭探路。
I know the markets within reach. The farther the town, the bigger my cut.
附近的集市我都熟，城鎮越遠，我收的分成就越多。
I know the mountain roads and the minds of men who ignore warnings. I will ride ahead for you.
我熟悉山路，也知道不聽警告的人都是什麼心思。我可以替你在前頭探路。
I know the roads, the fords and the thieves on them. Whether that keeps your wagons safe or empties someone else's is up to you.
道路、渡口，還有路上的賊，我全熟。用來保住你的貨車，還是掏空別人的，由你決定。
I know the southern roads and the minds of men who ignore warnings. I will ride ahead for you.
我熟悉南方道路，也知道不聽警告的人都是什麼心思。我可以替你在前頭探路。
I know the worth of a good horse, and the worth of a debt, down to the last copper...
一匹好馬值多少，一筆債又值多少，我連最後一枚銅子都算得清……
I know trade routes and their vulnerabilities, useful for protection or... otherwise.
我知道商路和它們的弱點，能用來保護，也能用來做……別的事。
I know warfare by water and land, if you need such skills.
我精通水陸作戰，只要你需要。
I lay in the reeds at the Gladden Fields for three days at a time, bow in the mud, waiting for river boats. Woodmen traders, fishermen, anyone with a cargo. A good shot needs no warband.
我在金鳶尾沼地的蘆葦裏一趴就是三天，弓放在泥裏，等河上的船。林中居民的商人、漁夫，只要帶着貨就行。箭法好，用不着帶戰團。
I lead from the front and fight harder than any I command, proven repeatedly.
我身先士卒，戰鬥得比任何手下都更兇，這一點已經反覆證明過。
I lead with honor and fight to win. Give me your trust and you will have mine.
我帶兵講榮譽，打仗求勝。你信任我，我也就信任你。
I lead with honor and fight with conviction, qualities that transcend politics.
我以榮譽領兵，憑信念戰鬥，這些品質不受政治限制。

I learned that a ledger can be a plea if you write it well. Now I go from hold to hold gathering food, coin and sworn blades for those families. Rhudaur is poor, but there is more kindness in it than anyone admits.
那時我明白了，賬冊寫得好，也能替人求條活路。如今我挨個堡壘奔走，給那些人家募集食物、錢財和願意出力的戰士。魯道爾雖窮，可心善的人，比大家嘴上說的多。

I learned that a ledger can be a plea if you write it well. Now I go from town to town gathering food, coin and sworn blades for those families. Cardolan is not rich, but there is more kindness in it than anyone admits.
那時我明白了，賬冊寫得好，也能替人求條活路。如今我挨個城鎮奔走，給那些人家募集食物、錢財和願意出力的戰士。卡多藍雖不富裕，可心善的人，比大家嘴上說的多。

I learned that a ledger can be a plea if you write it well. Now I go from town to town gathering food, coin and sworn blades for those families. The North is poor, but there is more kindness in it than anyone admits.
那時我明白了，賬冊寫得好，也能替人求條活路。如今我挨個城鎮奔走，給那些人家募集食物、錢財和願意出力的戰士。北方雖窮，可心善的人，比大家嘴上說的多。

I learned the cutting trade as a boy in a Variag war-camp, holding lamps while the camp surgeon sewed up men who had lost bets with an axe. By twenty I could set a bone, burn out a rot, and curse a fever faster than anyone south of the Ash Mountains.
小時候，我在瓦里亞格軍營學外科，舉着燈，看軍醫給那些跟斧頭較量輸了的人縫傷口。二十歲時，接骨、燒掉爛肉、咒罵發熱的病，我比灰燼山脈以南的誰都熟練。
I learned the long spear on the pitching decks of Lake-town's watch. Few things steady the hand like that.
我在長湖鎮的衛隊裏，在顛簸的甲板上練會了長矛。要練穩手，沒有幾種辦法比這更管用。
I learned the long spear on the pitching decks of the Old Ford ferries. Few things steady the hand like that.
我在老渡口顛簸的渡船甲板上練會了長矛。要練穩手，沒有幾種辦法比這更管用。
I learned the long spear on the pitching decks of the Redwater watch. Few things steady the hand like that.
我在紅水衛隊顛簸的甲板上練會了長矛。要練穩手，沒有幾種辦法比這更管用。
I learned the long spear on the swaying plank-ways of Woodmen-town. Few things steady the hand like that.
我在林中居民鎮搖晃的木板道上練會了長矛。要練穩手，沒有幾種辦法比這更管用。

I learned too much. Saruman's plans, his communications with other powers, the true scope of his ambitions. When I questioned certain orders, not out of mercy, but logic, he grew suspicious. Smart servants become dangerous servants. I departed before becoming another failed experiment dissolved in the pits.
我知道得太多了。薩茹曼的計劃，他同其他勢力的通信，還有他野心真正的規模。當我質疑某些命令時，不是出於憐憫，而是出於邏輯，他開始起疑。聰明的僕從會變成危險的僕從。於是我在被當成又一個失敗實驗、溶進坑裏之前離開了。
I led boat-raids out of Blue Craig against the coast of Lindon. A captain with a plan finds work, and I sell mine where they pay.
我帶船從藍巖出發，劫掠過林頓海岸。有計劃的隊長總能找到活，誰出錢，我就把計劃賣給誰。
I led forty men on the East Road, sworn to the king and to each other. We held the road between Last Bridge and the Trollshaws for three summers. Every man of mine could be trusted at my back.
我曾在東西大道帶領四十人，既向國王效忠，也彼此立過誓。我們在最後大橋和食人妖森林之間守了三個夏天。背後有他們任何一個，我都放得下心。
I led forty men on the Greenway, sworn to the king and to each other. We held the road between Bree and the Barrow-downs for three summers. Every man of mine could be trusted at my back.
我曾在綠大道帶領四十人，既向國王效忠，也彼此立過誓。我們在布理和古冢崗之間守了三個夏天。背後有他們任何一個，我都放得下心。
I led forty men on the Greenway, sworn to the king and to each other. We held the road from Sarn Ford down to Tharbad for three summers. Every man of mine could be trusted at my back.
我曾在綠大道帶領四十人，既向國王效忠，也彼此立過誓。我們在薩恩渡口到沙巴德的道路上守了三個夏天。背後有他們任何一個，我都放得下心。
I led forty riders at nineteen. I would have led four hundred, given the chance.
十九歲時，我就帶過四十個騎兵。給我機會，四百個我也帶得了。
I led raids on the passes for the Goblin-town host. A captain with a good plan always finds work, and I take it where it pays.
我替半獸人鎮的大軍帶隊劫掠過隘口。會做計劃的隊長不愁活幹，哪兒給錢，我就去哪兒。

I led shock troops in the eastern campaigns, the ones sent first into fortified positions. My warband specialized in pure brutality, no prisoners, no quarter, nothing left standing. We broke strongholds that had stood for centuries. The captains praised our effectiveness while keeping their distance from our methods.
我在東方戰役中率領突擊部隊，專門第一個衝進敵人的堅固陣地。我的戰團只擅長純粹的殘暴：不留俘虜，不施憐憫，不讓任何東西站着。我們攻破過屹立數百年的要塞。那些隊長一邊稱讚我們的效率，一邊又和我們的手段保持距離。

I led the raiding lances of clan Ezarkia, foremost of the nine tribes of Shaghâna. From the saddle I broke caravans and border forts alike, and brought back more plunder than any rider of my year. The Taskral himself knew my name.
我曾統領埃扎基亞氏族的突襲騎槍隊。埃扎基亞是沙加納九大部族中最顯赫的一支。我在馬背上擊破過商隊，也攻破過邊境堡壘，帶回的戰利品比同輩任何騎手都多。塔斯克拉爾本人都知道我的名字。

I led warbands against the Rohirrim, raiding their villages, burning their fields. No mercy, no hesitation, absolute results. My units left nothing alive, not warriors, not elderly, not children. Saruman wanted fear spread through Rohan, and I delivered it in rivers of blood.
我曾率戰團襲擊洛希爾人，劫掠他們的村莊，燒掉他們的田地。不留憐憫，不許猶豫，只要絕對的結果。我的部隊不留活口，不管戰士、老人還是孩子。薩茹曼想讓恐懼在洛汗蔓延，而我用血河把恐懼送了過去。
I left before I lost what humanity remained. Now I fight only those who can fight back. The line between warrior and butcher is thinner than most admit. I've been both, and prefer the former.
在剩下的人性也失去之前，我離開了。如今我只和能還手的人作戰。戰士和屠夫之間的界線，比大多數人願意承認的更薄。我兩者都做過，現在更願意做前者。
I left before the hearing, with my purse and my maps. Call me a traitor if you like. I sold a schedule, not a gate, and I still know every road in Minhiriath.
我沒等開審，就帶着錢袋和地圖走了。你愛叫我叛徒就叫吧。我賣的是時辰表，不是城門，而且明希瑞亞斯每條路我還是都認得。
I left before the hearing, with my purse and my maps. Call me a traitor if you like. I sold a schedule, not a gate, and I still know every road in the North.
我沒等開審，就帶着錢袋和地圖走了。你愛叫我叛徒就叫吧。我賣的是時辰表，不是城門，而且北方每條路我還是都認得。
I left before the hearing, with my purse and my maps. Call me a traitor if you like. I sold a timetable, not a gate, and I still know every road between the rivers.
我沒等開審，就帶着錢袋和地圖走了。你愛叫我叛徒就叫吧。我賣的是時辰表，不是城門，而且兩河之間每條路我還是都認得。
I left before they could chain me to tradition. Now I wander, healing those who need it and fighting when I must. The Enemy doesn't care about our conventions - why should we limit ourselves?
我在他們用各種傳統束縛住我之前就溜走了。如今我四處遊蕩，救治有需要的人，在迫不得已時拔劍戰鬥。敵人才不關心我們的傳統呢——爲什麼我們偏要作繭自縛？
I left that night. Since then I have stitched men across Cardolan, by roadside fires and in drovers' camps. I am not gentle, but my patients walk away more often than not.
那天夜裏我就走了。從那以後，卡多藍的路邊篝火旁、趕牲口的營地裏，都有我替人縫傷的身影。我手不輕，但我救的人，多半能自己走着離開。
I left that night. Since then I have stitched men across the North, by roadside fires and in rangers' camps. I am not gentle, but my patients walk away more often than not.
那天夜裏我就走了。從那以後，北方的路邊篝火旁、遊民營地裏，都有我替人縫傷的身影。我手不輕，但我救的人，多半能自己走着離開。
I left that night. Since then I have stitched men across the hills, by roadside fires and in shepherds' huts. I am not gentle, but my patients walk away more often than not.
那天夜裏我就走了。從那以後，羣山間的路邊篝火旁、牧羊人的小屋裏，都有我替人縫傷的身影。我手不輕，但我救的人，多半能自己走着離開。
I left the court's poisoned air to seek real service. Let them play their games - I'll defend Gondor with steel, not genealogies. True nobility is earned, not inherited.
我離開污濁的宮廷，是爲了尋求真正的奉獻。讓他們玩弄權術吧，我將用鋼劍而非家譜來保衛剛鐸。真正的貴族身份是贏得的，而非繼承來的。
I look foul and feel fair.
我看着不像好人，但心裏是個好人。
I lost a company once. Forty spears, and I buried none of them...
我曾丟掉一整隊人。四十支長矛，卻沒有一個人是我埋的……
I lost a company once. Forty swords, and I buried none of them...
我曾丟掉一整隊人。四十把劍，卻沒有一個是我埋的……
I lost the manor before I had seen it. Since then I have lived by wit, which is thin fare in a land of horsemen and spears. I did kill the four goblins, though. Nobody ever mentions that.
那座莊園我還沒見着，就給收回去了。此後我靠耍小聰明過日子，可在這滿是騎兵和長矛的地方，這本事不太頂飽。不過那四個半獸人確實是我殺的，這倒從來沒人提。
I made a promise at Combe once, and I have not yet found a way to keep it...
我曾在庫姆村許過一個諾，到現在也沒找到兌現的辦法……
I made a promise at Downsend once, and I have not yet found a way to keep it...
我曾在崗尾許過一個諾，到現在也沒找到兌現的辦法……
I made a promise in Ettendale once, and I have not yet found a way to keep it...
我曾在埃滕谷許過一個諾，到現在也沒找到兌現的辦法……
I make it my business to know things, and to know whom to tell. So, what is it worth to you to know me?
我的生意就是知道事情，也知道該告訴誰。那麼，認識我對你值多少錢？
I make steel others cannot. Keep me in iron and coal and you will not be sorry.
我能煉出別人煉不出的鋼。給足鐵和煤，你不會後悔。

I managed armed caravans to the far kingdoms, Gondor, Rohan, sometimes even the Woodland Realm. Negotiated with my tongue, fought with my axe when words failed. Profitable work, until I noticed patterns. Dark folk asking questions, movements of suspicious groups.
我曾管理前往遠方王國的武裝商隊，去過剛鐸、洛汗，有時甚至到林地王國。談得攏時用舌頭談，談不攏時用斧頭打。那是賺錢的活兒，直到我察覺到規律：黑暗之民在打聽消息，可疑隊伍也在移動。

I managed supply lines for the northern armies, weapons, armor, food for the warbands. Not glorious work, but essential. More importantly, it taught me the value of things, the flow of resources, and how easily inventory records can be... adjusted. The Dark Lord has many servants; he doesn't notice a few missing crates.
我曾管理北方軍隊的補給線，負責給戰團調配武器、護甲和糧食。這活兒不光彩，但不可或缺。更重要的是，它教會了我物資的價值、資源流動的路線，以及庫存記錄有多容易被……調整。黑暗魔君的僕從太多，少幾箱東西他不會注意到。

I managed trade caravans between Erebor and Dale, sometimes ranging to Lake-town and beyond. Profitable work, respectable position. But gold has a way of tempting even honest dwarves. The opportunity was too perfect, the amount too tempting.
我曾管理孤山和河谷城之間的商隊，有時還會去長湖鎮和更遠的地方。那是賺錢的活兒，也是體面的職位。但黃金總有辦法誘惑哪怕誠實的矮人。機會太完美，數目也太誘人。
I mapped the deep ways under the High Pass for Goblin-town. Chiefs pay for a guide who knows the tunnels, so I walk for whoever pays.
我替半獸人鎮畫過高隘口下面的深層地道。知道路的嚮導，酋長們都願意掏錢，所以誰付錢我就跟誰走。

I marched with Gil-galad's host in the last days of the Second Age, young then and sure of the plan. I saw the High King fall on the slopes of Orodruin, and I came home to Lindon with the other survivors, to a realm that was now only a memory of a kingdom.
第二紀元的最後那些日子，我隨吉爾-加拉德的大軍出征。那時年輕，對計劃深信不疑。我看着至高王倒在歐洛朱因的山坡上，與其他倖存者回到林頓。那個國度，如今只剩對昔日王國的回憶。
I may need to send you a message later. Can I dispatch a messenger to you?
之後我可能需要給你傳消息。可以派信使去找你嗎？
I mean to make my fortune in trade, traveller, but I need the goods to start. Bring me the stock and I will turn it to gold for us both.
旅人，我想靠做生意發財，可還缺第一批貨。你把貨物帶來，我把它們賣成錢，讓咱們兩個都能賺上一筆。
I mean to take what is rightfully mine, but the enemy's strength stands in the way. Break his forces in the field and the prize will fall the easier.
我打算拿走本該屬於我的東西，可敵軍擋在前面。打垮他們的野戰部隊，目標就更容易到手了。
I mourn no orcs, only the two who followed me. I walk alone now, and a spear is wasted without a line at its back. Let it be a line worth the trouble.
我不替奧克難過，只難過那兩個跟着我的人。現在我獨自走路，可長矛背後沒條陣線，再好也白搭。要跟，就跟個值得的。
I need a war to feed and a dwarf to kill. I am yours until I have both.
我得找場仗打個痛快，再宰個矮人。兩樣沒辦到之前，我就跟着你。
I need fighters, not an elder past his riding years.
我需要戰士，不需要過了騎戰年紀的長老。
I need warriors, a chieftain's throne. But I won't sell our pits for a foolish strike, leaving my dam and spawn to starve.
我需要戰士，也需要酋長的寶座。但我不會爲了打一場蠢仗就賣掉我們的礦坑，讓我娘和崽子們餓死。

I noticed the Master's toll-men taking more silver than they ever wrote down. I kept my own tally and took it to the council, and I was struck from the watch rolls before the ink dried. The week before, I had let a starving boy go, so I was blamed for that too.
我發現鎮長手下收稅的人，收的銀子比記下的多。我自己記了賬，交給議事會，墨還沒幹，鎮衛隊就把我的名字劃掉了。前一週我放走過一個快餓死的男孩，他們連這事也算到了我頭上。

I noticed the ford-wardens taking more silver in tolls than they ever wrote down. I kept my own tally and took it to the elders, and I was struck from the watch rolls before the ink dried. The week before, I had let a starving boy go, so I was blamed for that too.
我發現渡口的管事，收的過路銀子比記下的多。我自己記了賬，交給長老，墨還沒幹，守衛隊就把我的名字劃掉了。前一週我放走過一個快餓死的男孩，他們連這事也算到了我頭上。

I noticed the harbor-master's toll-men taking more silver than they ever wrote down. I kept my own tally and took it to the council, and I was struck from the watch rolls before the ink dried. The week before, I had let a starving boy go, so I was blamed for that too.
我發現港務長手下收稅的人，收的銀子比記下的多。我自己記了賬，交給議事會，墨還沒幹，鎮衛隊就把我的名字劃掉了。前一週我放走過一個快餓死的男孩，他們連這事也算到了我頭上。

I noticed the toll-men at the Forest Gate taking more silver than they ever wrote down. I kept my own tally and took it to the council, and I was struck from the watch rolls before the ink dried. The week before, I had let a starving boy go, so I was blamed for that too.
我發現森林之門收路費的人，收的銀子比記下的多。我自己記了賬，交給議事會，墨還沒幹，守衛隊就把我的名字劃掉了。前一週我放走過一個快餓死的男孩，他們連這事也算到了我頭上。
I offer Iron Hills steel and stubbornness, both unbreakable.
我能提供鐵丘陵的鋼鐵與固執，兩者都堅不可摧。
I offer a rider's skill and a horse's wisdom, if you'll have them.
你若願意，我有騎手的本領，也懂馬的心思。
I offer a shield-maiden's courage, if you'll accept it.
你若肯接納，我願獻上持盾女戰士的勇氣。
I offer a warrior's skill and bitter experience, if you'll take them.
你若肯用，我有戰士的本領，也有喫苦換來的教訓。
I offer blade and healing herbs alike, if you need them.
我願奉上刀劍與診療的技藝，若你需要的話。
I offer decades of experience, if you'll trust gray hair.
我擁有數十年的經驗，只要你信任這頭白髮。
I offer dwarven steel and battlefield experience, both tested against dragon and orc.
我能提供矮人鋼鐵和戰場經驗，兩者都經受過巨龍與奧克的考驗。
I offer eager strength and sharp eyes, if you'll have them.
你若願意，我有使不完的力氣，也有一雙好眼睛。
I offer elite training and unwavering purpose, if you need them.
你若需要，我受過精銳訓練，認準的目標也絕不動搖。
I offer hard skills and harder lessons, if you need them.
你若需要，我有狠練出來的本領，也有更慘痛的教訓。
I offer healing arts and knowledge of the growing shadow, both desperately needed.
我能提供醫術，也瞭解正在增長的陰影，這兩樣都急需。
I offer my bow and woodland skills, if you'll have them.
我願獻上我的弓箭與叢林技藝，若您不嫌棄的話。
I offer my eyes, my bow, and my knowledge of the wild.
我能獻上眼睛、弓，以及對荒野的瞭解。
I offer my lance and knowledge of these lands, if you need them.
若你需要，我願獻上騎槍，以及我對這片土地的瞭解。
I offer noble training and common sense, if you value them.
我提供貴族訓練和常識，如果你重視它們的話。
I offer pure combat skill and the ambition to see things through, no half-measures.
我能獻上純粹的戰鬥本領，以及把事情做到底的野心，絕不半途而廢。
I offer refined skills and hard-won cynicism, if you need them.
我提供精湛的技藝，如果你需要的話。
I offer skills best not spoken of openly, if you need them.
如果你需要的話，我提供一些最好不公開談論的技能。
I offer tactical skill and the willingness to remove obstacles by any means necessary.
我能提供戰術本領，也願意用任何必要手段移除障礙。
I offer words and sword in equal measure, if you need them.
若你需要，我願以言辭與武藝助你。
I once counted every ship in the Havens by the tide, and every one of them by what it carried...
我曾按潮汐清點港口裏的每一條船，也記下每條船裝着什麼……
I own a mallet, a bad name and a map of every ford between here and the Ash Mountains. The dead in those pens never troubled my sleep, but the debt of an unpaid wage does.
現在我有一把木槌、一個臭名聲，還有一張標着這裏到灰燼山脈所有渡口的地圖。奴欄裏的死人從沒擾過我的覺，欠着不付的工錢倒會。
I piloted small boats through the shoals of the Gulf at night, and I knew which captains wanted their cargo unlooked at. Mithlond is a tidy harbor, but no harbor is as tidy as it appears.
我夜裏替小船引航，穿過海灣淺灘，也知道哪些船長不想讓人查貨。米斯瀧德是個乾淨港口，可沒有港口真像看起來那麼幹淨。
我同情你的損失，女奧克。
I plan campaigns for the war chiefs of the northern holds. Sooner or later every host needs someone who thinks ahead.
我替北方堡壘的戰酋籌劃戰役。每支大軍，早晚都得有個會提前動腦子的人。
I plan, you pay. If the trap closes, I will not be in it.
我出計劃，你出錢。陷阱合攏時，我可不會在裏面。
I planned the raids and ran the quays of Blue Craig. A tactician who can see an open road is worth more than a captain, and I hire out as one.
我安排過藍巖的劫掠，也管過碼頭。能找出暢通道路的戰術家，比隊長值錢，我就靠這個受僱。

I planned the road south for three hundred of our best, every ford and every ration, with the white hand on their shields at the end of it. Then one came back with a brand on his arm and a story about pits and digging. The pay stopped, and so did my nerve.
我們最好的三百個戰士往南走，路線由我安排，渡口、口糧，樣樣算清。等到了地方，他們的盾牌就畫上了白手。後來一個回來了，胳膊上有烙印，嘴裏說的全是坑洞和挖掘。錢斷了，我也怕了。

I pressed the matter, and was relieved of command for 'spreading panic.' Now I ride alone, gathering proof of the threat. The King grows deaf under his steward's counsel while danger gathers at our doorstep.
我堅持追問，結果因“散佈恐慌”被撤了職。如今我獨自騎行，蒐集危險的證據。總管的話讓國王越來越聽不進別的聲音，而危險就在家門口聚集。

I pressed the matter, and was relieved of command for 'spreading panic.' Now I ride alone, gathering proof of the threat. The King grows weak under Wormtongue's counsel while danger gathers at our doorstep.
我堅持追查此事，結果被以“散佈恐慌”爲由解除指揮權。現在我獨自騎行，收集威脅存在的證據。國王在佞舌的勸說下越來越虛弱，而危險正在我們門前聚集。
I propose an alliance between our realms.
我提議讓我們的國度結成聯盟。

I proposed doubling our patrols, fortifying the River Running. The council called me paranoid, said trade was more important than phantom threats. When I persisted, they questioned my courage, suggested the wars had broken my nerve. The insult was too much.
我提議把巡邏加倍，鞏固奔流河防線。議會說我多疑，說貿易比虛幻的威脅更重要。我堅持下去，他們就質疑我的勇氣，暗示戰爭已經把我的膽子嚇壞了。這種侮辱太過分。
I provide access to Isengard steel and know how to move it profitably.
我能弄到艾森加德鋼，也知道怎樣把它運出去賺錢。
I provide access to Mordor's supply networks and the knowledge to exploit them profitably.
我能接觸魔多的補給網絡，也知道怎樣把它們變成利潤。
I provide diplomatic access, cultural knowledge, and flexible morality, all for reasonable compensation.
我能提供外交門路、文化知識和靈活的道德，價格合理。
I provide hard-to-find equipment and black market connections, no questions asked or answered.
我能提供難弄到的裝備和黑市門路，不問問題，也不回答問題。
I provide intelligence on Mordor's operations and the means to gather more, for the right price.
我能提供魔多行動的情報，也能提供收集更多情報的辦法，只要價格合適。
I provide intelligence on Saruman's operations and plans, for appropriate compensation.
我能提供薩茹曼行動和計劃的情報，當然，要有合適的報酬。
I provide untraceable death through alchemy, problems solved with no evidence.
我能通過鍊金術帶來無法追查的死亡，讓問題消失而不留下證據。
I raided the Vales of Anduin and built the ladders and rams for the pass assaults. Goblins talk of omens; I say the work is the work.
我搶過安都因河谷，也造過攻打隘口用的梯子和撞錘。半獸人愛談凶兆，我只管把活幹了。

I raided the Vales of Anduin since I had teeth, and when the host wanted a gate broken I built the rams and ladders for it. Cattle, children's toys, the odd Beorning's roof. The pack laughed at my jokes and followed me anywhere. Then the shaman threw her bones for me.
我剛長牙就去安都因河谷劫掠。大軍要攻破城門，我就造撞錘和梯子。牛、孩子的玩具，偶爾連貝奧恩人的屋頂都搶。手下愛聽我的笑話，我去哪兒，他們就跟到哪兒。後來，薩滿給我擲骨佔了一卦。
I raided the coastal farms of the Gulf of Lune and built the ladders and ram-beams for the walls. The sea gives omens; I give a good joke.
我劫掠過路恩灣的海邊農場，造過翻牆的梯子和撞錘梁木。大海給凶兆，我給笑話。

I raided the coastal farms south of the Gulf, building the ladders and ram-beams for every wall, with a crew that laughed at every word of mine. Sheep, boats, nets, once a small bell from a village shrine. Everyone loved me in the grey hours before a raid.
我劫掠過海灣南邊的沿海農場。每道牆要用的梯子、撞錘梁木，都是我造的。手下聽我說什麼都笑。我們搶羊、搶船、搶網，有次還從村裏的神龕搶了口小鐘。每次劫掠前，天色灰濛濛的時候，大家都喜歡我。

I raised a warg from a pup in the Great Goblin's kennels. We rode the Vales of Anduin together, burning thatch and dragging off sheep. I kept every coin and every knucklebone from those raids in a hole under my sleeping rock.
我在半獸人王的獸欄裏，從小養大一頭座狼。我們一起去安都因河谷，燒茅屋，拖走羊。我把搶來的每枚錢幣、每塊指骨，都藏在睡覺的石頭底下。

I raised siege towers and rams for a war-chief of the high plains, cutting timber that we Variags had never bothered to use. When the chief's host marched on a Haradrim border fortress, my engines went with it, and its walls shook under them.
我曾替高原上的一個戰酋造攻城塔和撞錘，爲此砍了不少我們瓦里亞格人從前懶得用的木材。酋長的大軍攻打一座哈拉德邊境要塞時，帶上了我的器械，打得城牆直晃。

I ran a toll at Last Bridge with a dozen hard men, and for a long while it was almost legal. We took a share of every grain wagon bound for Cameth Brin and called it protection. The wagons were never robbed while we were paid, which is more than the king's patrols could say.
我帶着十幾個狠角色，在最後大橋收過路費。有很長一段日子，這事差不多還算合法。往卡梅斯布林運糧的車，我們每輛都抽一份，說是保平安。只要交錢，糧車就從沒被劫過，這一點國王的巡邏隊都不敢保證。

I ran a toll on the Greenway with a dozen hard men, and for a long while it was almost legal. We took a share of every grain wagon bound for Bree and called it protection. The wagons were never robbed while we were paid, which is more than the king's patrols could say.
我帶着十幾個狠角色，在綠大道收過路費。有很長一段日子，這事差不多還算合法。往布理運糧的車，我們每輛都抽一份，說是保平安。只要交錢，糧車就從沒被劫過，這一點國王的巡邏隊都不敢保證。

I ran a toll on the river road with a dozen hard men, and for a long while it was almost legal. We took a share of every grain wagon bound for Tharbad and called it protection. The wagons were never robbed while we were paid, which is more than the king's patrols could say.
我帶着十幾個狠角色，在河邊大道收過路費。有很長一段日子，這事差不多還算合法。往沙巴德運糧的車，我們每輛都抽一份，說是保平安。只要交錢，糧車就從沒被劫過，這一點國王的巡邏隊都不敢保證。

I ran goods and men across the steppe borders for clan Shakar: contraband the Taskral taxed too dear, slaves the fortresses wanted quietly, blades to whichever lord paid. I knew every dry wash and hidden well between the tribes and the eastern roads.
我曾爲沙卡爾氏族在草原邊境運送貨物和人：塔斯克拉爾課稅太重的違禁品、堡壘暗中想要的奴隸、賣給任何出價領主的刀劍。我知道各部族和東方道路之間的每一條幹涸溝谷、每一口隱蔽水井。

I ran the iron trade from Thorin's Halls to the Havens: bar iron down the Lune to the shipwrights of Harlond, tools and nails along the Dwarf-road to the Shire. I knew the prices in every market from Michel Delving to Mithlond, and I could keep a caravan fed and guarded on half what others spent.
我曾做梭林大廳到灰港的鐵生意：鐵條沿路恩河運到哈瀧德的造船匠手裏，工具和釘子則沿矮人路送往夏爾。從大洞鎮到米斯瀧德，每個市場的價錢我都熟。商隊的喫食和護衛，我只花別人一半的錢就能安排好。
I ran the same night, down to the Vales. Now I shoot for coin from the roadside, or for the pleasure. I have not missed anything bigger than a hare for two winters.
那天夜裏我就跑了，下到河谷。現在守在路邊替人放箭，有時收錢，有時圖個痛快。兩個冬天以來，只要比兔子大，我就沒射丟過。
I read the tides and bound the wounded in Blue Craig, on the cliffs of the Ered Luin. A healer who knows the sea has work wherever there are ships.
我在藍巖看潮，也治傷，就在埃瑞德路因的海崖上。懂海的醫師，只要有船，就有活幹。
I refused and was discharged for 'declining vision due to age.' My eyes see clearly enough - it's Gondor's leadership that's blind. Now I seek employment where honor still means something.
我拒絕了，結果因年齡導致視力下降被解職。我的眼睛看得清清楚楚——是剛鐸的領導層瞎了眼。現在我尋求在一個仍然重視榮譽的地方工作。

I refused their bribes and left the White City. Now I seek the true history of our people, traveling from Ithilien to Anórien, gathering tales from those who remember. The Shadow grows in the East, and we cannot face it with lies as our foundation.
我拒絕了他們的賄賂並離開了。如今我追尋着族人真實的歷史，從伊希利恩到阿諾瑞恩，收集那些尚存記憶者的故事。陰影在東方滋長，我們絕不能以謊言爲基石去面對它。
I refused to look away and paid the price. Now I range alone, using my skills to survive and help those who cross my path. The wilds are dangerous, but at least they're honest.
我拒絕移開目光，也爲此付出了代價。如今我獨自巡行，靠自己的本事活下去，也幫助路上遇見的人。荒野很危險，但至少誠實。

I reported honestly that a lord of Arthedain had lost a border holding through carelessness. The lord was a friend of the Havens, and my report was inconvenient. I was asked to rewrite it, politely, three times.
阿塞丹有位領主，因疏忽丟了邊境領地，我如實寫進報告。可那位領主是灰港的朋友，報告就礙事了。他們客客氣氣，請我改寫了三回。

I reported my suspicions, someone was mapping our trade routes, timing our guards. The guild masters called me paranoid, bad for business. When a caravan I'd warned about was destroyed, they blamed me for not being there, though they'd assigned me elsewhere. Politics and gold won over truth.
我報告了懷疑：有人在繪製我們的商路，計算護衛換防的時間。行會大師們說我多疑，說這樣不利於生意。後來一支我警告過的商隊被毀，他們反而怪我不在場，儘管是他們把我派到了別處。政治和黃金贏過了真相。

I requested assignment to the eastern patrols, where orcs raid. Denied, too young, too valuable, too many connections. They wanted me safe, counting gold in the treasury. So I left one night, took my gear and savings. If they won't give me glory, I'll find it myself.
我申請加入東部巡邏隊，那裏常有奧克劫掠。申請被拒了：太年輕、太有價值、牽連太多。他們想讓我安全地待在寶庫裏數金子。於是某個夜裏，我帶上裝備和積蓄離開了。既然他們不給我榮耀，我就自己去找。
I resigned my commission rather than watch our defenses crumble through cowardice disguised as strategy. Now I seek those who still have the will to fight, not merely to retreat and call it wisdom.
我選擇辭去軍職，而不是看着剛鐸的防線被披着“策略”皮的怯懦之舉摧毀。現在我正在招募還有戰鬥意志的人，我可不要那種將撤退稱之爲智慧的軟蛋。

I retain copies of valuable intelligence, troop movements, supply routes, lists of agents and informants. This information has value to many parties. I also know how to gather more, how to build networks, how to turn secrets into coin. In the coming war, information will be worth more than steel.
我還留着一些有價值情報的副本：部隊調動、補給路線、密探和線人的名單。這些消息對很多人都有價值。我也知道如何收集更多，如何建立網絡，如何把祕密變成錢。在即將到來的戰爭裏，情報會比鋼鐵更值錢。
I ride wolves out of the northern holds, scouting and raiding down toward the Vales of Anduin. Most riders you meet will say the same.
我從北方堡壘騎狼出發，往安都因河谷偵察、劫掠。你碰見的大多數騎手，乾的都是這些。
I robbed a clan's war-chest, and when the riders closed in, I gave them the names of my whole gang to save my own neck. I do not pretend it was brave, only that it worked.
我偷過一個氏族的軍費箱。騎兵圍上來時，我爲了保命，把整夥同伴的名字都供了出去。我不裝什麼勇敢，只能說這辦法管用。

I rode a gray wolf out of the northern holds, the best of the litter, and we raided down into the Vales of Anduin every thaw. Woodmen steadings, sheep, grain, whatever burned. I was young and the pack was mine.
我從北方堡壘騎出來的，是窩裏最好的一頭灰狼。每到融雪的時候，我們就去安都因河谷劫掠。林中居民的農莊、羊、糧食，能燒的都不放過。那時我年輕，整幫傢伙都聽我的。

I rode as a lancer in the escort the Havens sent north to the kings of Arnor, as Círdan's people had done since Elendil's day. I learned to fight beside Dúnedain, and I came to admire their stubborn, short-lived courage.
我當過槍騎兵，隨灰港派出的衛隊北上，護送阿爾諾諸王。從埃蘭迪爾的時代起，奇爾丹的族人就一直這麼做。我學着與杜內丹人並肩作戰，也開始敬佩他們短暫生命裏那份頑強的勇氣。
I rode in the war-host of clan Taiymâkä and swore the blood-oath young, as we all do. I held it more dearly than most. To me an oath was the only thing on the steppe a man truly owns.
我曾騎在泰伊瑪卡氏族的戰團裏，年輕時就像所有人一樣立下血誓。我比大多數人更看重它。對我來說，誓言是草原上一個人真正擁有的唯一東西。
I rode shaggy ponies in the raids on the farms along the Gulf of Lune. A rider is always wanted by the Craig, and I ride for coin now.
我騎毛茸茸的小馬，劫掠過路恩灣沿岸的農場。藍巖總缺騎手，現在我騎馬掙錢。

I rode the post between Beorn's Hall and the Old Ford, carrying letters, coin and now and then a sick child to the healer. Every rider on that road knew me, and I knew every ford and farm along the Great River.
我曾騎馬跑貝奧恩大廳到老渡口的郵路，送信、送錢，偶爾也把生病的孩子送去看醫者。走那條路的騎手都認得我，大河沿岸每個渡口、每處農莊，我也全熟。

I rode the post between Dale and Esgaroth, carrying letters, coin and now and then a sick child to the healer. Every rider on that road knew me, and I knew every ford and farm along the River Running.
我曾騎馬跑河谷城到埃斯加洛斯的郵路，送信、送錢，偶爾也把生病的孩子送去看醫者。走那條路的騎手都認得我，奔流河沿岸每個渡口、每處農莊，我也全熟。

I rode the post between Vineholm and Redwater, carrying letters, coin and now and then a sick child to the healer. Every rider on that road knew me, and I knew every ford and farm along the River Running.
我曾騎馬跑葡萄洲到紅水的郵路，送信、送錢，偶爾也把生病的孩子送去看醫者。走那條路的騎手都認得我，奔流河沿岸每個渡口、每處農莊，我也全熟。

I rode the post between Woodmen-town and the Forest Gate, carrying letters, coin and now and then a sick child to the healer. Every rider on that road knew me, and I knew every glade and farm along the eaves of Mirkwood.
我曾騎馬跑林中居民鎮到森林之門的郵路，送信、送錢，偶爾也把生病的孩子送去看醫者。走那條路的騎手都認得我，黑森林邊緣每處林間空地、每個農莊，我也全熟。
I rode wargs out of the Great Goblin's kennels, raiding the Vales of Anduin. A rider with no beast is worth little, so I hire out and save.
我騎着半獸人王獸欄裏的座狼，去安都因河谷劫掠過。沒有坐騎的騎手不值錢，所以我出來賣力氣，攢錢。
