佐裏安家族的合丹率領着家族的槍騎兵。他手段強硬，魯恩平原上的人都畏懼他的旗幟。
Kareem is a wealthy merchant prince of the south.
卡里姆是南方一位富有的商界巨頭。

Kargoth, a brutal orc warrior of Gundabad, embodies the merciless spirit of Tolkien's orcs, forged in the pits of Angband's descendants. He leads scouting parties into the wilds, ambushing travelers and gathering intelligence for Azgar's campaigns, his hatred for the Free Peoples burning as fiercely as the forges beneath the mountains.
卡爾戈斯是貢達巴德殘暴的奧克戰士，體現托爾金筆下奧克毫不留情的精神，彷彿由安格班後裔的深坑鍛成。他帶領偵察隊深入荒野，伏擊旅人，併爲阿茲加爾的戰役蒐集情報；他對自由人民的仇恨像山下熔爐一樣熾烈。
Kargul, a claw master, trains beasts for combat, rending armor like the fell beasts' talons.
卡爾古爾是利爪大師，訓練野獸作戰，讓它們像兇惡巨獸的爪子一樣撕開鎧甲。
Karith commands raiding parties into enemy lands.
卡里斯率領劫掠隊深入敵境。
Kazla, a arcane enforcer, punishes disloyalty, maintaining order in Khamûl's shadowed halls.
卡茲拉用祕法懲罰不忠者，在可哈穆爾陰影籠罩的大廳中維持秩序。
Kaznia, a rune scribe, inscribes wards, fortifying the tower with dark enchantments.
卡茲妮婭是符文書寫者，刻寫守護符文，用黑暗附魔加固高塔。
Kazrag, a curse-bringer, afflicts foes with plagues, mirroring the sickness that befell Greenwood in the books.
卡茲拉格是帶來詛咒的人，以疫病折磨敵人，呼應書中大綠林遭受的病變。
Kazria, a fear monger, instills dread, mirroring the morale-crushing presence of the Nazgûl.
卡茲莉婭是散播恐懼的人，能灌輸畏懼，效果如那茲古爾令人軍心崩潰的存在感。
Keep me behind your line with a bow and a clear target, and I will be worth every coin.
讓我帶着弓待在你的陣線後面，給我一個看得清的目標，你花的每枚錢都會值得。
Keep me fed and give me a forge, and I'll keep your steel sharp.
讓我喫飽，再給我一座鍛爐，我會讓你的鋼鐵保持鋒利。
Keep me near your sick and wounded, and fewer of them will go into the ground.
讓我靠近你的病人和傷員，他們就會少一些被埋進土裏。
Keep me near your wounded and I will keep your riders in the saddle longer than you would believe.
讓我靠近你的傷員，我會讓你的騎手在馬背上撐得比你相信的更久。
Keep to this soldier or company (TAOM)
Keep walking, meat. The next pack may not be so kind. Or so full.
繼續走，肉。下一羣可沒這麼好說話，也未必喫得這麼飽。
Keep your share fair and I will shoot whoever you name.
分成公道，你點誰的名，我就射誰。
Keep-out radius from towns and castles for pitching a field or fortified camp. 0 disables the check; ambushes and lookouts are exempt. Default 10.
建立野戰營地或設防營地時，必須避開城鎮和城堡的距離。0表示不檢查距離，伏擊點和瞭望點不受此限制。默認：10。
Keeping faith unasked is rare, among any people.
不用別人催，就肯守信，在哪一族都難得。
Keeping faith with the helpless is no shame. The shame was his.
不辜負無力反抗的人，沒什麼可恥。可恥的是他。
Keeping those people alive is worth more than any battle.
讓那些人活下去，比打什麼仗都值。

Keeps the vanilla menu theme off the main menu while the menu video plays its own soundtrack, so it needs Main Menu Video on. Vanilla's music returns once you leave the main menu. Takes effect the next time the main menu opens.
菜單視頻播放自己的配樂時，不播放原版菜單主題曲。需要開啓“主菜單視頻”。離開主菜單後恢復原版音樂。下次打開主菜單時生效。
Kept order among the Orc work gangs.
Kept tallies at the Old Ford.
Kept vigil on the flets of the Golden Wood.
在金色森林的樹臺上守夜。
Kept watch from the flets of the mallorn trees.
Khada is heir to the Arkit clan.
卡達是阿爾基特氏族的繼承人。
Khadurak is the Taskral of Harad, supreme commander of the southern armies. He leads the Mumakil war elephants against the enemies of his people, allied with Mordor against Gondor.
卡杜拉克是哈拉德的塔斯克拉爾，也是南方諸軍的最高統帥。他率領猛獁戰象對抗族人的敵人，並與魔多結盟對抗剛鐸。
Khalida is wife to Khadurak, and a Haradrim noble lady of high standing.
哈莉達是喀杜拉克的妻子，也是一位地位尊貴的哈拉德貴婦。
Khamûl the Easterling, second of the Nine, once ruled a great kingdom in Rhun before accepting a Ring of Power.
“東夷”可哈穆爾是九戒靈中的第二位。他曾統治魯恩的一個強大王國，後來接受了一枚力量之戒。
Khand's colour on the map, written #RRGGBB. Blank uses the default, #E8841E.
可汗德在地圖上的顏色，格式爲 #RRGGBB。留空使用默認值 #E8841E。

Khand, a rugged land of rolling steppes and arid plains, lies southeast of Mordor and serves as a critical corridor between the east and west. Its people, the Variags, are fierce and nomadic, known for their swift horses and deadly curved blades. Living in a harsh environment, they have honed their skills as raiders and warriors, often clashing with their neighbors and serving as mercenaries for the highest bidder. Khand's allegiance has long been courted by the Dark Lord, and many of its warriors have ridden to war under the shadow of Mordor. Yet the Variags are a proud and independent people, loyal first to their clans and chieftains, who rule from fortified encampments scattered across the windswept plains.
可汗德是一片崎嶇土地，起伏草原與乾旱平原交錯，位於魔多東南，也是連接東方與西方的重要通道。這裏的人民瓦里亞格人兇悍而游牧，以快馬和致命彎刃聞名。他們生活在嚴酷環境中，磨鍊出劫掠者和戰士的技藝，常與鄰人衝突，也常爲出價最高者充當僱傭兵。黑暗魔君長期拉攏可汗德的效忠，許多可汗德戰士也曾在魔多陰影下出徵。然而瓦里亞格人驕傲而獨立，首先忠於自己的氏族和酋長；這些首領統治着散佈在風吹平原上的設防營地。
Kharzul is a Variag warrior chieftain of Khand, and a son of the High Warlord.
卡爾祖爾是可汗德的一位瓦里亞格戰士酋長，也是至高戰帥的兒子。
Khazna is a daughter of the High Warlord's house. She rides with his retinue, though she is still a child and carries no spear.
哈茲娜是至高戰帥家中的女兒。她隨他的侍從隊騎馬出行，但她還只是個孩子，並不攜帶長矛。
Khenbish of House Cilzeron is counted among the keen horse-archers of Rhûn, loosing his shafts from the saddle at a full gallop.
西爾澤隆家族的肯比什是魯恩出色的騎射手之一，能在戰馬全速奔馳時從馬背上射出箭矢。

Khorgath serves as a high officer in the armies of Mordor, a son of Sauron raised to the muster of war. He drives his legions toward the lands of Men with the cold patience of one who knows the Eye is always watching.
科爾加斯是索隆的兒子，從小就在備戰中長大，如今是魔多軍隊的高級軍官。他知道魔眼始終注視着自己，因此以冷酷的耐心驅使軍團，向人類的土地推進。
霍里金是奧拉古爾的妻子。
Khorlug of House Vazevian rides at the head of the clan's lancers, a hard-handed kinsman whose banner is feared across the plains of Rhûn.
瓦澤維安家族的霍爾盧格率領着家族的槍騎兵。他手段強硬，魯恩平原上的人都畏懼他的旗幟。
Khulan of House Adekig is a proud woman of the Easterlings, mistress of hearth and granary and no stranger to the horse and the bow.
阿德基格家族的忽蘭是一位驕傲的東夷女子。她掌管家務和糧倉，對騎馬和射箭也不陌生。
Khurubra Mashakian commands the northern tribes of Rhun.
庫魯布拉·馬沙基安統領魯恩北部部族。
Killing feeds your advance. +8% melee damage.
殺戮會推動你繼續向前。+8% 近戰傷害。
殺俘虜就是謀殺，沒什麼可說的。
擊殺收益增加四分之一。
King Thranduil acknowledges your loyalty. +{influence} influence, +{relation} relation.
瑟蘭杜伊國王認可你的忠誠。影響力+{influence}，關係+{relation}。
卡拉斯戈沙德王家衛士
國王裁決權的封地佔比上限
Kingdom decision relationship penalties increased by 25%.
王國決議造成的關係懲罰增加25%。

Knowledge is a blade with two edges. When the clan's lords fell to feuding over the Taskral's favor, I knew too much of all of them to be allowed to live in peace. The losing side named me traitor; the winning side simply wanted me gone before I sold what I knew.
知識是一把雙刃刀。當氏族領主們爲了塔斯克拉爾的寵信互相爭鬥時，我知道他們所有人太多祕密，已經不可能安穩活着。敗的一方稱我爲叛徒，勝的一方則只想在我賣出所知之前把我趕走。
Knowledge is only heavy when hoarded. Shared freely, it lifts all who receive it. Like my brother Thyrell, I serve this realm's glory. Will you add your chapter to our endless tale?
知識只有被囤積時纔會沉重。若慷慨分享，它會托起所有得到它的人。就像我的兄弟泰瑞爾一樣，我爲這個國度的榮耀效力。你願意把自己的篇章加入我們無盡的故事嗎？
Knowledge is the truest weapon, and I have spent a lifetime gathering it...
知識才是最可靠的武器，而我用一生收集它……
Knowledge of both trade and threats, invaluable combination.
既懂貿易，又懂威脅，這是無價的組合。
Knowledge of the land is as vital as any blade. I chart the paths others fear to tread, ensuring our forces never march blind.
瞭解土地和握住刀劍一樣重要。我繪出旁人不敢踏足的道路，確保我們的軍隊不會盲目行軍。

Knowledge of the secret ways is a jealous thing, and my House guarded its routes closely. When I was caught selling a path to a rival, a small thing I thought, and the coin was good, they branded me faithless and turned me out into the very jungle I had mastered. I survived it. Few would have.
祕密道路的知識總會招來嫉妒，而我的家族把自己的路線守得很嚴。我被抓到把一條路賣給敵對家族時，我覺得那只是小事，而且錢給得不錯，他們卻說我背信，把我趕進了我早已熟悉的那片叢林。我活了下來。很少有人能做到。
Knowledge without loyalty, useful if handled carefully.
不帶忠誠的知識，若謹慎使用，也很有用。

Known as the Riddermark, Rohan is a vast and sweeping kingdom of open plains and rolling hills, where the mighty Rohirrim—skilled horsemen and fierce warriors—dwell. Founded by Eorl the Young after his legendary ride to Gondor's aid, Rohan has long stood as a steadfast ally of Gondor against the darkness of Mordor. From the golden halls of Meduseld in Edoras, its kings rule over a proud and resilient people who live by the bond of horse and rider. The Rohirrim are famed for their cavalry charges, their songs of valor, and their unwavering courage. Though the shadow of Saruman has threatened their borders, the sons and daughters of Rohan remain ever ready to answer the call to arms, defending their homeland and the free peoples of Middle-earth.

洛汗又稱裏德馬克，是一個擁有遼闊平原和起伏丘陵的王國，居住在這裏的洛希爾人既是熟練的騎手，也是兇悍的戰士。年少的埃奧爾以一場傳奇般的馳援幫助剛鐸，並在此後建立了洛汗。自那以後，洛汗一直是剛鐸堅定的盟友，共同抵禦魔多的黑暗。國王們在埃多拉斯的金殿美杜塞爾德中統治着驕傲而堅韌的人民；人與馬之間的深厚聯繫，是他們生活的根基。洛希爾人以騎兵衝鋒、英勇的歌謠和堅定的勇氣聞名。雖然薩茹曼的陰影威脅着邊境，洛汗的兒女仍隨時準備響應徵召，保衛家園和中洲的自由人民。
Konsha of House Adekig is a proud woman of the Easterlings, mistress of hearth and granary and no stranger to the horse and the bow.
阿德基格家族的孔莎是一位驕傲的東夷女子。她掌管家務和糧倉，對騎馬和射箭也不陌生。
Korgul is a lieutenant of the Black Echelon who rose by outlasting the uruks placed above him. He gives an order once and looks for the axe if it is not obeyed.
科爾古爾是黑色梯隊的一名副官。他靠熬死一個又一個壓在自己頭上的烏魯克爬了上來。他的命令只說一遍，誰不聽，他就去找斧頭。
Korte is heir to Vakheraltan's scouts.
科爾特是瓦赫拉坦斥候隊的繼承人。
Kragloth commands a Gundabad sub-clan with the ferocity of Bolg's lieutenants in The Hobbit. His focus on mountain warfare makes him a master of ambushes in the high passes, targeting trade routes.
克拉格洛斯統領貢達巴德的一個分支氏族，兇狠程度堪比《霍比特人》中波爾格的副官。他專注山地戰，是高山隘口伏擊的大師，常把商路作爲目標。
Kralza, a commanding orc female, oversees training grounds with the authority of a captain. Her drills produce relentless fighters for the horde.
克拉爾扎是有統御力的奧克女性，以隊長般的權威管理訓練場。她的嚴苛訓練把新兵磨成可用的戰士。
Krazdra leads scouting parties for the Iron Fist. Her knowledge of the terrain surrounding Isengard is unmatched.
克拉茲德拉爲鐵拳帶領偵察隊。她熟悉艾森加德周邊地形，因此能把部隊帶到敵人最薄弱的地方。
Krimpa breaks the new-taken slaves of Harad and the East, and is proud that few of them survive her breaking.
克林帕負責折磨剛從哈拉德和東方抓來的奴隸，直到他們屈服。她很自豪，因爲很少有人能活着熬過她的折磨。
Krimza of the Throgmaw orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
克林扎是斯羅格莫氏族的一名女奧克，住在地底深處，兇狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族遜色。
Krithak of the Throgmaw warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
克里薩克是斯羅格莫戰幫的一名奧克隊長，脖頸粗壯。他經常在山路上劫掠，手裏的砍刀已崩出許多缺口。
Krithash of the Gashrim warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
克里薩什是嘎什林戰幫的一名奧克隊長，脖頸粗壯。他經常在山路上劫掠，手裏的砍刀已崩出許多缺口。
Krithza of the Vargrim orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
克里斯扎是瓦格林氏族的一名女奧克，住在地底深處，兇狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族遜色。
Krogar is a marauder orc, leading pillaging bands reminiscent of those that ravaged the Shire's borders. His hauls sustain the clan's war machine.
克羅加爾是奧克掠奪者，帶領洗劫隊伍行動，讓人想起曾蹂躪夏爾邊境的那些暴徒。他帶回的物資維持氏族戰爭機器運轉。
Krozar, a lurker chief, ambushes from trees, like the spiders that ensnared Bilbo's company.
克羅扎爾是潛伏首領，從樹上發動伏擊，就像曾困住比爾博一行的蜘蛛。
Krumbash of the Lugbúrz warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
克魯姆巴什是路格布爾茲戰幫的一名奧克隊長，脖頸粗壯。他經常在山路上劫掠，手裏的砍刀已崩出許多缺口。
Krunza of the Vrakmaw orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
克倫扎是弗拉克莫氏族的一名女奧克，住在地底深處，兇狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族遜色。
Kruznor is a strategist orc, planning incursions with the cunning of Grishnákh from the books. His schemes exploit weaknesses in Dwarven defenses.
克魯茲諾爾是奧克戰略家，以書中格里什納赫式的狡詐策劃入侵。他的計謀專門利用矮人防線的弱點。
Krûklash maintains discipline among the Uruk-hai with an iron fist. Those who disobey his orders rarely live to regret their mistake.
克魯克拉什以鐵腕維持烏魯克的紀律。違抗他命令的人，很少能活到後悔的時候。
Kustîg of House Adekig is counted among the keen horse-archers of Rhûn, loosing his shafts from the saddle at a full gallop.
阿德基格家族的庫斯提格是魯恩出色的騎射手之一，能在戰馬全速奔馳時從馬背上射出箭矢。
Kuyug was chief noyan of the Arkit clan. His brilliance with horse archery shaped an entire generation of Easterling warriors.
庫由格曾是阿爾基特氏族的首席那顏。他出衆的騎射本領影響了整整一代東夷戰士。
Kysaro's Middle-earth main menu in place of the vanilla one. Takes effect the next time the main menu opens.
使用 Kysaro 製作的中洲主菜單替代原版。下次打開主菜單時生效。

Kysaro's faction screen with painted portraits, a map and a hero picker, in place of TAOM's faction map. Picking one of that faction's lords or ladies makes you that character, with their clan, fiefs and kingdom: character creation goes straight to the career choice and then into the game (Player Switcher's settings apply). Picking a legend or any other character starts you with its look, gear and skills. When it is shown it takes the place of Player Switcher's panel for that character creation. Takes effect the next time character creation reaches the culture screen.
使用 Kysaro 製作的勢力界面，包含繪製的人物肖像、地圖和英雄選擇，替代 TAOM 的勢力地圖。選擇該勢力的領主或女領主後，會繼承該角色及其家族、領地和王國，角色創建直接進入職業選擇，隨後開始遊戲，適用玩家角色切換設置。選擇傳奇人物或其他角色時，只繼承其外貌、裝備和技能。顯示時替代此次創建中的玩家角色切換面板。下次角色創建進入文化界面時生效。
Kysaro's reskin of the character creation face generator. Outside character creation the face generator stays vanilla. Takes effect the next time it opens.
使用 Kysaro 製作的角色創建捏臉界面。角色創建之外的捏臉界面保持原版。下次打開時生效。
Kysaro's reskin of the clan naming screen. Takes effect the next time it opens.
使用 Kysaro 製作的家族命名界面。下次打開時生效。
Kysaro's reskin of the difficulty and campaign options screen at the end of character creation. Takes effect the next time it opens.
使用 Kysaro 製作的角色創建末尾難度與戰役選項界面。下次打開時生效。
Kysaro's reskin of the family, childhood, adolescence, youth, adulthood and age screens. Takes effect the next time one of them opens.
使用 Kysaro 製作的家庭、童年、少年、青年、成年和年齡界面。下次打開其中任一界面時生效。
Kysaro's reskin of the final review screen, where you name your character. Takes effect the next time it opens.
使用 Kysaro 製作的最終檢查與角色命名界面。下次打開時生效。

Kysaro's skill icons in place of the vanilla ones, everywhere in the game. Turning them on applies the next time the main menu opens; turning them off takes effect after a restart, because the vanilla icons are not kept once replaced.
在遊戲各處使用 Kysaro 的技能圖標替代原版。開啓後下次打開主菜單時生效；關閉後需要重啓，因爲替換後不會保留原版圖標。
Kzha, a lich-like mage, extends unlife, reflecting Sauron's immortality pursuits.
克扎是近似巫妖的法師，延長非生非死的存在，呼應索隆對不朽的追逐。

Kûragh of the Akheth is Rûklash's foremost uruk in the Gorgoroth forges, and the smith-snaga fear him more than the bellows. Plunder is his sickness, and he has been known to march his company up the Morgul road on private errands of robbery. He took a fat share from a Cirith Ungol train two winters past, and Thûlnar has not forgotten it. He watches Rûklash for any sign of weakness, and reckons that a hammer-captain who tires at the anvil will not last a march to the Black Gate.
阿克赫斯氏族的庫拉格是盧克拉什在戈堝洛斯鍛爐中最得力的烏魯克。鐵匠斯那嘎怕他，勝過怕風箱旁的苦工。他搶劫成癮，曾帶着自己的部隊走上魔古爾大道，只爲替自己搶東西。兩個冬天前，他從一支奇立斯烏苟運輸隊中搶走了豐厚的一份，圖勒納爾至今沒有忘記。庫拉格盯着盧克拉什的每一點軟弱，認定一個在鐵砧前就會累倒的錘兵隊長，根本撐不到行軍抵達黑門。
Labored in the fields of the Pelennor.
Labored in the forges of the Dark Land.
在黑暗之地熔爐中勞作。
Labored on the farms of Minhiriath.
在明希瑞亞斯農場幹活。
Labored on the farms of the North Downs.
Ladogual serves as a captain in Ergeon's host.
拉多瓜爾在埃爾吉昂的軍中擔任隊長。
Lagdash of the Morzûk warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
拉格達什是莫爾祖克戰幫的一名奧克隊長，脖頸粗壯。他經常在山路上劫掠，手裏的砍刀已崩出許多缺口。
拉梅頓單手劍護手 A
拉梅頓單手劍配重球 A
拉梅頓雙手劍護手 A
拉梅頓雙手劍配重球 A
大額賞錢：每名士兵的金幣
Lasand serves in the Westfold garrison.
拉桑德在西伏爾德守軍中效力。
Last Alliance boosts mount resilience while active.
最後的聯盟生效期間，會強化坐騎韌性。
Last Alliance charge greatly reduced, ride without ceasing.
最後的聯盟充能消耗大幅降低，可以不停騎行。
Last Alliance charge reduced, swifter activation.
最後的聯盟充能消耗降低，可以更快發動。
Last Alliance duration extended, maintaining momentum.
最後的聯盟持續時間延長，讓勢頭保持更久。
Last Alliance grants +5% melee damage and inspires your allies.
最後的聯盟提供 +5% 近戰傷害，並鼓舞你的盟友。
Last Alliance radius expanded, sweeping wider formations.
最後的聯盟作用範圍擴大，可以掃過更寬的陣型。
Last Alliance radius greatly expanded, unstoppable impact.
最後的聯盟作用範圍大幅擴大，衝擊勢不可擋。

Last summer we caught a band of Men who had robbed our wagons near the borders of the Shire. They threw down their weapons and asked for the warden's judgement. I gave them mine instead, there on the road. Shire-folk saw it, the Thain sent word to Thorin's Halls, and the king could not keep me after that.
去年夏天，我們在夏爾邊界附近抓到一夥搶了自家貨車的人類。他們扔下武器，請求由守將裁決。我當場在路上給了他們我的裁決。夏爾人看見了，長官給梭林大廳傳了信，國王再也沒法留下我。

Laswen of the House of Olindurionath, three and fifty winters of age and the eldest sister of the present lord, is the keeper of the house's chronicles upon the rim of the Langstrand. From her seat above the grey strand she has counted the sails of three generations of corsairs, and she has written down the names of the watchmen who did not return. She is the steady voice of the King's cause within her hall, for she has weighed the long ledger of the coast's neglect and finds the Steward's keeping wanting.
拉斯玟來自奧林杜瑞昂納斯家族，五十三歲，是現任領主的長姐，也是長灘邊緣家族編年史的保管者。她坐在灰色海岸上方，記錄了三代烏姆巴爾海盜的船帆，也寫下了那些一去不返的守望者姓名。在自己的廳堂裏，她是支持國王事業的穩定聲音；她仔細衡量海岸長期被忽視的賬目，認爲宰相的治理已經虧欠太多。
Latest generation Uruk-hai who stole 'deserved' equipment. Arrogant but capable.
最新一代烏魯克，偷走了自稱“應得”的裝備。傲慢，但確實能幹。
Launch a brutal boarding assault — boosts +15% melee damage and +10% damage reduction to allies within 50m for 8s.
發動殘酷的登船攻擊：50 米內的盟友獲得 +15% 近戰傷害和 +10% 傷害減免，持續 8 秒。
Layered armour turns aside the sharpest strikes. +7 health.
層層疊加的護甲能擋住最鋒利的兵刃。+7 生命值。
Lazga of the Uzgnâsh orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
拉茲加是烏茲格納什氏族的一名女奧克，住在地底深處，兇狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族遜色。
Lazgar of the Hrakdûr warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
拉茲加爾是赫拉克杜爾戰幫的一名奧克隊長，脖頸粗壯。他經常在山路上劫掠，手裏的砍刀已崩出許多缺口。
Lead your warpack in a coordinated charge — boosts +25% charge damage, +20% mount speed, and +10% melee damage for 8s.
帶領戰羣一同發起衝鋒：+25% 衝鋒傷害，+20% 坐騎速度，+10% 近戰傷害，持續 8 秒。
Leadership means nothing when those above you are blind...
當你上頭都是些睜眼瞎的時候，所謂的領導就是胡扯……
Learned craft in the workshops of Dale.
在河谷邦工坊學習手藝。
Learned healing arts in the halls of Cirdan.
在奇爾丹的殿堂中學習醫術。
Learned healing arts in the halls of Elrond.
在埃爾隆德廳堂學習醫術。
Learned seamanship and swordsmanship aboard the Black ships.
在黑船上學習航海和劍術。
Learned spirit-lore and healing with the clan elders.
隨氏族長者學習靈術和醫治。
Learned the woodwright's craft at Ironwood Hall.
在鐵木廳學習木匠手藝。
Learned the woodwright's craft in Beorn's Hall.
在貝奧恩大廳學習木匠手藝。
Leave the herd alone from now on.
Leaving your people undefended seems reckless.
丟下百姓，讓他們無人保護，未免太莽撞。

Left before they could make me an example. My warriors deserved better leadership than cowards who steal valor. Out here, combat ability matters more than politics. I'll find those who respect strength and lead them to real victories, not managed conflicts.
在他們把我做成榜樣前，我離開了。我的戰士值得更好的領袖，而不是那些偷走勇名的懦夫。在外面，戰鬥能力比權謀更重要。我會找到尊重力量的人，帶他們取得真正的勝利，而不是被人管控的衝突。
Legendary first-age veteran of the Eldar.
傳說中的第一紀元埃爾達老兵。
傳說中的第一紀元老兵。
奈斯地區的傳奇神射手。

Legolas, son of Thranduil, is a masterful archer and scout, as depicted in both books and films, venturing beyond Mirkwood to aid the Free Peoples with his keen senses and unerring aim against the forces of darkness.
萊戈拉斯是瑟蘭杜伊之子，也是一名技藝精湛的弓手和斥候，正如書中與電影中所描繪的那樣。他離開黑森林，援助自由人民，憑藉敏銳感官和百發百中的箭術對抗黑暗勢力。
Lend your company to the works
Let him be. I've found power in lifting others that no amount of conquest could match. Now I walk these lands both as creator and warrior. Will you have one who builds as fiercely as he fights?
隨他去吧。我在扶持他人中找到的力量，勝過任何征服。如今我既是創作者，也是戰士，行走在這些土地上。你願意接納一個建造時和戰鬥時一樣兇猛的人嗎？
Let me advise you, and I will never again trust a map over the ground.
讓我爲你出主意，我再不會信地圖勝過實地。
Let me look through my things again.
讓我再翻翻自己的東西。
Let me plan your campaigns, and I'll show you what strategy can achieve.
讓我規劃你的戰役，我會讓你看見戰略能做到什麼。
Let me search beside you, and I will give my bow and my word to your road.
讓我和你同行尋找吧。我願用這張弓、用自己的承諾，守護你走的路。
Let me search with you, and my bow and my word are yours on the road.
讓我和你同行尋找吧。在路上，我的弓和我的承諾都交給你。
Let me shoot from behind your line, and perhaps this time I will not leave it.
讓我在你的陣線後面放箭吧，也許這回，我不會離開。
Let me stand in your front rank, and I will earn what the lads called me or learn I never could.
讓我站在你的前排。我會掙到夥伴們給我的那個名號，或者認清自己永遠不配。
Let the merchants bow to the Elves. The world still needs dwarves who know what a shield-wall is for, and orcs do not trade. My hammer goes where it can be of use.
讓商人去向精靈彎腰吧。世上還需要知道盾牆有什麼用的矮人，奧克可不做買賣。哪裏用得上我的錘子，我就去哪兒。

Let them fight their clean wars with their careful strategies. I know only one way to fight, total, absolute, without mercy or hesitation. There are those who understand that war isn't about reputation, it's about making your enemies extinct. I'll find them, and we'll finish what Mordor was too squeamish to complete.
讓他們去打那些乾乾淨淨、精打細算的仗吧。我只知道一種打法：徹底、絕對，不留憐憫，也不猶豫。總有人明白，戰爭不是爲了名聲，而是爲了讓敵人徹底滅絕。我會找到他們，然後完成魔多嫌太軟弱、不敢做完的事。

Let them grow fat on gold while darkness gathers. I'll take my warnings elsewhere, to those who remember that dragons aren't the only threat. My axe and experience serve better on the frontier than in council chambers where gold speaks louder than wisdom.
就讓他們在黃金上養肥自己吧，黑暗正在聚集。我要把警告帶給別處，帶給那些還記得巨龍不是唯一威脅的人。我的斧頭和經驗，在邊境上比在議事廳裏更有用；在那裏，黃金的聲音比智慧更響。

Let them send their controlled, obedient warriors to die in sieges. I'll fight on my own terms, for those who appreciate pure ferocity. Point me at your enemies and watch them break. The rage is mine to unleash, not Saruman's to spend.
讓他們把那些受控、聽話的戰士送去死在圍城裏吧。我要按自己的方式戰鬥，爲懂得欣賞純粹兇性的僱主而戰。把你的敵人指給我，看着他們崩潰。怒火由我釋放，不該由薩茹曼拿去消耗。
Let them talk. We are the last of the Dúnedain who still walk the wild. I have tracked orcs down out of the Ettenmoors and turned wolves back at the Brandywine before the farmers knew they had come.
隨他們說去。我們是仍在荒野中行走的最後一批杜內丹人。我曾從埃滕荒原一路追蹤奧克，也曾在白蘭地河邊趕走狼羣，當地農夫甚至不知道它們來過。

Let them think what they will. I know my courage, proven in real battles, not drunken brawls. The world beyond Erebor offers plenty of fights for those who seek them. My ancestors' warrior spirit drives me forward, not backward into meaningless duels.
隨他們怎麼想。我知道自己的勇氣，它在真正的戰鬥中證明過，而不是在醉酒鬥毆裏。孤山之外的世界，有足夠多的戰鬥給尋找戰鬥的人。祖先的戰士之魂推動我向前，而不是退回無意義的決鬥。

Lets AI lord parties HOLD the roster their party template spawns them with. Without this they spawn at 500-3000 and are trimmed back to the vanilla 50-150 cap within a day. Also relieves AI food and wage pressure, because those drive a second, morale-based desertion path that ignores the cap entirely. Off restores the pre-feature behaviour. Note that is not the same as raw vanilla: the Troop Weight elite tax has its own toggle and still deflates a heavy party's limit when it is on.
讓AI領主部隊保留部隊模板生成的兵力。不開啓時，他們剛生成時有500至3000人，卻會在一天內被削減到原版50至150人的上限。此功能也會減輕AI的糧食和軍餉壓力，因爲這兩項會通過降低士氣引發另一種逃兵機制，完全不受人數上限限制。關閉後恢復此功能加入前的表現。注意，這並不等於純原版：兵種權重有獨立開關，開啓時仍會讓精銳佔比較高的部隊可容納的人數減少。

Lets one key (Take the Seat, default Q, rebindable under Keybindings > Action) lift your view off the hero so you can fly over the field, and bring it back with a short glide. Your hero stands fast while you are up, or fights on if that setting is on. Off, the key does nothing, the mission time keys (Quicken, Slow and Stay time) stop too, and the next press of one cancels any change they made. Default: on.
按一個鍵即可讓視角離開英雄，自由飛越戰場，再以短暫平滑移動返回英雄。按鍵爲“坐上觀望之椅”，默認Q，可在“按鍵綁定”下的“動作”中修改。升空後，英雄原地堅守；若開啓相應設置，也可以繼續戰鬥。關閉後，此鍵無效，任務中的時間加速、減速和暫停按鍵也會停用；下次按任一時間鍵時，會取消此前造成的時間變化。默認：開啓。

Lets the hero you name Quartermaster (never you, and only while that hero is in your party) take standing orders in conversation: buy food at markets, slaughter livestock when the stores run low, lift the host's spirits with pay or drink, and sell your goods at a nearby town for a cut. Orders stand down for an enlisted player and for a co-op client. Default: on.
你任命的軍需官英雄可以通過對話接受長期指令，包括在市場買糧、存糧不足時宰殺牲畜、通過發賞錢或請喝酒鼓舞士氣，以及把貨物送到附近城鎮出售並收取佣金。軍需官不能是你自己，且只有該英雄在你的部隊中時才執行。玩家參軍服役或作爲合作聯機客戶端時，這些指令會暫停。默認：開啓。

Lets the ruler of your realm rename its towns, castles and villages from the Fiefs tab of the kingdom screen for influence, and lets four fiefs take an older or darker name while the matching side holds them. A name you chose is never overwritten. Single-player only. Switching it off gives those fiefs their map names back; a name you chose stays. The button follows the next time the kingdom screen opens; the older names change at the next capture, load or change of realm. Default: on.
允許本國統治者在王國界面的封地頁中，消耗影響力爲城鎮、城堡和村莊改名；另外四處封地在特定陣營佔有時，會採用古名或暗影勢力使用的名稱。你自行取的名字不會被覆蓋。僅限單人模式。關閉後，這四處封地恢復地圖上的原名，但你自行取的名字會保留。改名按鈕會在下次打開王國界面時更新；古名則在下次易主、讀檔或所屬國家改變時更新。默認：開啓。

Lets you talk to the governor of a town or castle your clan owns, inside that fief, and pay silver to the watch to raise its loyalty. Each offer shows its price, and there is a ceiling on how far silver can raise loyalty. When off, the line is hidden. Single-player only. Default: on.
允許你在自己家族的城鎮或城堡內與總督交談，支付銀幣犒賞衛隊，提高封地忠誠度。每個選項都會顯示費用，金錢能提升的忠誠度也有上限。關閉後隱藏此對話選項。僅限單人模式。默認：開啓。

Lets your company rebuild a looted village of your own realm from the village menu, and lend its labour to a construction project in a fief you own from the keep menu (from_the_ashes.json holds the hours, labour and materials). When off, those two options are hidden; a job already under way still finishes or stops normally. Single-player only. Default: on.
允許你的部隊通過村莊菜單重建本國被劫掠的村莊，也可通過城堡菜單爲自己封地的建築工程提供勞力；耗時、勞力和材料要求設在from_the_ashes.json中。關閉後隱藏這兩個選項，已經開工的任務仍會正常完工或停止。僅限單人模式。默認：開啓。
Letters each kingdom's name across its land when the camera is zoomed out.
拉遠鏡頭時，在各王國領土上顯示國名。
Level {LEVEL} of {MAX}: archers on each high tower, up to {POSTS}. They fill again at every clear, and the garrison cap counts them.
等級{LEVEL} / {MAX}：每座高塔最多駐有{POSTS}名弓手。每擊退一波便會補充，他們也計入駐軍人數上限。

Level {LEVEL} of {MAX}: each high tower also looses a volley of {ARROWS} arrows every {SECONDS} s while its archers stand, up to {POSTS} of them. They fill again at every clear, and the garrison cap counts them.
等級{LEVEL} / {MAX}：每座高塔最多駐有{POSTS}名弓手，只要弓手仍在，每{SECONDS}秒還會齊射{ARROWS}支箭。每擊退一波便會補充弓手，他們也計入駐軍人數上限。
Level {LEVEL} of {MAX}: the gate holds {PERCENT}% more than a new one. A hurt gate stays as hurt.
等級{LEVEL} / {MAX}：城門比全新城門多承受{PERCENT}%的傷害。已有損傷不會修復。
Level {LEVEL} of {MAX}: {ARROWS} arrows every {SECONDS} s, each at an attacker in the densest group near the walls. Press N during a wave.
等級{LEVEL} / {MAX}：每{SECONDS}秒射出{ARROWS}支箭，逐個瞄準城牆附近最密集敵羣中的敵人。在敵軍進攻時按N發動。
Level {LEVEL} of {MAX}: {ARROWS} arrows every {SECONDS} s, each at an attacker near where you look. Press N during a wave.
等級{LEVEL} / {MAX}：每{SECONDS}秒射出{ARROWS}支箭，逐個瞄準你視線附近的敵人。在敵軍進攻時按N發動。
Levies from the farms around Andrath are sent to hold the line below the old barrows. Not all of us stand when the warbands come.
安德拉思周圍農莊徵來的兵，被派去守古冢下的陣地。可戰團殺來時，我們不是人人都站得住。
Levies from the farms of the North Downs are sent to hold the line below the old barrows. Not all of us stand when the warbands come.
北崗農莊徵來的兵，被派去守古冢下的陣地。可戰團殺來時，我們不是人人都站得住。
Levies from the hill farms of Ettendale are sent to hold the line below the hold. Not all of us stand when the warbands come.
埃滕谷山中農莊徵來的兵，被派去守堡壘下的陣地。可戰團殺來時，我們不是人人都站得住。

Leôrdinoth Kalkian, a veteran campaigner of Rhûn, leads seasoned warriors into battle during the Third Age for Sauron. His experience turns the tide in many conflicts. Leôrdinoth's tactical genius maximizes the Easterlings' martial prowess.
萊奧迪諾斯·卡爾基安是魯恩久經戰陣的老將，在第三紀元率領身經百戰的戰士爲索隆作戰。他的經驗曾在許多戰鬥中扭轉局勢。他出色的戰術才能讓東夷的戰鬥力得到充分發揮。
Lhakra rides the pen-borders hunting runaways, and brings them back in pieces as a lesson to the rest.
拉克拉騎馬在奴隸營邊界追捕逃奴，再把他們的殘肢帶回來，警告其他人。
Lie in wait and break the deserters when they come. Rid us of them and you will have our thanks and our coin.
先埋伏起來，等那些逃兵來了就打垮他們。替我們除掉這羣人，我們會感謝你，也會給你報酬。
Lies, all of it. I fought under Bolg, proud and fierce. Then the defeat. Dwarves, elves, men crushed us. Shame burns still.
全是謊話。我曾在波爾格麾下作戰，驕傲又兇狠。然後就敗了。矮人、精靈和人類碾碎了我們。那份恥辱到現在還在燒。
Lifts your view off your hero so you can fly over the field, and brings it back with a short glide. Your hero stands fast while you are up, or fights on if that setting is on. Defaults to Q.
讓視角脫離角色，自由飛越戰場；切回時會平滑返回角色。使用指揮視角時，角色會原地待命；若啓用了自動戰鬥設置，則會繼續作戰。默認按鍵爲 Q。
Light Fletching grants +5% ranged damage, making every shaft count.
輕羽箭提供 +5% 遠程傷害，讓每一支箭都有價值。
Light infantry move swiftly across the Mark. +5% party movement speed.
輕裝步兵能迅速穿越馬克。+5% 部隊移動速度。
Light infantry move swiftly across the plain. +5% party movement speed.
輕步兵迅速穿行平原。+5%部隊移動速度。

Lond Cirion stands at the mouth of the mighty River Lagorduin where it empties into the Bay of Belfalas, commanding the central coastline of Anfalas - the Long Beach, also known as Langstrand in the Common Speech. The city holds the unique distinction of being the oldest Númenórean settlement in all of Gondor, predating even the great cities of Pelargir and Minas Anor, founded by the first wave of Númenórean seafarers who discovered the Bay of Belfalas during the Second Age.Originally named Ciryalondë by those ancient mariners, the settlement served as the first permanent foothold of Númenor on the mainland of Middle-earth in this region. Over the millennia, as the Quenya tongue faded from common use and Sindarin became the primary Elvish language of Gondor, the old name fell from memory and was replaced by Lond Cirion. The current name honors Cirion, the twelfth Ruling Steward of Gondor (T.A. 2489-2567), who forged the legendary alliance with the Éothéod that led to the founding of Rohan - though whether the city was renamed during his lifetime or posthumously to commemorate his deeds remains uncertain in historical records.The city rises in dramatic terraces up from the harbor, built into the rocky hillsides that characterize this stretch of coastline. Ancient Númenórean engineering is evident in the massive retaining walls and stone foundations that support the upper levels, testament to the skill of builders who worked here over four thousand years ago. The city's multi-level construction allows it to maximize defensibility while maintaining access to the vital harbor below, with ingenious lift systems connecting the upper, middle, and lower districts.

隆德奇瑞安立於拉戈爾都因河口，這條大河在此注入貝爾法拉斯灣，城市控制着安法拉斯中部海岸。安法拉斯意爲長灘，通用語中也稱蘭斯特蘭德。隆德奇瑞安還有一個獨特地位：它是剛鐸全境最古老的努門諾爾人定居點，甚至早於佩拉基爾和米那斯阿諾爾等大城，由第二紀元最早發現貝爾法拉斯灣的一批努門諾爾航海者建立。古代水手最初稱這裏爲奇瑞亞隆德，它是努門諾爾人在中洲這片大陸海岸上建立的第一個永久據點。數千年過去，昆雅語逐漸退出日常使用，辛達語成爲剛鐸主要的精靈語，舊名也隨之被人淡忘，最後由隆德奇瑞安取代。現名紀念剛鐸第十二任攝政宰相奇瑞安；他締結了與伊奧希奧德的傳奇盟約，並最終促成洛汗建立。不過這座城市究竟是在他生前改名，還是在他死後爲紀念其功績而改名，史料中仍無定論。城市從港口向上層層展開，修築在這一段海岸特有的岩石丘陵上。巨大的擋土牆和支撐上層城區的石基都能看出古代努門諾爾工程技藝，見證着四千多年前建築者的本領。多層城區既增強防禦，又保留了通往下方重要港口的通道，並用巧妙的升降裝置連接上、中、下城區。

Lothgobel stands as a modest but resilient village on the main northern route into Lamedon, positioned where travelers descending from the mountain passes first glimpse the fertile valleys below. The settlement consists of sturdy stone-and-timber buildings characteristic of upland Gondorian construction, with steep-pitched roofs to shed mountain rains and thick walls against winter winds from the White Mountains. During the War of the Ring, Lothgobel suffered occupation by Corsairs of Umbar who used its strategic position to threaten the road to Calembel, forcing many inhabitants to flee to their lord's stronghold. The village's central tavern - a significant structure for such a small settlement - serves as gathering place for travelers and locals alike, offering respite before the final approach to the regional capital. Following liberation by Aragorn and the Army of the Dead, Lothgobel's people have returned to rebuild their lives, though the memory of occupation lingers in cautious glances toward the southern roads. The surrounding hillsides support small farms and pastures where sheep graze, contributing to Lamedon's reputation as a center for wool production.

洛斯戈貝爾是一座樸素卻堅韌的村莊，坐落在通往拉梅頓的北方主路上。旅行者從山口下行時，會在這裏第一次望見下方肥沃的山谷。聚落由結實的石木建築構成，帶有剛鐸高地建築的典型特徵：屋頂陡峭，以便排走山雨；牆體厚重，用來抵禦白色山脈吹來的冬風。魔戒大戰期間，洛斯戈貝爾曾被烏姆巴爾的海盜佔據，他們利用這裏的戰略位置威脅通往卡倫貝爾的道路，迫使許多居民逃往領主的堡壘。村中中央酒館對這樣一座小村來說相當重要，是旅人與本地人共同聚集的地方，也讓人在前往地區首府的最後一段路前稍作休息。阿拉貢和亡者大軍解放此地後，洛斯戈貝爾的人們已經返回重建生活，不過被佔領的記憶仍會讓他們謹慎地望向南方道路。周圍山坡上有小農場和牧場，綿羊在此喫草，也讓拉梅頓作爲羊毛產地的名聲更穩固。

Lothuial, consort to Thranduil, draws from the elegant elven queens in Middle-earth's tales, providing counsel and healing wisdom to the royal house. Her presence strengthens the bonds of Nos Lasgalen, fostering unity among the Wood-elves as they confront the darkness spreading through Mirkwood.
洛蘇伊阿爾是瑟蘭杜伊的配偶，她的形象取材於中洲故事中優雅的精靈王后。她爲王室出謀劃策，也傳授治病救人的知識。她的存在加深了拉斯嘉蘭一族的紐帶，讓森林精靈在面對蔓延於黑森林的黑暗時更加團結。

Lothwen, dowager-aunt of the House of Imrazôrionath, has counted seventy and two winters upon the white cliffs of Belfalas, and her counsel is sought ere any voyage is undertaken or any betrothal sealed. In her youth she sailed with her brother to the haven of Edhellond and there, it is whispered, looked upon the last of the Elven mariners; the silver brooch she yet wears is the token of that meeting. She abides by the Steward of the City and chides any kinsman who would speak of a king unproven, for vigilance is the long virtue of her line.
洛絲玟是伊姆拉佐瑞昂納斯家族的寡居姑母，已經在貝爾法拉斯的白色峭壁上度過七十二個寒冬。無論家族要啓航遠行，還是締結婚約，都要先聽她的意見。年輕時，她曾隨兄長航向埃蒂爾瀧德港；據人低聲傳說，她在那裏見到了最後一批精靈水手。她至今佩戴的銀胸針，正是那次相遇的信物。她支持白城宰相，也會斥責任何談起未被證實之王的親族，因爲警惕是她這一脈長久以來的美德。

Lothériel of the House of Imrazôrionath was born to the silver shores of Belfalas, where the sea-wind tempers the daughters of old Númenor as surely as the sword tempers the son. Though yet young in her years, she has thrice ridden with the Swan-Knights upon the watch of the southern roads, and the elder ladies of Dol Amroth name her quick of wit and steady of hand. Her house holds firm to Lord Denethor, for the City must not falter while the shadow grows long, and the oath of the Stewards is an oath of stone.
伊姆拉佐瑞昂納斯家族的洛希瑞爾生於貝爾法拉斯銀色海岸，海風磨鍊舊努門諾爾的女兒，正如劍鋒磨鍊兒子。她年紀尚輕，卻已經三次隨天鵝騎士巡守南方道路；多阿姆洛斯的年長貴婦都稱她機敏且穩重。她的家族堅定支持德內梭爾領主，因爲陰影拉長時白城絕不能動搖，而宰相的誓言就像石頭一樣堅定。

盧加拉訓練戰犬的座狼羣。她的野獸毫不動搖地聽從命令，撕咬敵人陣線的側翼。
Lugash of the Uzgnâsh warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
盧嘎什是烏茲格納什戰幫的一名奧克隊長，脖頸粗壯。他經常在山路上劫掠，手裏的砍刀已崩出許多缺口。
Lugburz is scoutmaster of the White Hand, and the maps of the Gap of Rohan are kept in his head rather than on paper. He sends his runners out in threes and expects two back.
路格布爾茲是白手的斥候長。洛汗隘口的地圖不在紙上，而在他的腦子裏。他每次派出三名傳令兵，預料只能回來兩人。

Lugdush, grim commander of the Black Echelon, is a brutal enforcer of Saruman's doctrine. Towering and iron-clad, he drills his soldiers into a wall of shields and steel, smashing opposition with unflinching discipline. Unlike his berserker kin, Lugdush values structure over rage—his warriors are trained, not frenzied. He speaks little but strikes decisively, and his presence on the battlefield signals a cold, inevitable advance. Among the Uruk-hai, Lugdush is feared not for his voice, but for the silence that follows his command.
路格都什是黑色梯隊陰沉的指揮官，也是薩茹曼教條的殘暴執行者。他高大而披鐵甲，把士兵操練成盾與鋼鐵組成的牆，以毫不動搖的紀律碾碎反抗。與狂戰同族不同，路格都什看重陣形勝過怒火；他的戰士是被訓練出來的，而不是單靠狂怒驅使。他話不多，但出手果斷；當他出現在戰場上，就意味着一場冰冷而不可阻擋的推進即將到來。在烏魯克之中，路格都什令人恐懼的不是他的吼聲，而是他下令後隨之而來的沉默。
Lugrod is an old killer of the Morannon garrison, slow to anger and slower to forgive, who has outlived three captains by being the last orc standing on the wall.
盧格羅德是魔欄農駐軍中的老殺手，不輕易發怒，更不輕易原諒。他總是城牆上最後一個還站着的奧克，已經熬死了三任隊長。
Lugza of the Throgmaw orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
盧格扎是斯羅格莫氏族的一名女奧克，住在地底深處，兇狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族遜色。
Luichan commands Variag horsemen of the western plains.
盧伊錢統領西部平原的瓦里亞格騎手。
Lurtash of the Gashrim warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
盧爾塔什是嘎什林戰幫的一名奧克隊長，脖頸粗壯。他經常在山路上劫掠，手裏的砍刀已崩出許多缺口。
Lurthak is a brawler orc, engaging in pit fights that mirror the brutal orc recreations in the tales. His strength bolsters the clan's frontline in massive melees.
盧爾薩克是奧克鬥毆手，參與格鬥坑裏的搏殺，呼應故事中奧克殘酷的消遣。他的力量加強了氏族在大規模混戰中的前線。

Lurtz, the savage chieftain of the Black Maw, is the embodiment of raw Uruk ferocity. Bred for strength and domination, he leads his berserker warband with a thirst for slaughter unmatched even among the White Hand. Lurtz scorns restraint—his warriors fight in brutal packs, tearing through enemy ranks with overwhelming violence. Though he lacks the finesse of Saruman's other captains, few can rival his battlefield presence. Driven by fury and instinct, Lurtz and the Black Maw are loosed only when Saruman demands utter annihilation.
盧爾茲是黑顎部族野蠻的首領，是烏魯克原始兇性的化身。他爲力量與支配而生，帶着連白手同類都難以匹敵的殺戮欲統領自己的狂戰隊伍。盧爾茲蔑視剋制；他的戰士成羣撲殺，以壓倒性的暴力撕開敵陣。雖然他不具備薩茹曼其他隊長那樣的細膩手腕，但很少有人能在戰場氣勢上與他相比。盧爾茲和黑顎受怒火與本能驅使，只有在薩茹曼要求徹底殲滅時纔會被放出。
Lurtzag of the Throgmaw warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
盧爾察格是斯羅格莫戰幫的一名奧克隊長，脖頸粗壯。他經常在山路上劫掠，手裏的砍刀已崩出許多缺口。
Lurzia, a spell sentinel, detects magic, countering elven sorcery in Mirkwood's conflicts.
盧爾齊婭是法術哨衛，能偵測魔法，在黑森林沖突中對抗精靈巫術。

Lurzok, an orc archer captain, draws from the bow-wielding orcs that harried travelers in Middle-earth lore. His volleys from the mountain heights defend Gundabad's approaches, picking off scouts from Dwarven or Elven parties.
盧爾佐克是一名奧克弓箭隊長，源自中洲傳說中那些用弓騷擾旅人的奧克。他從山嶺高處齊射，守住通往貢達巴德的道路，射殺矮人或精靈隊伍派出的斥候。
萊奧布蘭德·德阿弗林加斯
萊奧蒙德·德阿弗林加斯
Léomund Deáfringas is a Rohirrim lord of the western vales.
德阿弗林加斯家族的萊奧蒙德是西部谷地的一位洛希爾領主。
Lûthkan Khundolar commands warriors of the western provinces.
昆多拉爾家族的盧斯坎統領西部行省的戰士。
Maeswen lies in a sheltered dale below Tûr Morva. Its shaggy hill ponies are small but sure-footed, and the clans of Dunland trade them as far as the Isen.
邁斯溫位於圖爾莫爾瓦下方一處避風的山谷。當地毛髮粗長的山地小馬個頭不大，腳步卻很穩。黑蠻地的氏族把它們賣到遠至艾森河一帶。
Maireas is a Variag warlord of the eastern hills, and has held them through three winters of raiding.
毛蕾阿斯是東部丘陵的一位瓦里亞格軍閥，已守住這些丘陵，熬過了三個充滿劫掠的冬天。
Make me your eyes and your bow. I will see them coming, and I will not wait for a white cloth.
讓我替你探路、替你放箭。我會看見他們過來，可不會等他們舉白布。

Makes AI/player caravans range beyond the local town cluster instead of shuttling between very-close towns, trade across the endless Free-vs-Evil war (per War Trade Policy below), and carry fuller baskets. Off = exact vanilla caravan behavior. Advanced curve knobs live in caravan_trade/caravan_trade_config.json; config edits need an app restart.
讓AI和玩家商隊走出本地城鎮羣，不再只往返於相鄰城鎮；按下方戰時貿易規則，在自由人民與黑暗勢力的長期戰爭中繼續貿易，並採購更豐富的貨物。關閉後完全恢復原版商隊行爲。進階參數位於 caravan_trade/caravan_trade_config.json，修改後需要重啓遊戲。
Malrior, son of Borhador, carries on his father's duties as the old lord ages. He is steady and dependable, respected by his clan.
馬爾瑞奧爾是博爾哈多爾之子，隨着老領主年邁，他繼續承擔父親的職責。他沉穩可靠，受到氏族尊敬。
Malthorn leads Nos Malgalad, a house that has not forgotten Amdir who fell at Dagorlad, and keeps that memory sharp upon its spears.
瑪爾梭恩領導着瑁加拉德家族。這個家族從未忘記在達戈拉德陣亡的阿姆狄爾，他們手中的長矛時刻提醒着他們這段往事。
Manan raids the coastal settlements of Gondor.
馬南襲擊剛鐸沿海定居點。
Manned the palisade of the Forest Gate.
守衛森林之門的木柵圍牆。
Manned the towers of Mordor's fortresses.
Maps and swords? Jack of all trades, master of none?
地圖和劍？樣樣都會，樣樣不精？
Maraa is wife to Calemir, known for her wisdom.
瑪拉婭是卡勒米爾的妻子，以智慧聞名。
Maraia is wife to the Loke-Khan, queen of the Golden Realm.
瑪萊婭是洛克可汗的妻子，也是黃金國度的王后。
March! Defend {settlement} in the name of Sauron!
出發！以索隆的名義保衛{settlement}！
Marched in the Orc legions of the Dark Lord.
隨黑暗魔君的奧克軍團行軍。
Marched in the shadow legions of Dol Guldur.
隨多古爾都陰影軍團行軍。
Marched with the caravan guards on the Dwarf-road.
隨商隊護衛沿矮人路行進。
Marhath leads horse breeders of the southern grasslands.
馬爾哈思率領南部草原的養馬人。
Mark a target through the mists — boosts +20% ranged damage, +20% draw speed, and +15% movement speed for 8s.
在迷霧中鎖定獵物：+20% 遠程傷害，+20% 拉弓速度，+15% 移動速度，持續 8 秒。
Mark these well. You will find them as I say.
記好這些地方，照我說的就能找到。
Marked Prey grants +5% ranged damage and marks a target for relentless pursuit.
標記獵物提供 +5% 遠程傷害，並把目標標出來，供獵手窮追不捨。

Markets and battle loot hand out light and medium armour freely. Heavy, elite and lord pieces are sold only where a town's armoury, its Barracks, is high enough; lord kit can also be forged there or earned piece by piece on the lord's gear ladder, whose last rung awards the named hero weapons; they are never sold or looted. Visit a town's armoury to upgrade a piece with metals. Takes effect from the next game load.
輕型和中型鎧甲可以正常從市場和戰利品中獲得。重型、精英和領主裝備只在軍械庫（兵營）等級足夠的城鎮出售；領主裝備也可以在那裏打造，或逐級完成領主裝備任務獲取。任務的最後一級獎勵知名英雄的專屬武器，這些武器不會出售，也不會作爲戰利品掉落。到城鎮軍械庫，可以用金屬材料升級裝備。下次載入遊戲後生效。
Marsh folk of Swanfleet live on wildfowl, eels and whatever the tide leaves. We learn early to count every arrow and every coin.
天鵝澤的沼澤居民靠水鳥、鰻魚和潮水留下的東西過活。我們很小就學會了，每支箭、每枚錢都得算着用。
Marshal's Word failed and is off until this scene ends. Your orders work as before.
元帥軍令發生錯誤，已停用至本場景結束。命令操作恢復原有方式。
Marshals of Westmark ride the long line between the plains and the forest eaves, and we trust our own eyes before any steward's word.
西境的元帥沿着平原和林緣間的漫長邊線巡行。比起任何總管的話，我們更信自己的眼睛。
Marzuk is a chieftain of the eastern Haradrim, lord of the oasis settlements.
馬爾祖克是東部哈拉德人的酋長，統治着綠洲聚落。
Massed spear-fodder of the High Pass warrens.
高隘口巢穴中成羣的長矛炮灰。
Master bowman of the vineyard slopes.
葡萄園山坡上的弓箭大師。
Master bowman of the western eaves.
Master of both, actually. My maps have guided armies to victory, and my blade has defended them when needed. If you value preparation as much as prowess, I offer my services.
實際上，兩樣我都精通。我的地圖曾引導軍隊走向勝利，而需要時，我的劍也能守住他們。若你像重視武勇一樣重視準備，我願爲你效力。
Master smith exiled for dangerous experiments. My craft pushes boundaries others fear.
鐵匠大師，因危險實驗被流放。我的技藝會推向別人害怕觸碰的邊界。

Master smith of the third circle, I was. Forged arms for Dáin's guard, repaired heirlooms from before the dragon. But I grew obsessed with old texts, pre-Smaug techniques, alloys lost to dragon-fire. Some called my interest unhealthy.
我曾是第三環的鐵匠大師。爲戴因的衛隊鍛造武器，也修復過巨龍來襲前的傳家寶。但我漸漸癡迷於古籍，癡迷於斯毛格之前的技藝，癡迷於那些被龍焰吞沒的合金。有人說我的興趣不太健康。

Master toggle for the combat feel pack: skill-based crush-through, monster/orc crush-through, creature cleave, creature stagger immunity, weight-based charge knockdown, shield penetration, race combat modifiers. When off, everything below is inert and combat behaves exactly as before this feature.
戰鬥手感改進的總開關，包括基於技能的破防、巨獸和半獸人破防、巨獸連續橫掃、巨獸硬直免疫、基於重量的衝鋒擊倒、盾牌穿透和種族戰鬥修正。關閉後，下方所有選項均不生效，戰鬥完全恢復此功能加入前的表現。
Master toggle for the siege auto-dismount feature. When off, sieges behave vanilla (mount stays equipped).
圍城自動下馬功能的總開關。關閉後，圍城保持原版表現，坐騎仍處於裝備狀態。

Master toggle. When off, cavalry uses vanilla charge logic. When on, the player's cavalry formations execute coordinated line charges with passthrough + reform behavior. Default OFF while war-elephant interaction is being tuned. Saved values from before November 2026 were reset to this default; if you had chosen your own, set it again.
總開關。關閉後，騎兵使用原版衝鋒邏輯。開啓後，玩家的騎兵編隊會協同展開橫列衝鋒，衝穿敵陣後重新整隊。目前仍在調整與戰象的互動，因此默認關閉。2026年11月以前保存的數值已重置爲此默認值；若你曾自行調整，請重新設置。

Master toggle. When off, every TAOM crash finalizer passes exceptions straight through and the AppDomain hook ignores them, so the game's own handler takes over (BUTR's too, unless TAOM already suspended it this session; then restart). Takes effect immediately: the finalizers are always installed at launch and check this toggle only when an exception arrives. Default ON.
總開關。關閉時，TAOM 的崩潰終結器直接放行異常，AppDomain 鉤子也忽略它們，交給遊戲本身的處理程序；BUTR 也會接手，除非本次運行中 TAOM 已暫停它，此時需重啓。立即生效：終結器始終在啓動時安裝，異常到來時才檢查此開關。默認：開啓。
Master toggle. When off, formations use vanilla positioning. When on, formations with mixed melee + ranged units are reordered per the chosen layout while holding position.
總開關。關閉時使用原版站位。開啓時，近戰與遠程混編的編隊在堅守位置時，會按所選陣型重新安排站位。

Master toggle. When off, hideout density + bandit party sizes use vanilla values. When on, both scale with PlayerProgress (0.0 new campaign -> 1.0 endgame) per the curves below. Turning it off restores vanilla's live numbers at once (including its 2-party minimum for a camp to count as infested) and stops scaling future spawns; it deletes no bandit party already on the map and culls no hideout above the cap, so a swamped campaign thins only as they are cleared.
總開關。關閉時，藏身處密度和匪徒部隊規模使用原版數值；開啓時，按下方曲線隨玩家進度增長（0.0爲新戰役，1.0爲後期）。關閉後立即恢復原版實時數值，包括判定營地被佔據所需的最低2支部隊，並停止調整後續生成。但不會刪除地圖上已有的匪徒，也不會清除超過上限的藏身處；已經氾濫的匪徒只能隨着清剿逐漸減少。
Master toggle. When off, inventory 'Sell All' uses vanilla. When on, it opens a 4-option menu.
總開關。關閉後，物品欄的“全部出售”使用原版方式。開啓後，會彈出包含4個選項的菜單。
Master toggle. When off, the F6 hotkey and the Fiefs button on the map bar are inert and the carousel options are disabled. Effective immediately at runtime. Default: true.
總開關。關閉後，F6快捷鍵和地圖欄的“封地”按鈕不再響應，封地輪選菜單中的選項也會停用。立即生效。默認：開啓。
Master toggle. When off, the Presets overlay is not added to the inventory screen and existing presets are inert (preserved in save).
總開關。關閉後，物品欄界面不再添加預設面板，已有預設也不再生效，但會保留在存檔中。
找到{COUNT}處，按距離從近到遠排列。
Matches: {COUNT}, showing the nearest {SHOWN}. Narrow the search.
找到{COUNT}處，只顯示最近的{SHOWN}處。請縮小搜索範圍。
Mathmog is a powerful Uruk-hai war chief.
馬思莫格是一名強大的烏魯克戰酋。
Mattered little. Preferred the tunnels anyway. Better scavenging alone.
這也沒多重要。反正我更喜歡隧道。一個人搜刮更自在。
Mattock Storm charge greatly reduced, nearly always available.
戰鎬風暴所需充能大幅減少，幾乎隨時都能發動。
Mattock Storm charge reduced, activating more frequently.
戰鎬風暴所需充能減少，可以更頻繁地發動。
Mattock Storm duration extended, fortifying the defense.
戰鎬風暴持續時間延長，讓防線更加穩固。
Mattock Storm grants +5 health, the weight of the mattock behind you.
戰鎬風暴提供生命值+5，巨鎬的重量爲你增添力量。
Mattock Storm grants additional defensive buffs while active.
戰鎬風暴生效期間，提供額外的防禦增益。
Mattock Storm radius greatly expanded, devastating power.
戰鎬風暴的作用範圍大幅擴大，威力更具毀傷性。
Mattock Storm radius increased, empowering more warriors.
戰鎬風暴的作用範圍擴大，更多戰士獲得增益。

Maugrukh commands the watcher-tower of Cirith Ungol, that high paranoid roost above the Morgul Vale where Shelob lairs in the under-passes. He took the tower by cutting down the previous captain on the stair, an old quarrel about a shipment of mail looted from the tarks at Osgiliath. The Eye sees little of him there, and he likes it so, for a captain far from Lugburz may eat his own ghash and answer to none. He hates Mauhoshat of Udun, who once named his garrison a kennel of snaga.
毛格魯克指揮奇立斯烏苟的守望塔；那座疑神疑鬼的高巢俯視着魔古爾山谷，而希洛布就潛伏在下方通道里。他奪下高塔的方式，是在樓梯上砍倒前任隊長；起因是一批從歐斯吉利亞斯塔克那裏搶來的鎖甲引發的舊怨。大眼在那裏很少看見他，而他也喜歡如此，因爲遠離路格布爾茲的隊長可以喫自己的嘎什，不必聽命於任何人。他憎恨烏頓的毛霍沙特，因爲對方曾把他的駐軍叫作一窩斯那嘎。

Mauhoshat was hammered into a captain in the marshalling camps of Udun, where the legions of the Morannon are sorted and counted before the long march out. He took the Arki standard by goading three rivals into a knife-quarrel and walking out of the pit alone, a tale the muster-clerks of Lugburz are said to have written down. He covets the favour of the Great Eye above all, and trains his uruks to be noticed by the wraiths who ride down from the iron gate. The Ikhon under Maugrukh he names a company of pit-rats, for they reported his muster-count light at the last great gathering.
毛霍沙特是在烏頓集結營中被錘打成隊長的；魔欄農軍團在長途出征前都會在那裏分揀清點。他通過挑動三名對手陷入刀鬥，然後獨自走出坑場，奪下阿爾基旗幟；據說路格布爾茲的點兵書記把這個故事記了下來。他最渴求大魔眼的恩寵，並訓練自己的烏魯克，希望他們能被從鐵門騎下來的戒靈注意到。他把毛格魯克麾下的伊孔稱作一羣坑鼠，因爲他們在上一次大集結時報告他的點兵數不足。
Mauhur of the Grobûrz warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
毛胡爾是格羅布爾茲戰幫的一名奧克隊長，脖頸粗壯。他經常在山路上劫掠，手裏的砍刀已崩出許多缺口。

Mauhúr, captain of the Red Echelon, is a relentless tactician forged in the blood pits beneath Isengard. Clad in iron, he commands the vanguard of Saruman's war host with ruthless precision. Mauhúr believes victory is won not by strength alone, but by the cold execution of orders. His warband is always first into the breach, driving fear into the hearts of men with disciplined aggression and merciless efficiency. To Mauhúr, hesitation is failure—and failure is death. Under his command, the Red Echelon carves a path of destruction worthy of the White Hand.
毛胡爾是赤紅梯隊的隊長，是在艾森加德地下血坑中鍛出的冷酷戰術家。他身披鐵甲，以無情的精準指揮薩茹曼戰軍的先鋒。毛胡爾相信勝利不只靠力量，更靠冷靜執行命令。他的戰幫總是第一個衝入缺口，用紀律嚴明的攻勢和毫不留情的效率讓人類心生恐懼。在毛胡爾看來，遲疑就是失敗，而失敗就是死亡。在他的指揮下，赤紅梯隊爲白手劈開一條配得上毀滅之名的道路。

Merit a troop type banks for each enemy its soldiers kill in a qualifying battle. Higher = faster promotions. Default: 1.
在符合條件的戰鬥中，某兵種的士兵每殺死一名敵人，爲該兵種積累多少功績。數值越高，晉升越快。默認：1。

Merit a troop type must bank before it earns a promotion offer. Note merit is pooled per troop TYPE, not per soldier — a large stack of one type reaches the bar faster than a small one. Higher = rarer promotions. Default: 32. Saved values from before November 2026 were reset to this default; if you had chosen your own, set it again.
一個兵種累計多少功績後，會獲得晉升機會。功績按兵種彙總，不按單個士兵計算，所以同兵種人數多的隊伍比人數少的更快達到門檻。數值越高，晉升越少。默認：32。2026年11月以前保存的數值已重置爲此默認值；若你曾自行調整，請重新設置。

Merit multiplier for a clan that had no party in the winning assault, so land goes to the houses that fought for it. Applies to your clan as well, exempt or not: this is about what a clan did, not what it holds. No effect when nothing is on record for the settlement, such as a fief that changed hands without an assault. 1.00 = off. Default: 0.50.
沒有派部隊參加獲勝攻城戰的家族使用此功績倍率，讓土地更容易分給爲它作戰的家族。你的家族無論是否豁免其他懲罰，也受此項影響：判斷的是參戰功勞，不是已有領地。定居點沒有參戰記錄時不生效，例如未經攻城就轉手的領地。1.00表示關閉。默認：0.50。

Merit multiplier for a clan that holds no town or castle at all. Keeps poor clans able to field parties instead of withering and leaving the kingdom. Vanilla already favours landless clans (a flat +30 and nothing in its holdings divisor), so this stacks on a strong base. 1.00 = no bonus. Default: 2.00.
沒有任何城鎮或城堡的家族使用此功績倍率，幫助貧窮家族維持部隊，避免衰敗後退出王國。原版本來就優待無領地家族（固定+30，領地除數中也不增加負擔），此加成會繼續疊加。1.00表示無加成。默認：2.00。

Merit multiplier for the clan that carried the winning assault: the largest share of the winning besieging side's battle contribution, the same number the loot split uses. Every other clan of that kingdom that fielded a party there gets it in proportion, 1 + (bonus - 1) x its share of the top clan's contribution, so a clan with half the top clan's contribution gets half the bonus. Mercenaries and allies from other kingdoms cannot be granted the fief and are not counted. Vanilla's flat +30 for the assault leader's clan is untouched. 1.00 = off. Default: 2.50.
爲勝利攻城中貢獻最大的家族增加功績倍率，貢獻比例使用與戰利品分配相同的數值。本王國其他派出部隊參戰的家族，按比例獲得加成：1 +（加成 - 1）× 其貢獻相對最高家族的比例。因此貢獻爲最高家族一半的家族，獲得一半的額外加成。傭兵和其他王國盟友不能獲得領地，不計入評估。原版給攻城指揮者家族的固定+30不變。1.00表示關閉。默認：2.50。
Merit multiplier for the king's own clan, which vanilla already hands a flat +60 on top of its tier and strength. Below 1.00 damps the crown's claim. 1.00 = vanilla. Default: 0.75.
國王所屬家族的分配評分倍率。原版在家族等級和實力評分之外，還會給統治家族固定60點加成。低於1.00可以削弱王室的分配優勢。1.00爲原版。默認：0.75。
Merit multiplier when it does not match. Lower means foreign clans rarely win a settlement of another culture. 1.00 = off. Default: 0.60.
家族文化與聚落不同時的分配評分倍率。數值越低，外來家族越難獲得其他文化的聚落。1.00表示關閉。默認：0.60。
Merit multiplier when the clan's culture matches the settlement's. Vanilla has no equivalent, which is how an orc clan ends up holding an elven city. 1.00 = off. Default: 1.50.
家族文化與聚落相同時的分配評分倍率。原版沒有此機制，因此可能出現半獸人家族統治精靈城市的情況。1.00表示關閉。默認：1.50。
Meters past the target before cavalry reforms a new line. Larger = wider passthrough sweep. Default 25.
騎兵衝過目標多少米後重新列陣。數值越大，衝穿敵陣後的行進範圍越大。默認：25米。

Metres over which a wraith projects dread. Full strength within the inner radius from dread_aura_config.json (default 2m), falling to nothing at this distance. Default 5. The ceiling is 15: beyond 15 m the engine's proximity search stops using its grid and checks every agent on the field, on every pulse.
戒靈散佈恐懼的距離，單位爲米。在dread_aura_config.json設置的內圈半徑內爲全額效果，默認內圈2米；效果隨距離減弱，在此距離降至零。默認：5。上限爲15米，因爲超出15米後，引擎的鄰近搜索不再使用空間網格，而是每次生效時檢查全場所有單位。

Metres relative to the human eye height. Negative lowers the camera. Default -0.20. The resulting height is clamped to a safe range, so extreme values cannot put the camera in the floor. Like the toggle above, a change lands the next time a dwarf visual is built.
相對於人類視點高度的偏移，單位爲米。負值會降低鏡頭，默認-0.20。最終高度會限制在安全範圍內，極端數值也不會把鏡頭放進地板裏。與上方開關相同，修改後在下次創建矮人外觀時生效。

Turning this on with an empty config changes nothing; add entries in combat_mechanics_config.json first.

Morale per second drained at full strength, before the target's tier/hero resistance and its racial resistance. The aura stops at a morale floor of 10 (dread_aura_config.json), so it never routs anyone by itself. At the default 5.0, in an even fight, a tier-3 human reaches the floor after about 22 seconds of contact, a tier-6 elite about 37, and an elven hero of level 16 or more never. Below about 1.0 the engine's own morale recovery outpaces the drain.

Mordor is a dark, desolate realm forged in shadow and ruled by the Dark Lord Sauron. Nestled behind the towering black mountains, this kingdom brims with orc armies, ruthless trolls, and fiery forges crafting weapons of war. From his fortress in Barad-dur, Sauron commands an unstoppable force, poised to spread his dominion across Middle-earth. Mordor's skies are clouded with ash, and its lands are barren, a fitting domain for Sauron's twisted ambition and dark magic.
魔多是一片由陰影鍛成、由黑暗魔君索隆統治的黑暗荒蕪之地。高聳黑山之後，這個國度充滿奧克大軍、殘忍食人妖和打造戰爭武器的熾熱熔爐。索隆從巴拉督爾要塞發號施令，統率一股幾乎無法阻擋的力量，隨時準備把自己的統治擴散到整個中洲。魔多天空佈滿灰燼，大地貧瘠荒涼，正適合索隆扭曲的野心與黑暗魔法。

Mordor is one path to power, not the only path. The Dark Lord's empire will expand, and when it does, those positioned correctly will rise with it. I have the blood, the training, and the ambition. I just need the right opportunity, the right alliance. Power doesn't care where you find it.
魔多是通向權力的一條路，但不是唯一的路。黑暗魔君的帝國必將擴張，到那時，站對位置的人會隨之上升。我有血統，有訓練，也有野心。我只需要合適的機會，合適的盟友。權力不在乎你從哪裏得到它。

Mordor's loss is my gain. Out here, strength matters more than politics. I'll build my own warband eventually, lead them to victories no committee of frightened veterans would dare attempt. The world is ripe for taking, I just need the opportunity and warriors willing to follow strength.
魔多失去我，是我的收穫。在外面，力量比權謀更重要。總有一天我會建立自己的戰團，帶他們打下那些膽小老兵組成的委員會不敢嘗試的勝仗。這個世界正適合奪取，我只需要機會，以及願意追隨力量的戰士。

Mordor's reach extends far, but so do the shadows where one can hide. My skills translate well beyond dungeon walls, interrogation, intimidation, extracting truth from the unwilling. There are many who would pay for such expertise, and I'm no longer bound by the Tower's restrictions.
魔多的手伸得很遠，但可供藏身的陰影也同樣漫長。我的本事離開地牢也一樣有用：審訊、威嚇、從不情願的人口中逼出真相。願意爲這種手藝付錢的人很多，而我也不再受那座高塔的規矩束縛。
More of the faithful answer your call. Voice of the One charge cost -20.
更多虔信者回應你的召喚。至尊魔戒之聲充能消耗 -20。
More riders join the charge each time. Warpack Charge duration +2s.
每一次衝鋒都會有更多騎手加入。戰羣衝鋒持續時間 +2 秒。
Morgash rose through the ranks as master of reconnaissance. His scouts range far ahead of Isengard's armies, marking targets for destruction.
莫爾加什從隊伍中一路爬升，成爲偵察大師。他的斥候遠遠走在艾森加德大軍前方，爲即將被摧毀的目標作標記。
“烏魯克斥候指揮官”莫爾加什
Morgha stands at the Dark Lord's side, mistress of the inner hierarchy of Lugbúrz. Her word carries the weight of the Eye, and the captains of Mordor fear her counsel as much as Sauron's wrath.
莫爾加站在黑暗魔君身旁，掌管路格布爾茲的內部權力體系。她的話就如魔眼的命令一樣有分量；魔多將領對她的意見，與對索隆的怒火一樣畏懼。
Morgith is a mysterious figure who communes with the spirits of the ancient hills.

Morgul warrior who defied a coward's order. Fled rather than face punishment for victory.

Morgulash, a shadowy sorceress, weaves dark spells in Dol Guldur, her arts reminiscent of the necromancy that corrupted the hill fortress in the books, aiding Khamûl in summoning undead minions.
摩古拉什是一名行蹤詭祕的女巫，在多古爾都施展黑暗法術，幫助可哈穆爾召喚亡靈僕從。她的法術讓人想起書中腐化那座山丘堡壘的死靈術。
Moria Frenzy charge greatly reduced, nearly always available.

Moves a soldier who stays stuck back to where he can walk: off the walkable ground or still in water for 10 seconds, he steps to the nearest good spot within 6 m at his own height; still stuck after 30 seconds, he moves to his place in his formation while you are at least 25 m away. A riderless horse gets the short step only. Never the player, fleeing men, creatures, men working a ladder or machine, or men holding a set post or waiting at a ladder. Field battles, sieges and sally-outs, not co-op. Default: on.
將持續卡住的士兵移回可行走位置：離開可行走地面，或在水中靜止10秒後，移到同一高度、6米以內最近的有效位置；30秒後仍卡住，且你距其至少25米時，則移回其編隊位置。無人騎乘的馬只會進行短距離移動。絕不移動玩家、逃兵、生物、操作梯子或器械的士兵，也不移動堅守指定崗位或正在梯旁等待的士兵。適用於野戰、攻城和突圍出擊，合作聯機除外。默認：開啓。
