Siegeberht patrols the borders of Rohan.
西格伯特巡視洛汗邊境。
Sifra Bonewalker walks among the fallen after battle, collecting trophies from the slain.
“行骨者”西弗拉會在戰後走到死者之間，從陣亡者身上收集戰利品。
Sigga Wyrmbane earned her name slaying a great serpent in the mountain passes.
“斬龍”西加因在山口斬殺一條巨蛇而贏得這一名號。
Sigrun Boarfang is known for her fearless charges into enemy ranks.
“野豬牙”西格倫以無所畏懼地衝入敵陣而聞名。
Silenced for speaking truth, all too common.
因說出真相而被堵住嘴，這太常見了。
Silivren tends the stores and songs of Nos Malgalad alike, for in Lorien the two have never been far apart.
熙利弗仁既照管瑁加拉德家族的物資，也傳承家族的歌謠。在羅瑞恩，生活與歌謠從來就密不可分。

Silmador, kinsman of Lord Rondamir and second of the hall, is reckoned the swiftest rider of the house and warden of its eastern marches toward the Mering Stream. He bears a coat of mail wrought in the smithies of Erech, bequeathed to him by his uncle who fell on the Pelennor of an older war. By his wedding to Galinwen of Pelargir he has drawn the salt-wind of the haven into the high vales. He holds, as his kinsman holds, with Denethor of the House of Húrin.
希爾瑪多爾是隆達米爾領主的親族，也是廳堂中的第二號人物，被認爲是家族最快的騎手，並守衛通往梅爾林河的東部邊境。他穿着一件埃瑞赫鐵匠打造的鎖子甲，這件甲由一位在舊日佩蘭諾戰場陣亡的叔父傳給他。通過與佩拉基爾的加林玟成婚，他把港口的鹹風引入了高地山谷。他和自己的親族一樣，支持胡林家族的德內梭爾。

Silmariel, born of the lesser house of Tarondor in Lebennin, came to Garvirionath in her twenty-second summer bringing a dowry of fair river-meadows and the loyalty of pikemen of the Five Streams. She is a lady of soft speech and unbending mind, and the hearth-hall of Amon Din has prospered under her hand. In the matter of the Steward and the claimant from the North, she counsels her lord to keep faith with Minas Tirith ere all is sundered.
西爾瑪瑞爾出身萊本寧塔隆多爾小家族，二十二歲那年帶着富饒河畔草地的嫁妝，以及五谿長槍兵的忠誠來到加爾維瑞昂納斯。她說話溫和，意志卻不彎；阿蒙丁的爐廳在她手中日益興旺。在宰相與北方宣稱者的問題上，她勸自己的領主在一切分裂之前先守住對米那斯提力斯的信義。
Silver Rain charge greatly reduced, relentless fire.
銀雨充能消耗大幅降低，可以持續傾瀉箭火。
Silver Rain charge reduced, maintaining constant pressure.
銀雨充能消耗降低，可以持續壓制敵人。
Silver Rain duration extended, sustained barrage.
銀雨持續時間延長，可以維持更久的齊射。
Silver Rain gains additional penetration while active.
銀雨生效期間，會獲得額外破甲能力。
Silver Rain grants +5% ranged damage, arrows tipped in starlight.
銀雨提供 +5% 遠程傷害，箭鏃閃耀着星光。
Silver Rain radius greatly expanded, inescapable volleys.
銀雨作用範圍大幅擴大，箭雨讓敵人無處可逃。
Silver Rain radius increased, covering wider kill zones.
銀雨作用範圍擴大，覆蓋更寬的殺傷區域。
Silver cannot steady this place beyond what it holds now.
即使花錢，也無法讓這裏的忠誠度再提高了。
Silver in the right hands steadies the watch. Loyalty here stands at {TAOM_WSILVER_LOYALTY}. What will you spend?
錢用對了地方，衛隊才能穩住局面。這裏的忠誠度是{TAOM_WSILVER_LOYALTY}，你打算花多少？
Silvina serves in the garrison of the spider's pass.
西爾維娜在蜘蛛隘口的守軍中效力。
Silvind is a shieldmaiden of the Westfold.
西爾溫德是西伏爾德的盾女。

Silwen, brought in dower from a sister-house of Pelargir to the House of Eärnurionath, has the bearing of the sea-roads in her speech and the wariness of the haven-watch in her eye. She wedded Calion in the autumn of her three and thirtieth year, and to her dowry she added a chart of the southern shoals drawn by her grandsire who fell at the burning of the quays. With her husband she holds for the King returned, for she has seen, year upon year, how the Corsairs grow bold while the City waits, and waiting alone shall not now suffice.
希爾玟作爲嫁妝從佩拉基爾的姐妹家族進入埃雅努瑞昂納斯家族；她說話裏帶着海路的氣息，眼中有港口守望者的警惕。三十三歲那年秋天，她嫁給卡利昂；除嫁妝之外，她還帶來一張南方淺灘海圖，那是她祖父所繪，而祖父死於碼頭焚燬之時。她與丈夫一樣支持歸來的國王，因爲她年復一年看見烏姆巴爾海盜變得大膽，而白城只是等待；如今單靠等待已經不夠。

Simple existence, fight, kill, win. Led assault teams against Rohan's outlying fortresses. First through the breach every time, blade red with enemy blood. My warriors followed because I never asked them to do what I wouldn't do. Earned my position through strength, not breeding or favor.
我的活法很簡單：戰鬥，殺敵，取勝。我曾率領突擊隊攻打洛汗邊境要塞。每次都是第一個衝進缺口，刀上滿是敵人的血。我的戰士追隨我，因爲我從不要求他們做我自己不肯做的事。我的位置靠力量贏來，不靠培育出身，也不靠偏愛。
只有一處咽喉要地聚落
Sire forged siege-engines for dark lords. I scratched runes, steady claw. Roamed pits, just us, bliss, till he rotted.
我爹曾爲黑暗領主打造攻城器械。我用穩穩的爪子刻符文。我們在坑裏來回奔走，只有我們倆，那日子很好，直到他腐爛死去。
Sire slain young. Dam bound to another. He coveted our pit. Hired sly goblin, law-twister.
我爹死得早。我娘被綁給了另一個傢伙。他貪我們的坑，僱了個滑頭半獸人，專門扭曲規矩。

Size of party-icon figures and their mounts on the campaign map. Vanilla = 0.30; default 0.15 = half (makes parties feel smaller relative to settlements). Applies on the next icon rebuild after changing.
戰役地圖上部隊圖標中人物和坐騎的大小。原版爲0.30，默認0.15爲原版的一半，讓部隊相對聚落顯得更小。修改後，在下次重建圖標時生效。
Skardush of the Skarnâk warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
斯卡爾杜什是斯卡爾納克戰幫的一名奧克隊長，脖頸粗壯。他經常在山路上劫掠，手裏的砍刀已崩出許多缺口。
Skarnak leads a company of Mordor orcs, a brutal captain who claws his way up the muster by breaking those above him. The lash and the Eye are the only laws he keeps.
斯卡納克率領一支魔多奧克部隊，是個殘暴的隊長。他靠打垮上級不斷往上爬，只服從鞭子和魔眼。
Skarnash of the Uzgnâsh warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
斯卡爾納什是烏茲格納什戰幫的一名奧克隊長，脖頸粗壯。他經常在山路上劫掠，手裏的砍刀已崩出許多缺口。
Skarnza of the Bûrzghâsh orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
斯卡爾恩扎是布爾茲加什氏族的一名女奧克，住在地底深處，兇狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族遜色。
Skarza of the Hrakdûr orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
斯卡爾扎是赫拉克杜爾氏族的一名女奧克，住在地底深處，兇狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族遜色。
Skill like yours should not rot unused.
你這樣的箭術，不該白白荒廢。
技藝嫺熟的巴德一族鐵匠
技藝精湛的貝奧恩族鐵匠
技藝精湛的多溫尼安鐵匠
技藝嫺熟的哈拉德金屬匠
技藝嫺熟的可汗德金屬匠
技藝精湛的羅瓦尼安鐵匠
技藝嫺熟的洛希爾鐵匠
技藝精湛的林中居民鐵匠
Skills honed in darkness, terrible but useful.
在黑暗中磨出的本事，殘酷，卻有用。
Skip horses/mounts when selling damaged. Default: true.
出售受損物品時跳過馬匹和其他坐騎。默認：開啓。
跳過馬匹和其他坐騎。默認：開啓。
受過散兵訓練的海戰士。
Skraa keeps the under-cells of the Tower-guard, where the questioning is done and seldom finished quickly.
斯克拉看守塔衛的地下牢房。審訊都在那裏進行，而且很少會很快結束。
Skrelga of the Skarnâk orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
斯克雷爾加是斯卡爾納克氏族的一名女奧克，住在地底深處，兇狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族遜色。
Skrunak, chieftain of the Hrakdûr orcs, holds the deep galleries and cold passes of the Misty Mountains for the Shadow.
斯克魯納克是赫拉克杜爾奧克的酋長，爲黑暗勢力守衛迷霧山脈深處的地下通道和寒冷的隘口。
Slave trader and murderer who fled Mordor after killing his partner. Works for coin, nothing more.
奴隸販子兼殺人犯，殺死同夥後逃離魔多。只爲錢辦事，僅此而已。
Slayer, she-orc as shadows whisper. Common in depths. Perhaps met kin before.
殺手，女奧克，如陰影低語般的人物。深處並不少見這種事。也許你以前見過她的親族。
Sleeping men are not a fleet, whatever flag they sailed under.
睡着的人可不算艦隊，不管他們掛什麼旗。
你殺了自己的伴侶？離我遠點！
Slow your steps, traveller. The desert gives nothing for free, and the road through it is ours to sell. Pay the toll, or the sand will take the rest.
慢點，過路的。沙漠裏沒有白拿的東西，走這裏的路，也得向我們買。交過路費，不然剩下的一切就留給沙子。
超過{LEVEL}級後，學習速度降至最低
狡猾的羅瓦尼安走私販
狡詐的黑蠻地人走私者
小額賞錢：每名士兵的金幣
Smell that? Burnt iron. Good. That is my work on me.
聞到了嗎？燒過的鐵味。好，那是幹活留下的味道。

Smelting a weapon returns at most the number set below of each iron grade, of iron ore and of hardwood, and no hardwood at all when any metal comes out. Charcoal use is unchanged. This curbs the loop of selling looted weapons as iron. Default: on.
熔煉一件武器時，每種品級的鐵、鐵礦石和硬木的產量，分別不超過下方上限；只要產出任何金屬，就完全不產出硬木。木炭消耗不變。這能抑制靠熔煉戰利品武器、出售金屬反覆賺錢的玩法。默認：開啓。
Smoke brings rumor. A sensible lord waits for proof.
烽煙傳來的不過是傳言。明智的領主會等證據。
Snaga is a servant of the Shadow.
斯那嘎是黑暗勢力的僕從。
Snaga riders attack in packs. +2% troop damage.
斯那嘎騎手成羣發動攻擊。+2% 部隊傷害。
Snagash of the Morzûk warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
斯納嘎什是莫爾祖克戰幫的一名奧克隊長，脖頸粗壯。他經常在山路上劫掠，手裏的砍刀已崩出許多缺口。
Snagrat drives the field-gangs of Nurn from horseback, and has never once walked among the slaves he herds.
斯納格拉特總是騎在馬上，驅趕努爾恩田地裏的勞工。他從未走到這些受他驅使的奴隸當中。
Snagrat of the Maughâsh warband is a thick-necked orc captain, his cleaver notched from the raiding of the mountain roads.
斯納格拉特是毛嘎什戰幫的一名奧克隊長，脖頸粗壯。他經常在山路上劫掠，手裏的砍刀已崩出許多缺口。
Snarl, I'm here to gorge, not yap. But fine, quick.
吼，我是來喫飽的，不是來閒扯的。行吧，快點說。
Snarla keeps the forges of the Ash Guard burning day and night. Her weapons arm the armies that march from Isengard.
斯納拉讓灰燼衛的熔爐日夜燃燒。她打造的武器武裝着從艾森加德出征的軍隊。
齜牙咧嘴的半獸人打手
Snazga of the Maughâsh orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
斯納茲加是毛嘎什氏族的一名女奧克，住在地底深處，兇狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族遜色。
Sneak-Creeping grants +5% movement speed and lets the rider vanish into Mordor's shadow.
潛行突進提供 +5% 移動速度，並讓騎手消失在魔多的陰影中。
Snurga of the Gashrim orcs is a snarling she-orc of the deep places, as quick with the knife as any of her brood.
斯努爾加是嘎什林氏族的一名女奧克，住在地底深處，兇狠暴躁。她出刀的速度不比任何同族遜色。

So I carry my lance to where it is paid for honestly. The war the Taskral is raising will need men who do not break, and I have never broken at anything. Let others fight for a cause. I fight to be the best, and to be paid like it.
所以我把騎槍帶到能誠實付錢的地方。塔斯克拉爾正在掀起的戰爭需要不會崩潰的人，而我從未在任何事上崩潰過。讓別人爲了事業戰鬥吧。我戰鬥是爲了成爲最強，也爲了拿到配得上最強的報酬。

So I carry my reckoning elsewhere. A war-band is only a small House, and it runs on the same arithmetic: coin in, coin out, and no waste. The Dark Lord's war will ruin the careless and enrich the precise. I intend to be precise, and to serve someone who values it.
所以我把自己的算賬本事帶到了別處。一支戰團不過是個小家族，也遵循同樣的算術：錢進來，錢出去，不許浪費。黑暗魔君的戰爭會毀掉粗心的人，也會讓精明的人發財。我打算繼續精明，也打算爲懂得重視它的人效力。

So I carry my sword to where loyalty still means something. I am young, I know, and I have seen one hard year where older men have seen twenty. But I keep my word past breaking, and a captain who can trust the man at his back has something many lords would envy. I would be that man for you.
所以我把劍帶到忠誠仍有意義的地方。我知道自己年輕，也知道年長者見過二十個艱難年頭，而我只見過一個。但我會守信到最後一刻，而一個能信任背後之人的隊長，擁有許多領主都會羨慕的東西。我願爲你做那個人。
So I do neither. I walk, I eat, and I keep a count of every grey-feathered arrow I find. When I have enough, I will walk up to Mithlond's gate and ask for the patrol-captain.
那我就一樣也不幹。我走路、喫飯，撿到一支灰羽箭就記下一支。等攢夠了，我會走到米斯瀧德大門前，點名找那個巡邏隊長。

So I drift, and there is always need for a man who knows horseflesh and how to acquire it quietly. The tribes are mustering and good mounts will be worth their weight in silver soon. I would rather break and tend them than steal them, if the work is honest enough.
所以我到處漂泊。總有人需要一個懂馬，也懂得如何悄無聲息弄到馬的人。各部族正在集結，好馬很快就會比等重的銀子還值錢。若這活兒足夠正當，我更願意馴養並照料它們，而不是偷它們。

So I drill other men's companies now, and choose lords who fight like soldiers rather than butchers. The Dark Lord's war will be no gentle thing, I know. But there is a difference between a hard war and a foul one, and I will only lend my craft to the former.
所以如今我訓練別人的連隊，也選擇那些像士兵而不是屠夫一樣作戰的領主。我知道黑暗魔君的戰爭不會溫和。但艱苦的戰爭和骯髒的戰爭並不是一回事，我只會把手藝借給前者。

So I keep my own counsel and my own oath now, and sell my sword only to those who will not make me ashamed to draw it. There is a war coming that will swallow honest men whole. I would rather choose where I spend mine.
所以如今我只聽自己的判斷，也守自己的誓言，只把劍賣給那些不會讓我羞於拔劍的人。一場戰爭正在逼近，它會把誠實的人整個吞下去。我寧願自己選擇把命花在哪裏。
So I left before he finished the sum. Honor is a tale for the dead. A plan is what lives, and mine are still good.
所以他還沒算完，我就走了。榮譽是講給死人聽的，計劃才讓人活着。我的計劃照樣管用。

So I left the beasts I loved rather than watch them die for nothing, and that grief rides with me still. I know warfare and I know command, but I have no taste for throwing lives, beast or man, away for show. Give me a captain who spends his strength wisely, and I will serve him well.
所以我寧願離開自己愛的巨獸，也不願看着它們白白死去，而這份悲傷至今仍跟着我。我懂戰爭，也懂指揮，但我不願把生命，無論野獸還是人，拿去做給別人看。給我一個懂得明智使用力量的隊長，我就會好好爲他效力。
So I left, and I have been unlucky in a wider world ever since. Strange, though: the arrows still miss me. Perhaps the doom is waiting for something larger.
我就走了，從那以後，換了更大的天地倒霉。倒也奇怪，箭還是射不中我。也許那場災還在等更大的事。

So I rebuild, the only way I know, by making myself useful to someone with a war to fund. The Dark Lord's muster will bankrupt the foolish and enrich the shrewd, and I have learned, expensively, how to tell them apart. Let me keep your army in the field, and I will keep myself in coin.
所以我用自己唯一懂的方法重建一切：讓自己對某個需要軍費的人有用。黑暗魔君的徵召會讓蠢人破產，也會讓精明人發財，而我用昂貴的代價學會了分辨兩者。讓我讓你的軍隊留在戰場上，我也會讓自己繼續有錢可賺。

So I sold some of it. A Bree-land gang paid well to learn which wagons carried ore and which carried silver, and when to expect them. It went smoothly for three seasons, until the Bree watch took the gang and the gang named its friends. My house struck my name from its rolls before the warden could send for me.
所以我賣了點消息。布理鄉的一個匪幫肯出好價錢，打聽哪輛車裝礦石、哪輛裝銀子，什麼時候會到。三個季度都順順當當，後來布理衛隊抓了他們，他們就把朋友的名字都供了。守將還沒來傳我，家族就先把我除名了。
So be it. Form up, as we were taught. If this is the end, it is at least a soldier's end.[ib:aggressive][if:convo_annoyed]
那就這樣吧。按教過的辦法列陣！如果今天就是最後一天，至少讓我們像士兵一樣死。[ib:aggressive][if:convo_annoyed]
So be it. I will tell you what you want to know.
好吧，我告訴你想知道的事。
So here I am, a watchman without a ford, holding a tally nobody wants. I keep it anyway, in case a better council ever asks.
所以我到了這兒，成了個沒渡口可守的衛兵，攥着一本誰都不想要的賬。我還是接着記，萬一哪天有個像樣的議事會肯問呢。
So here I am, a watchman without a harbor, holding a ledger nobody wants. I keep the tally anyway, in case a better council ever asks.
所以我到了這兒，成了個沒港口可守的衛兵，攥着一本誰都不想要的賬。我還是接着記，萬一哪天有個像樣的議事會肯問呢。
So here I am, a watchman without a town, holding a ledger nobody wants. I keep the tally anyway, in case a better council ever asks.
所以我到了這兒，成了個沒城鎮可守的衛兵，攥着一本誰都不想要的賬。我還是接着記，萬一哪天有個像樣的議事會肯問呢。

So my craft is for hire, on either side of a wall. With the Dark Lord's war coming, every lord will want his strongholds sound and his enemy's breached. I am too old to climb the ladders, but I can tell you precisely where to set them. Or where to fear them set against you.
所以我的手藝現在可以僱用，牆的哪一邊都行。黑暗魔君的戰爭將至，每個領主都希望自己的要塞牢固，也希望敵人的城牆被攻破。我太老了，爬不上攻城梯，但我能準確告訴你該把梯子架在哪裏，或者該害怕敵人把梯子架在哪裏。

So my learning travels with me now. A captain who can read a captured order, parse a treaty, or know an enemy lord's blood-claims has an edge over one who cannot. The Dark Lord's war is fought with words and lineages as much as spears, and I can fight on that ground at least.
所以如今我的學問跟着我旅行。一個隊長若能讀懂繳獲的命令、解析條約，或知道敵方領主的血統主張，就比做不到這些的人更有優勢。黑暗魔君的戰爭既用文字和血脈來打，也用長矛來打，至少在那片戰場上，我能出力。

So my talents are on the market, for those with the stomach to use them. In war, a forged order in the right hands is worth a thousand spears in the wrong place. I do not pretend my trade is honest, but it is effective, and the Dark Lord's war will have ample need of it.
所以我的才能現在擺在市場上，給那些有膽量使用它們的人。戰爭中，一份落到合適人手裏的僞造命令，勝過一千支站錯地方的長矛。我不假裝自己的行當誠實，但它很有效，而黑暗魔君的戰爭會非常需要它。
So you choose the sword. The dunes have swallowed greater hosts than yours.
這麼說，你選了刀劍。比你龐大得多的軍隊，也被這些沙丘吞沒過。
So you nurse a grudge and call it thrift.
你只是心懷怨恨，卻管它叫節儉。
索哈泰是瓦赫拉坦的妻子。

Soldiers standing with the hideout boss in the final fight, on both the daytime assault and the night sneak-in. The fight is exactly the boss plus this many (0 = the boss alone), whether you take the duel or fight them all; the rest of the camp is cleared in the first phase. Applies with Enable Bandit Scaling off too. Vanilla fields 5 to 10 with the boss. Default: 4.
白天強攻和夜間潛入時，最後階段跟隨首領的士兵人數。無論單挑還是一起作戰，都只有首領加這些護衛；0表示首領獨自一人。其他營地敵人在第一階段清理。關閉“匪徒縮放”後仍生效。原版首領有5到10名護衛。默認：4。

Soldiers who do the killing in a hard-won battle can be promoted into named companions. Turn OFF to stop it entirely: no merit is earned, no promotion is ever offered. Companions you already promoted stay exactly as they are, and banked merit is kept in case you turn it back on. Takes effect immediately; no restart. Default ON.
在艱難獲勝的戰鬥中殺敵的士兵，有機會晉升爲擁有名字的同伴。關閉後完全停止此功能，不再獲得功績，也不會提出晉升建議。已經晉升的同伴保持不變，已積累的功績也會保留，供重新開啓後使用。立即生效，無需重啓。默認開啓。
Solun was a respected noyan who fell in battle against the Free Peoples. His widow Gûrtilm now leads their clan with iron determination.
歲侖是一位受人尊敬的那顏，在與自由人民的戰鬥中陣亡。他的遺孀古爾提姆如今以堅定的決心領導着氏族。
Some are bred for fury beyond even Saruman's control...

Some are drawn to darkness by circumstance, others are born to it...
有些人是被境遇拖向黑暗，有些人則生來屬於黑暗……
有些戰鬥需要祕密進行。
Some daughters of the plains ride and fight as their grandmothers did. The villages call it shame, and the raiders call it a mistake.
平原上有些女兒，像祖母當年一樣騎馬作戰。村裏人說這是丟臉，劫掠者則發現自己打錯了主意。
Some dwarves are born for war, whatever peacetime brings...

Some of us remember Gil-galad's host and what its fall cost. That memory sits heavily on the Elves who stayed in Lindon.
我們有些人，還記得吉爾-加拉德的大軍，也記得它倒下的代價。這份記憶，一直壓在留守林頓的精靈心上。
Some of us remember when the mountain was desolate, and fear it could be again...
我們中有人記得孤山荒廢時的模樣，也害怕它再次變成那樣……
Some serve the Dark Lord, others serve only themselves...
有些人侍奉黑暗魔君，有些人只侍奉自己……
Some warriors are too effective for their own good...

Something went wrong, and nothing was handed out.
出了點問題，什麼也沒發出去。
Sometimes myths serve better than facts in dark times.

有時想活下去，就得妥協。
Sometimes the simplest warriors are the most dangerous...
有時候，最簡單直接的戰士才最危險……
Sometimes we must lose ourselves to find our true path.

Stripped of rank, I now offer my mind and experience to those who judge by merit, not birth. The coming war will need commanders who can think, not just those who can swing a sword.
我被剝奪軍銜後，把頭腦和經驗獻給那些按能力而不是出身評判人的人。即將到來的戰爭需要會思考的指揮官，而不只是會揮劍的人。
Strips your battle + civilian equipment to inventory.
將你的戰鬥裝備和平民裝備全部卸下，放入物品欄。
Stronghold-upgrade keep-out radius from towns and castles. Default 26.
升級爲堡壘時，必須與城鎮和城堡保持的距離。默認：26。
Stubborn heavy infantry and steady crossbows
頑強的重步兵與沉穩的弩手
Studied craft and lore in Cirdan's halls.
在奇爾丹的殿堂中學習工藝和學識。
Studied craft and lore in Elrond's halls.
在埃爾隆德廳堂學習工藝和傳說。
Studied healing and herb-lore under a Ranger healer.
在遊俠醫者手下學習醫術和草藥知識。
Studied the healing arts of the Golden Wood.
學習金色森林的醫治技藝。
Subetai of House Cilzeron rides at the head of the clan's lancers, a hard-handed kinsman whose banner is feared across the plains of Rhûn.
西爾澤隆家族的速不臺率領着家族的槍騎兵。他手段強硬，魯恩平原上的人都畏懼他的旗幟。
Successful raids bring great renown. +8% battle renown gain.
成功的掠襲會帶來響亮威名。+8% 戰鬥聲望獲取。
Successful raids build fearsome reputation. +8% battle renown gain.
成功的掠襲會積累令人畏懼的名聲。+8% 戰鬥聲望獲取。
Such a horde devours everything — +20% party food consumption.
這樣一支部落會吞掉一切；部隊食物消耗 +20%。
Such snarls keep mates in line.
這種咆哮就是用來管住配偶的。
Sukayna is wife to the scout commander.
蘇凱娜是斥候統領的妻子。
Sulhana is a noble of the frontier.
蘇爾哈娜是邊境地區的貴族。
被烈日曬成古銅色的輕步兵僱傭軍。
Suna of House Cilzeron is a proud woman of the Easterlings, mistress of hearth and granary and no stranger to the horse and the bow.
西爾澤隆家族的蘇娜是一位驕傲的東夷女子。她掌管家務和糧倉，對騎馬和射箭也不陌生。
Sunfire Volley boosts screening effectiveness while active.
烈陽投矛生效期間，會提高掩護與牽制的效果。
Sunfire Volley charge greatly reduced, unrelenting harassment.
烈陽投矛充能消耗大幅降低，騷擾攻勢毫不放鬆。
Sunfire Volley charge reduced, never out of javelins.
烈陽投矛充能消耗降低，標槍永遠不會用盡。
Sunfire Volley duration extended, sustained harassing fire.
烈陽投矛持續時間延長，讓騷擾火力不斷持續。
Sunfire Volley grants +5% ranged damage and quickens javelin throws.
烈陽投矛提供 +5% 遠程傷害，並加快標槍投擲速度。
Sunfire Volley radius greatly expanded, an inescapable barrage.
烈陽投矛作用範圍大幅擴大，形成避無可避的標槍雨。
Sunfire Volley radius increased, javelins cover wider ground.
烈陽投矛作用範圍擴大，標槍能覆蓋更寬的區域。
蘇尼法是伍爾夫的妻子。

Supply distribution was unfair, older warriors got better equipment despite my superior performance. When I took what I deserved from the armory, they called it theft. I called it justice. Rather than submit to punishment for being right, I took my gear and left. Strength should be rewarded, not punished.
補給分配不公。那些老戰士明明表現不如我，卻拿到了更好的裝備。我從軍械庫拿走自己應得的東西，他們說這是盜竊。我說這是公道。與其因爲正確而受罰，我乾脆帶上裝備離開。力量應該得到獎賞，而不是懲罰。
Supply orders are not available in a shared campaign.
合作戰役中無法下達補給命令。
Supply orders cancelled; the goods and gold are lost.
補給訂單已取消，貨物和金幣均已損失。
Suran commands warriors of the southern tribes.
蘇蘭統領南部部族的戰士。
容錯處理任務啓動異常
Survived alone in the mountain passes.
Svala Redfang is an Orc captain under Gothmog's command.
“紅牙”斯瓦拉是勾斯魔格麾下的一名奧克隊長。
天鵝騎士劍配重球 B
羣潮戰術能埋沒更強的敵人
Swear service in person, not through a messenger.
宣誓效忠必須親自前往，不能派信使代勞。
Swift in dark, sniff trails from broken bones.
我能在黑暗裏快走，也能從碎骨裏嗅出蹤跡。

Swing round their flank and strike from the side
繞到敵軍側翼，從側面進攻

橫掃傷害佔蜘蛛基礎撕咬傷害的百分比。默認較低，因爲一次橫掃能命中多名士兵。

切換國境的顯示方式：按國家劃分、按自由人民與暗影陣營劃分，或按你的盟友與敵人劃分。默認按鍵爲 G。

切換職業會退還所有職業選項，費用爲{GOLD}金。
Sword-and-shield guardian of the royal barrows.
手持劍盾、守衛王家古冢的衛士。
Sword-and-shield knight of the old blood.
出身古老血脈的劍盾騎士。
Sylva Serpent-Strike is a daughter of the clan, trained in both combat and diplomacy.
“蛇擊”西爾瓦是氏族的女兒，同時接受過戰鬥和外交方面的訓練。

TAOM無法將弓的着色器安裝到{FOLDER}，部分弓可能使持弓者隱形。請以管理員身份運行一次遊戲；若仍無效，請重新安裝TAOM。具體原因見TAOM日誌。
TAOM: last battle load may not have finished
TAOM：上次戰鬥可能未能完成載入

TAOM：在{PHASE}階段，以下補丁組未能應用：{GROUPS}。本次遊戲中，這些組的部分修復將無法使用；具體原因見 TAOM 日誌。
Take a chance on me and I will repay it. I only ask that the cause be one I can stomach.
給我一次機會，我會報答你。我只要求這份事業別讓我反胃。
Take a soldier after your hero falls
Take an enemy lord prisoner in battle and the deed is done. You will be richly rewarded.
在戰鬥中俘虜一名敵方領主，任務就算完成。你會得到豐厚的獎賞。
Take it, then. The shame is yours, not mine.
拿去吧。丟臉的是你，不是我。
Take me along and I will bring your enemies' walls down; if the doom comes, it will find a bigger prize than me standing next to you.
帶上我，我能弄塌敵人的城牆。厄運真來了，站你旁邊，總能找到比我更大的目標。
Take me along, and I will find you food, goodwill and honest allies.
帶我同行吧。我能替你找到食物，贏來好感，也結交可靠的盟友。
Take me on and I will put an arrow wherever you point. Do not ask me for more than that.
僱我吧，你指哪兒，我的箭就射到哪兒。別指望我做別的。
Take me on and your wounded will walk again, the ones who can.
僱我吧。你的傷員裏，只要還有希望的，我就讓他們重新站起來。
Take me on, and I swear to report only what happened. Mostly.
僱我吧，我發誓以後只報實情。大致上是。
Take me on, and I will find you what your enemies hide, and keep my hands to myself, mostly.
僱我吧，我能替你找出敵人藏着的東西，也會管住自己的手。大致上會。
Take me with you, and I will find you provisions, goodwill and honest allies.
帶我同行吧。我能替你找到補給，贏來好感，也結交可靠的盟友。
Take me with you. I see what is behind the next ridge.
帶上我。我能看出下道山脊後面有什麼。
Take me. I know every unguarded door in the old halls.
帶上我，古老大廳裏哪道門沒人守，我都知道。

Takes the giant spiders out of the game. Spider riders ride wargs instead. New volunteers, upgrades and the Elite Emissary no longer lead to a spider troop, and spider troops leave the encyclopedia and the Custom Battle troop list. Spider broods leave the campaign map, most within a day. The rest applies the next time you start or load a game. Spider troops that already exist stay, on wargs: in parties, garrisons, prisons and volunteer slots. Fords of War still offers its Spider Riders, on wargs. Lore text, and cobwebs in some scenes, stay. Default: off.
移除遊戲中的巨型蜘蛛，蜘蛛騎兵改騎座狼。新招募的兵員、升級路線和精銳招募使者不再提供蜘蛛兵種，百科和自定義戰鬥的兵種列表也會移除這些兵種。戰役地圖上的蜘蛛羣會陸續離開，大部分在一天內消失；其他效果在下次新開或載入遊戲時應用。現存蜘蛛士兵仍保留在部隊、駐軍、監獄和待招募兵位中，但改騎座狼。渡口之戰仍提供蜘蛛騎兵，同樣改騎座狼。背景文本和部分場景中的蛛網不變。默認：關閉。

Talborin, fifty winters told, wedded into the House of Olindurionath out of a kindred-hall of the Langstrand, and he bears upon his shield the grey gull of his fathers quartered with the device of his wife's line. In his youth he sailed with the watch-galleys that ward the long coast against the corsair sail, and a scar of that work yet runs from his temple to his jaw. He stands with his house for the King returned, for he has watched too many years of vigilance go unrewarded by the lords of the inland City.
塔爾博林今年五十歲，來自長灘的一個家族，後來與奧林杜瑞昂納斯家族聯姻。他盾牌上四分的紋章同時繪有父輩的灰鷗和妻子家族的標誌。年輕時，他曾隨巡邏槳帆船守衛漫長的海岸，抵禦海盜船襲擊；那段歲月留下的傷疤至今仍從太陽穴延伸到下頜。他與家族一起支持歸來的國王，因爲他親眼見過，海岸守軍多年的警戒與堅守，始終沒有得到內陸白城諸領主應有的回報。

Talendir, twin-brother to Orweniel, is fourteen and the hope of Baranionath, fair-haired after his mother and grey-eyed after his sire. He rides daily upon the strand at Edhellond and is taught the sword by old men who served his grandfather. In the quarrel of these days he knows only that his father stands with the Steward, and that is enough.
塔倫迪爾是奧玟妮爾的孿生兄弟，十四歲，是巴拉尼昂納斯的希望。他繼承母親的金髮和父親的灰眼，每天在埃蒂爾瀧德海岸騎馬，由曾侍奉祖父的老人教授劍術。對於當下的紛爭，他只知道父親站在宰相一邊，而這已經足夠。
Talk is cheap, and I do not give it away. But for you I will make an exception.
空話不值錢，我也不會白送。不過對你，我可以破一次例。
Talk, talk. Fine. How much shiny? Show us, and be fast, the cold makes us cruel.[ib:hip][rf:convo_angry]
說啊說的。行吧，有多少亮閃閃的？拿出來，快點，天一冷，我們下手可更狠。[ib:hip][rf:convo_angry]
Talric Crowcall can mimic any bird's cry, using them as signals in battle.
“鴉鳴”塔爾裏克能模仿各種鳥叫，並在戰鬥中用作信號。
Tamir of House Mithruntai is counted among the keen horse-archers of Rhûn, loosing his shafts from the saddle at a full gallop.
米斯倫泰家族的塔米爾是魯恩出色的騎射手之一，能在戰馬全速奔馳時從馬背上射出箭矢。
Taorse is heir to Carfyd's raiding band.
陶爾瑟是卡爾菲德劫掠隊的繼承人。
Tariq is heir to the eastern oasis lords.
塔裏克是東部綠洲諸領主的繼承人。
沙加納塔斯克拉爾領地
Taurion, warden of Nos Taurion, oversees the Forest River's defenses, inspired by the enchanted waters in The Hobbit, protecting trade and borders from southern threats.
陶瑞昂是陶瑞昂一族的守衛長，負責密林河一帶的防務。他的職責受《霍比特人》中那條帶有魔力的河流啓發，保護貿易與邊境免受南方威脅。
Taurkan of House Bozorganith rides at the head of the clan's lancers, a hard-handed kinsman whose banner is feared across the plains of Rhûn.
博佐加尼思家族的陶爾坎率領着家族的槍騎兵。他手段強硬，魯恩平原上的人都畏懼他的旗幟。
Technical precision is its own form of warfare.
技術上的精準，本身也是一種戰爭方式。
泰根與庫爾哈爾恩並肩效力。
Telchar of Nogrod forged Narsil. No smith of Nogrod has matched him since, but some of us try...
諾格羅德的鐵爾哈鑄造了納熙爾。此後的諾格羅德鐵匠，沒人趕得上他，可總有人要試試……
Tell me where your kin hold their lands.
告訴我，你的族人有哪些領地。
Tell me where your realm keeps its strength.
告訴我，你的國家把兵力部署在哪裏。
Tells you when your party rides into another kingdom's lands.
部隊進入另一個王國領地時提示。
Tempered by forge and war, your hide turns blades. Bloodrage radius +3.
鍛爐和戰爭把你的身軀磨得像鐵一樣堅硬。嗜血狂怒作用範圍 +3。
Temun is a warrior of the Arkit clan.
鐵木恩是阿爾基特氏族的戰士。
Temur of House Mithruntai rides at the head of the clan's lancers, a hard-handed kinsman whose banner is feared across the plains of Rhûn.
米斯倫泰家族的鐵木爾率領着家族的槍騎兵。他手段強硬，魯恩平原上的人都畏懼他的旗幟。
Tended the bees and cattle of the Vales.
照料安都因河谷的蜂羣和牛羣。
Tended the gardens and orchards of the Grey Havens.
照料灰港的花園和果園。
Tended the gardens and orchards of the Hidden Valley.
照料隱祕山谷的花園和果園。
Tens of thousands march under your standard. +5 party size.
成千上萬的軍隊在你的旗幟下行軍。+5 部隊規模。
Terrace Wall charge greatly reduced, nearly always available.
梯田壁壘所需充能大幅減少，幾乎隨時都能發動。
Terrace Wall charge reduced, activating more frequently.
梯田壁壘所需充能減少，可以更頻繁地發動。
Terrace Wall duration extended, fortifying the defense.
梯田壁壘持續時間延長，讓防線更加穩固。
Terrace Wall grants +5% resistance and steadies the defenders.
梯田壁壘提供+5%抗性，讓守軍更加堅定。
Terrace Wall grants additional defensive buffs while active.
梯田壁壘生效期間，提供額外的防禦增益。
Terrace Wall radius greatly expanded, devastating power.
梯田壁壘的作用範圍大幅擴大，威力更具毀傷性。
Terrace Wall radius increased, empowering more warriors.
梯田壁壘的作用範圍擴大，更多戰士獲得增益。
Terror finishes more men than steel does.
被恐懼毀掉的人，比刀劍殺的還多。

Tests alternative swing clips: when a mission has act_taom_ swing codes loaded, it counts which clip each swing plays and where in the clip a hit lands, and only logs; it changes nothing in the game. While such codes exist it costs a per-frame sweep of every person in every mission, towns included; with none loaded it writes one log line per mission. Read at the start of each mission.
測試替代揮擊動畫：任務加載了act_taom_揮擊代碼時，統計每次揮擊實際播放的動畫片段，以及命中發生在片段的哪個位置。只寫日誌，不改遊戲行爲。只要存在這些代碼，就需要每幀掃描各任務中的所有人物，包括城鎮場景；沒有加載時，每個任務只寫一條日誌。在每個任務開始時讀取此設置。
卡拉斯加拉松的沙理安
Thalion, a mighty warrior, channels the strength of ancient heroes, defending the clan's star-gazing clearings from nocturnal assaults.
沙理安是一名強大的戰士，承載古代英雄的力量，守衛族人觀星的林間空地，抵擋夜間襲擊。
Thalka, a ritual master, performs sacrifices, empowering the clan with Sauron's dark rites.
薩爾卡是儀式大師，主持獻祭，用索隆的黑暗儀式強化氏族。
Thalka, a web strategist, plans entanglements, trapping foes in Dol Guldur's schemes.
薩爾卡是蛛網戰術家，專門佈置纏繞陷阱，把敵人困進多古爾都的陰謀裏。
Thalrug serves as a cavalry orc rider, commanding warg packs akin to those in the Battle of Five Armies. His swift strikes harass foes from afar, extending Gundabad's reach.
薩爾魯格是奧克騎兵，統率類似五軍之戰中出現的座狼羣。他的快速打擊從遠處騷擾敵人，也把貢達巴德的觸手伸得更遠。
Thamza leads caravans across the desert wastes.
薩姆紮帶領商隊穿越沙漠荒原。
Thandirion, Warden-captain of the Naith, commands the hidden crossings of the Celebrant and answers only to the Lord and Lady of the Galadhrim.
桑迪瑞安是耐斯的守衛隊長，負責守住凱勒布蘭特河上隱祕的渡口，只聽命於加拉茲民的領主和夫人。
Thanes of the plains hold small halls and large pride. When a hall falls, its lord rides on with nothing but his name.
平原上的領主，廳堂雖小，傲氣卻大。廳堂一倒，主人繼續騎行，除了名字什麼也不剩。
Thank you. I mean it, and I hate that I do. Name an offer. We have not eaten properly in a week.[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
謝謝，是真心的。可我真恨自己落到了這一步。你出多少？我們一週沒喫頓像樣的飯了。[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
Thank you. I will not forget this kindness.
謝謝你。我不會忘記這份恩情。
Thank you. That is kind of you.

Tharzog, a shrewd and savage leader, commands his Uruk-hai with a ruthless efficiency that embodies Isengard's dark might. His loyalty to Saruman is matched by his cunning, orchestrating battles with a keen eye for exploiting any flaw in his enemies' defenses. Bruzgash's harsh demeanor and unrelenting drive inspire dread in both allies and foes, his forces a relentless tide of destruction. Under his banner, the Black Echelon spreads fear, furthering Saruman's dominion with every brutal conquest.
薩爾佐格是一名精明而野蠻的領袖，以無情的效率指揮烏魯克，體現艾森加德的黑暗力量。他對薩茹曼的忠誠與他的狡猾同樣深厚，能以敏銳眼光發現敵方防線的每一處破綻。他嚴酷而執着，讓盟友和敵人都感到恐懼；他的部隊像毀滅的潮水般不斷推進。在他的旗幟下，黑色梯隊散播恐懼，並以每一次殘暴征服擴張薩茹曼的統治。
That boon is not on offer.
當前沒有這項祝福可選。
That cannot be done just now.
That cannot be done now. Speak to me of it another time.
現在還辦不到，改天再來談吧。
That chieftain burned two of our steadings the year before, and I would shoot him again. But the warden wants scouts who keep their word to goblins, so I sell my eyes and my bolts elsewhere.
那個酋長前一年燒了我們兩處農莊，再來一次，我照樣射死它。可守將要的斥候，連對半獸人也得守信，我就把眼力和弩箭賣到別處去。
That command cannot be given now.
現在無法下達這項命令。
That companion could not be discharged right now.
現在無法撤去這名同伴的任命。

That day shattered my world. A rival goblin clan from the depths assaulted us, seeking our forges and slaves. They slew my dam and the brute I was bound to serve. Our lair burned, treasures looted. The survivors scattered into the frozen peaks.
那一天毀掉了我的世界。一個來自深處的敵對半獸人氏族襲擊了我們，想搶我們的鍛爐和奴隸。他們殺了我娘，也殺了那個我被迫侍奉的蠻橫東西。我們的巢穴被燒，財寶被搶。倖存者逃散進冰封山峯。
That feeds us until the first frost. You are kinder than the Steward ever was to us. Go on, and keep your head down.
這些夠我們喫到初霜了。你比宰相對我們還好。走吧，路上低調些。
That hero is already in the field.
That is a generous thought. Bring them forward and let us see them.
你可真慷慨，帶他們過來，讓我們看看。
這裏已經叫這個名字了。
That keeps the fires lit through the winter. Go on, and tell the valley lords the hills still have owners.[ib:closed][rf:convo_bemused]
這下冬天的爐火有着落了。走吧，告訴谷地那些領主，這些山還是有主的。[ib:closed][rf:convo_bemused]
That lane already has packs waiting.
That market will not have us just now.
那個集市現在不肯接待我們。
That order is still cooling down.
That pack is not for sale.
That party has no room for so many.
那支部隊容不下這麼多士兵。
That was a generous thing to give away.
能讓出這樣的東西，你真慷慨。

The AI builds a Guard House in its towns and castles ahead of other buildings: always while it has none, and about 60 percent of the time while it can still be upgraded (guardHousePriorityChance in castle_patrols.json). Your own fiefs are never touched. Default: on.
AI會優先在城鎮和城堡建造衛兵營房：尚未建造時始終優先；仍可升級時，約有60%的概率優先升級，概率由castle_patrols.json中的guardHousePriorityChance設置。不會改動你自己的封地。默認：開啓。
The Anduin flows dark, and strange ships sail at night...
安都因河暗流湧動，奇怪的船隻在夜間航行……

The Axemen of Erebor are veterans of King Thorin's battles who found peacetime ill-suited to their temperament. Trained in the close-quarter fighting of the Dwarven halls — shield wall, short axe, mattock — they are formidable on any terrain but excel in the mountain passes that connect Erebor to the kingdoms of men. They take contracts from any who can afford their fee, but will not raise an axe against Erebor or Rivendell.
孤山斧兵是曾跟隨梭林國王作戰的老兵，和平生活並不合他們的脾氣。他們受過矮人廳堂近身戰訓練，精通盾牆、短斧和鶴嘴鋤，在任何地形上都很難對付，尤其擅長在連接孤山與人類王國的山道上作戰。他們會接受任何付得起酬金者的僱傭，但絕不會向孤山或幽谷舉斧。

The Bardings of Dale, descendants of Bard the Bowman, are a proud and industrious people living in the shadow of Erebor. Renowned for their skilled archers and disciplined warriors, they safeguard their thriving city and the trade routes of the north. United by a strong sense of community and honor, the Bardings stand firm against the darkness threatening their lands.
河谷邦的巴德一族是神箭手巴德的後裔，生活在孤山陰影之下，是驕傲而勤勉的人民。他們以熟練弓手和紀律嚴明的戰士聞名，守護繁榮的城市和北方貿易道路。巴德一族重視共同體和榮譽，在威脅家園的黑暗面前堅定不退。

The Bardings of Dale, named for Bard the Bowman, are a proud and industrious people who rose to prominence after reclaiming their homeland from the shadow of Smaug. Nestled between the Lonely Mountain and the Long Lake, Dale thrives as a hub of trade and culture. Known for their resilience and craftsmanship, the Bardings excel in forging weapons and armor, rivaling even the Dwarves of Erebor. Their armies, composed of disciplined archers, stalwart swordsmen, and agile skirmishers, defend their lands with fierce determination. United under noble leaders, the Bardings are ever watchful, guarding against the encroaching darkness and preserving their rich heritage.
河谷邦的巴德一族得名於“神箭手”巴德。他們驕傲而勤勉，在擺脫斯毛格的陰影、奪回家園之後崛起。坐落在孤山與長湖之間的河谷城，是貿易與文化的中心。巴德一族堅韌頑強，工藝精湛，尤其擅長鍛造武器和鎧甲，足以與孤山矮人媲美。他們的軍隊由紀律嚴明的弓手、堅定的劍士和敏捷的散兵組成，始終堅決保衛自己的土地。在高貴領袖的團結下，他們警惕着逼近的黑暗，守護着深厚的文化傳承。

The Beornings and the Woodmen of the Vales hold the upper Anduin between the Misty Mountains and Mirkwood, with the Carrock and the Old Ford as their keys. Farmers, herdsmen and honey-keepers, they stand apart from the War of the Ring, but the orcs and wolves of the mountains test their few halls every year.
貝奧恩一族和安都因河谷的林中居民守着迷霧山脈與黑森林之間的安都因河上游，以卡爾巖和老渡口爲要地。他們種地、放牧、養蜂，置身魔戒大戰之外，但山中的奧克與狼每年都會侵擾他們爲數不多的廳堂。

The Beornings and the Woodmen of the Vales hold the upper Anduin between the Misty Mountains and Mirkwood. They keep the High Pass and the Old Ford open for honest travellers and take a heavy toll of orcs and wolves. Their chieftains hold Beorn's Hall and the Carrock and want no part in the wars of kings.
貝奧恩一族和安都因河谷的林中居民守着迷霧山脈與黑森林之間的安都因河上游。他們保障高隘口和老渡口暢通，讓正派的旅人安全通行，也讓奧克與狼付出慘重代價。他們的酋長掌握着貝奧恩大廳和卡爾巖，不願捲入諸王的戰爭。

The Beornings are the great woodmen who dwell in the vale of the Anduin between the Misty Mountains and Mirkwood, led by the skin-changers of Beorn's line. They allow no Orc to cross their territory, charge a toll at the Ford of Carrock to fund their watch, and answer to no king in Middle-earth. Though they will trade and talk with Elves and Dwarves, any army that marches through their forest without leave will find that the Beornings have very large teeth.
貝奧恩一族是居住在安都因河谷的高大林中人，生活在迷霧山脈與黑森林之間，由貝奧恩血脈中的換皮人統領。他們不準任何奧克穿越自己的領地，並在卡爾巖渡口收取通行費來維持守望；他們也不向中洲任何國王效忠。雖然他們會與精靈和矮人貿易交談，但任何未經許可便穿過其森林的軍隊，都會發現貝奧恩一族的牙齒非常大。

The Beornings keep the upper vale of the Anduin between the Misty Mountains and Mirkwood, a folk of farmers, herdsmen and honey-keepers who share the river meadows with the Woodmen of the Vales. They hold the Carrock and the Old Ford, take no toll from honest travellers and a heavy one from orcs and wolves. Their chieftains are chosen for strength and plain speech, and they follow no king into a war that is not their own.
貝奧恩一族守着迷霧山脈與黑森林之間的安都因河上游，與河谷中的林中居民共享河畔草甸。他們種地、放牧、養蜂，掌握着卡爾巖和老渡口，不向正派的旅人收取過路費，卻會讓奧克與狼付出慘重代價。酋長憑力量和坦誠贏得推舉，他們不會跟隨任何國王捲入與自己無關的戰爭。
The Betrayer was once a king in the East before his corruption.
背叛者曾是東方的一位國王，最終墮入腐化。
The Black Númenóreans remember when they ruled, and some still hunger for power...
黑努門諾爾人還記得自己曾經統治過什麼，有些人至今仍渴望權力……

The Blind Eye is a brotherhood of smugglers, fences, and hired killers operating across the coasts of Harad and the deep desert. They are said to descend from a cult of assassins who served a forgotten Haradrim king, and their methods — poison, shadow, and the leveraging of secrets — remain unchanged. Lords who wish to quietly remove a rival, or merchants who need cargo moved without customs inspection, know where to leave a gold coin and a sealed letter.
盲眼會是一個由走私者、銷贓者和僱傭殺手組成的兄弟會，在哈拉德海岸和深漠中活動。據說他們源自一個侍奉過被遺忘哈拉德國王的刺客教團，他們的方法至今未變，仍是毒藥、陰影和祕密勒索。想悄悄除掉對手的領主，或需要貨物避開關稅檢查的商人，都知道該把金幣和密封信件留在哪裏。

The Broadbeams closed the hospice doors to me, and no house in the Blue Mountains will cross them for a bone-setter. So I walk the Dwarf-road with my satchel and sell what I know to whoever has wounded to mend.
寬梁族不許我再進醫館，而藍色山脈沒有哪家肯爲一個接骨師得罪他們。我便揹着藥包走上矮人路，誰有傷員要治，我就把本事賣給誰。
The Broadbeams of Belegost stood against a dragon once. We have not forgotten how to stand...
貝烈戈斯特的寬梁族曾頂住過巨龍。該怎麼站穩，我們還沒忘……
德魯懷斯伊阿烏諸氏族。

The Corsair Blades are veteran sea-fighters from the harbours of Umbar who have taken to selling their skills on land. They fight as crossbowmen — the preferred arm of shipboard warfare — and are as comfortable in a siege as they are on a rolling deck. Their captain, a scarred Númenórean exile, keeps them to their contracts with iron discipline, knowing that their reputation is their most valuable cargo.
海盜刀鋒是來自烏姆巴爾港口的老練海戰者，如今把自己的本事賣到陸地上。他們作爲弩手作戰，弩正是登船戰最偏愛的武器；他們在圍城戰中和在搖晃甲板上一樣自在。他們的船長是一名滿臉傷疤的努門諾爾流亡者，以鐵一般的紀律讓部下遵守契約，因爲他知道名聲纔是他們最有價值的貨物。
The Corsairs of Umbar sail to {settlement}!

The Corsairs of Umbar, seafaring raiders and master sailors, are a ruthless and cunning people allied with Sauron. Known for their swift ships and relentless naval warfare, they strike fear into the coastlines of Middle-earth. Proud of their maritime heritage, they bring the chaos of the seas to the land, raiding and pillaging in the name of their dark alliances.
烏姆巴爾的海盜是海上劫掠者，也是老練的水手；他們殘酷狡詐，並與索隆結盟。他們以迅捷船隻和毫不留情的海戰聞名，讓中洲的海岸線人人畏懼。他們爲自己的航海傳統而自豪，把海上的混亂帶上陸地，以黑暗盟約之名劫掠和掠奪。
The Creator? You mean you shaped all of this?
創造者？你的意思是，這一切都是你塑造的？

The Cult of the Lidless Eye is a secret society rooted in the Black Númenórean tradition, venerating Sauron as a god-king who will restore his faithful to glory when he rises again. They recruit among the dispossessed of Dunland and the forgotten corners of the realm, promising divine favour and earthly power. In truth, their leaders answer to agents of Barad-dûr, and their cell-based structure makes them nearly impossible for any lord's justice to eradicate.
無瞼魔眼教團是一個紮根於黑努門諾爾傳統的祕密結社，他們把索隆敬爲神王，相信當他再次崛起時，會讓忠信者重返榮耀。他們從黑蠻地失去一切的人，以及王國被遺忘的角落中招募成員，許諾神恩與塵世權力。事實上，他們的領袖聽命於巴拉督爾的密探，而他們以小據點分散運作的結構，也讓任何領主的審判都幾乎無法將其剷除。
The Dark Lord is pleased. +{influence} influence, +{relation} relation.
黑暗魔君對你的表現很滿意。影響力+{influence}，關係+{relation}。
The Dark Lord's eye sweeps the field. Voice radius +5.
黑暗魔君之眼掃過戰場。至尊魔戒之聲作用範圍 +5。
The Dark Marshall commands the Nazgûl in battle, second only to the Witch-King.
黑暗元帥在戰場上統領那茲古爾，地位僅次於安格瑪巫王。
The Defense of the East Bank

The Drúedain, known to Men as Woses or the Wild Men of the Woods, are an ancient people who dwell in the deep forest of Drúadan and the hidden valleys of the White Mountains. They clear ground with fire, grow what they need on the ash-rich soil, and move on when the land is spent — a way of life the settled peoples of Middle-earth have never understood and never bothered to. The Drúedain want no lord, pay no tax, and ask only to be left to the forest's silence.
德魯伊甸人被人類稱爲野人或林中野人，是居住在德魯阿丹森林深處和白色山脈隱祕谷地中的古老民族。他們用火清理土地，在富含灰燼的土壤上種出所需作物，土地耗盡後便繼續遷徙。這種生活方式，中洲的定居民族從未理解，也從未願意理解。德魯伊甸人不要領主，不納稅，只希望別人讓他們留在森林的寂靜中。

The Dunedain watched the Shire from beyond its borders, but sometimes information required closer observation. You entered, spent three days moving through the farmland, gathered what was needed, and left without disturbing a single garden gate. The Hobbits never knew. That was the point.
杜內丹在夏爾邊界之外守望，但有些情報需要更近觀察。你進入其中，在農田間行動三天，收集所需信息，然後沒有驚動任何一扇花園門便離開了。霍比特人從不知道。這正是重點。

The Dunlending Reavers are the broken remnant of a hill-clan that once dwelt in the valleys now ruled by the Rohirrim. Their grandfathers were driven from fertile land into the rocky heights, and they have nursed that bitterness into a raider's philosophy: everything taken from a southron or a king's man is merely the restoration of what was stolen. In practice they are brigands, but dangerous ones who know every goat-track through the hills.
黑蠻地劫掠者是一個破碎山地氏族的殘餘，他們曾居住在如今由洛希爾人統治的山谷裏。他們的祖父被從肥沃土地趕進岩石高地，而他們把這份怨恨釀成了劫掠者的信條：從南方人或王家人手裏奪走的一切，都只是取回被偷走的東西。實際上他們是強盜，但也是危險的強盜，熟悉山中每一條羊道。

The Dunlendings are a rugged and fierce people, dwelling in the wild hills and untamed lands west of Rohan. Long resentful of the Rohirrim, whom they see as invaders of their ancestral homes, the Dunlendings are united by their shared heritage and fierce independence. Skilled in guerrilla warfare and survival, they rely on cunning and ferocity to overcome their enemies. Though often dismissed as simple hill folk, the Dunlendings are a proud and enduring people, fiercely protective of their lands and ways of life. Driven by a deep-seated grudge against Rohan, they have allied themselves with the forces of darkness, seeking revenge and the restoration of their lost lands.
黑蠻地人粗獷兇悍，居住在洛汗以西荒涼的丘陵和未開墾的土地上。他們長期怨恨洛希爾人，認爲對方是侵佔祖傳家園的侵略者。共同的傳承和對獨立的堅決追求將各部團結在一起。他們擅長游擊戰，也精於在荒野中生存，靠機智與兇悍擊敗敵人。外人常以爲他們只是普通山民，卻沒看見他們的驕傲與堅忍。他們會拼命捍衛自己的土地和生活方式。對洛汗根深蒂固的仇恨，促使他們與黑暗勢力結盟，希望報仇並奪回失地。
The Dunlendings move like mountain goats. +8% party movement speed.
黑蠻地人能像山羊一樣穿行山地。+8% 部隊移動速度。

The Dunlendings, fierce hillmen of the western highlands, are a proud and ancient people. Resentful of the Rohirrim, they are known for their guerilla tactics and tenacity in battle. United under strong leaders, they fight for their survival and to reclaim the lands they believe are rightfully theirs.
黑蠻地人是西部高地上強悍的山民，也是一個驕傲而古老的民族。他們怨恨洛希爾人，擅長游擊戰，在戰鬥中極其頑強。只要有強有力的首領把他們團結起來，他們就會爲了生存而戰，也爲了奪回他們認爲本該屬於自己的土地而戰。

The Dwarves had fortified a pass that Blue Craig used for winter raids, cutting off access and costing the mountain a full season of plunder. You planned the assault, led the van, and broke the outpost's gate in a single push. The pass reopened. The Dwarves did not come back.
矮人在藍巖冬季掠襲必經的山口築起工事，封住了通路，讓山中的族人整整一季都沒能外出搶掠。你策劃進攻，親自帶領先鋒，一次衝鋒就撞開了哨站大門。山口重新暢通，矮人再也沒有回來。

The Dwarves had fortified a pass that Goblin-town used for winter raids, cutting off access and costing the mountain a full season of plunder. You planned the assault, led the van, and broke the outpost's gate in a single push. The pass reopened. The Dwarves did not come back.
矮人在半獸人鎮冬季掠襲必經的山口築起工事，封住了通路，讓山中的族人整整一季都沒能外出搶掠。你策劃進攻，親自帶領先鋒，一次衝鋒就撞開了哨站大門。山口重新暢通，矮人再也沒有回來。

The Dwarves had fortified a pass that Gundabad used for winter raids, cutting off access and costing the mountain a full season of plunder. You planned the assault, led the van, and broke the outpost's gate in a single push. The pass reopened. The Dwarves did not come back.
矮人在貢達巴德冬季劫掠常用的一處山口築起工事，切斷通路，讓山中少了整整一季掠獲。你規劃突擊，率領先鋒，一次衝擊便撞開前哨大門。山口重新開放，矮人再沒回來。

The Dwarves had fortified a pass that the Misty Mountains used for winter raids, cutting off access and costing the mountain a full season of plunder. You planned the assault, led the van, and broke the outpost's gate in a single push. The pass reopened. The Dwarves did not come back.
矮人在迷霧山脈冬季掠襲必經的山口築起工事，封住了通路，讓山中的族人整整一季都沒能外出搶掠。你策劃進攻，親自帶領先鋒，一次衝鋒就撞開了哨站大門。山口重新暢通，矮人再也沒有回來。

The Dwarves were mapping something in the Grey Mountains and Blue Craig needed to know what. You followed them through the high passes without being seen, waited until they camped, took the maps, and were back in the fortress before they raised the alarm.
矮人正在灰色山脈繪製地圖，藍巖需要弄清他們在測繪什麼。你悄悄跟着他們穿過高處的山口，等他們紮營後偷走地圖，在他們發出警報前就回到了要塞。

The Dwarves were mapping something in the Grey Mountains and Goblin-town needed to know what. You followed them through the high passes without being seen, waited until they camped, took the maps, and were back in the fortress before they raised the alarm.
矮人正在灰色山脈繪製地圖，半獸人鎮需要弄清他們在測繪什麼。你悄悄跟着他們穿過高處的山口，等他們紮營後偷走地圖，在他們發出警報前就回到了要塞。

The Dwarves were mapping something in the Grey Mountains and Gundabad needed to know what. You followed them through the high passes without being seen, waited until they camped, took the maps, and were back in the fortress before they raised the alarm.
矮人在灰色山脈測繪某些東西，而貢達巴德必須知道他們在做什麼。你無聲跟隨他們穿過高山口，等他們紮營後拿走地圖，並在他們發出警報前回到要塞。

The Dwarves were mapping something in the Grey Mountains and the Misty Mountains needed to know what. You followed them through the high passes without being seen, waited until they camped, took the maps, and were back in the fortress before they raised the alarm.
矮人正在灰色山脈繪製地圖，迷霧山脈的族人需要弄清他們在測繪什麼。你悄悄跟着他們穿過高處的山口，等他們紮營後偷走地圖，在他們發出警報前就回到了要塞。

The Dúnedain of Arthedain are the last heirs of Arnor, the North-kingdom Elendil founded. From Fornost upon the North Downs the line of Arvedui still keeps the watch that Isildur's heirs have kept for a thousand years, though their towns are few, their lords are poor and the shadow of Angmar never leaves the hills. They are fewer than their southern kin and prouder than their numbers warrant, and every season the wild lands press closer.
阿塞丹的杜內丹人是阿爾諾最後的繼承者，那是埃蘭迪爾建立的北方王國。阿維杜伊的後人依然在北崗上的佛諾斯特堅守，延續着伊熙爾杜的繼承者千年來的守望，只是城鎮已所剩無幾，領主貧困，安格瑪的陰影始終籠罩丘陵。他們比南方的同族更少，卻有着與人數不相稱的驕傲，而荒野正一季又一季地向他們逼近。

The Dúnedain of Cardolan hold the south of old Arnor, the plains and river country between the Baranduin and the Greyflood. Their kings lie in the barrows of Tyrn Gorthad, their barges still come up to Tharbad, and their riders are the best of the three northern kingdoms. Their towns are few and their lords quarrel with Arthedain and Rhudaur over the old crown, while the wild lands grow bolder every year.
卡多藍的杜內丹人守着古代阿爾諾的南部，也就是巴蘭都因河與灰水河之間的平原和沿河地帶。他們的歷代國王長眠於提殞戈沙德的古冢，駁船仍駛向沙巴德，騎兵則是北方三個王國中最出色的。這裏城鎮稀少，領主們爲古老的王冠與阿塞丹、魯道爾爭執不休，而荒野的威脅一年比一年猖獗。
The East Road companies hold the way between Last Bridge and the Trollshaws for the king. We are sworn to each other, and the Gundabad raiders have given many of us cause for hatred.
東西大道的守軍替國王守着最後大橋到食人妖森林的道路。我們彼此立過誓，而貢達巴德的劫掠者，讓我們很多人都有了恨他們的理由。

The Easterlings are a diverse and fearsome people from the distant lands of Rhûn. Known for their loyalty to Sauron, they march to war with precision and discipline, wielding curved blades, spears, and massive war-drums that echo across the battlefield. Their golden armor and crimson banners reflect their fierce pride and martial prowess. Divided into clans and tribes, the Easterlings unite under powerful chieftains to bring the might of Rhûn against the Free Peoples of Middle-earth.
東夷來自遙遠的魯恩，族羣衆多，作戰兇悍。他們以對索隆的忠誠聞名，軍紀嚴明，步伐整齊。他們手持彎刀和長矛，巨大戰鼓的轟鳴在戰場上回蕩。金色鎧甲與猩紅戰旗展現出他們的自豪和精湛武藝。他們分屬不同的氏族和部落，卻會在強大首領的號令下聯合起來，將魯恩的力量投入與中洲自由人民的戰鬥。

The Easterlings are a proud and disciplined people, hailing from the vast eastern lands beyond Mordor. Renowned for their resilience and mastery of warfare, they are both farmers and warriors, blending agrarian traditions with a fierce martial culture. Their armies are known for their fearsome cavalry, adorned in ornate armor and carrying deadly spears and bows. With a rich heritage of craftsmanship and loyalty to their kin, the Easterlings march to war under vibrant banners of gold and crimson, striking fear into the hearts of their enemies. Their allegiance to Sauron has made them a formidable force, uniting under his shadow to expand their dominion across Middle-earth.
東夷來自魔多以東遼闊的土地，是驕傲而紀律嚴明的民族。他們以堅韌和精通戰爭聞名，既是農民也是戰士，把農耕傳統和強悍的尚武文化結合在一起。他們的軍隊以可怖的騎兵著稱，戰士身披華麗盔甲，手持致命的長矛和弓箭。東夷有深厚的工藝傳統，也忠於自己的族人；他們在金紅相間的鮮明旗幟下奔赴戰場，讓敵人心生畏懼。他們效忠索隆，因此成爲一股強大的力量，在他的陰影下聯合起來，試圖把統治擴展到中洲各地。

The Easterlings of the eastern plains. A deep-rooted steppe cavalry tradition pairs with the Easterling Outriders' speed and the Easterling Host's numbers. Heavy cavalry that arrives in force, bringing tribute as well as spears.
東部平原上的東夷人，將根深蒂固的草原騎兵傳統與東夷遊騎兵的速度、東夷大軍的人數優勢結合起來。重騎兵成羣到來，帶來的不只有長矛，還有貢賦。
The Elven Volley is fully upgraded.
The Elven Volley is loosed during a wave.
只能在敵軍進攻時發動精靈齊射。
The Elven Volley is not ready yet.

The Elven border wardens had held the approach for two seasons. You identified the gap in their rotation, timed your crossing to the minute, and brought your patrol through and back without a casualty. The shadow-masters noted your report and gave you a permanent command.
精靈邊境守衛已經守住這條通道兩個季節。你發現他們輪換中的空隙，把越界時間精確到分鐘，並帶着巡邏隊毫髮無損地穿過去又回來。陰影大師記下了你的報告，並給了你永久指揮權。

The Elves of Lothlórien, known as the Galadhrim, are a noble and enigmatic people dwelling in the Golden Wood. Guided by the wisdom and power of Lady Galadriel and Lord Celeborn, they are guardians of one of the last bastions of elven beauty and tranquility in Middle-earth. The Galadhrim are unmatched archers, blending seamlessly with the golden Mallorn trees of their homeland.
洛絲羅瑞恩的精靈被稱爲加拉茲民，是居住在金色森林中的高貴而神祕的族羣。在加拉德瑞爾夫人和凱勒博恩領主的智慧與力量引導下，他們守護着中洲最後幾處仍保有精靈之美與寧靜的堡壘。加拉茲民是無可匹敵的弓手，能與故土金色的瑁瓏樹融爲一體。
The Elves of Rivendell march to {settlement}!

The Elves pay well and check little, or so I thought. For two years my bars to Harlond carried a core of slag under good iron, until a shipwright of the Havens split one on his anvil. The Elves shut their quays to Thorin's Halls for a season, and the merchants' guild handed me to the king to open them again.
精靈出價高，又不怎麼查貨，至少我原來這麼想。兩年裏，我送到哈瀧德的鐵條，都是外包好鐵、內填礦渣。後來灰港一個造船匠在鐵砧上敲開了一根。精靈整整一季不準梭林大廳的船靠碼頭，商人行會爲了讓碼頭重開，就把我交給了國王。
The Enemy uses such weakness against us.
敵人利用了我們的這種弱點。
The Eotheod are faster than legend. +8% party movement speed.
伊奧希奧德的速度勝過傳說。+8% 部隊移動速度。
The Eotheod ride the wind itself. +5% movement speed.
伊奧希奧德彷彿乘風而行。+5% 移動速度。
The Eye of Sauron has turned upon you. {HUNTER} rides out with a host to destroy you.
索隆之眼已盯上你。{HUNTER}正率領大軍前來消滅你。

The Falathrim of Lindon are the last of the Sindar shipwrights, dwelling at Mithlond where the Gulf of Lune meets the sea. Círdan has kept the Grey Havens since the First Age, and it is from his quays that the white ships pass into the West.
林頓的法拉斯民是最後一批辛達族造船者，居住在路恩灣通向大海的米斯瀧德。自第一紀元起，奇爾丹便一直守護着灰港，白船從他的碼頭啓航，駛向西方。
The Felling of the Dark Wood

The Firebeard dwarves broke through from below, and a flood of mine-water came with them. The smelters went cold, fire to steam in one breath. Forty of my forge-brothers boiled. I carried the last of the good ore out on my back, and the overseer took it, and took my hammer too.
火須族矮人從下方打通了過來，礦井裏的水也跟着湧進來。一口氣的工夫，熔爐就滅了，烈火變成蒸汽，四十個鍛坊兄弟被活活燙死。我背出最後一批好礦石，監工拿走礦石，還拿走了我的錘子。

The Galadhrim needed to know how many were garrisoned at the southern fortress before any action was planned. You volunteered to go and look. You were gone six days. What you brought back gave Galadriel the information she needed to make her decision.
加拉茲民需要在行動前知道南方要塞駐紮了多少人。你自願前去查看，離開六天。你帶回的情報給了加拉德瑞爾作出決定所需的信息。

The Galadhrim of Lothlórien, dwellers of the Golden Wood, are an ethereal and noble people led by Lady Galadriel and Lord Celeborn. Masters of archery and woodland warfare, they guard their enchanted realm with unmatched skill. Their loyalty to their kin and homeland is unwavering, and their subtle magic preserves Lothlórien as a sanctuary of hope and light amidst the growing shadow.
洛絲羅瑞恩的加拉茲民居住在金色森林中，是由加拉德瑞爾夫人和凱勒博恩領主統領的高貴精靈。他們精通弓術和林地戰法，以無可匹敵的技藝守衛這片受祝福的國度。他們對族人和家園的忠誠從不動搖，而他們細膩的魔力讓洛絲羅瑞恩在日漸擴大的陰影中仍是一處希望與光明的庇護所。

The Goblins of Goblin-town swarm the tunnels beneath the High Pass of the Misty Mountains. Cowardly alone but overwhelming in number, they breed endlessly in the dark and pour out to ambush travellers on the mountain roads. Under their Great Goblin and his captains they harry Elves, Dwarves, and Men alike, serving the growing Shadow for plunder and spite.
半獸人鎮的半獸人擠滿了迷霧山脈高隘口下方的隧道。他們單獨行動時膽怯，但數量足以壓倒敵人；他們在黑暗中無休止地繁殖，湧出洞穴伏擊山路上的旅人。在半獸人王和其頭目的統領下，他們騷擾精靈、矮人和人類，爲日漸壯大的陰影效力，也爲了掠奪與惡意而戰。

The Goblins of the Ered Luin are a teeming, vicious rabble dwelling in the warrens of Blue Craig. Led by their Great Goblin and petty captains, they raid the mountain roads without end, driven by greed and an ancient hatred of the Free Peoples.
埃瑞德路因的半獸人數量衆多、兇殘成性，擠在藍巖縱橫交錯的洞穴裏。在半獸人王和衆多小頭目的率領下，他們受貪慾和對自由人民的古老仇恨驅使，不斷劫掠山間道路上的行人。

The Goblins of the High Pass are a teeming, vicious rabble dwelling in the warrens of Goblin-town. Led by their Great Goblin and petty captains, they raid the mountain roads without end, driven by greed and an ancient hatred of the Free Peoples.
高隘口半獸人是居住在半獸人鎮巢穴中的龐大而兇惡的烏合之衆。他們由半獸人王和小隊長統領，無休止地劫掠山路，受貪婪和對自由人民的古老仇恨驅使。

The Goblins of the High Pass swarm the tunnels beneath the Misty Mountains, the spawn of the host the Great Goblin once led against dwarf and wayfarer alike. Numberless and vicious, they pour from Goblin-town to raid the mountain roads.
高隘口的半獸人在迷霧山脈下方的隧道中蜂擁而動，他們是半獸人王昔日率領、同時襲擊矮人與旅人的那支大軍的餘孽。他們數量衆多，兇狠惡毒，從半獸人鎮湧出，劫掠山路。

The Golden Flower earned its glory through deeds, not words. My blade sings with centuries of elven technique, and my oath binds me to protect all free peoples. I would bring that same dedication to your company.
金花家族的榮耀靠的是行動，不是言辭。我的劍承載着數百年的精靈技藝，我的誓言也約束我守護所有自由人民。我願把同樣的忠誠帶到你的隊伍中。

The Golden Flower once stood against the greatest darkness and fell with honor. We who bear their name now must ensure their sacrifice was not in vain. Beauty, wisdom, and valor - these are our watchwords.
金花家族曾經直面最深的黑暗，最終在英勇的戰鬥中覆滅。如今沿用這個名字的我們，不能讓他們的犧牲白費。美、智慧與勇氣，是我們牢記的信條。
The Golden Flower? That order fell long ago in Gondolin...
金花家族？那個騎士團不是早已在剛多林陷落了嗎……

The Golden Wood lies nestled between the Silverlode and the mighty Anduin. Guarded by the will of Galadriel and Celeborn, it stands as a bastion of Elven grace and defiance - a land untouched by time, where the leaves do not fall.
金色森林坐落在銀脈河與浩蕩的安都因河之間。它受加拉德瑞爾與凱勒博恩的意志守護，是精靈優雅與抗爭的堡壘，一片彷彿不受時間觸及、葉子也不會凋落的土地。

The Golden Wood, realm of Lady Galadriel and Lord Celeborn. Wardens of Lorien defend the mallorn-forests cheaply; Lembas Bread sustains every march; Elven Harmony keeps morale unshakable. Timeless Craft means every change is slow.
金色森林是加拉德瑞爾夫人和凱勒博恩領主的國度。羅瑞恩守衛能以較低成本守護瑁瓏林；蘭巴斯麪包供養每一次行軍；精靈和諧讓士氣不可動搖。永恆工藝意味着任何改變都很緩慢。

The Gondorian square had held through three direct assaults and the battle-lord was considering withdrawal. You identified the timing of their shield rotation, requested the flanking cavalry, and committed the charge at exactly the right moment. The square broke. The battle was won.
剛鐸方陣撐過三次正面突擊，戰領已在考慮撤退。你看準他們盾牌輪換的時機，請求調動側翼騎兵，並在正好的一刻投入衝鋒。方陣崩潰，戰鬥獲勝。

The Gondorians, descendants of the Númenórean exiles, are the proud stewards of the greatest kingdom of Men in Middle-earth. Known for their towering stone fortresses and unwavering courage, Gondor is a bastion of hope against the looming shadow of Mordor. Its disciplined armies, comprised of valiant infantry, skilled archers, and mounted knights, stand as a shield for all free peoples. Guided by noble stewards and captains, the Gondorians hold fast to their traditions, unyielding in their duty to protect the realm and its legacy.
剛鐸人是努門諾爾流亡者的後裔，也是中洲最偉大人類王國的驕傲守護者。剛鐸以高聳石砌堡壘和不屈勇氣聞名，是抵擋魔多陰影的希望堡壘。它紀律嚴明的軍隊由英勇步兵、熟練弓手和騎士組成，是所有自由人民的盾牌。在高貴宰相和將領的引領下，剛鐸人堅守傳統，毫不退縮地履行守護王國和傳承的職責。

The Great Goblin's tithe-collector took half my kill-share every moon. Said it was the chief's right. One night the share was short. I shot him from the shelf, clean, in the throat, and watched him fall down the steps. Nobody saw. Everybody knew.
半獸人王的收稅人每個月都要拿走我一半的擊殺分成，說是酋長應得的。一天晚上，分到手的少了，我就在巖臺上給了他一箭，正中喉嚨，看着他滾下臺階。沒人看見，人人都知道。
The Greenway companies hold the road between Bree and the Barrow-downs for the king. We are sworn to each other, and the Gundabad raiders have given many of us cause for hatred.
綠大道的守軍替國王守着布理到古冢崗的道路。我們彼此立過誓，而貢達巴德的劫掠者，讓我們很多人都有了恨他們的理由。
The Greenway companies hold the road from Sarn Ford to Tharbad for the king. We are sworn to each other, and the Dunlending raiders have given many of us cause for hatred.
綠大道的守軍替國王守着薩恩渡口到沙巴德的道路。我們彼此立過誓，而黑蠻地的劫掠者，讓我們很多人都有了恨他們的理由。

The Grey Company are the last organised brotherhood of the Dúnedain Rangers, descendants of the kings of Arnor who lost their kingdom ages ago. They ride across the North without a home of their own, keeping the peace in lands that have forgotten their names. Though their first loyalty is to the line of Elendil, they take contracts from lords across Middle-earth when their wandering brings them through civilised lands.
灰衣勁旅是杜內丹遊俠最後一支有組織的兄弟會，他們是久遠年代失去王國的阿爾諾諸王后裔。他們沒有自己的家園，騎馬穿行北方，在那些已經忘記他們姓名的土地上維持安寧。雖然他們最忠於埃蘭迪爾一脈，但流浪經過文明土地時，也會接受中洲各地領主的僱傭。

The Gundabad Orcs of the Misty Mountains are savage and relentless. From the ancient stronghold of Mount Gundabad, they raid the surrounding lands, driven by a thirst for vengeance and conquest. Under the rule of powerful chieftains, they amass legions of goblins, wargs, and trolls. Gundabad's warriors are brutish and cunning, masters of ambush and overwhelming force.
迷霧山脈的貢達巴德奧克野蠻而殘忍。他們從貢達巴德山這座古老要塞出發，襲擾周邊土地，被複仇與征服的渴望驅使。在強大酋長的統治下，他們聚集起半獸人、座狼和食人妖組成的大軍。貢達巴德戰士既蠻橫又狡詐，擅長伏擊和以數量壓倒敵人。

The Haradrim are a proud and fierce people hailing from the deserts and savannahs of the distant south. Renowned for their mastery of exotic beasts such as mûmakil, their warriors combine skill, resilience, and deadly precision in battle. Harad is a land of extremes, with its scorching sun, golden sands, and vibrant oases. Its people are united by ancient traditions, loyalty to their tribes, and the call of their chieftains and kings. Often allied with the forces of darkness, the Haradrim are driven by vengeance against Gondor and the promise of power and dominion offered by Sauron.

哈拉德是位於剛鐸以南的廣袤之地，地域遼闊多樣，既有熾熱的沙漠，也有鬱鬱蔥蔥的叢林與富饒的綠洲。其地貌如其民族般多元，綿延的沙丘與縱橫的河流交織成壯麗的景觀。哈拉德的歷史源遠流長，雄偉的古城與堡壘遍佈其間，昔日的統治者之名仍迴盪在傳說之中。哈拉德懷斯大沙漠將北部邊疆與腹地分隔，而南方沿岸的港口與海盜活動頻繁。如今，在索隆的旗幟下，衆多部族與王國團結一體，將他們深厚的傳統與勇武精神化爲戰爭的力量，使這片充滿活力的土地成爲文化與征伐的交匯之地。

The Haradrim host moved toward Gondor and you rode at the front of the war-column, fighting the skirmishes that cleared the way. When the great battle came you were among those whose name the Black Serpent knew when it was over — for those who survived to tell him.
哈拉德人大軍向剛鐸推進，你騎在戰鬥縱隊前列，參與清路的小規模戰鬥。大戰結束時，黑蛇記住了你的名字，至少那些活着能告訴他的人會這麼說。

The Haradrim of Harwan, sons of the sun. A long desert heritage underlies the Sons of the Sun +10% speed bonus and the Haradrim Warbands' larger numbers, built on a thriving caravan economy. Mumakil rule the southern plains.
哈拉德的哈拉德林是太陽之子。悠久的沙漠生活賦予太陽之子10%的速度加成，繁榮的商隊經濟則支撐起人數衆多的哈拉德林戰幫。猛獁主宰着南方平原。

The Haradrim, warriors of the southern deserts, are a fierce and resilient people allied with Sauron. Known for their exotic war beasts and skilled cavalry, they march to war under crimson banners. Proud and deeply rooted in their traditions, they bring the savagery of the desert to the battlefields of Middle-earth.
哈拉德人是南方沙漠中的戰士，也是與索隆結盟的強悍民族。他們以異域戰獸和精銳騎兵聞名，在深紅旗幟下踏上戰場。他們驕傲而深深紮根於自身傳統，把沙漠的兇悍帶到中洲的戰場上。
The Havens learned who held the pen, and I left before the council finished its sentence. I still have the silver. I find I cannot spend it.
灰港查到了繪圖的人。議會還沒念完判決，我就離開了。白銀還在我手裏，可我發現，自己花不下去。

The Hill-Men of Dunland, ancient enemies of the Rohirrim. Generations in the deep woods and high moors shaped the Hill Marchers and Hill-Tribe Levies, cheap, fast, angry warbands that march on plain and forest alike. Their smiths are slow, but their warbands are not.
黑蠻地的山民是洛希爾人世代的仇敵。深林與高原上的生活，造就了山地行軍兵和山地部落徵召兵：他們成本低、行軍快、滿懷怒火，無論平原還是森林都能前進。他們的鐵匠動作慢，戰幫卻不慢。
The Houses of Healing grow crowded, yet fewer healers remain...
診療院被越來越多的傷員塞滿，可醫生總是短缺……
The Iron Hills breed warriors as hard as the metal they're named for...
鐵丘陵孕育出的戰士，像那片土地名字裏的金屬一樣堅硬……

The Iron Hills dwarves caught us at a ford. I gave them the wounded and the weak flank, bought an hour, and marched the rest away. Thirty-one stayed behind in the mud. The captain saw the count and called it murder.
鐵丘陵的矮人在渡口截住我們。我把傷兵和薄弱的側翼丟給他們，換來一個小時，帶着剩下的人撤走。三十一個留在泥裏。隊長看了傷亡數，說這是謀殺。
The King's guard of Vidugard rides at his side in every hall and on every field. When the court rots, some of us ride away.
維杜加德的王家衛士，無論在廳堂還是戰場，都隨侍國王身側。可王廷腐爛時，我們有些人會騎馬離開。

The King, in his befuddled state, stripped me of lands and title. My own people were told I was a traitor. Now I wander, a thane without a hall, seeking to restore my name through deeds since words failed me.
國王神志昏沉，就這樣剝奪了我的土地和頭銜。我的子民被告知我是叛徒。如今我四處流浪，成了沒有廳堂的領主；言辭已經救不了我，我只能靠行動恢復名譽。

The King, once mighty, now sits grey and weary while Aldwulf whispers poison. I heard orders given that made no sense: troops withdrawn from threatened borders, supplies sent to uncertain destinations.
國王過去威風凜凜，如今卻一臉灰敗、滿身疲憊地坐着，任阿爾德伍爾夫在耳邊灌毒。我聽過一些毫無道理的命令：從受威脅的邊境撤軍，把補給送到不明去處。

The King, trusting his steward, stripped me of lands and title. My own people were told I was a traitor. Now I wander, a thane without a hall, seeking to restore my name through deeds since words failed me.
國王信他的總管，奪了我的土地和頭銜，還告訴我的百姓，我是叛徒。如今我成了沒有廳堂的領主，到處流浪。既然說話洗不清名聲，我就靠行動把它掙回來。
The Knight of Umbar was once a lord of the Corsairs before taking the Ring.
烏姆巴爾騎士曾是海盜領主，後來接受了那枚戒指。
The Lady of the Wood is grateful. +{influence} influence, +{relation} relation.
森林夫人感謝你的援助。影響力+{influence}，關係+{relation}。
The Last Stand at the Carrock

The Lindon watch laid a net for me at the river-mouth. I saw the white sails too late. I let the second boat take the arrows and slipped away with the first. The second boat's crew were mine for nine years, and they drowned in the shallows within sight of land.
林頓守衛在河口給我設了個圈套，我發現白帆時已經晚了。我讓第二條船擋箭，自己乘第一條溜了。第二條船的人跟了我九年，最後淹死在看得見岸的淺水裏。
The Lonely Mountain is reclaimed, but not all dwarves found peace in its halls...
孤山已經被奪回，但不是所有矮人都在它的大廳裏找到了安寧……

The Lonely Mountain reclaimed. Master Smiths cut smithing energy by 30%; Dwarven Honor adds loyalty every day; Dwarven Stubbornness keeps morale unshakable. Slow to build a wall — but the wall holds until the mountain itself falls.
孤山已經被奪回。工匠大師讓鍛造精力消耗減少 30%；矮人榮譽每天增加忠誠；矮人固執讓士氣不可動搖。他們修牆很慢，但牆一旦建成，就會堅守到山本身崩塌爲止。

The Lonely Mountain, Erebor, stands as the greatest of the Dwarven kingdoms in the north. Rich in gold and mithril, it is home to the line of Durin. The Dwarves of Erebor are renowned craftsmen and fierce warriors, their halls echoing with the songs of their ancestors.
孤山，又稱埃瑞博山，是北方最偉大的矮人王國。這裏盛產黃金和祕銀，也是都林一脈的家園。孤山的矮人以精湛工藝和勇猛善戰聞名，他們的廳堂中迴盪着祖先的歌聲。
The Lonely Mountain. My kin hold its halls again, and the forges burn day and night. Ask me again once we have shared more fires.
孤山。我的族人又回到了那裏的廳堂，鍛爐日夜不熄。等我們再一起度過幾個圍坐營火的夜晚，你再來問我吧。
The Long Defeat could not start. The log has the reason.
無法啓動漫長的敗仗，具體原因見日誌。
The Long Defeat has no fortress to defend. Check long_defeat/fortresses.json.
漫長的敗仗沒有可防守的要塞，請檢查long_defeat/fortresses.json。
The Long Defeat needs the game client and cannot start here.
漫長的敗仗需要遊戲客戶端，無法在此啓動。
The Long Lake's +10% village grain and the Lake-town Muster's -50% army influence cost come together; relationship penalty +20% on kingdom decisions.
長湖讓村莊穀物產量增加10%，長湖鎮集結讓組建軍團的影響力花費降低50%；王國決策造成的關係懲罰增加20%。

The Longbeards came in force and the shift-boss ordered the tunnel sealed. I refused. I stood in the gap with the haft and held it until the roof came down on half my crew. The boss lived. He called it my doing.
長鬚族大舉進攻，工頭下令封死地道，我不肯。我掄着鎬柄堵住缺口，撐到頂上塌下來，壓住半數工友。工頭活了，還說全是我乾的。

The Longbeards of Erebor are a proud and industrious race, dwelling in the halls of the Lonely Mountain. Masters of craftsmanship and mining, they are renowned for their skill in forging weapons, armor, and treasures of unrivaled beauty. Led by their King under the Mountain, the dwarves of Erebor are a resilient people, fiercely protective of their homeland and its riches.
孤山的長鬚族是驕傲而勤勞的矮人，居住在孤山深處的廳堂中。他們精於工藝與採礦，善於打造武器、盔甲和精美無比的珍寶。在山下之王的統領下，孤山矮人堅韌不屈，誓死守護家園與財富。
The Lost? That's an ominous title for a Haradrim.
迷途者？對哈拉德人來說，這稱號可不太吉利。
The Mark needs warriors who won't be silenced.
馬克需要不會被堵住嘴的戰士。
The Mark wastes half its strength ignoring women warriors.
馬克無視女戰士，是在浪費自己一半的力量。
The Mark's finest guardian. +12% battle renown gain.
馬克最優秀的守護者。+12% 戰鬥聲望獲取。

The Men of Dorwinion tend the vineyards on the warm slopes above the Sea of Rhûn, and their wine goes up the Redwater and the River Running to the halls of Elves and Men far to the west. They are vintners, boatmen and river traders, a Northman folk who would rather sell to a stranger than fight him. Their king keeps his court at Vineholm, and every year the Easterlings across the inland sea look harder at his rich and lightly guarded land.
多溫尼安人在魯恩內海上方溫暖的山坡經營葡萄園，葡萄酒沿紅水河與奔流河運往遙遠西方的精靈和人類廳堂。他們是酒商、船伕和沿河貿易商，也是北方人的一支，比起打仗，更願意向陌生人賣東西。他們的國王在葡萄洲設立王庭，而內海對岸的東夷一年比一年覬覦這片富饒而守備薄弱的土地。
The Mouth of Sauron speaks with the Dark Lord's authority. Once a Black Numenorean, he has forgotten his own name after ages of service to evil. He commands the garrison of the Black Gate.
索隆之口以黑暗魔君的權威發言。他曾是黑努門諾爾人，但在漫長的邪惡侍奉中早已忘記自己的本名。如今他統領黑門守軍。

The Mouth's Servants are the Eyes of Barad-dûr operating beyond the Black Gate — informants, enforcers, and spies embedded among the peoples bordering Mordor. Where Sauron's armies cannot yet reach, these agents collect tribute and silence dissent. They work through bribery, blackmail, and quiet murder, ensuring that no conspiracy against the Dark Lord takes root before it is uprooted and crushed.
索隆之口的僕從是在黑門之外活動的巴拉督爾之眼，他們是線人、執行者和間諜，潛伏在魔多邊境各族之中。在索隆的軍隊尚未抵達之處，這些密探負責徵收貢賦並壓制異議。他們依靠賄賂、勒索和無聲謀殺行事，確保任何反對黑暗魔君的陰謀都來不及紮根，便被連根拔起並碾碎。

The Necromancer's inspectors had rejected two previous batches from the fortress's smiths. You reworked the smelting process, accepted no compromise on the quench, and delivered a batch that the inspector examined in silence before marking as approved. It was the first such approval in three years.
死靈法師的檢驗官已經退回要塞鐵匠兩批成品。你重做熔煉流程，對淬火不作任何妥協，交出的一批武器讓檢驗官沉默檢查後蓋上合格標記。這是三年來第一次合格。

The Necromancer's southern hold in Mirkwood. Shadow Command rallies hordes at almost no influence; Dark Conscription drills militia veterans; Shadow Captains swell the one town to twenty notables. Voracious Hordes eat as much as they slay.
多古爾都是死靈法師在黑森林南部的據點。陰影指揮能幾乎不耗影響力地召集部落；黑暗徵兵會訓練老兵民兵；陰影隊長讓唯一的城鎮膨脹到二十名要人。貪婪部落喫得和殺得一樣多。

The Noldor Elves of Rivendell are a wise and ancient people, renowned for their unmatched knowledge, artistry, and valor. Under the guidance of Lord Elrond, they preserve the fading beauty and lore of the Elder Days within the hidden sanctuary of Imladris. Masters of both the sword and the bow, the Noldor combine martial skill with the grace and precision of their kind.
幽谷的諾多精靈古老而睿智，以無人能及的學識、藝術和勇氣聞名。在埃爾隆德領主的指引下，他們在這處隱祕的庇護所中保存着遠古時代漸漸消逝的美與知識。諾多精靈精通劍術與弓術，將出色的武藝與精靈一族的優雅、精準融爲一體。
The North owes your people more than it knows.
北方人欠你們太多了，只是他們自己不知道。
The Northmen are faster than legend. +8% party movement speed.
北方人行軍之快，勝過傳說。+8%部隊移動速度。
The Northmen crash over the enemy like a wave. +6% troop damage.
北方人如浪潮般沖垮敵軍。+6%部隊傷害。

The Northmen of South Rhovanion ride the wide plains between the southern eaves of Mirkwood and the Brown Lands, a free people of horse-breeders who count the Éothéod of the north as their kin. Their fathers were the lords of the Northmen in the days of the old kings, and the barrows of those kings still stand on the grasslands. Twice the Wainriders came out of the East with wagon and fire and broke them, and the riders of the plains have not forgotten it.
南羅瓦尼安的北方人在黑森林南部邊緣與褐地之間的遼闊平原上馳騁。他們以養馬爲生，崇尚自由，視北方的伊奧希奧德爲同族。古代諸王在位時，他們的祖先曾是北方人的領主，那些國王的古冢至今仍矗立在草原上。戰車民曾兩次帶着大車與烈火從東方而來，摧毀了他們的家園，平原上的騎手至今沒有忘記。

The Northmen of South Rhovanion ride the wide plains between the southern eaves of Mirkwood and the Sea of Rhûn. They are horse-lords, kin of the Éothéod who rode north long ago, and they have not forgotten the Wainriders who once burned their halls. Their kings hold Vidugard and owe no lord in the West or the East.
南羅瓦尼安的北方人在黑森林南部邊緣與魯恩內海之間的遼闊平原上馳騁。他們是馭馬者，與很久以前向北遷徙的伊奧希奧德同源，至今沒有忘記戰車民焚燒廳堂的往事。他們的國王統治維杜加德，不向西方或東方的任何領主效忠。
The Northmen ride the wind itself. +5% movement speed.
北方人如同乘風而行。+5%移動速度。
The Old Forest Road from Woodmen-town to the Forest Gate is longer than it looks, friend.
朋友，沿老密林路從林中居民鎮到森林之門，比看起來遠得多。
The One's blessing shields the faithful. +5 health.
至尊魔戒的賜福庇護着虔誠的信徒。+5 生命值。
The One's eye is upon you. +8% resistance to ranged.
至尊魔戒之眼正注視着你。+8% 遠程抗性。

The Orc scouts had slipped the outer markers and were moving toward the heart of the wood. You picked them out of the darkness from sixty yards — three shots, three falls, no alarm given. The patrol found them in the morning and could not tell from which direction the arrows had come.
奧克斥候越過外圍標記，正向森林心臟移動。你在六十碼外的黑暗中找出他們，三箭三倒，沒有響起警報。巡邏隊清晨找到屍體時，甚至看不出箭從哪個方向射來。

The Orcs of Gundabad, residing in the mist-shrouded mountains, are a brutal and savage force. Led by their warlords, they wage endless raids on neighboring lands. Driven by hatred and cruelty, they are relentless in their quest to dominate the north.
貢達巴德奧克居住在霧氣籠罩的羣山中，是殘暴而野蠻的力量。在軍閥統領下，他們不斷襲擊周邊土地。仇恨與殘忍驅使着他們，讓他們執着於支配北方。

The Orcs of Mordor are a brutal and relentless force, bred in the dark pits of Barad-dûr to serve the will of Sauron. Cruel and savage, they march to war in endless hordes, wielding crude but deadly weapons forged in the fires of Mount Doom. Clad in jagged armor and bearing black banners emblazoned with the Red Eye, they bring fear and destruction wherever they tread. Bound by the iron will of their Dark Lord, the Orcs of Mordor are divided into warbands led by ruthless captains, united only in their desire for conquest.
魔多奧克是在巴拉督爾黑暗深坑中孕育出的殘暴軍隊，只爲服從索隆的意志。他們殘忍而野蠻，成羣結隊奔赴戰場，揮舞着在末日山烈焰中鍛造的粗糙兇器。他們身披鋸齒般的甲冑，舉着繪有紅眼的黑旗，所到之處只留下恐懼與毀滅。在黑暗魔君的鐵腕之下，魔多奧克分成由殘酷頭目率領的戰團，只因征服慾望而暫時團結。

The Orcs of the Misty Mountains are a brutal and numberless host of the high peaks. Led by their warlords, they wage endless raids on the lands below, relentless in their cruelty and their hunger for conquest.
迷霧山脈奧克是高峯之上的殘暴大軍，數量多到難以計數。他們由各自戰領統率，無休止地劫掠山下土地，殘忍而貪婪，從不停止征服的慾望。

The Orcs of the Misty Mountains are a savage war-host dwelling among the high peaks and deep places of the range. Driven by an ancient hatred of Elves and Dwarves, they muster vast and ill-armed legions and fall upon the lands below, serving the dark powers that stir in the East.
迷霧山脈奧克是盤踞在羣峯與深穴中的野蠻戰羣。出於對精靈和矮人的古老仇恨，他們集結起龐大但裝備粗劣的軍團，撲向山下諸地，爲東方正在甦醒的黑暗力量效力。
The Order of the Silver Swan taught me that wisdom and warfare go hand in hand. Every mountain pass marked, every river crossing noted - these save more lives than any single sword stroke.
銀天鵝騎士團教會我，智慧與戰爭本就相輔相成。每一條山口、每一處渡河點，只要標註清楚，救下的人命就可能比一次揮劍更多。
The Pathfinder? That's an intriguing title.
探路者？這個稱號倒是有意思。
The Provender-master's cut at Trade 250. Never read above the largest cut. Between 0 and 90. Default: 10.
軍需官交易技能達到250時收取的佣金比例。實際採用的數值不會高於最高佣金。範圍：0至90。默認：10。

The Provender-master's cut, in percent of a town's price, when you send goods to be sold there and the Provender-master has no Trade skill. It falls to the smallest cut at Trade 250, and each town further down the list adds 5. Between 0 and 90. Default: 30.
把貨物送到城鎮出售時，若軍需官的交易技能爲0，按城鎮售價的此百分比收取佣金。交易技能達到250時，降至最低佣金；城鎮在列表中每靠後一位，再增加5個百分點。範圍：0至90。默認：30。

The Ranger patrol was three days from help when a rock fall crippled two members. You set the worst injuries, built shelter from what the mountain offered, and kept the party alive for eleven days until the rescue party found you. Everyone came home.
遊俠巡邏隊距援助還有三天路程時，落石砸傷兩名成員。你固定最嚴重的傷處，用山中能提供的材料搭建庇護所，讓隊伍撐了十一天，直到救援找到你們。所有人都回來了。
The Rangers of the North, the last of Númenor's blood in the wild. We guard the Shire and the roads, and no one thanks us for it. We prefer it so.
北方遊民，荒野中最後的努門諾爾後裔。我們守護夏爾和道路，卻沒人爲此道謝。我們更喜歡這樣。

The Riddermark of the Horse-lords. Horse-lord Heritage cheapens every mounted recruit and upgrade; Riders of the Mark cuts mounted wages; Horse-lord Fellowship binds the Mark in loyalty. Cavalry Dependent — parties heavy with infantry slow to a crawl.
這裏是馭馬者的裏德馬克。“馭馬者傳承”降低騎乘兵種的招募和升級費用；“馬克騎手”降低騎兵工資；“馭馬者同袍情誼”則增強馬克人民的忠誠。但他們也依賴騎兵：部隊中步兵過多，就會走得十分緩慢。
The Riders of Rohan ride to {settlement}!
The Rohirrim crash over the enemy like a wave. +6% troop damage.
洛希爾人如浪潮般沖垮敵軍。+6% 部隊傷害。
The Rohirrim sing of your courage! +{influence} influence, +{relation} relation.
洛希爾人會歌頌你的勇氣！影響力+{influence}，關係+{relation}。

The Rohirrim, known as the Horse-lords, are the proud and noble people of Rohan, a realm of wide open plains and rolling hills. They are renowned for their skill as riders and their unmatched cavalry, which forms the backbone of their military strength. Living in a tightly-knit feudal society, the Rohirrim are led by a king and a loyal nobility who are bound by honor and tradition to protect their land and people. They are fiercely independent, valuing freedom above all, and their warriors are trained to fight with spears, swords, and bows, all while astride their powerful steeds.
洛希爾人以馭馬者之名聞名，是洛汗驕傲而高貴的人民。洛汗由遼闊平原和起伏丘陵組成，他們以精湛騎術和無可匹敵的騎兵著稱，騎兵也是他們軍力的核心。洛希爾人生活在緊密的封建社會中，由國王和忠誠貴族統領，他們以榮譽和傳統守護自己的土地與人民。他們極其重視自由，戰士們善用長矛、刀劍和弓箭，也能在強健戰馬背上作戰。

The Rohirrim, or Horse-lords of Rohan, are renowned for their unmatched cavalry and deep bond with their steeds. Proud and free-spirited, they dwell in the rolling plains of the Riddermark, living in villages and strongholds like Edoras. Guided by their King and loyal to their people, the Rohirrim prize honor, loyalty, and courage. Their warriors ride fearlessly into battle, forming the backbone of Middle-earth’s resistance against the shadow. Though steadfast in their traditions, the Rohirrim are ever ready to defend their land and allies, wielding spears, swords, and shields with precision.
洛希爾人也被稱爲洛汗的馭馬者，以無可匹敵的騎兵和與戰馬之間的深厚感情聞名。他們驕傲而嚮往自由，生活在裏德馬克起伏的平原上，居住在村落和埃多拉斯這樣的要塞中。洛希爾人服從國王的領導，忠於自己的人民，重視榮譽、忠誠和勇氣。他們的戰士無畏地策馬迎敵，是中洲抵抗陰影的重要力量。他們堅守傳統，也隨時準備以嫺熟的矛術、劍術和盾術保衛家園與盟友。

The Sand-Riders are the nomadic desert clans of the deep Harad interior, masters of the waterless wastes between the Ephel Dúath and the distant southern sea. They range across routes known only to themselves, demanding tribute from any caravan bold enough to cross their territory. The settled lords of Near Harad treat them as a nuisance; the Sand-Riders consider the settled lords thieves who stole what the desert had already given freely.
沙騎者是哈拉德內陸深處的游牧沙漠氏族，掌握着埃斐爾度阿斯與遙遠南海之間的無水荒原。他們沿着只有自己知道的路線遊走，向任何膽敢穿越其領地的商隊索要貢賦。近哈拉德的定居領主把他們視爲麻煩；沙騎者則認爲那些定居領主纔是小偷，偷走了沙漠本已無償賜下的東西。
The Seat of Seeing failed and is off until this scene ends. Your own view is back.
觀望之椅發生錯誤，已停用至本場景結束。已恢復你的正常視角。

The Serpent Guard are mounted soldiers in the service of the Serpentlord of Near Harad. Bred in the saddle on the rolling plains south of the Ephel Dúath, they are unmatched as horse-archers in all of Middle-earth's southern lands. In times of peace between Harad and Mordor, the Guard hires its services to Haradrim lords and to any other power rich enough to afford their golden fee.
巨蛇衛隊是爲近哈拉德巨蛇領主效力的騎兵。他們從小就在埃斐爾度阿斯以南起伏平原的馬背上長大，是中洲南方諸地無可匹敵的騎射手。在哈拉德與魔多和平時期，衛隊會向哈拉德領主，以及任何付得起高昂酬金的勢力出租武力。
The Serpent Lord is satisfied. +{influence} influence, +{relation} relation.
巨蛇領主對你很滿意。影響力+{influence}，關係+{relation}。
The Shadow of Umbar haunts the southern coasts.
烏姆巴爾之影徘徊在南方海岸。
The Shadow of the Northmen hunts in the cold lands.
北方人之影在寒冷土地上游獵。
The Shadow: enemy towers fire a quarter slower.
暗影：敵方防禦塔射速降低四分之一。

The Shaghâna are a fierce tribal people of the eastern Harad steppes, renowned as relentless raiders and skilled horsemen. Bound by oath and clan, they answer to their Taskral and serve the dark designs of Sauron from their sun-scorched fortresses.
沙加納人是哈拉德東部草原上的兇悍部族民族，以不知疲倦的劫掠者和熟練騎手聞名。他們受誓言和氏族約束，聽命於塔斯克拉爾，從烈日灼燒的要塞中爲索隆的黑暗謀劃效力。

The Silvan Elves of Mirkwood, also known as the Woodland Realm, are a proud and resilient people who call the vast forest their home. Ruled by King Thranduil, they are skilled hunters and warriors, navigating the shadowed woods with unmatched agility and precision. The Mirkwood Elves are masters of the bow, striking swiftly and silently from the trees.
黑森林的西爾凡精靈，又稱林地王國的精靈，是以廣闊森林爲家的驕傲族羣。他們由瑟蘭杜伊王統治，擅長狩獵與作戰，能在陰影籠罩的林間迅捷而精準地行動。黑森林精靈精通弓術，常從樹影中迅速而無聲地發動攻擊。
The Tainted spreads corruption wherever he rides.
污穢者所到之處都會散播腐化。
沙加納塔斯克拉爾領地。

The Tower of Guard, Gondor's capital and greatest fortress-city, built in seven concentric levels on the Hill of Guard at the eastern end of the White Mountains with Mount Mindolluin behind it. The White City houses the Citadel with the Tower of Ecthelion, the Court of the Fountain with the White Tree, and serves as seat of the Stewards of Gondor (and later King Elessar). Surrounded by the fertile Pelennor Fields enclosed by the great defensive wall called the Rammas Echor.
守衛之塔，剛鐸的首都，也是王國最偉大的要塞城市。它建在白色山脈東端的守衛山上，背靠明多路因山，由七層同心城區構成。白城的王城內矗立着埃克塞理安之塔，白樹生長在湧泉庭院。這裏是剛鐸宰相們的治所，後來也成爲埃萊薩王的駐地。城外是肥沃的佩蘭諾平野，外圍環繞着名爲拉馬斯埃霍爾的宏偉防禦長牆。
The Undying was a sorcerer-king who sought immortality and found only eternal servitude.
不死者曾是一位追求永生的巫王，但他得到的只有永恆奴役。

The Variag Ravagers are war-bands of young Variag warriors from the steppes of Khand who spend their early manhood in a state of ritual warfare: they may own no cooked food, sleep under no permanent roof, and take no mercy. While most eventually return to the settled life of their clans, some never do, and these form the Ravagers — outlaws who prey on the roads of Khand and raid across its borders into Harad and Gondor.
瓦里亞格劫掠團由可汗德草原上的年輕瓦里亞格戰士組成，他們在成年初期會進入一種儀式性的戰爭生活：不能擁有熟食，不能睡在固定屋頂之下，也不得心懷憐憫。大多數人最後會回到氏族的定居生活，但也有人再也回不去，這些人組成了劫掠團，成爲襲擊可汗德道路並越境劫掠哈拉德和剛鐸的亡命徒。
The Variag of Khand. A tradition of woodland militia blends with the Steppe Charioteers' +10% speed across open ground. Mercenary bands ride for whoever pays the most coin.
可汗德的瓦良格人，將林地民兵傳統與草原戰車兵在開闊地上增加10%的速度結合起來。他們的僱傭兵團爲出價最高的人而戰。
The Variags honor the bold. +{influence} influence, +{relation} relation.
瓦里亞格人敬重勇敢的人。影響力+{influence}，關係+{relation}。

The Variags of Khand are a fierce and warlike people, hailing from the dry and rugged lands east of Mordor. Known for their mercenary prowess and loyalty to Sauron, the Variags fight with unmatched ferocity. They ride swift warhorses into battle, wielding curved blades and long spears with deadly precision. Their bronze and crimson armor, adorned with intricate designs, reflects their proud and martial heritage. Divided into tribes and clans, the Variags unite under powerful warlords, bringing fear and chaos to the enemies of the Dark Lord.
可汗德的瓦里亞格人是兇悍好戰的民族，來自魔多以東干燥崎嶇的土地。他們以僱傭兵本領和對索隆的忠誠聞名，作戰時兇猛無匹。他們騎着迅捷戰馬衝入戰場，以彎刃和長矛進行致命打擊。他們的青銅與深紅鎧甲飾有複雜紋樣，反映出驕傲而尚武的傳統。瓦里亞格人分成部族和氏族，在強大軍閥下聯合起來，爲黑暗魔君的敵人帶來恐懼與混亂。

The Variags of Khand are a ruthless and warlike people from the eastern steppes. Known for their mastery of horses and deadly chariots, they bring a unique and brutal style of warfare. Aligned with Sauron, the Variags fight for power and plunder, spreading fear across Middle-earth.
可汗德的瓦里亞格人來自東方草原，是殘酷好戰的民族。他們精通騎術，也善於使用致命的戰車，帶來獨特而兇狠的戰爭方式。瓦里亞格人與索隆結盟，爲權力和劫掠而戰，把恐懼散播到整個中洲。
The Variags of Khand march to {settlement}!
可汗德的瓦里亞格人向{settlement}進軍！
The War of the Ring has not yet begun. No kingdom may declare war.
魔戒大戰尚未開始，任何王國都不能宣戰。
The War of the Ring rages. There can be no peace.
魔戒大戰正烈，沒有和平可言。

The Warden forbade me from joining field units, saying a woman's place was in the Houses, not the battlefield. When I continued practicing combat medicine with willing soldiers, they threatened to revoke my healer's seal.
監護人禁止我參軍，說什麼女人就該待在家裏，而不是跑到戰場上。當我繼續和願意教我的士兵學習戰場救護時，他們威脅說要撤銷我的醫師資格。

The Wild Easterlings are the unconquered steppe clans of the Sea of Rhûn, who have resisted the authority of every lord who has tried to bring them to heel — Rhûn chieftain, Mordor lieutenant, and King of Dale alike. They range across the grasslands east of the Celduin, rounding up horses, raiding flocks, and collecting road tribute from any caravan foolish enough to cross their steppe without an armed escort.
野性東夷是魯恩內海一帶尚未被征服的草原氏族，他們抗拒過每一位試圖迫使他們臣服的領主，無論是魯恩酋長、魔多副官，還是河谷城國王。他們遊蕩在凱爾都因河以東的草原上，驅趕馬羣，劫掠牲畜，也向任何沒有武裝護衛卻愚蠢穿越草原的商隊收取過路貢賦。
The Witch-King of Angmar, Lord of the Nazgûl, is Sauron's most terrible servant. He was once a great king of Men, corrupted by his Ring of Power into an undying wraith.
安格瑪巫王是那茲古爾之首，也是索隆最可怕的僕從。他曾是人類中的偉大國王，卻被力量之戒腐化，變成了不死的戒靈。
The Wood is content. Keep to the path, stranger, and do not look back at the shadows. They are not all ours.[ib:closed]
林子滿意了。沿着小路走，外鄉人，別回頭看那些陰影，裏面可不全是我們的人。[ib:closed]

The Wood-Elves of Mirkwood, led by King Thranduil, are guardians of the vast and mysterious forest. Known for their agility and mastery of the bow, they blend into the shadows, striking with precision and grace. Their realm is one of beauty and peril, protected by the resolve of its warriors and the timeless wisdom of their king. Fiercely independent, the Elves of Mirkwood fight to preserve their forest against encroaching darkness.
黑森林的森林精靈由瑟蘭杜伊國王統領，是這片遼闊神祕森林的守護者。他們以敏捷和弓術聞名，能隱入陰影，以精準而優雅的方式發動攻擊。他們的國度美麗而危險，由戰士的決心和國王悠久的智慧共同守護。黑森林精靈極其獨立，爲了保衛森林免受逼近的黑暗侵蝕而戰。

The Woodland Realm of Mirkwood has endured much hardship over the years. Under the leadership of Thranduil, the Woodelves have become reclusive and wary of strangers. Yet in the heart of Thranduil lingers a fire kindled in the ancient days of the First Age.
黑森林的林地王國多年來歷經苦難。在瑟蘭杜伊統治下，森林精靈變得避世，也對陌生人保持戒備。但在瑟蘭杜伊心中，仍有一團從第一紀元遠古歲月點燃的火焰。
The Woodmen hunt me for the ambush, and my own warband hunts me for the betrayal. I sleep in different holes. I have never been so alert, and never so poor.
林中居民因爲伏擊的事追殺我，自己的戰團因爲背叛追殺我。我換着洞睡，從沒這麼警覺，也從沒這麼窮。

The Woodmen of Angáladh live under the western eaves of Mirkwood, where their fathers cleared steads among trees so hard that axes ring on them like iron. They are bowmen, woodcutters and hunters, few in number and slow to trust, at peace with the Elves of the northern wood.
