Every year the shadow in the south of the forest grows, and every year their king sends more of his archers to watch the Narrows.
安加拉茲的林中居民生活在黑森林西部邊緣。他們的祖先在樹木間開墾農莊，那些樹木十分堅硬，斧頭砍上去會發出金鐵般的聲音。他們是弓手、伐木工和獵人，人數不多，不輕易相信外人，與森林北部的精靈和平相處。森林南方的陰影一年比一年深重，國王每年都會派更多弓手前去守望狹地。

The Woodmen of western Mirkwood cleared their steads under the eaves of the forest and named their realm for the iron-hard trees that ring Woodmen-town. They are bowmen and woodwards, few in number, at peace with the Elves to the north and ever watchful of Dol Guldur to the south.
黑森林西部的林中居民在森林邊緣開墾農莊，以環繞林中居民鎮、堅硬如鐵的樹木爲自己的國家命名。他們是弓手和護林人，人數不多，與北方精靈和平相處，時刻警惕南方的多古爾都。

The Wreckers of the Long Lake live in the reed-beds and rotting old jetties of the Long Lake's shadowed shores, far from the respectable lights of Esgaroth. They make their living by luring barges onto hidden shoals with false lanterns, then stripping the cargo and selling it through fences in the town itself. Despite the efforts of the Lake-town Master and the Dale merchants, the Wreckers have too many friends in the dockside taverns to be easily driven out.
長湖誘船者住在長湖陰暗岸邊的蘆葦叢和腐朽舊碼頭中，遠離埃斯加洛斯體面燈火。他們靠假燈引誘駁船撞上暗灘謀生，隨後剝走貨物，再通過鎮裏的銷贓者賣出去。儘管長湖鎮鎮長和河谷商人一直試圖打擊他們，但誘船者在碼頭酒館中有太多朋友，很難被徹底趕走。

The accusation was true but unprovable, the thane had covered his tracks well. It became my word against his gold and influence. Rather than see me martyred, King Dáin suggested a pilgrimage, a journey to 'seek wisdom.' Exile disguised as honor.
指控是真的，卻無法證明。那個領主把痕跡抹得很乾淨。最後變成我的證詞，對上他的黃金和影響力。戴因國王不願看我成爲殉道者，便建議我去朝聖，踏上一段“尋求智慧”的旅程。說到底，那是披着榮譽外衣的流放。
The ancestors ride with you always. Warcry charge cost -20.
先祖永遠與你同騎。埃奧爾戰吼充能消耗 -20。
The ancient clan's fury envelops the entire battlefield. Savage Rush radius +5.
古老氏族的怒火籠罩整片戰場。蠻勇突襲作用範圍 +5。
The approach goes wrong early and you pull back with what you brought.
剛接近目標就出了岔子，你只得帶着原來的人手撤回。
The archers draw and hold until you give the word, or for 14 seconds at most.
弓兵拉弓待命，等候你下令，最多保持14秒。
The archers draw and hold, and the word is given for you once most of them are ready. A bow is held for 14 seconds at most.
弓兵拉弓待命，多數人準備好後便會自動下令齊射，每張弓最多保持14秒。
The archives of Minas Tirith hold many secrets, yet some truths must be sought beyond stone walls...
米那斯提力斯的檔案館中藏有許多祕密，但有些真相必須在石牆之外尋找……
The arena master has no answer for you now.
競技場老闆現在無法回答你。
The arena master knows of no tournament in a friendly town. You keep your coin.
競技場老闆不知道有哪個友好城鎮正在舉辦競技大會，你無需付錢。
The arena master names the nearest tournaments:{newline}{LIST}
競技場老闆告訴你最近的幾場競技大會：{newline}{LIST}

The armies of Isengard, led by Saruman the White, are a formidable force of Uruk-hai and mercenaries. Forged in the fires of industry, their weapons and armor are crafted for destruction. The forces of Isengard march to war with ruthless efficiency, bent on conquest and domination.
艾森加德的軍隊由白袍薩茹曼統領，是由烏魯克和僱傭兵組成的可怕力量。他們的武器和盔甲在工業爐火中鍛成，只爲毀滅而生。艾森加德軍隊以冷酷高效的方式奔赴戰場，一心追求征服和支配。

The armies of Mordor, forged in the shadow of Mount Doom, are a relentless force of darkness commanded by Sauron, the Dark Lord. Comprised of orcs, trolls, and wicked men, they march to war under the burning Eye, sowing fear and destruction. These legions are driven by cruelty and servitude, wielding jagged blades and crude armor. Bound by Sauron's iron will, the forces of Mordor are a deadly tide seeking to engulf all of Middle-earth in shadow.
魔多的軍隊在末日山的陰影中鍛成，是一股由黑暗魔君索隆指揮的無情黑暗力量。奧克、食人妖和邪惡人類組成這些軍團，他們在燃燒之眼下奔赴戰爭，播撒恐懼與毀滅。這些軍團由殘忍和奴役驅動，揮舞鋸齒般的刀刃，穿着粗糙盔甲。在索隆鐵一般的意志束縛下，魔多大軍如致命潮水般湧來，想把整個中洲吞沒在陰影中。
The armourer cannot take up your commission today.
鑄甲師今天無法接受你的委託。
The armourer has no {PIECE} for your people yet.
鑄甲師暫時還沒有你所屬文化的{PIECE}。
The armourer takes the materials. Your {PIECE} waits at any level {LORD} armoury.
鑄甲師已收下材料。你的{PIECE}可以在任意{LORD}級軍械庫領取。
The armourer takes them, and a master armourer at a level {LORD} armoury will fit you with your {PIECE}.
鑄甲師收下材料後，{LORD}級軍械庫的鑄甲大師便會爲你打造{PIECE}。
The armourer will rework it into {TARGET} for {PRICE}.
鑄甲師會以{PRICE}的費用，將它改造成{TARGET}。
The armourer works only for the host of this campaign.
鑄甲師只爲本次合作戰役的主機玩家提供服務。
The arrows are already nocked. You were never alone out here.[ib:aggressive][if:convo_very_stern]
箭早就搭好了。你在這裏從來就不是一個人。[ib:aggressive][if:convo_very_stern]

The autumn the Angmar host came down the North Road, villagers crowded the postern begging shelter we could not feed. I advised that the gate stay shut, and it did. The garrison lived through the winter, and the marshal never looked at me again.
安格瑪大軍沿北大道南下的那個秋天，村民擠在城牆暗門外求庇護。我們沒糧食養他們，我建議關着門，門就沒開。駐軍熬過了冬天，元帥卻再也不肯看我一眼。

The autumn the trolls came down from the Ettenmoors, hill families crowded the gate begging shelter we could not feed. I advised that the gate stay shut, and it did. The garrison lived through the winter, and the castellan never looked at me again.
食人妖從埃滕荒原下來的那個秋天，山裏人拖家帶口擠在城門外求庇護，可我們沒糧食養他們。我建議關着門，門就沒開。駐軍熬過了冬天，堡主卻再也不肯看我一眼。
The baggage and the wounded need hands.
輜重和傷員都需要人照料。

The band had struck three caravans on the Dwarf-road east of the mountains and slipped away before anyone could follow. You went alone into the hills, found the camp, counted them, sketched the approach, and brought the report back in time for the wardens to act on it.
這羣奧克在山脈東邊的矮人路上襲擊過三支商隊，每次都在別人追來前逃掉。你獨自進山，找到營地，清點人數，畫下進攻路線，並及時帶回情報，讓守衛能夠採取行動。

The band had struck three times from the same direction and slipped away before anyone could follow. You went alone into the pines, found the camp, counted them, sketched the approach, and brought the report back in time for the garrison to act on it.
這支隊伍已經從同一方向襲擊三次，每次都在別人追上前逃走。你獨自進入松林，找到營地，數清人數，畫下接近路線，並及時帶回報告，讓守軍能夠行動。

The base knockdown penetration of a charge at the neutral ratio and full speed. Default 0.4, vanilla's value, which cancels a troop's 0.4 base resistance so only Athletics protects him. 0.5 and up floors an ordinary man on any head-on hit that does damage; 0.3 needs a hard hit.
基準重量比、全速下的基礎擊倒穿透值。默認0.4，與原版相同，會抵消士兵0.4的基礎抗性，因此只有跑動技能繼續提供保護。0.5及以上時，任何造成傷害的正面撞擊都能撞倒普通人；0.3則需要較重的撞擊。
The battle is paused. Press Stay time (Home unless rebound) again to go on.
戰鬥已暫停。再次按“暫停時間”繼續，默認Home，除非已改鍵。

The battle-lord needed to know whether the fortress could be bypassed or had to be reduced. You went forward alone, spent four days observing from the river's eastern bank, and returned with a detailed assessment of its garrison strength, supply schedule, and the approach that gave the best odds. The battle-lord called it the most useful report he had received in a campaign.
戰領需要知道這座要塞能否繞過，還是必須攻下。你獨自前出，在河東岸觀察四天，帶回一份詳細評估，寫明守軍強度、補給時間和勝算最高的接近路線。戰領說，這是他整場戰役收到過最有用的報告。
The best horsemen of the three northern realms
北方三個王國中最出色的騎兵
The best scouts see danger before it sees them...
最好的斥候，總能在危險發現自己之前先發現危險……

The blood feud had been running for three years and was costing both tribes more than either would admit. You asked to speak at the gathering, laid out the numbers without sentiment, and proposed terms that neither side loved but both could accept. They accepted.
血仇已經持續三年，雙方付出的代價都超過了他們願意承認的程度。你請求在集會上發言，不帶感情地擺出數字，並提出一套雙方都不喜歡、卻都能接受的條款。他們接受了。
The blood of Eorl runs hot in my veins, demanding action...
埃奧爾的血在我體內滾燙，催我行動……
The blood of enemies wards off further harm. +8% cut resistance.
敵人的鮮血會擋下後續傷害。+8% 劈砍抗性。
The blood of the old kings of Vidugard runs hot in my veins, demanding action...
維杜加德昔日諸王的熱血在我血管裏奔湧，催着我行動……
The blood-frenzy holds longer. Bloodrage duration +2s.
鮮血引發的狂怒持續更久。嗜血狂怒持續時間 +2 秒。

The border was tense and no one wanted to go first. You went, established contact, made the first exchange, and survived long enough to make a second. Within a year, two other merchants had followed. The trading house you founded became the model for the rest.
邊境氣氛緊張，沒人願意第一個去。你去了，建立聯繫，完成第一筆交換，並活到能做第二筆。一年內，另外兩名商人跟着你來了。你創辦的商行成了後來者的樣板。
The bow sings truest from horseback...
在馬背上，弓弦的歌聲才最真……
The boy knew the danger and chose to stay. The guild wanted a reason, and I gave them one. I can still forge what no smith west of the Misty Mountains can, and I mean to finish what Telchar began.
那孩子知道危險，還是自己選擇留下。行會只想找個理由，我給了他們一個。我如今還是能鍛出迷霧山脈以西任何鐵匠都做不出的東西，我也一定要完成鐵爾哈開創的事業。

The buyers from the south had come expecting to set the price as they always did. You organized the Rohirrim sellers before the fair, agreed on a floor, and held it. The buyers paid what the horses were worth. The sellers remembered who had made it happen.
南方買主來時還以爲能像往常一樣壓價。你在馬市前組織洛希爾賣家，約定底價並堅持到底。買主付出了馬匹真正的價值，賣家也記住了是誰辦成這件事。
The buyers from the south had come expecting to set the price as they always did. You rallied the breeders, held out together, and the herds sold at a price the fair still remembers.
南方來的買家本以爲還能像往常一樣由自己定價。你召集育馬人，大家一起堅持不讓步，最後賣出的價格，馬市至今還記得。
The camp is cold ash by the time you leave it.
你離開時，營地已化成一片灰燼。
The camp is still being set up.
The camp must be raised before a scout rides out.
派斥候出發前，必須先紮營。
The camp was struck; {SCOUT} rejoins the party.

The campaign map updates every settlement nameplate every frame (about a thousand in TAOM), hidden ones included. When on, a nameplate that is hidden and cannot become visible this frame (out of height range, not tracked, not in range, nothing about its settlement changed) is left alone, which saves frame time on the map, most in fast forward. Everything else updates exactly as in the vanilla game. Takes effect on the next frame, so it can be switched with the map profiler on to compare the [MapProfile] lines. Default ON.
戰役地圖每幀都會更新全部定居點名稱牌，TAOM約有一千個，包括已隱藏的名稱牌。開啓後，已隱藏且本幀不可能變爲可見的名稱牌會跳過更新，條件包括高度不符、未被追蹤、不在範圍內，以及定居點信息未變化。這能節省地圖幀耗時，快進時尤其明顯。其他名稱牌仍完全按原版更新。下一幀生效，可在地圖分析器開啓時切換，對比[MapProfile]日誌。默認：開啓。

The captain had heard of your work and commissioned a sword for the ceremony of his promotion. When he drew it before the assembled guard and it rang true, you knew the craft had repaid every sore morning in the smithing quarter.
那位隊長聽說過你的手藝，委託你爲晉升儀式打造一柄劍。當他在集結的衛兵面前拔劍，劍身發出清亮聲響時，你知道鐵匠區每個痠痛清晨都得到了回報。

The caravan carried tribute and was attacked twice by rival tribes. You fought at the front both times and held the column's order. The Mumak arrived, the tribute was delivered, and the merchants paid your fee without argument, which was the strongest praise they gave.
商隊載着貢品，兩次遭到敵對部族襲擊。你兩次都在前方作戰，穩住隊列。猛獁抵達，貢品送到，商人毫不爭辯地付了你的報酬，這就是他們能給出的最高稱讚。

The champion had broken his previous bow in the defence of the eastern passes and needed a replacement before the season's tournament. You worked three days without rest on the stave. When the champion drew it the first time he nodded once and walked away without speaking. That was enough.
那位冠軍在防守東部山口時折斷舊弓，季賽前急需替代品。你連續三天不休息地處理弓身。他第一次拉開那張弓時點了點頭，什麼也沒說就走了。這已經足夠。
The chance each second that an idle archer in range fixes on you. 0 never, 1 always. Default: 0.25.
射程內的空閒弓兵每秒轉而瞄準你的概率。0爲從不，1爲始終。默認：0.25。
The chanting saps enemy will. +8% troop morale.
吟誦會削弱敵人的意志。+8% 部隊士氣。

The chief ordered me to forge collars and chains for his slave caravans, and I refused, though he offered twice the silver. He burned my forge to the ground, with the tools my father left me inside it.
酋長命我替販奴商隊打項圈和鎖鏈，給雙倍銀子，我也不肯。他把我的鐵匠鋪燒成平地，父親留給我的工具也全在裏面。
The claimant must serve its realm.
宣稱者必須效忠於該國度。
The clan provides for its own. -5% troop wages.
氏族會供養自己的戰士。-5% 部隊工資。

The clans had always traded east, but the best steel came from the west. You made the first contact, found a merchant willing to make the journey to the Sea of Rhun, and negotiated terms that made the exchange worthwhile for both parties. The tools that came back transformed three winters of work.
氏族一直向東貿易，但最好的鋼來自西方。你建立第一次聯繫，找到願意前往魯恩內海的商人，並談成讓雙方都覺得值得的條款。帶回來的工具改變了之後三個冬天的勞作。
The clans have old scores to settle. Savage Rush charge cost -20.
各氏族有舊賬要清算。蠻勇突襲充能消耗 -20。
The clans ride as one unstoppable force. +6% troop damage.
各氏族騎手齊心協力，勢不可擋。+6% 部隊傷害。
The clans united are unstoppable. +6% troop damage.
聯合起來的氏族勢不可擋。+6% 部隊傷害。
The cleanup starts when this many enemy soldiers or fewer are left. Default: 3.
敵方剩餘士兵不超過此數時，開始清退流程。默認：3。
The coastal realm of Bellakar, settled by Numenorean Faithful who remained true to the Valar. A bastion of civilization on the southern shores.
貝拉卡爾的沿海國度，由仍忠於維拉的努門諾爾忠實者建立，是南方海岸上的文明堡壘。

The collapse had trapped eight Orcs in the lower gallery. You assessed the stress pattern, directed the reinforcement work, and got the crew to safety before the secondary collapse that followed would have killed them. The warchief's engineer gave you the plans to keep.
塌方把八個奧克困在下層礦廊。你評估受力走向，指揮加固工作，並在隨後二次塌方本會殺死他們之前把隊伍救到安全處。戰酋的工程師把圖紙交給你保管。

The colour of your realm when it is none of the kingdoms above: your clan's land while it serves no kingdom, then a kingdom you found. Written #RRGGBB. Blank gives it a free colour. In one of the kingdoms above, that kingdom's own field applies.
不屬於上述王國時，你所在國家的顏色：未效忠任何王國時是家族土地，之後是自己建立的王國。格式爲 #RRGGBB，留空使用可用顏色。身處上述王國時，使用該王國自己的設置。
The column can no longer account for {AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON} of your back pay.
部隊已無法再兌現拖欠你的{AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON}軍餉。
The column fought without you, and you had no way into the line.
隊伍在你缺席時參加了戰鬥，你當時無法加入。

The coming war will create demand for my expertise. Poisons can eliminate key leaders, contaminate supplies, create chaos without attributable cause. I carry my knowledge and recipes. Those who appreciate surgical precision over blunt force will find my services invaluable, for appropriate compensation.
即將到來的戰爭會製造對我專長的需求。毒藥可以清除關鍵領袖，污染補給，在找不到源頭的情況下製造混亂。我隨身帶着知識和配方。那些欣賞精準處理、勝過蠻力砸爛的人，會發現我的服務極有價值，當然，報酬也要合適。

The commission came from the stables — a request for a blade that could be carried on horseback without awkwardness. You studied the problem, adjusted the balance, and presented the result. Theoden's captain tested it in the yard and had it sent to the king's armory the same afternoon.
委託來自馬廄，需要一把能在馬背上攜帶而不礙事的劍。你研究問題，調整重心，並呈上成品。希奧頓的隊長在訓練場試劍，當天下午就把它送進國王武庫。

The contact was a disgruntled stable-hand who wanted money more than loyalty to the Mark. You cultivated the relationship carefully and received two seasons of patrol schedules in exchange for a sum the chief considered modest. The clan raided without incident for the year that followed.
那名線人是個心懷不滿的馬廄幫工，比起對馬克忠誠，他更想要錢。你小心經營這層關係，用酋長認爲不算多的一筆錢，換來了兩個季節的巡邏表。接下來一年裏，氏族劫掠都沒有出事。

The corsair haven and Black Numenorean port-city on the southern bays. Corsair Trade slashes caravan costs, Corsair Glory adds renown, Desert Corsairs march fast across the sands — but Corsair Greed inflates every wage bill.
烏姆巴爾是南方海灣上的海盜港，也是黑努門諾爾人的港口城市。海盜貿易大幅降低商隊花費，海盜榮耀增加聲望，沙漠海盜能快速穿越沙地；但海盜貪婪會抬高每一筆工資。
The council counted the stores first, and rightly.
議事會先清點存糧，這沒什麼錯。

The council praised the ford and then quietly passed me over for every command, because I had named my captain's flight aloud. I carry the eleven names with me. A man who will not lie for his betters finds few doors open.
議事會誇我們守住渡口，後來每次任命指揮官，卻都悄悄把我跳過去，就因爲我當衆說出了隊長逃跑的事。那十一個名字，我一直記着。一個不肯替上司撒謊的人，能走的門可不多。
The council was right to count the stores before it counted feelings.
先算糧食再談感受，議事會沒做錯。
The council was right to count the stores before the sentiment.
先算糧食再談同情，議事會沒做錯。
The country has been picked over, and recently.
這一帶剛被搜刮過不久。

The creature had driven three scouting parties back and killed two. You studied its web-patterns, identified the anchoring tree it returned to, and took it at dawn with a long Elven blade while it was feeding. Thranduil's captains hung the trophy at the path's entrance.
那隻怪物逼退了三支偵察隊，還殺死兩人。你研究它的織網規律，找出它總會返回的錨定樹，並在黎明時趁它進食，用精靈長刃將其拿下。瑟蘭杜伊的隊長把戰利品掛在道路入口。
The cry of Rhovanion heartens all who hear it. +8% troop morale.
羅瓦尼安的呼喊鼓舞着每個聽見它的人。+8%部隊士氣。
The cry of Rohan heartens all who hear it. +8% troop morale.
洛汗的呼聲會鼓舞所有聽見它的人。+8% 部隊士氣。
The cult's network keeps the host provisioned. +13% ammo.
教團的關係網確保軍隊補給充足。+13% 彈藥。

The culvert was needed to keep the pit floors dry through the flood season. Saruman had given thirty days. You reorganized the labour gangs, simplified the routing, and finished in twenty-two. Saruman examined the work without comment, which meant it was acceptable.
這條涵洞用於在洪水季保持坑底乾燥。薩茹曼給了三十天。你重組勞工隊，簡化路線，二十二天便完成。薩茹曼查看工程後一言不發，這就說明它合格。
The damage of the head butt and the drop kick, as a percentage of their normal damage. Armour does not reduce it. At 0 the attacks still play but hurt no one and knock no one down. Default: 100.
頭槌與飛踢相對於正常傷害的百分比，不受護甲減免。設爲0時，仍播放攻擊動作，但不會造成傷害，也不會擊倒敵人。默認：100。
The damp of the river country makes you resilient. +5% blunt resistance.
河鄉的潮溼環境讓你更能硬扛。+5% 鈍擊抗性。
The dark host swells beyond measure. +6 party size.
黑暗軍勢膨脹到無法衡量。+6 部隊規模。
The dark protects you longer. Sneak-Creeping duration +4s.
黑暗會更久地庇護你。潛行突進持續時間 +4 秒。

The darkness from Dol Guldur had seeped into a clearing near the realm's edge, blackening the soil and killing what grew there. Over two seasons you worked to remove the taint and replant, and the saplings took. Thranduil's foresters came to see it for themselves.
多古爾都的黑暗滲入王國邊緣一處空地，使土壤發黑，植物枯死。你用兩個季節清除污穢、重新栽種，幼樹終於成活。瑟蘭杜伊的林務官親自來看過。
The dead don't care about justice.
The deeds of the Eotheod are sung for ages. +14% battle renown gain.
伊奧希奧德的事蹟會被世代傳唱。+14% 戰鬥聲望獲取。
The deeds of the Northmen are sung for ages. +14% battle renown gain.
北方人的事蹟將傳唱千古。+14%戰鬥聲望獲取。
The deeps of Nogrod have lain flooded since the First Age. I meant to drain them...
諾格羅德的深處，自第一紀元起就泡在水裏。我原想把它排幹……
The defenders fall back to the lord's hall
The desert taught me to see beauty in emptiness, to build something from nothing. Now I sculpt entire realms from the void, each creation a piece of the home I carry within rather than behind.
沙漠教會我從空曠中看見美，也教會我從無到有建立事物。如今我從虛無中雕琢出一個個完整的國度，每件作品都像是我隨身帶着的故鄉碎片，而不是被我拋在身後的過去。

The deserter had killed two overseers and vanished into Gorgoroth's wastes. You went alone, followed the trail for four days across the ash flats, and came back with proof of what you found. No one asked for details.
那個逃兵殺了兩名監工後消失在戈堝洛斯荒地裏。你獨自出發，沿灰燼平地追蹤四天，帶回了發現目標的證據。沒有人追問細節。
The diggings need workers and free men won't go down there. Bring me captives in chains and they'll earn their keep with a pick.
礦坑裏缺工人，可自由民都不肯下去。給我帶些戴着鐐銬的俘虜，他們得靠揮鎬幹活換口飯喫。

The discipline of Sparta serves many purposes. While my brothers trained for phalanx formations, I found patterns in code more elegant than any shield wall. Every XML node precisely placed, every function a calculated strike.
斯巴達的紀律有許多用途。我的兄弟們訓練方陣，而我在代碼中找到了比盾牆更優雅的秩序。每個節點都精確歸位，每個函數都是一次計算好的打擊。
The dispatch arrives late, and you cannot swear it arrived unread.
急件送遲了，你也無法保證途中沒人拆看。
The dispatch is in the right hands, and no others.
急件送到了該收的人手裏，沒經任何旁人的手。
The dread realm of the Witch-king of Angmar in the far north. From his fortress of Carn Dum, the Witch-king wages war upon the remnants of Arnor.
這是遠北安格瑪巫王的恐怖國度。巫王從卡恩督姆堡壘出發，向阿爾諾殘餘勢力發動戰爭。

The dwarf kingdom of the Blue Mountains. Durin's Folk made Thorin's Halls there in their exile, and in this age the Broadbeams and the Firebeards hold Belegost and Nogrod again. Its lords are few and its halls are poorer than those of its kin in the east, but its smiths are the oldest in the West, and its axes keep the goblins of Blue Craig from the roads to Lindon.
藍色山脈的矮人王國。都林一族流亡時在這裏建起梭林大廳，如今寬梁族和火須族也重新掌握了貝烈戈斯特與諾格羅德。這裏領主不多，大廳不如東方同族的富有，但鐵匠傳承在西方最爲悠久，他們的戰斧讓藍巖的半獸人無法侵擾通往林頓的道路。

The dwarf-halls of the Blue Mountains at the western edge of Middle-earth. Durin's Folk made Thorin's Halls in their exile, and the Broadbeams and the Firebeards keep Belegost and Nogrod again. They mine iron and sell it to the Elves of Lindon and the Men of Eriador, while the goblins of Blue Craig gnaw at their roads.
中洲西端藍色山脈中的矮人廳堂。都林一族流亡時建起梭林大廳，如今寬梁族和火須族也重新守住了貝烈戈斯特與諾格羅德。他們開採鐵礦，將鐵料賣給林頓精靈和埃利阿多的人類，而藍巖的半獸人始終侵擾着他們的道路。

The dwarves of Ered Luin dwell in the Blue Mountains at the western edge of Middle-earth. Durin's Folk came there in exile and made Thorin's Halls, and in this age the Broadbeams and the Firebeards keep Belegost and Nogrod again, the oldest dwarf-cities of the West. They are miners and smiths, poorer than their kin in the east, and they trade iron with the Elves of Lindon and the Men of Eriador while the goblins of Blue Craig gnaw at their roads.
埃瑞德路因的矮人生活在中洲西端的藍色山脈。都林一族流亡至此，建起梭林大廳；如今寬梁族和火須族也重新守住了貝烈戈斯特與諾格羅德，那是西方最古老的矮人城市。他們是礦工和鐵匠，不如東方的同族富有，靠着向林頓精靈和埃利阿多人類出售鐵料維生，而藍巖的半獸人始終侵擾着他們的道路。

The eastern of Arnor's three successor kingdoms, a hill realm between the Hoarwell and the Loudwater. Its Dúnedain lords hold Cameth Brin and the Angle and rule a hard people of hill-men. It stands apart from the War of the Ring, but trolls walk its fells and the orcs of Gundabad and the mountains watch every pass.
阿爾諾分裂後的三個王國中，最東邊的一個，是蒼泉河與響水河之間的山地王國。杜內丹領主據守卡梅斯布林和河角地，統治着強悍的山民。它沒有捲入魔戒大戰，但食人妖在高地出沒，貢達巴德及羣山中的奧克緊盯着每一處隘口。

The eastern of the three realms into which Arnor was sundered, a hill kingdom between the Hoarwell and the Loudwater. Its Dunedain lords hold Cameth Brin and the Angle and rule a hard people of hill-men, with trolls in the fells and orcs on every pass.
阿爾諾分裂出的三個王國中，魯道爾位於東方，是蒼泉河與響水河之間的山地王國。杜內丹領主掌握着卡梅斯布林和河角地，統治着堅韌的山民；高地有食人妖出沒，每處山口都有奧克盤踞。

The eastern ruins of Gondor's ancient capital across the Anduin from West Osgiliath, now a haunted battlefield contested between Gondor's Rangers and Mordor's forces. The broken eastern half of the great bridge leads to collapsed buildings and flooded streets where Orcs lurk among fallen towers. Strategic crossing point controlling access to Ithilien and the road to Minas Morgul.
這裏是剛鐸古都的東部廢墟，隔安都因河與西歐斯吉利亞斯相望，如今成了剛鐸遊俠與魔多軍隊爭奪的陰森戰場。大橋東半部已經崩裂，通向倒塌的建築和被水淹沒的街道，奧克潛伏在傾覆的高塔之間。此地是控制伊希利恩通路和通往米那斯魔古爾道路的戰略渡口。
The emissary could not complete the deal.
使者未能完成這筆交易。
The emissary has no elite units to offer right now.
使者目前沒有可供招募的精銳兵種。
The emissary only deals with the host of this campaign.
使者只與本場合作戰役的主機玩家交易。
The enemy capture is slipping back: {PERCENT}%
敵方佔領進度正在回退：{PERCENT}%
The enemy holds a capture point.
敵方控制了一個佔領點。

The engine reserves room for the skeletons drawn in each frame in two per-frame buffers (65,536 and 262,144 entries) and never checks that the next one fits; one skeleton too many (about 2,340 in view for the first buffer) freezes the battle for good. When on, TAOM bounds-checks both buffers by rewriting 13 bytes of the engine at launch at each one, so a skeleton that would not fit is drawn from that buffer's first slots instead (its bones may look wrong for that frame). TAOM installs each check only where the exact engine bytes are found exactly once: a build that only moves the function is still patched, and a changed build gets nothing written. It also writes nothing for a buffer another module already guards, and guards the other one regardless. Takes effect at the next launch. Default ON.

引擎爲每幀繪製的骨骼預留兩個緩衝區，容量分別爲65,536和262,144項，卻不檢查下一個骨骼能否放入。多出一個骨骼就可能使戰鬥永久卡死，第一個緩衝區大約在視野內有2,340個骨骼時達到上限。開啓後，TAOM在啓動時分別改寫兩處引擎代碼，每處13字節，爲兩個緩衝區增加邊界檢查。放不下的骨骼改用該緩衝區開頭的槽位繪製，因此那一幀的骨骼外觀可能有誤。每處補丁只有在精確引擎字節序列僅找到一次時纔會安裝：僅移動函數位置的版本仍可匹配，代碼已經改變的版本不會寫入。其他模塊已保護的緩衝區也不會被改寫，但不妨礙保護另一個緩衝區。下次啓動生效。默認：開啓。
The envoy bows to your words: the price falls to {PRICE} denars.
使者被你說服，將價格降到了{PRICE}第納爾。
The envoy returns in {DAYS} {?DAYS>1}days{?}day{\?} at the same price. Nothing is spared until you pay.
使者會在{DAYS}{?DAYS>1}天{?}天{\?}後帶着同樣的開價回來。在付款前，你的村莊仍可能遭到劫掠。
The envoy will not be moved: the price stays at {PRICE} denars.
使者不肯讓步，價格仍爲{PRICE}第納爾。

The existing channels had not been extended in a generation. You surveyed the terrain, proposed a new branch, organized the labor, and finished the construction before the spring floods. The oasis produced twice as much as the previous year. Three other settlements sent messengers to learn how.
現有水渠已經一代人沒有延伸。你勘察地形，提出新支渠，組織勞力，並在春洪前完工。綠洲產量達到上一年的兩倍。另有三個聚落派信使來學習做法。

The existing process wasted a third of the steel through brittle failures at the quench. You identified the temperature as the problem, proposed a fix, tested it against Saruman's overseer's skepticism, and proved it in a single shift. Production doubled within the month.
原有流程在淬火時會因脆裂浪費三分之一鋼材。你找出問題在溫度，提出修正，並頂着薩茹曼監工的懷疑完成測試，一個班次內就證明有效。一個月內產量翻倍。

The existing routes had been taxed to the point where merchants were looking for alternatives. You identified an underused passage through the bay islands, arranged the fees, and brought three new merchant houses into the harbor within a season. The harbormasters were irritated but richer.
舊路線稅負太重，商人已經在尋找替代選擇。你找出一條穿過海灣羣島的冷門航道，安排費用，一個季節內就把三家新商行帶進港口。港務長們很不高興，但也更富了。
The faction that rules the majority of Middle-earth.
統治中洲大部分地區的勢力。
The faithful march without weariness. +5% party movement speed.
虔信者行軍不知疲憊。+5% 部隊移動速度。
The farms owe me their tithe and pay it in grain, not coin -- when they pay at all. Collect what is owed and bring it in, and you will have a cut.
農場欠我什一稅，要用糧食交，不是錢幣。當然，得他們肯交纔行。把欠的收上來交給我，你也能分到一份。
The farthest the hunter closes in one hour while out of your sight, in map units. Default 15.
追獵者在你的視野之外時，每小時最多向你接近的距離，以地圖單位計算。默認：15。

The fewest days a clan that signs on as a mercenary stays with its kingdom. Until then it cannot leave a ruler who is in debt, be hired away by another kingdom, or leave in its daily consideration of whether to stay. A clan with more time left is not shortened. Your own clan is not bound, and neither is dismissing or hiring away a mercenary yourself. 0 turns it off. Applies when a clan signs on; clans already serving get it at their next signing. Between 0 and 120. Default: 30.
家族簽約成爲傭兵後，至少爲該國效力的天數。在此之前，不會因統治者欠款而離開，也不能被其他國家挖走，或在每日去留判斷中自行離職。原有剩餘期限更長時，不會被縮短。你自己的家族不受約束，你親自解僱或挖走傭兵也不受此限制。0爲關閉。家族簽約時生效，已經服役的家族會在下次簽約時採用。範圍：0至120。默認：30。
The fief hub cannot be opened right now.
現在無法打開封地管理界面。
The fiercest warriors are often too fierce for their own armies...
最兇悍的戰士，往往連自己的軍隊都嫌他太兇……
The finest bowmen of Rhovanion rally to your banner. +5 party size.
羅瓦尼安最優秀的弓手聚集在你的旗幟下。部隊人數上限+5。
The finest bowmen of Rohan rally to your banner. +5 party size.
洛汗最優秀的弓手聚集到你的旗幟下。+5 部隊規模。
The finest riders serve truth, not corrupted counsel...
最好的騎手忠於真相，不會聽信腐敗的讒言……
The finest riders serve truth, not corrupted kings...
最好的騎手效忠真相，而不是腐敗的國王……

The finest weapons of your people go to those whose deeds match the names they carry. Strike down enemies with your own hand, take enemy lords captive and win battles, or bring the armourer your people's lord's materials instead; then a master armourer will fit you with it.
你所屬文化最精良的武器，會交給功績配得上它們名聲的人。親手擊倒敵人、俘獲敵方領主、贏得戰鬥，或者向鑄甲師交付你所屬文化的領主級材料，大師便會爲你打造武器。
捕魚的士兵帶回了{N}份魚。
The fleet remembers your service. +{influence} influence, +{relation} relation.
艦隊會記住你的貢獻。影響力+{influence}，關係+{relation}。
The folk of {ISSUE_SETTLEMENT} have lost their seed grain and will go hungry unless the fields are sown.
{ISSUE_SETTLEMENT}的居民失去了糧種。如果不能及時播種，他們就要捱餓了。
The folk of {ISSUE_SETTLEMENT} lack the tools to work their land and craft their goods.
{ISSUE_SETTLEMENT}的居民缺少耕種和製作貨物所需的工具。
The folk of {ISSUE_SETTLEMENT} need livestock driven to them to rebuild their flocks.
{ISSUE_SETTLEMENT}的居民需要有人運來牲畜，讓畜羣重新繁衍。

The food order never spends the gold your party needs for this many days of wages, so buying food cannot leave your troops unpaid. 0 lets it spend the whole purse. Morale purchases are not limited: they show their price. Between 0 and 30. Default: 3.
買糧指令始終保留足以支付此天數軍餉的金幣，避免買糧後無錢發餉。0爲允許花光全部錢款。鼓舞士氣的付費選項不受此限制，但會顯示價格。範圍：0至30。默認：3。
The forest teaches you to sense danger early. +10% party spotting range.
森林教會你更早察覺危險。+10% 部隊偵察範圍。
The forge grows cold when there are no deeds to inspire the songs. I seek glory and gold, as any proper dwarf should!
若沒有值得寫進歌裏的事蹟，熔爐也會冷下去。我追求榮耀和黃金，任何像樣的矮人都該如此！
The forge stands cold, traveller. Without iron the smith cannot shoe a horse nor mend a ploughshare, and the village suffers for it.
旅人，鍛爐的火已經熄了。沒有鐵料，鐵匠既不能給馬釘蹄鐵，也不能修補犁鏵，整個村子都受到了影響。
The forges of Erebor burn bright, but some smiths seek different fires...
孤山的鍛爐燒得明亮，但有些鐵匠想尋找不同的火……
The fortress of Isengard, domain of Saruman the White.
艾森加德要塞，白袍薩茹曼的領地。
The full host of the Eotheod rides to war. +6 party size.
伊奧希奧德全軍馳向戰場。+6 部隊規模。
The full host of the Northmen rides to war. +6 party size.
北方人全軍策馬出征。部隊人數上限+6。
The fury does not abate. Savage Rush duration +2s.
怒火不會衰退。蠻勇突襲持續時間 +2 秒。
The game is rebuilding its shaders after a change to your mod list or to the game. It is not frozen.
MOD列表或遊戲發生變化後，遊戲正在重新編譯着色器，並未卡死。
The gardens of Ithilien still bloom, though shadow creeps ever closer...
伊希利恩的花園依舊繁花盛開，儘管陰影正悄然逼近……
The garrison does not trust me with a command now, and my father will not speak of it. I would sooner die useful than live as a joke. I still carry the spear.
如今駐軍不信任我，不再讓我帶兵，父親也不肯提那件事。與其活着被人當笑話，我寧可死得有點用。我還帶着那支長矛。
The garrison eats from the stored goods; keep the stash provisioned or it will starve.
駐軍會消耗倉庫裏的食物，請及時補充，否則他們會捱餓。
The garrison of {FORT} harries your march, slowing it: {KILLED} killed, {WOUNDED} wounded and {FOOD} food lost.
{FORT}的駐軍襲擾你的行軍，使行軍減慢：{KILLED}人陣亡，{WOUNDED}人受傷，損失{FOOD}份食物。
The gate needs a steady pair of eyes on who comes and goes.
城門需要有人認真盯着，留意進出的人。

The gatekeeper at the Morannon had been taxing every band that passed and pocketing half the take. You documented the scheme, presented it to his superior at exactly the right moment, and watched the post change hands. You made sure it changed to yours.
魔欄農的守門人向每支經過的隊伍收稅，並把一半收入裝進自己口袋。你記錄下整套手法，在正合適的時候呈給他的上級，看着崗位易手。你確保它落到了自己手裏。

The goblin-warrens of Blue Craig in the Blue Mountains (Ered Luin) of the far west, hard by the Grey Havens of Lindon. A distinct, numberless host of goblin-kind — separate from their Misty Mountains cousins of Goblin Town — they swarm the western crags and trouble the Elves of the western shore.
藍巖的半獸人巢穴位於遙遠西方的藍色山脈，也就是埃瑞德路因，緊鄰林頓的灰港。它們是一支獨立而數量龐大的半獸人族羣，與迷霧山脈半獸人鎮的同類不同，常在西方峭壁間蜂擁而出，騷擾西岸的精靈。

The goblins of Blue Craig hold the western spurs of the Ered Luin, cut off from their kin under the Ered Luin by the length of Eriador. They raid the Dwarf-roads and the shores of Lune, and the Elves of Mithlond count them the nearer enemy.
藍巖的半獸人佔據着埃瑞德路因西側的支脈，與埃瑞德路因山下的同族隔着整個埃利阿多。他們劫掠矮人的道路和路恩沿岸地區，是米斯瀧德精靈身邊更近的敵人。
The gold in the largest purse you can give a companion. A purse is worth 1 relation per 500 gold, at most 10 (5000 gold). Between 500 and 5000 gold. Default: 5000.
可以贈送給同伴的大錢袋金額。每500金幣價值1點關係，最多10點，即5000金幣。範圍：500至5000金幣。默認：5000。
The gold in the middle purse you can give a companion. A purse is worth 1 relation per 500 gold, at most 10 (5000 gold). Between 500 and 5000 gold. Default: 2000.
可以贈送給同伴的中錢袋金額。每500金幣價值1點關係，最多10點，即5000金幣。範圍：500至5000金幣。默認：2000。

The gold in the smallest purse you can give a companion. The gold leaves you and goes to the companion. A purse is worth 1 relation per 500 gold, at most 10 (5000 gold), before the scaling and the cap. Between 500 and 5000 gold. Default: 500.
可以贈送給同伴的小錢袋金額。錢款從你這裏轉給同伴。在關係折算和上限計算前，每500金幣價值1點關係，最多10點，即5000金幣。範圍：500至5000金幣。默認：500。

The great Houses of Âbanissa rule the deep south of Harad, a land of humid jungles, ancient stone palaces and towering war-beasts. Their armies march beneath banners of dynasty, commanding respect and terror across the southern lands.
阿巴尼薩各大家族統治着哈拉德極南方，那是一片潮溼叢林、古老石宮和高大戰獸組成的土地。他們的軍隊在王朝旗幟下前進，在南方諸地贏得敬畏，也散播恐懼。
The greatest charge in the age of men. Warcry radius +5.
這是人類紀元最偉大的衝鋒。埃奧爾戰吼作用範圍 +5。
The greatest riders follow you. +9 health.
最出色的騎手會追隨你。+9 生命值。

The green land west of the Blue Mountains, last realm of the High Elves on the shores of Middle-earth. From the Grey Havens of Mithlond the white ships sail into the West. Círdan the Shipwright, eldest of the Eldar, keeps the fading light of the Falathrim — wise, few, and each blade irreplaceable. Lindon shares the Falathrim strength of Mithlond.
林頓是藍色山脈以西的綠色土地，也是中洲海岸上高等精靈最後的國度。白船從米斯瀧德的灰港駛向西方。造船者奇爾丹是最年長的埃爾達，守護着法拉斯民漸漸消逝的光輝。他們睿智、人數稀少，每一柄劍都無可替代。林頓與米斯瀧德同享法拉斯民的力量。
The ground here does not suit this camp.
這裏的地形不適合建立這種營地。
The ground shakes as the riders descend. Warpack Charge radius +3.
騎手衝下時，大地也隨之震動。戰羣衝鋒作用範圍 +3。

The guild cheats with its own weights, only more carefully. I fled before the hearing with what I could carry. I still know every price and every buyer in Eriador, and a captain who wants his stores bought cheap has a use for me.
行會自己也拿秤砣騙人，只不過更小心。我沒等開審，就帶着拿得動的家當逃了。埃利阿多每種貨的價錢、每個買主，我還是都熟。想便宜買補給的隊長，用得着我。

The guild displayed twelve pieces per year from craftsmen across the region. You submitted three — a blade, a lock mechanism, and a decorative fitting — and all three were accepted. The guild master told you it was the first time a single craftsman had placed three pieces in the same year.
行會每年從整個地區工匠中挑選十二件作品展出。你提交了三件：一把刀、一套鎖具和一件裝飾配件，三件全被選中。行會大師告訴你，這是第一次有一名工匠同年入選三件。
The halls of Erebor honor your bravery! +{influence} influence, +{relation} relation.
孤山大廳會銘記你的英勇！影響力+{influence}，關係+{relation}。
The hammering does not let up. Hammer Down duration +4s.
連續重擊不會停下。重錘壓頂持續時間 +4 秒。
The harsh hills of Dunland make you resilient. +5% resistance to melee.
黑蠻地嚴酷的丘陵讓你更加堅韌。+5% 近戰抗性。

The harvest had failed and the winter stores were low. You went to Isengard alone, spoke to the right man, and came back with grain in exchange for iron ore the clan had been sitting on for years. The chief was astonished; the clan ate.
收成失敗，冬儲見底。你獨自前往艾森加德，找對人談話，用氏族多年擱置的鐵礦換回糧食。酋長驚訝不已，氏族則有飯可喫。

The heir ordered a surrendered caravan guard put to the axe, and I stepped between them. He struck me across the face, and his clan named me oath-breaker, which in Khand is worse than being named dead.
繼承人下令用斧頭砍死一個投降的商隊護衛，我擋在了中間。他一巴掌打在我臉上，他的氏族還說我是背誓者。在可汗德，這比被叫作死人還糟。
The herds are sold now, and the stud-lands have grown over. I have gone looking for work that will let me earn back what that winter cost, though I have never been able to say how much that is.
如今馬羣賣了，育馬的土地長滿荒草。我出來找活，希望能賺回那個冬天賠進去的東西，可我從來說不清，那究竟值多少。
The high towers are fully manned.
The hill-folk are tougher than they look. +6 health.
山民比外表看上去更結實。+6 生命值。
The hill-songs raise your warriors' spirits. +8% troop morale.
山丘之歌會振奮你的戰士。+8% 部隊士氣。
The hills forge you like iron. +6 health.
丘陵中的生活讓你變得像鋼鐵一樣堅韌。+6 生命值。
The hills make the skull thick and the will unbreakable. +10% resistance to blunt.
丘陵造就厚硬頭骨，也造就不可動搖的意志。+10% 鈍擊抗性。
The horde devours everything — +20% party food consumption.
這支羣潮會喫掉一切；部隊食物消耗 +20%。
The horn can only sound between waves.
只能在兩波之間吹響號角。
The horn pays half as much.
The horn pays twice as much for the time it skips.
吹號提前開戰時，按跳過時間獲得的獎勵變爲2倍。
The horse-lords of Harlindon breed good mounts for Arthedain and the Havens alike. Trade is old among us, and so are its debts.
哈林頓的馭馬者爲阿塞丹和灰港培育好馬。我們做買賣的歷史很久，欠下的債也一樣。

The horses began refusing to go near the Gap of Rohan - even the bravest stallions would rear and flee. Animals sense evil before men do. When I reported this to the horse masters, they blamed bad training.
馬匹開始拒絕靠近洛汗隘口，就連最勇敢的種馬也會立起前蹄逃開。動物比人更早感知邪惡。我把這事報告給馬師，他們卻怪訓練不當。

The horses began refusing to go near the road toward Dol Guldur, and even the bravest stallions would rear and flee. Animals sense evil before men do. When I reported this to the horse masters, they blamed bad training.
馬開始不肯靠近通往多古爾都的路，連最勇敢的公馬也會揚起前蹄，掉頭逃走。牲畜比人更早察覺邪惡。我告訴管馬的人，他們卻說是沒馴好。
The horses grow restless, and strange wolves prowl our borders...
戰馬開始不安，奇怪的狼也在邊境遊蕩……
The horses grow restless, and strange wolves prowl the southern eaves...
馬羣越來越不安，奇怪的狼也在南邊林緣遊蕩……
The horses whisper of storms approaching...
馬兒低聲訴說，風暴正在逼近……
The host could not be mustered here.
The host needs its spirits lifted.
The host raids your villages as it raids any others.
這支大軍仍會劫掠你的村莊，與你之外的村莊一視同仁。
The host shares out {COUNT} of the stores. Spirits rise, but the camp falls into disorder.
部隊分發了{COUNT}份儲備物資。士氣提高了，但營地也變得混亂。
The hosts of Gundabad march to {settlement}!
The hosts of Rhun march to {settlement}!
The hunt is over, for now.
The hunt never ends for you. +9 health.
對你來說，狩獵永不結束。+9 生命值。
The hunter's host is filled to this many times your strength (your army's, when you lead one). Default 1.3.
將追獵者的軍隊補充至你當前實力的此倍率；你率領軍團時，則按軍團實力計算。默認：1.3。
The hunters of Mirkwood march to {settlement}!
狩獵的士兵帶回了{N}份肉。

The influence an office such as the Steward of Gondor or a Marshal of the Mark pays its holder's clan each week, as a percentage of its amount in realms_titles.xml. 0 stops it. Between 0 and 300. Default: 100.
剛鐸宰相、洛汗元帥等官職每週向任職者家族提供的影響力，按realms_titles.xml中數值的百分比計算。0爲停止提供。範圍：0至300。默認：100。

The influence it costs to usurp, form, restore or revoke a title, as a percentage of its cost in realms_titles.xml. Restoring Gondor's throne for Aragorn costs 2500 at 100. Applies to AI lords too. Between 10 and 500. Default: 100.
奪取、設立、恢復或剝奪頭銜所需的影響力，按realms_titles.xml中費用的百分比計算。設爲100時，爲阿拉貢恢復剛鐸王位需要2500影響力。也作用於AI領主。範圍：10至500。默認：100。

The intelligence taken from the Elven warden described the full rotation of Thranduil's eastern border patrol. It was the most useful strategic information Dol Guldur had received in a year. No one asked how you got the prisoner out. You did not explain.
從那名精靈守衛口中得到的情報，說明了瑟蘭杜伊東部邊境巡邏的完整輪換。這是多古爾都一年裏得到的最有用戰略信息。沒人問你怎麼把囚犯帶出來，你也沒有解釋。
The isolation of Stangard breeds iron resolve. +6 health.
斯坦加德與外界隔絕的生活磨鍊了你的意志。+6 生命值。
The isolation of Wainwatch breeds iron resolve. +6 health.
戰車哨站的孤寂鑄就鋼鐵般的決心。生命值+6。
The jungle hides everything and forgives nothing. I learned to move through it unseen. Listen, and I will tell you how.
叢林會藏下一切，卻什麼也不會原諒。我學會了在其中無聲穿行。聽着，我告訴你我是怎麼學會的。
The keep can hold 30 more defenders.
主堡可容納的守軍減少40名。
The keep takes 40 percent longer to fall.
The king's treasurers at Cameth Brin keep the counts of grain and refugees. A few of us have spoken up for the hill families and been sent away for it.
卡梅斯布林的王室財務官們清點糧食和難民人數。我們有些人替山民家庭說過話，也因此被趕了出來。
The king's treasurers at Caras Gorthad keep the counts of grain and refugees. A few of us have spoken up for the border farmers and been sent away for it.
卡拉斯戈沙德的王室財務官們清點糧食和難民人數。我們有些人替邊境農民說過話，也因此被趕了出來。
The lads call me Bear, after the old chieftain. I have not earned it yet, but I will.
夥伴們叫我熊，就像那位老首領。我還配不上，可遲早會配得上。
The lads call me Spiderbane. I have not earned it yet, but I will.
夥伴們叫我蜘蛛剋星。我還配不上，可遲早會配得上。
The lads named me after Ostmar the Warden. I have not earned it yet, but I will.
夥伴們拿守望者奧斯特馬爾的名字叫我。我還配不上，可遲早會配得上。
The lads named me after the dragon-slayer. I have not earned it yet, but I will.
夥伴們拿屠龍英雄的名字叫我。我還配不上，可遲早會配得上。
The lancers of Lindon have ridden north to Arnor since the days of Elendil. The old alliance is no small thing to those of us who kept it.
從埃蘭迪爾的時代起，林頓的槍騎兵就曾北上阿爾諾。對我們這些守住承諾的人，古老的聯盟從來不是小事。

The last bastion of the Dunedain in the south. Tower Guard hold the line, Gondorian Discipline rallies armies cheaply, and the Men of the Fields march on plains. War-Depleted Lands grow slowly — but Gondor stands.
剛鐸是南方杜內丹人最後的堡壘。聖白塔衛隊堅守陣線，剛鐸紀律讓軍隊能以較低成本集結，原野之民能在平原上行軍。戰火耗盡的土地增長緩慢，但剛鐸仍屹立不倒。

The last of the three realms into which Arnor was sundered, Arthedain did not fall. Arvedui's line still holds Fornost upon the North Downs, though its lords are few, its towns poor, and Angmar's shadow lies always on the northern hills.
阿爾諾分裂出的三個王國中，阿塞丹堅持到了最後，至今仍未陷落。阿維杜伊的後人依然統治着北崗上的佛諾斯特，只是領主所剩無幾，城鎮貧困，安格瑪的陰影始終籠罩着北方丘陵。

The last raid, I saw the trap early. Beornings in the trees, both sides. I took the strong ones and ran. The rearguard I left to hold the pass, and they held, and they died. The Great Goblin counted the dead and asked who gave the order.
最後一次，我早早看出是陷阱。路兩邊的樹裏，全是貝奧恩一族的人。我帶着強壯的跑了，留下後衛守隘口。他們守住了，也死了。半獸人王數完死人，問是誰下的令。

The least relation you lose with an army's leader when you pay influence to disband it. The cost is a random whole number between the least and the most. If the least is above the most, the two swap. Applies only in single player, and only while Enable Personal Relations is on. Default: 28.
花費影響力解散軍團時，與軍團長最少損失的關係值。實際損失在最小值和最大值之間隨機取整數；最小值高於最大值時，兩者會互換。只在單人模式且開啓個人關係時生效。默認：28。

The ledgers had been misaligned since the reclamation, with losses no one could explain. You spent three months cross-referencing records and identified the error — a simple conversion mistake compounded across twenty years of entries. The King's treasurer shook your hand.
自孤山收復以來，賬簿一直對不上，有些損失沒人解釋得清。你花三個月交叉覈對記錄，找出了錯誤：一次簡單的換算失誤，在二十年記錄中不斷累積。國王的司庫和你握了手。

The ledgers of Thorin's Halls had been misaligned for years, with losses no one could explain. You spent three months cross-referencing records and found the error: a simple conversion mistake compounded across twenty years of entries. The King's treasurer shook your hand.
梭林大廳的賬目多年對不上，虧空也沒人說得清。你花三個月交叉覈對記錄，終於找到原因：一個簡單的換算錯誤，在二十年的賬目中不斷累積。國王的財務官握住了你的手。
The long work wears on the men (morale -{N}).
長時間勞作讓士兵疲憊不堪（士氣 -{N}）。
The lord of Egladil called it butchery and broke the company. Half my men went home; the rest followed other captains. I am not sorry, only alone.
埃格拉迪爾的領主說這是屠殺，解散了隊伍。一半人回了家，其他人跟了別的隊長。我不後悔，只是剩下了自己。
The lord warden called it butchery and broke the company. Half my men went home; the rest followed other captains. I am not sorry, only alone.
守將說這是屠殺，解散了隊伍。一半人回了家，其他人跟了別的隊長。我不後悔，只是剩下了自己。

The lord's harness is the last armour a master armourer forges, and only for a proven captain. Strike down enemies with your own hand, take enemy lords captive and win battles, or bring the armourer your people's lord's materials instead; then a master armourer will fit you with it.
領主鎧甲是鑄甲大師最後打造的裝備，只屬於經過考驗的指揮官。親手擊倒敵人、俘獲敵方領主、贏得戰鬥，或者向鑄甲師交付你所屬文化的領主級材料，大師便會爲你打造鎧甲。
The lords of Rhun acknowledge your service. +{influence} influence, +{relation} relation.
魯恩的領主們認可你的貢獻。影響力+{influence}，關係+{relation}。
The map shows the Free Peoples and the Shadow.
地圖顯示自由人民與暗影陣營。
The map shows your allies and your enemies.
地圖顯示你的盟友和敵人。
The mark is set deep and does not fade. Marked Prey duration +2s.
標記已經刻得很深，不會輕易消退。標記獵物持續時間 +2 秒。
The mark of the Wolfskin leaves no survivors. Marked Prey radius +5.
月獠的標記不會留下活口。標記獵物作用範圍 +5。
The mark persists through the chaos of battle. Marked Prey duration +4s.
即使戰場一片混亂，標記也會繼續存在。標記獵物持續時間 +4 秒。
The marshal called it butchery and broke the company. Half my men went home; the rest followed other captains. I am not sorry, only alone.
元帥說這是屠殺，解散了隊伍。一半人回了家，其他人跟了別的隊長。我不後悔，只是剩下了自己。
The master armourer fits you with {ITEM}.
The master armourer of {ISSUE_SETTLEMENT} has a heavy harness half-forged and no steel to finish it.
{ISSUE_SETTLEMENT}的鑄甲大師有一副重甲只打造了一半，缺少鋼料，沒法完成。
The master armourer will fit you with one of these. Choose it.
鑄甲大師會爲你打造其中一件。請選擇。
The men are already at work.
The men are felling timber for the camp.
士兵正在爲營地砍伐木材。
The men are fishing the waters near the camp.
士兵正在營地附近的水域捕魚。
The men are out hunting game for the camp.
士兵已外出爲營地狩獵。
The men cannot be set to work during an encounter.
遭遇期間無法安排士兵幹活。
The men cannot work while a scout is out.
斥候在外偵察時，無法安排士兵幹活。
The men stand down. The work is abandoned.
士兵停止幹活，工作已放棄。
The mere sight of you breaks enemy morale. +12% troop morale.
敵人光是看見你就會士氣崩潰。+12% 部隊士氣。

The messenger had been ambushed east of the Ford and could not ride unaided. You found him, fought off the Orc stragglers still searching the road, and brought him in. Cirdan himself spoke to you briefly before turning to the message.
那名信使在渡口以東遭到伏擊，已經無法獨自騎馬。你找到他，擊退仍在沿路搜尋的零散奧克，將他帶了回來。奇爾丹親自同你說了幾句話，隨後才查看那封信。

The messenger had been ambushed east of the Ford and could not ride unaided. You found him, fought off the Orc stragglers still searching the road, and brought him in. Elrond himself spoke to you briefly before turning to the message.
那名信使在渡口以東遭伏擊，已經無法自行騎馬。你找到他，擊退仍在搜尋道路的奧克散兵，並把他帶回。埃爾隆德本人在轉向查看消息前，曾簡短地與你說話。
The messenger seems confused — they were trying to reach someone in your own party!
信使似乎有些困惑：他們要找的人就在你的隊伍裏！
The messenger system is disabled in settings.
信使系統已在設置中關閉。

The mind is the sharpest weapon. I debug problems others can't even see, and my solutions are elegant and deadly. In battle or in code, precision is everything. Allow me to demonstrate by joining your cause.
頭腦纔是最鋒利的武器。我能調試別人甚至看不見的問題，我的解法優雅而致命。無論在戰鬥裏還是在代碼中，精準都是一切。讓我加入你的事業，親自證明給你看。
The miners of {ISSUE_SETTLEMENT} have struck a seam of the rare metal a lord's armour is forged from, and the shaft needs timber before it falls in.
{ISSUE_SETTLEMENT}的礦工發現了一條稀有金屬礦脈，這種金屬可以打造領主鎧甲。礦井需要木料支撐，否則就會坍塌。

The minions of Dol Guldur, under the command of the Necromancer, are a dark and sinister force. Hidden within the corrupted forest of Mirkwood, they employ treachery and shadow to weaken their enemies. Orcs, wargs, and other foul creatures march forth to spread fear and decay across Middle-earth.
多古爾都的爪牙聽命於死靈法師，是一股陰暗邪惡的力量。他們藏身在黑森林被腐化的林地深處，利用背叛與陰影削弱敵人。奧克、座狼和其他污穢生物從那裏出發，把恐懼和腐敗散播到中洲各地。

The mistake was selling some of that information to private buyers, wealthy lords who wanted intelligence on their rivals, merchants seeking trade secrets. The profit was substantial until someone noticed classified information appearing in unexpected places. I destroyed evidence and fled before the investigation reached me.
錯誤在於，我把一部分情報賣給了私人買家：想掌握對手動向的富有領主，尋找貿易祕密的商人。利潤很可觀，直到有人發現機密情報出現在不該出現的地方。我銷燬證據，在調查追到我身上前逃走了。
The most enemy archers that hold you as their target at the same moment. Default: 8.
同一時刻最多有多少名敵方弓兵持續把你作爲目標。默認：8。
The most men the hunter's party holds after its host is topped up. Default 250.
補充追獵軍隊後，其部隊最多容納的士兵數。默認：250。
The most of each iron grade, of iron ore and of hardwood that one smelt returns while the cap is on. Between 1 and 10; a value outside that range counts as 1. Default: 1.
開啓產量限制後，每次熔煉最多產出的各品級鐵、鐵礦石和硬木數量。範圍：1至10；超出範圍按1處理。默認：1。

The most promotion prompts a single won battle may raise. Each prompt pauses the game, so a large number after a large battle means a long queue of dialogs. Merit above the cap is not lost — it carries to the next battle. Default: 2. Saved values from before November 2026 were reset to this default; if you had chosen your own, set it again.
贏得一場戰鬥後，最多彈出多少次晉升提示。每次提示都會暫停遊戲，大戰後提示過多就需要連續處理大量對話框。超出上限的功績不會丟失，會留到下一場戰鬥。默認：2。2026年11月以前保存的數值已重置爲此默認值；若你曾自行調整，請重新設置。

The most relation one barter can buy by offering more than the goods are worth. The loop buys at most 3 points in vanilla (the setting here), before the Tribute perk (x1.2, rounded up) and the Charm relation bonus the engine adds when it applies the change. Points cost more the further relation is from 0, so only a large overpay reaches the cap. Default: 15.
一次交易中，主動多付錢最多能增加多少關係。原版這項循環最多買到3點關係，這裏的設置會調整該上限；之後還會計算“以禮相待”技能的1.2倍效果並向上取整，以及引擎結算時附加的魅力關係加成。關係偏離0越遠，每點關係的費用越高，因此只有多付較大金額才能達到上限。默認：15。

The most relation one gift asks for, after the taste bonus and the scaling by relation (above relation 0 a gift adds (90 minus relation) / 90 of its worth, so a 1-point gift stops working near relation 45 and nothing helps at 90). A companion's gift starts at 1 to 5 by the item's value; a lord's starts at the catalog's value for the goods (1 to 10), and a hero who prizes the goods adds a bonus. Your Charm can add to what lands. Default: 15.
一份禮物在計算喜好加成和現有關係折算後，最多請求增加的關係值。關係高於0時，禮物價值會乘以“90減當前關係，再除以90”，因此基礎價值1點的禮物在關係約45時就會失效，關係達到90時，任何禮物都不再有效。同伴禮物的基礎加成爲1至5點，取決於物品價值；領主禮物按目錄中貨物的基礎值計算，爲1至10點。英雄特別喜歡該物品時還會加成，你的魅力也可能提高最終增幅。默認：15。
The most relation you lose with an army's leader when you pay influence to disband it. Applies only in single player, and only while Enable Personal Relations is on. Default: 32.
花費影響力解散軍團時，與軍團長最多損失的關係值。只在單人模式且開啓個人關係時生效。默認：32。

The most you may bet in each tournament round. 0 = unlimited (up to your purse); raise this slider for a bigger cap, or back to 0 to remove it. Roguery's Deep Pockets doubles any other value. Vanilla is 150. Default: 15,000. Saved values from before 2026-11-10 were reset to this default; if you had chosen your own, set it again.
每輪競技大會的最高投注額。0表示不設上限，但不能超過你持有的錢；提高滑塊數值可以提高上限，設回0則取消上限。流氓習氣的“錢袋頗深”技能會使非零上限翻倍。原版爲150，默認：15,000。2026-11-10以前保存的數值已重置爲此默認值；若你曾自行調整，請重新設置。

The mountain grows soft with prosperity. Merchants outnumber warriors, gold matters more than iron. When I said as much at council, they suggested I was too 'Iron Hills' for Erebor's new age. The dismissal was polite but clear.
孤山在繁榮中變軟了。商人多過戰士，黃金比鐵更重要。我在議會上這麼說，他們暗示我對孤山的新世代來說太“鐵丘陵”了。那番打發很客氣，但意思很清楚。

The mountain has its warriors, but the world needs them more. Darkness spreads from Mordor, Dol Guldur threatens the north. I'll find real fights, real purpose. When Erebor calls its sons to war, and it will, I'll be ready, battle-hardened from the outside world.
山中有自己的勇士，但世界更需要他們。黑暗從魔多蔓延，多古爾都威脅北方。我要去尋找真正的戰鬥，真正的目標。等孤山召喚子民參戰時，而那一天一定會來，我會帶着外界磨出的戰鬥經驗準備好。
The mountain's mechanisms are wondrous, but some engineers dream beyond...
山中的機關令人驚歎，但有些工程師的夢想還要更遠……
The mountains are cruel; weakness invites the blade.
羣山殘酷，軟弱只會招來刀子。
The newest breeds are strongest, and they know it...
最新的品種最強，他們自己也清楚……
The next host of its side rides against your kingdom first, and every tribute after this one costs more.
對方下一支大軍會優先進攻你的國家，此後的每次貢金也都會漲價。
The next patrol needs someone to lead it out and bring it back whole.
下一支巡邏隊需要有人帶隊出去，再把所有人平安帶回來。

The noble Dwarves of Erebor, are renowned for their craftsmanship, resilience, and pride. From their halls in the Lonely Mountain, they forge mighty weapons and treasures of unmatched beauty. Clad in mail and armed with axes, they defend their kin with steadfast courage, seeking to reclaim their legacy and preserve their heritage against all who threaten it.
孤山的高貴矮人以工藝、堅韌和自豪聞名。他們在孤山廳堂中鍛造強大的武器和無與倫比的珍寶。他們身披鎖甲、手持戰斧，以堅定勇氣保衛族人，也努力奪回自己的遺產，守住不容敵人侵犯的傳承。
The nock and release is pure muscle memory. Light Fletching charge cost -30.
搭箭與松弦已經成了純粹的肌肉記憶。輕羽箭充能消耗 -30。
The northern borders grow wild, and few watch them now...
北方的邊境變得越來越荒涼，現在很少有人守衛了……

The oasis had been considered legend. You read the old accounts, identified the geographic clues, and went into the deep desert with ten days of water. On the ninth day you found it. The return took longer than expected but the route you marked brought caravans there within the season.
那片綠洲一直被認爲只是傳說。你閱讀舊記載，找出地理線索，帶着十天的水進入深沙漠。第九天你找到了它。回程比預想更久，但你標出的路線在同一季就把商隊帶到了那裏。
The officers are arguing over the next march and want another voice at the table.
軍官們正爲接下來的行軍爭論不休，想再聽聽別人的意見。

The official had been diverting cargo for three years and everyone knew it, but no one had the documentation. You got the documentation, recovered the cargo on behalf of the merchants, and presented the accounts to the town council along with a list of recipients. The official left Dale quietly.
那名官員截留貨物三年，人人都知道，卻沒人有證據。你拿到了證據，代表商人追回貨物，並把賬目連同收貨人名單交給鎮議會。那名官員悄悄離開了河谷邦。
The old Wainrider road lies open in the East
戰車民昔日的進軍道路在東方暢通無阻
The old alliance still means something to me, even if the Havens would rather forget it...
那個古老的聯盟，對我仍有分量，儘管灰港寧願忘記……

The old drydock could only handle one hull at a time and the fleet was backing up. Your redesign allowed parallel work on two vessels simultaneously. The ship-masters were skeptical until the first simultaneous completion came in ahead of schedule. They were not skeptical after that.
舊幹船塢一次只能處理一條船體，艦隊已經排起長龍。你的重新設計允許兩艘船同時施工。船主們一開始懷疑，直到第一次雙船同時提前完工。那之後他們就不再懷疑。

The old grounds had been grazed out and the elder council was divided on where to go next. You proposed a route, argued the case with numbers and precedent, and led the migration yourself. Three hundred animals and eighty-two people made it to the new grounds intact.
舊牧地已經被啃光，長老議會也對下一步去向爭執不下。你提出路線，用數字和先例說明理由，並親自帶隊遷徙。三百頭牲畜和八十二個人完整抵達新牧地。

The old hall had stood for three generations before the riders put a torch to it. You designed the new one, organized the timber cutting, and led the build yourself. The hall that stands now is stronger and larger than the one that burned. That was the point.
舊大廳立了三代人，最後被騎手一把火燒掉。你設計新廳，組織伐木，並親自帶隊施工。如今矗立的新廳比被燒燬的那座更堅固、更寬大。這正是意義所在。

The old maps showed a collapse, but you followed the sound of water in the deep stone and found the gallery intact behind the rubble. The mithril seam within was modest, but the engineers who mapped it added your name to the survey record.
舊地圖上寫着塌方，但你順着深層岩石中的水聲前進，在碎石後發現礦廊完好無損。裏面的祕銀礦脈不算大，但負責測繪的工程師把你的名字寫進了勘查記錄。

The old maps showed a collapse, but you followed the sound of water in the deep stone and found the gallery intact behind the rubble. The seam within was rich, and the engineers who mapped it added your name to the survey record of Thorin's Halls.
舊地圖標着那裏已經坍塌，可你循着深處岩石間的水聲，發現碎石後面的礦道完好無損。裏面的礦脈十分富饒，測繪的工程師把你的名字寫進了梭林大廳的勘測記錄。

The old warriors say darkness is coming, that we'll all be tested soon. I intend to be ready, experienced, not some green recruit when that day comes. Let me earn my beard-rings in the wild, not the training yard.
老戰士們說黑暗正在逼近，很快我們都會受到考驗。我打算準備好，積累經驗，而不是等那天到來時還像個新兵。讓我在荒野裏贏得鬍鬚環，而不是在訓練場上。
The one you were keeping to is gone.
之前跟隨的目標不見了。
The ones who hold this town do not know you well enough yet. I keep my talk of the roads for friends.
這座城鎮的統治者還不夠信任你，道路消息只向朋友說。

The operation moved goods that could not be declared through channels that did not officially exist, to buyers who paid in coin that was never counted. You ran it cleanly enough that no watch captain was ever able to make a case. When you closed it, you did so because you chose to.
這套生意把不能報關的貨物通過官方不存在的渠道送給買家，買家用從不入賬的錢付款。你經營得足夠乾淨，沒有任何巡守隊長能立案。你關掉它，只是因爲你自己選擇關掉。

The orc-host of the Misty Mountains holds the high places and deep delvings from Mount Gram to the gates of Moria. Bred for war in the cold peaks, they answer the call of the Shadow and hunger to reclaim the mountains for their own.
迷霧山脈的奧克大軍佔據着從格拉姆山到墨瑞亞大門之間的高地和深窟。他們在寒冷山峯中爲戰爭而生，回應陰影的召喚，渴望奪回羣山據爲己有。

The orc-host that holds the deep places of the Misty Mountains — the black pits of Moria, won from the Dwarves, and the cold peaks from Caradhras to Methedras. Larger and better-armed than the goblin rabble of the High Pass, they muster vast war-hosts for almost no influence and march hungry but tireless across the snows.
這支奧克大軍佔據着迷霧山脈深處：從矮人手中奪來的墨瑞亞黑暗坑道，以及從卡拉茲拉斯到美塞德拉斯的寒冷峯巒。他們比高隘口的半獸人烏合之衆更龐大、裝備更好，幾乎不耗影響力就能集結大戰羣，飢餓卻不知疲倦地穿越雪地。
The order could not be placed.

The others may crawl back to rebuild under a new tyrant, but not I. I refuse to grovel in a pit where any snarling beast can claim dominance. I'll peddle my curses and poultices among warbands, learning to twist fates and spill blood. If I ever claim a lair, it'll be under a dark lord's banner, not amid the chaos of goblin squabbles.
其他人也許會爬回去，在新的暴君手下重建巢穴，但我不會。我不願在那種坑裏低頭討活，隨便一頭齜牙咧嘴的野獸都能稱王。我會在戰團之間兜售詛咒和藥膏，學會扭轉命運、放出更多血。若我有一天佔下一座巢穴，也會是在黑暗領主的旗幟下，而不是陷在半獸人內鬥的混亂裏。

The overseer had promised punishment if the forge-tower was not ready before the Dark Lord's inspection. You drove the work gangs harder than anyone thought possible and the tower stood complete with two days to spare. The overseer took the credit; you took the survival.
監工放話，如果熔爐塔不能趕在黑暗魔君視察前完工，就會有人受罰。你把工隊逼得比任何人想像中更狠，塔提前兩天完工。功勞歸了監工，活命歸了你。
The pack is always ready to charge. Warpack Charge cost -20.
戰羣隨時準備發起衝鋒。戰羣衝鋒充能消耗 -20。

The pass was narrow enough for one to hold, and someone had to stay. You volunteered, held the Orcs for long enough, and then retreated the way you had agreed. The company made it out. So did you, though you chose not to discuss how.
那處山口窄到一個人就能守住，而必須有人留下。你自願留下，拖住奧克足夠久，然後按約定路線撤退。隊伍逃了出去，你也逃了出去，只是不願談怎麼做到的。
The patrol captains of Barad Forn walk the Greenway and the North Downs, and we know every ford and track. Some of us sell that knowledge more freely than we should.
巴拉德佛恩的巡邏隊長走遍綠大道和北崗，每處渡口、每條小徑都熟。我們有些人賣起這些消息來，實在太隨便。
The patrol captains of Last Bridge walk the East Road and the Hoarwell crossings, and we know every ford and track. Some of us sell that knowledge more freely than we should.
最後大橋的巡邏隊長走遍東西大道和蒼泉河各處通道，每處渡口、每條小徑都熟。我們有些人賣起這些消息來，實在太隨便。
The patrol captains of Tharbad walk the Greenway and the river tracks, and we know every ford and landing. Some of us sell that knowledge more freely than we should.
沙巴德的巡邏隊長走遍綠大道和沿河小徑，每處渡口、每個泊船處都熟。我們有些人賣起這些消息來，實在太隨便。
The paychest is short — {AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON} of your wages is owed against later.
軍餉不足，暫欠你的{AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON}軍餉將留待以後補發。
The people of Dale honor your courage! +{influence} influence, +{relation} relation.
河谷邦人民敬重你的勇氣！影響力+{influence}，關係+{relation}。

The people of Gondor are a proud and resilient folk, heirs to the greatest kingdom of Men in Middle-earth. Founded by the Númenórean exiles Isildur and Anárion, Gondor stands as a bastion of strength and hope against the encroaching darkness of Mordor. Its stone cities, crowned by the majestic Minas Tirith, are marvels of engineering and endurance. Guided by noble stewards and valiant captains, they field disciplined armies of steadfast infantry and swift mounted knights, a shining beacon of defiance in the face of despair.
剛鐸人是驕傲而堅韌的民族，繼承了中洲最偉大人類王國的遺產。剛鐸由努門諾爾流亡者伊熙爾杜和阿納瑞安建立，是抵禦魔多黑暗擴張的力量與希望堡壘。以雄偉的米那斯提力斯爲冠冕的石城，是工程與耐力的奇蹟。在高貴攝政和勇敢將領的帶領下，剛鐸軍隊擁有紀律嚴明的堅定步兵和迅捷騎士，是絕望面前的一道明亮烽火。

The people of Isengard are Saruman's legions, forged through industry and fueled by a dark vision of domination. Centered around the impenetrable tower of Orthanc, Isengard is home to the Uruk-hai, bred for strength, endurance, and obedience. With machines of war and the cunning of their master, they crush all opposition with ruthless precision.
艾森加德的軍隊是薩茹曼的軍團，由工業鑄成，也由統治中土世界的黑暗野心驅動。堅不可摧的歐爾桑克塔是他們的中心，艾森加德也是烏魯克的巢穴；這些戰士爲力量、耐力和服從而生。依靠戰爭機器和主人的狡詐，他們會以冷酷而精準的手段碾碎一切抵抗。

The people of Umbar are seafaring warriors and corsairs, masters of the seas south of Gondor. Descended from Númenórean exiles, they are known for their cunning and ferocity in battle. Under black sails, their fleets raid the coasts, striking fear into the hearts of their enemies. While their allegiances lie with Sauron, the Corsairs of Umbar are fiercely independent, valuing strength and cunning above all.
烏姆巴爾，是位於剛鐸南部的一個地區。它在歷史上曾經數度易手，成爲被烏姆巴爾海盜控制的獨立國家，直到埃萊薩王的時代才被剛鐸王國徹底收復。烏姆巴爾位於貝爾法拉斯灣南部、安都因河入海口以南，其東面是遼闊的哈拉德地區，南邊則是不爲人知的遠哈拉德。“烏姆巴爾”這一名稱來源於某種人類語言，其含義並不清楚。它和昆雅語詞彙“烏姆巴爾”（意爲“命運”）沒有任何關係。
The people of {TOWN} honor your victory.
The people of {VILLAGE} will long remember the raid.
{VILLAGE}的人民會長久記住這次劫掠。
The people of {VILLAGE} will long remember what was taken from them by force.
{VILLAGE}的人民會長久記住被強行奪走的東西。

The piece — a detailed relief map of Eriador's ancient road network, reconstructed from fragmentary sources — was considered accurate enough to be copied into the library's archives. Three loremasters disagreed about two valleys; you were right about both.
那是一幅埃利阿多古道路網的精細浮雕地圖，由零碎來源重建而成，被認爲準確到足以複製進圖書館檔案。三位學識大師對兩處山谷意見不一；你兩處都判斷對了。
The pilots of the Gulf know every cove and shoal after dark. We carry cargo that others cannot find their own way to.
海灣的領航員，天黑也認得每處小灣和淺灘。有些貨，別人自己找不到路去送，我們能送。
The plain's finest guardian. +12% battle renown gain.
平原最出色的守護者。+12%戰鬥聲望獲取。
The plains hold no secrets from you. +8% party spotting range.
平原對你沒有祕密。+8% 部隊偵察範圍。
The plains need warriors who won't be silenced.
平原需要不肯閉嘴的戰士。
The plains taught me more than any hall of warriors ever could...
平原教會我的，比任何戰士廳堂都多……
The player switcher could not start and is disabled for this session.
角色切換功能無法啓動，本次遊戲中已停用。

The poison was fast-acting and the shaman said there was nothing to be done. You remembered a different teaching — a preparation from the cold steppe plants that worked against this type of wound. You prepared it, applied it, and sat through the night. The chieftain recovered. He gave you a place at his council.
毒發得很快，薩滿說已經無能爲力。你記起另一種教法：用寒冷草原植物製成的配方，能對付這類傷口。你調製、敷用，並守了一整夜。酋長康復了，還給了你議事席位。
The pony's strength becomes your own. +7 health.
矮馬的力量也成了你的力量。+7 生命值。

The post covered both approaches and could not be left unmanned. You kept the full vigil yourself through a cold night and a half a day's shift without rest, reporting three incidents that the relief watch found exactly as you described them.
這個哨位覆蓋兩條通路，不能無人駐守。你獨自熬過寒夜和半個白班，沒有休息，並報告了三處情況；接替守望者後來發現，一切都和你說的一樣。
The power to create from nothing? Impressive indeed.
從無到有創造事物的力量？確實令人佩服。

The previous courier had been bleeding supply convoys for months through bad routing and worse deals. You cut the dead weight, renegotiated the toll agreements, and doubled throughput inside a season. The overseers rewarded you with a better cut and a worse conscience.
前任信使因爲糟糕路線和更糟的交易，已經讓補給車隊流血數月。你砍掉累贅，重新談判過路協議，一個季節內就讓吞吐量翻倍。監工給了你更高分成，也給了你更沉重的良心。
The prey can never escape your mark. Marked Prey charge cost -30.
獵物永遠逃不出你的標記。標記獵物充能消耗 -30。

The price of Dwarvish iron at the Grey Havens had not been revised in a lifetime of Men. You assembled the facts and put the case to the Elves of Lindon with such clarity that the agreement was rewritten within the month, and King Farin's treasurer learned your name.
以人類的壽命算，灰港的矮人鐵料價格已經一輩子沒調整過了。你整理事實，把道理向林頓精靈講得清清楚楚，一個月內就改訂了協議，法林王的財務官也記住了你的名字。

The price of buying a claim on a title, as a percentage of its price in realms_titles.xml (40 for a Barony up to 500 for a Kingdom, in your people's own resource). AI lords pay for theirs in gold, at the same percentage. Between 10 and 500. Default: 100.
購買頭銜宣稱的費用，按realms_titles.xml中價格的百分比計算。基礎費用從男爵領的40到王國的500不等，使用所屬民族的專屬資源。AI領主使用金幣支付，採用相同百分比。範圍：10至500。默認：100。
The price of good leather has climbed beyond all reason, and my craft dies for want of it. Bring me some at an honest cost and I will remember it.
好皮革的價格漲得太離譜了，再弄不到，我的生意就要做不下去了。按公道的價錢給我帶一些來，我會記住你的幫助。
The quartermaster has kit for your new rank.
軍需官已經爲你的新軍銜準備好裝備。
The quartermaster has nothing in his stores for your company.
軍需官的庫存裏沒有適合你這支隊伍的裝備。
The quartermaster is short on supplies and needs a hand sorting it out.
軍需官的物資不夠了，需要有人幫忙解決。
The quartermaster takes back your service kit: {COUNT} item(s).
軍需官收回了配發給你的裝備，共{COUNT}件。
The quartermaster wants every soldier's kit checked before the muster.
軍需官要求在集結前檢查每一名士兵的裝備。
The quartermasters of Cameth Brin keep the grain and the wall-works, and we answer for every hard sum the tower demands. Few in the town thank us for it.
卡梅斯布林的軍需官管糧食，也管城牆修繕。爲了守住高塔，那些難算的賬都得我們負責，鎮上卻沒幾個人謝我們。
The quartermasters of Fornost Erain keep the grain and the siege works, and we answer for every hard sum the walls demand. Few in the capital thank us for it.
佛諾斯特·埃萊因的軍需官管糧食，也管攻城工事。爲了守住城牆，那些難算的賬都得我們負責，都城卻沒幾個人謝我們。
The quartermasters of Tharbad keep the wharves and the granaries, and we answer for every hard sum the river gate demands. Merchants seldom thank us for it.
沙巴德的軍需官管碼頭和糧倉。河門開不開，那些難算的賬都得我們負責，商人卻很少謝我們。
The rage burns longer in your breast. Savage Rush duration +4s.
怒火在你胸中燃燒得更久。蠻勇突襲持續時間 +4 秒。
The rage needs little provocation. Savage Rush charge cost -30.
這股怒火不需要多少挑釁就會爆發。蠻勇突襲充能消耗 -30。
The rage of your ancestors flows through you. Savage Rush radius +3.
先祖的怒火在你體內流淌。蠻勇突襲作用範圍 +3。

The raiders had timed their strike for the harvest period when the farmsteads were exposed. You had anticipated the possibility, organized the local levies in advance, and met them at the valley entrance. The raid broke on the spear-line before it reached a single farmstead.
劫掠者把襲擊選在農莊暴露的收穫期。你提前想到這種可能，先組織好當地徵召兵，並在山谷入口迎上他們。劫掠還沒碰到任何農莊，就撞碎在長矛陣線上。
The raiders had timed their strike for the harvest, when the farmsteads lay open. You gathered the levy, met them on foot at the stream-crossing and held them there until the riders came.
劫掠者專挑收穫季節發動襲擊，那時農莊缺少防備。你召集徵召兵，在溪流渡口徒步迎敵，把他們擋在那裏，直到騎兵趕到。
The rain of arrows does not abate. Light Fletching duration +2s.
箭雨不會停歇。輕羽箭持續時間 +2 秒。
The rangers who ward the hamlets of Ettendale swear to keep their roofs from burning. Duty calls us away as often as it keeps us home.
守護埃滕谷小村的遊民，都發誓不讓村民的屋頂燒起來。可職責讓我們留守家鄉，也同樣常把我們召去遠方。
The rangers who ward the villages of Bree-land swear to keep their roofs from burning. Duty calls us north as often as it keeps us home.
守護布理鄉村莊的遊民，都發誓不讓村民的屋頂燒起來。可職責讓我們留守家鄉，也同樣常把我們召去北方。
The rangers who ward the villages of Cardolan swear to keep their roofs from burning. Duty calls us away as often as it keeps us home.
守護卡多藍村莊的遊民，都發誓不讓村民的屋頂燒起來。可職責讓我們留守家鄉，也同樣常把我們召去遠方。
The realm wastes half its strength ignoring women warriors.
不肯用女戰士，王國就白白浪費了一半力量。
The realms of Men and Elf alike have been crushed. Long live Sauron!
人類與精靈的國度都已覆滅。索隆萬歲！

The recruits were the worst draft Isengard had seen — underfed, undisciplined, and convinced of their own worthlessness. After twelve weeks under your instruction they held the line in a training exercise that the Uruk-hai observers called adequate. Coming from them, that was high praise.
那批新兵是艾森加德見過最糟的徵召：喫不飽、沒紀律，還確信自己一無是處。經過你十二週訓練，他們在演習中守住陣線，烏魯克觀察員評價爲合格。出自他們之口，這已經是很高的稱讚。
The refuge is dismantled; its garrison and stores return to your party.
避難所已拆除，駐軍和物資已歸入你的部隊。
The refuge is raised. It stands as your forward base; manage it to deposit troops.
避難所已建成，可以作爲你的前進基地。進入管理界面即可安排士兵駐守。
The refuge is still being raised.

The riders had taken the clan's breeding stock before anyone raised the alarm. You assembled six men, tracked the party through the night, caught them at the Isen ford, and brought the cattle back before morning. The chief added your name to the stronghold's stone.
騎手在警報響起前偷走了氏族種牛。你召集六個人，連夜追蹤，在艾森河渡口趕上他們，並在天亮前把牛帶回。酋長把你的名字刻進了堡壘石上。
The riders of Rhûn are satisfied. Go west, and say the grass was kind to you.[ib:closed][rf:convo_bemused]
魯恩騎兵滿意了。往西走吧，就說這片草原待你不薄。[ib:closed][rf:convo_bemused]
The riders of Wainwatch hold the eastern plains against every raid, and we carry the old kings' pride into every charge. Some of us ride on alone.
戰車哨站的騎兵在東部平原抵擋每一次劫掠，每次衝鋒都帶着昔日諸王的驕傲。我們有些人，如今獨自騎行。
The riders of the Wainwatch frontier learn war without mercy. Not all of us can live with what we learn.
戰車哨站邊境的騎兵，學的是不留情的打法。可我們不是人人都能跟學來的這些東西過一輩子。
The ring of hammer on steel is the music I was born to play...
錘子敲在鋼上的聲音，是我天生該演奏的音樂……

The rival had been blocking your advancement for two years through bribes and better connections. You identified what he valued, arranged for the right objects to be in the wrong place at the wrong time, and made the discovery at the right moment. You had his position before the month was out.
那個對手靠賄賂和更好的關係擋了你兩年晉升。你弄清他重視什麼，把正確物件安排到錯誤地方，再在正確時機完成發現。月底之前，他的位置已經是你的。

The rival tribe had prospered for years through unfavorable toll agreements imposed on your trade routes. You studied their caravan schedules for a season, chose the right moment in the deep desert, and took back what had been taken. Your tribe considered it justice; the rival tribe called it something else.
敵對部族多年靠對你們商路強加不利通行費而興旺。你研究他們商隊時間表一個季節，在深沙漠中選準時機，把被拿走的東西奪了回來。你的部族認爲這是正義，對方則另有說法。
The river holds no fear for you. +5% movement speed.
這條河嚇不倒你。+5% 移動速度。
The river's control is vital to Gondor.
河流的控制權對剛鐸至關重要。
The road from Dale to the lake is longer than it looks, friend.
朋友，從河谷城到湖邊的路，比看起來長得多。
The road from Vineholm to Redwater is longer than it looks, friend.
朋友，從葡萄洲到紅水的路，比看起來長得多。
The road from the Old Ford to the Carrock is longer than it looks, friend.
朋友，從老渡口到卡爾巖的路，比看起來長得多。

The road had been effectively closed for two seasons by spider and Orc harassment. You mapped the safest remaining corridors, negotiated guard arrangements with Thranduil's captain, and led the first merchant convoy through to success. Trade resumed within the month.
這條路因蜘蛛和奧克騷擾，實際上已關閉兩個季節。你繪出剩餘最安全通道，與瑟蘭杜伊的隊長談妥護衛安排，並帶領第一支商隊成功通過。一個月內貿易便恢復了。
The road is quiet behind you, and stays quiet.
你經過後，道路恢復了平靜，也一直沒有再出亂子。
The roof fell on your crew because you were stubborn.
就是你不肯讓步，才讓工友被塌下來的石頭壓住。
The same precision that guides my art guides my blade. A master craftsman must defend their works. Besides, one who can create such beauty knows exactly how to unmake one's enemies. Shall I join you?
指引我創作的精準，同樣也指引我的劍。大匠必須守護自己的作品。更何況，懂得創造美的人，也最清楚該如何拆解敵人。要我加入你嗎？

The scouts had been taken deep in the corrupted southern wood where the patrols would not go. You went alone at night, cut them free, and led them out through three spider-guarded paths. Two of them asked how you knew the way. You told them it was instinct.
斥候被帶到腐化南方森林深處，巡邏隊不會去那裏。你夜裏獨自前往，割開蛛網，把他們帶出三條有蜘蛛守衛的道路。其中兩人問你怎麼知道路。你說那是直覺。
The sea takes more than ponies.
大海拿走的，可不止小馬。
The sea-watch archers of the Falathrim guard the coast and the foothills. We are trained to shoot true and to hold the line.
法拉斯民的海防弓手，守着海岸和山麓。我們練的不只是射準，還得守住陣線。
The selected companies hold the line: shielded foot soldiers in a shield wall, circle or square stop attacking until you press Hold the Line again or order a charge.
所選編隊開始維持陣線：盾牆、圓陣或方陣中的持盾步兵停止攻擊，直到你再次按下“維持陣線”或下達衝鋒命令。
The sergeant needs someone to walk the night rounds before the watch changes.
軍士需要有人在換崗前完成夜間巡邏。
軍士們對你的表現做了評價：{GRADE}。
The servants of Dol Guldur march to {settlement}!
多古爾都的僕從向{settlement}進軍！

The settlement's supply line had been cut and the tools were failing. You assessed what could be recovered, salvaged the best material from broken pieces, and reforged it into working equipment. Three Rangers asked for your work over new supply when the line reopened.
聚落補給線被切斷，工具也在損壞。你評估哪些還能回收，從破損物件中取出最好的材料，重新鍛成可用裝備。補給線恢復後，仍有三名遊俠寧願要你的作品，不要新貨。
The shadow cavalry's deeds are legendary. +14% battle renown gain.
暗影騎兵的功績已成傳說。+14% 戰鬥聲望獲取。
The shadow clings to you longer. Sneak-Creeping duration +2s.
陰影會更久地纏繞在你身邊。潛行突進持續時間 +2 秒。
The shadow has been hard on us, traveller. Rats and a bitter winter took our seed-corn. Without grain to sow, we will not last the year.
旅人，黑暗籠罩下的日子可不好過。鼠患和嚴冬毀掉了我們的糧種。沒有糧食播種，我們就撐不過這一年。
The shadow is appeased. +{influence} influence, +{relation} relation.
陰影得到了安撫。影響力+{influence}，關係+{relation}。
The shadow of the south of Mirkwood at the border
黑森林南方的陰影逼近邊境
The shield-maidens of old knew no fear, neither should I...
古時的盾女不知恐懼，我也不該害怕……
The shop is closed during a wave.
敵軍進攻期間，商店不開放。
The siege drags on: every tower and keep now weakens by the minute.
戰鬥拖延太久，所有防禦塔和主堡都會每分鐘繼續衰弱。
The slaughter order always leaves this many head of each livestock type alive. The game itself still slaughters livestock when every other food is gone. Between 0 and 20. Default: 2.
宰殺指令始終爲每種牲畜保留此數量。其他食物耗盡時，遊戲自身仍會宰殺牲畜。範圍：0至20。默認：2。

The slave pits at the Front Porch had a ring, and I ruled it for four winters. Dwarf captives, men, a Beorning cub once, I broke them all while the crowd screamed. The Great Goblin's own sons put bones on me.
前門廊的奴隸坑裏有個鬥場，我在那裏稱霸了四個冬天。矮人俘虜、人類，還有一次是個貝奧恩小崽子，都被我打垮了，觀衆叫得震天響。半獸人王的兒子也拿骨頭押我贏。
The slave pits were mine, in a way. I kept the tally, the chains, the price of a dwarf, of a Rohirric farm-girl, of a Beorning cub. The Great Goblin paid me a tenth. He is generous, as spiders are.
奴隸坑也算歸我管。我記人數、管鎖鏈，知道一個矮人、一個洛汗農家姑娘、一個貝奧恩小崽子各值多少。半獸人王給我一成抽傭，他跟蜘蛛一樣慷慨。
The smashing continues. Hammer Down duration +2s.
破壞還會繼續。重錘壓頂持續時間 +2 秒。
The smith of {ISSUE_SETTLEMENT} has run dry of iron and cannot mend tool nor blade.
{ISSUE_SETTLEMENT}的鐵匠耗盡了鐵料，沒法修理工具和刀劍。
The smiths of Forlindon work the iron that comes down from the Blue Mountains. We make good blades, and we ask what they are for.
佛林頓的鐵匠，用藍色山脈運來的鐵打劍。我們造好劍，也會問，這劍拿來幹什麼。
The soldier who fires an ability, and a few of the kin who join him, shout in their own voice.
觸發能力的士兵，以及部分響應的同族士兵，會用自己的聲音喊叫。
The song of the Eotheod carries the riders onward. Warcry duration +2s.
伊奧希奧德的歌聲帶着騎手繼續向前。埃奧爾戰吼持續時間 +2 秒。
The song of the Northmen carries the riders onward. Warcry duration +2s.
北方人的歌聲引領騎手前進。戰吼持續時間+2秒。
The sons of Dale's old houses are raised to lead men and to ride out when the horns sound. Some of us find our commands elsewhere.
河谷城古老家族的子弟，從小就學帶兵，號角一響便跨馬出征。我們有些人得去別處找帶兵的差事。
The sons of Dorwinion's old vintner houses are raised to lead men and to ride out when the horns sound. Some of us find our commands elsewhere.
多溫尼安古老釀酒家族的子弟，從小就學帶兵，號角一響便跨馬出征。我們有些人得去別處找帶兵的差事。
The sons of the old Vale houses are raised to lead men and to ride out when the horns sound. Some of us find our commands elsewhere.
河谷古老家族的子弟，從小就學帶兵，號角一響便跨馬出征。我們有些人得去別處找帶兵的差事。
The sons of the old Woodmen houses are raised to lead men and to ride out when the horns sound. Some of us find our commands elsewhere.
林中居民古老家族的子弟，從小就學帶兵，號角一響便跨馬出征。我們有些人得去別處找帶兵的差事。

The southern clan had iron but no smiths. Blue Craig had tinkerers but needed food and furs. You brokered the first exchange, set the terms, and kept both sides from killing each other long enough for the deal to become habit. The warchief gave you a percentage.
南方氏族有鐵料，卻沒有鐵匠；藍巖有工匠，卻缺少糧食和皮毛。你促成了第一筆交易，定下條件，還讓雙方暫時放下了廝殺，直到交易成了常事。戰酋也分給了你一份利潤。

The southern clan had iron but no smiths. Goblin-town had tinkerers but needed food and furs. You brokered the first exchange, set the terms, and kept both sides from killing each other long enough for the deal to become habit. The warchief gave you a percentage.
南方氏族有鐵料，卻沒有鐵匠；半獸人鎮有工匠，卻缺少糧食和皮毛。你促成了第一筆交易，定下條件，還讓雙方暫時放下了廝殺，直到交易成了常事。戰酋也分給了你一份利潤。

The southern clan had iron but no smiths. Gundabad had smiths but needed food and furs. You brokered the first exchange, set the terms, and kept both sides from killing each other long enough for the deal to become habit. The warchief gave you a percentage.
南方氏族有鐵卻沒有鐵匠，貢達巴德有鐵匠卻需要食物和毛皮。你促成第一批交換，定下條款，並讓雙方在足夠長時間裏沒有互相砍死，使交易變成習慣。戰酋分給了你一成。

The southern clan had iron but no smiths. Moria had smiths but needed food and furs. You brokered the first exchange, set the terms, and kept both sides from killing each other long enough for the deal to become habit. The warchief gave you a percentage.
南方氏族有鐵料，卻沒有鐵匠；墨瑞亞有鐵匠，卻缺少糧食和皮毛。你促成了第一筆交易，定下條件，還讓雙方暫時放下了廝殺，直到交易成了常事。戰酋也分給了你一份利潤。

The southern of Arnor's three successor kingdoms. Its kings lie in the barrows of Tyrn Gorthad and its riders keep the plains between the Baranduin and the Greyflood. It stands apart from the War of the Ring, but Dunland, the goblins and the orcs of the mountains test its few towns every year.
阿爾諾分裂後的三個王國中，最南邊的一個。歷代國王長眠於提殞戈沙德的古冢，騎兵守護着巴蘭都因河與灰水河之間的平原。它沒有捲入魔戒大戰，但黑蠻地人、半獸人和山中的奧克每年都會侵擾它爲數不多的城鎮。

The southern of the three realms into which Arnor was sundered. Its kings lie in the barrows of Tyrn Gorthad and its riders keep the plains between the Baranduin and the Greyflood, but its towns are few and its lords contend with Arthedain and Rhudaur for the crown of Arnor.
阿爾諾分裂出的三個王國中，卡多藍位於南方。歷代國王長眠於提殞戈沙德的古冢，騎兵守衛着巴蘭都因河與灰水河之間的平原。這裏城鎮稀少，領主們仍與阿塞丹、魯道爾爭奪阿爾諾的王冠。
The spearmen of Sarn Ford are first into the water and last to hear an order. Most of us have paid for it at least once.
薩恩渡口的矛手，第一個下水，最後一個聽見命令。我們大多數至少爲此受過一次罰。
The spearmen of the Egladil watch are first over the ditch and last to hear an order. Most of us have been punished for it at least once.
埃格拉迪爾守衛隊的矛手，第一個越過壕溝，最後一個聽見命令。我們大多數至少爲此受過一次罰。
The spearmen of the Emyn Beraid watch are first over the ditch and last to hear an order. Most of us have been punished for it at least once.
埃敏貝萊德守衛隊的矛手，第一個越過壕溝，最後一個聽見命令。我們大多數至少爲此受過一次罰。
The spearmen of the Woodmen hold the Emyn Duir road beside the Wardens, and the work there is not gentle. We learn it, and we do not forget it.
林中居民的矛手跟守望者一起守着埃敏杜伊爾大道，那裏的差事可不溫和。我們學會了，也就忘不了。

The spy had been in the city for two years, passing information to the clans about Rohirrim garrison strengths. You noticed the pattern in what went wrong on raids where only a few people had been told the details. Three conversations later you had the name and the method of transfer.
那名間諜在城裏潛伏兩年，把洛希爾守軍實力情報傳給氏族。你從幾次只有少數人知情的劫掠爲何出錯中看出規律。三次談話後，你知道了名字，也知道了傳遞方式。
The spy had been in the town for two years, passing word of the herds and the garrison to the east. You watched him until you knew the pattern, and delivered him to the king's wardens.
這名間諜在城裏待了兩年，一直把馬羣與駐軍的消息送往東方。你盯着他，直到摸清他的活動規律，再把他交給國王手下的守衛。
The steppe breeds hard riders, and the Ezarkia hardest of all. Ask, and I will tell you how I came to ride alone.
草原會養出強悍的騎手，而埃扎基亞氏族又是其中最硬的。你問吧，我會告訴你自己爲什麼會獨自上路。

The steward Aldwulf came with tax collectors, demanding twice our usual tribute. When I protested, he accused me of hoarding wealth while the King's treasury ran thin. He had documents, forged but convincing, showing I'd traded with the Wainriders.
總管阿爾德伍爾夫帶着稅吏上門，索要平時兩倍的貢賦。我提出異議，他就指控我在國庫空虛時私藏財富。他拿出一批文書，雖是僞造，卻做得像真的，聲稱我跟戰車民做過買賣。
The stores and the market here do not hold enough.
現有儲備加上本地集市的存貨也不夠。
The stores are in my keeping. What would you have me do?
物資都由我保管，有什麼吩咐？
The stores are thin tonight and there isn't enough to go around.
今晚存糧不多，已經不夠大家分了。
The stores do not hold enough, and there is no market here to buy the rest.
現有儲備不足，這裏也沒有集市可以買齊剩下的。
The strongest warriors sometimes outgrow their masters...
最強的戰士，有時會強到不再適合服從主人……
The stronghold is complete; its walls and garrison stand stronger.
堡壘已建成，城牆更加堅固，駐軍的防禦也更強了。
The sun smiles on you today. Go in peace, and tell others the southern road has keepers.[ib:closed][rf:convo_bemused]
今天太陽照顧你。平安走吧，也告訴別人，南方這條路是有人看着的。[ib:closed][rf:convo_bemused]
The supply caravan could not be assembled.

The supply fleet was three hours out when you noticed the way the coastal birds were behaving around a particular headland. You called for a halt, went ahead in a small craft, and found a Gondorian squadron waiting in the calm water behind it. The fleet turned back. The admiral gave you the next command.
補給艦隊離港三小時時，你注意到某處岬角附近海鳥的異常行爲。你下令停船，乘小船先行偵察，在岬角後方平靜水面中發現一支剛鐸分艦隊。艦隊返航，海軍上將把下一次指揮權交給了你。
The supply screen failed to open (see log). Returning to the map.
補給界面打開失敗（請查看日誌）。正在返回地圖。
The swan ships sail less often now, and corsairs grow bold...
如今天鵝船已經不怎麼出海了，海盜們的膽子也越來越大了……

The teeming goblin-warrens beneath the High Pass of the Misty Mountains. Since the fall of the Great Goblin the tribes have multiplied without number — vast, ill-armed swarms that win by sheer weight and breed faster than any foe can cull them. They run swiftest over the snows of their mountain home, but such hordes are ever ravenous.
這裏是迷霧山脈高隘口下方擠滿半獸人的地穴。半獸人王死後，各部族不斷繁衍，如今已經多得數不清。他們裝備簡陋，卻能靠數量壓倒敵人，繁衍的速度更是讓敵人殺不勝殺。他們在家鄉的山間雪地上跑得飛快，但如此龐大的羣體也總是缺喫少糧。

The terms on Erebor's iron exports had not been renegotiated since the Mountain's reclamation. You identified the imbalance, assembled the facts, and presented the case to King Dain's steward with such clarity that the agreement was revised within the month.
孤山鐵器出口條款自山中王國收復以來就沒重新談過。你看出其中失衡，整理事實，並清楚地向鐵足戴因的管家陳述理由，一個月內協議便完成修訂。
The themed, layered banner editor, both during character creation and in a running campaign. Takes effect the next time it opens.
在創建角色和戰役進行期間，使用帶主題樣式和圖層的旗幟編輯器。下次打開編輯器時生效。

The three chiefs had not spoken in a generation, and the Rohirrim were counting on their division. You rode between camps for a week, said the right things to the right people in the right order, and on the day of the expedition's arrival, three clans stood together on the ridge. The Rohirrim turned back.
三位酋長已經一代人不說話，洛希爾人也正指望他們繼續分裂。你在各營地間奔走一週，按正確順序對正確的人說了正確的話。遠征隊到來那天，三個氏族一同站在山脊上。洛希爾人退了回去。
The thunder rolls on. Warcry of Eorl duration +4s.
雷鳴般的戰吼久久不息。埃奧爾戰吼持續時間 +4 秒。
The thunder rolls on. Warcry of Vidugard duration +4s.
雷鳴滾滾不息。維杜加德戰吼持續時間+4秒。
The title alone: its lands stay with their lords.
僅授予頭銜：土地仍歸原領主所有。
The tournament master offers a choice of prizes. Choose the one you will fight for; it is yours if you win.
競技大會主持人提供了幾種獎品。選擇你想爭取的那一件；贏得比賽後，它就歸你。
本次競技大會鍛鍊了你的{SKILL_NAME}。

The tournament was fought across three brutal rounds in the main hall. You came in as no one's favourite and left with a warchief's silver arm-ring and a better bunk. The other competitors respected you more for winning than they had for anything before.
比武在主廳中進行了三輪殘酷較量。你入場時沒人看好，離開時卻戴着戰酋賜予的銀臂環，還換到更好的鋪位。其他競爭者終於比以往任何時候都更尊重你，因爲你贏了。
The tower at Cameth Brin stands because someone counted every stone and every mouth...
卡梅斯布林的高塔還立着，是因爲有人數清每塊石頭、每張嘴……

The trade routes are compromised, but the guild won't listen. I take my knowledge freelance now, which paths are safe, which merchants are honest, where the shadows gather. War and trade will mix soon enough, and those prepared will profit... or at least survive.
商路已經被滲透，但行會不肯聽。如今我把自己的知識拿出來單幹：哪些路安全，哪些商人誠實，陰影在哪裏聚集。戰爭和貿易很快就會攪在一起，準備好的人會獲利……至少能活下來。

The traveller had taken a Morgul-tainted wound and the senior healers were already preparing their regrets. You had read a different account of the toxin's behavior in the library's older texts. You applied what you had read and the traveller recovered.
那名旅人受了帶有魔古爾污染的傷，高階醫者已準備表示遺憾。你曾在圖書館更古老的文本中讀到過這種毒素的另一種變化。你照着所讀方法處理，旅人活了下來。
The truth is worth any price.
真相值得付出任何代價。

The truth remains whether they believe it or not. Dark forces gather intelligence on Erebor's defenses, and I know who helps them. Out here, my skills and knowledge serve those who value truth over comfortable lies. My crossbow and keen eyes seek honest employment.
真相不會因爲他們不信就消失。黑暗勢力正在收集孤山防禦的情報，而我知道誰在幫他們。在外面，我的本事和知識會服務於那些重視真相、勝過舒適謊言的人。我的弩和敏銳眼睛，只尋找誠實的僱主。

The unexpected often proves the most valuable. My southern eyes see angles others miss, my desert heritage brings different perspectives to northern lands. Perhaps being lost was just the beginning of being found. May I travel with you?
出乎意料的東西，往往最有價值。我的南方眼光能看見別人錯過的角度，沙漠出身也讓我能以不同方式看待北方土地。也許迷失只是被找回的開始。我可以與你同行嗎？

The unnatural cold and the stillness of the birds were the first signs. You reported what you felt to the Galadhrim command before anyone else had noticed. The Lady's power moved to reinforce the borders. Afterward, Celeborn said your instincts were unusually sharp.
不自然的寒意和鳥羣的靜默是最早跡象。你在其他人察覺前，把自己的感受報告給加拉茲民指揮。夫人的力量隨後加強了邊界。事後，凱勒博恩說你的直覺異常敏銳。
The unseen hand protects you. +10% resistance to melee.
看不見的手會護住你。+10% 近戰抗性。
