戰羣衝鋒提供 +10% 坐騎衝鋒傷害，並使敵軍陣線陷入混亂。
Warrior blood seeks war, nature's own truth.
戰士之血追尋戰爭，這是天性。
Warrior who refused to tolerate cowardly leadership.
拒絕忍受懦弱領導的戰士。
Warriors bred for battle sometimes clash with the hierarchy...
爲戰鬥培育出的戰士，有時會撞上等級制度……
警惕的多古爾都囤貨者
警惕的貢達巴德囤貨者
警惕的艾森加德囤貨商
Watch of the Sea of Rhûn
Watch-tales bring rumor. A sensible elder waits for proof.
哨兵帶來的不過是傳言。明智的長老會等證據。
Watched the walls of Harad's desert cities.
守望哈拉德沙漠城市城牆。
Waunfawr lies on a wide moor near Lhanuch. Its flocks give the coarse grey wool that Dunlending weavers make into cloaks against the mountain rain.
瓦恩瓦爾位於蘭努赫附近的一片遼闊荒原。羊羣提供粗糙的灰色羊毛，黑蠻地織工用它織成披風，遮擋山中的雨水。
We are at war with your realm. I will tell you nothing of our roads.
我們正與你的國家交戰，不會告訴你任何道路消息。
We are beset by enemies, traveller.
我們正遭到敵人的圍攻，旅人。
We are only herders of the eastern grass, traveller, driving our horses to a fair. No threat to you.
我們只是東部草原上的牧人，過路的，正趕着馬去集市，不會威脅你。
We are only shepherds out of the hills, stranger, nothing worth your sword.
我們只是山裏出來的牧羊人，外鄉人，沒必要衝我們動刀。
We are {PERCENTAGE}% stronger than our enemies!
We carry the light of ages past into these darkening times. From Rivendell's libraries to its training grounds, I've mastered both lore and blade.
我們把久遠年代的光帶進如今漸暗的時代。從幽谷的藏書室到訓練場，我既鑽研學識，也磨鍊劍術。

We caught a band of Dunlendings rustling cattle. My captain ordered them all killed - men, women, children. I obeyed, but one boy reminded me of my own son. After that night, I couldn't stop seeing his face.
我們抓到一夥偷牛的黑蠻地人。隊長下令全殺掉，男人、女人、孩子。我服從了，但有個男孩讓我想起自己的兒子。那一夜之後，我再也無法停止看見他的臉。

We caught a band of raiders stealing horses. My captain ordered them all killed, men, women, children. I obeyed, but one boy reminded me of my own son. After that night, I couldn't stop seeing his face.
我們逮住一夥偷馬的劫掠者，隊長命令全殺了，男人、女人、孩子，一個不留。我照辦了，可有個男孩讓我想起自己的兒子。那晚以後，他的臉就一直在我眼前。

We discovered barges moving upriver by night, bearing no banners. When we investigated, they carried weapons and supplies - but fled when challenged. My admiral ordered me to ignore such vessels, saying they were 'approved traffic.'
我們發現夜間有駁船逆流而上，船上沒有任何旗幟。調查時發現它們裝載着武器和補給品——但在受到盤問時逃走了。上級命令我無視這類船隻，稱其爲“經批准的運輸”。
We dug deeper for a better seam of iron. Something in the dark answered with a drumbeat and then with fire. The tunnel crew went in, and I held the door shut with a hammer while they screamed.
爲了更好的鐵礦脈，我們往深處挖。黑暗裏有東西回應了我們，先是鼓聲，接着是火。挖地道的那幫傢伙進去了，我用錘子頂住門，聽着他們在裏頭慘叫。

We held, but I was seen fighting. The village elders said I brought shame, that women who took up arms invited chaos. They demanded I marry immediately or leave. My father, fearing scandal, sided with them.
我們守住了，但我作戰的事被人看見。村中長者說我帶來羞恥，說女人拿起武器只會招來混亂。他們要求我立刻嫁人，否則就離開。父親害怕醜聞，站到了他們那邊。
我方控制了一個佔領點。
我方失去了一座防禦塔。

We took a band of Easterling raiders who had burned three farms, and I put the prisoners down rather than march them for days to the stocks. My captain called it murder. The dwarves said nothing, which I took for agreement.
我們抓到一夥燒了三處農莊的東夷劫掠者。我不願押着他們走幾天去上枷，就把俘虜殺了。隊長說這是謀殺。矮人什麼也沒說，我就當他們贊同。

We took a band of Easterling raiders who had burned three vineyards, and I put the prisoners down rather than march them for days to the stocks. My captain called it murder. The old wardens said nothing, which I took for agreement.
我們抓到一夥燒了三座葡萄園的東夷劫掠者。我不願押着他們走幾天去上枷，就把俘虜殺了。隊長說這是謀殺。老守望者什麼也沒說，我就當他們贊同。

We took a band of raiders in the pay of Dol Guldur who had burned three farms, and I put the prisoners down rather than march them for days to the stocks. My captain called it murder. The Wardens said nothing, which I took for agreement.
我們抓到一夥受僱於多古爾都、燒了三處農莊的劫掠者。我不願押着他們走幾天去上枷，就把俘虜殺了。隊長說這是謀殺。守望者什麼也沒說，我就當他們贊同。

We took back most of the horses and every child, but two farmhands did not return, and the village is a burned ring of posts. I sold the herd to pay the dead men's families. A rider's hands are all I have left.
我們搶回大部分馬，也救回了所有孩子，可兩個農工再沒回來，村子也只剩一圈燒焦的柱子。我賣了馬羣，把錢賠給死者的家屬。現在我只剩這雙騎馬的手。

We went up to the Carrock after a Beorning. I ran at him alone, and he was not a man but a bear the size of a wagon. The warband stood on the rocks and watched. He broke my shoulder and my pride, and not one of them came down.
我們去卡爾巖追一個貝奧恩人。我獨自衝向他，可他不是人，是頭大車那麼大的熊。戰團的傢伙站在石頭上看着。他打斷了我的肩膀，也打掉了我的傲氣，沒一個傢伙肯下來幫我。
Weak foot soldiers, and few riders.
Weaker troops than Men or Elves

Weapons you locked in the inventory no longer appear in the smithy's smelting list, so they cannot be smelted by accident. Unlock one in the inventory to smelt it. A weapon you lock inside the smithy leaves the list at your next smelt or tab switch. No restart. Default: on.
在物品欄鎖定的武器，不再出現在鐵匠鋪的熔煉列表中，以免誤熔煉。需要熔煉時，先在物品欄解鎖。在鐵匠鋪內鎖定的武器，會在下次熔煉或切換頁籤時移出列表。無需重啓。默認：開啓。
飽經風霜的巴德一族地主
飽經風霜的貝奧恩族地主
飽經風霜的多溫尼安地主
飽經風霜的可汗德地主
飽經風霜的羅瓦尼安地主
飽經風霜的洛希爾地主
飽經風霜的林中居民地主
夾在洛汗和艾森加德之間
Weighted party size: elite units consume more party capacity. Elites 2x, level 41+ elites 3x, warg riders 2x, cave trolls 4x, mumakil 10x.
按兵種權重計算部隊容量：精銳士兵佔用更多名額。精銳爲2倍，41級及以上精銳爲3倍，座狼騎兵爲2倍，洞穴食人妖爲4倍，猛獁爲10倍。
Welcome to the column, soldier. Fall in.
Well met, stranger of the long road. We have walked long between wells, and you look well supplied. Your silver and your waterskins, or we take everything you own.
趕了這麼遠的路，能遇到也是緣分，外鄉人。我們從上一個水井走了很久，看你倒是補給充足。交出銀子和水袋，不然就把你的一切都拿來。
Westmark archers are the finest on the plain. +5 health.
西境射手是平原上最優秀的弓手。生命值+5。
Westmark's warriors are tempered by proximity to Mirkwood. +6 health.
西境戰士在緊鄰黑森林的環境中經受磨鍊。生命值+6。
What do you have for me?
What others dream, I make reality. I dive deep into the very fabric of creation, weaving features from pure logic and determination.
別人只會做夢，而我讓夢成真。我深入創造本身的織理，用純粹的邏輯和決心編出一個個功能。
What she-orc craves a rat-stinking mate?
哪個女奧克會想要一個滿身鼠臭的伴侶？
What should the men turn their hands to? Each task takes some hours and brings in goods when it is done.
讓士兵做些什麼？每項工作都要花幾個小時，完成後可獲得相應物資。
What would you have me bring?
What would you have me do?

When Arthedain called for help against a northern host, the council of the Havens weighed it and refused to send riders. I went anyway, without leave, and fought at the ford until we were overrun. I came home to a stern silence and a closed gate.
阿塞丹求援，抵抗北方大軍，灰港議會權衡之後，不肯派騎手。我沒獲准，還是去了，在渡口打到我們被擊潰。回家迎接我的，只有嚴厲的沉默和緊閉的大門。

When Dol Guldur's corruption crept into the southern forest and drove the settlers out, you volunteered to lead them north along the forest's edge. The route was not obvious and the pursuit came twice. All forty-three people you started with arrived at Esgaroth.
多古爾都的腐化蔓延進南部森林，把定居者趕了出來。你自願帶他們沿森林邊緣北上。路線並不明顯，追兵還來了兩次。出發時的四十三個人全都抵達了埃斯加洛斯。

When Easterling forces swept down from the north and pressed into the city streets, you were among the guard that held the central square while Brand directed the defence. You were the last one standing beside the king before the relief came through the eastern gate.
東夷大軍從北方席捲而下，壓入城中街道時，你是守住中央廣場的衛隊成員之一，而布蘭德在此指揮防禦。援軍從東門趕到前，你是最後仍站在國王身邊的人。
When I questioned these orders, Aldwulf marked me as 'unreliable.' I was reassigned to distant patrols, then dismissed entirely. I won't serve a puppet court while the real threats gather strength.
我質疑這些命令，阿爾德伍爾夫就把我列爲“不可靠”的人。他們先把我調去偏遠地方巡邏，後來乾脆開除。我不會在真正的威脅日漸壯大時，還給一個傀儡王廷效力。
When I questioned these orders, Wormtongue marked me as 'unreliable.' I was reassigned to distant patrols, then dismissed entirely. I won't serve a puppet king while the real threats gather strength.
我質疑這些命令時，格里馬·佞舌把我標成“不可靠”。我先被調去偏遠巡邏，後來徹底被解職。真正的威脅正在積蓄力量，我不會侍奉一個傀儡國王。

When I returned, certain counselors suggested I misunderstood the situation. They wanted the war but needed someone to blame. I resigned before they could make me their scapegoat. Now I seek honest dealings, rare as they are.
當我回來時，某些顧問暗示我誤解了情況。他們想要戰爭，但需要一個替罪羊。我在他們把我變成替罪羊之前辭職了。現在我尋求誠實的交易，儘管這世道已鮮有誠信可言。

When Mordor pressed hard across the river, you held your section of the bridge until the order to fall back was given. The captain commended your name to the Steward's herald, and the men of your company remembered what you did that day.
魔多強攻渡河時，你守住自己負責的橋段，直到撤退命令下達。隊長把你的名字報給宰相的傳令官，你的連隊也記住了你那天做過什麼。
When ON (default), AI lords also pay no morale for same-side prisoners, so allied factions absorb each other's captured troops more readily. When OFF, only you benefit (if 'Apply To Player' is on).
開啓時（默認），AI領主招募同陣營俘虜也不消耗士氣，使同盟勢力更容易吸收彼此被俘的士兵。關閉後，只有玩家受益，前提是“應用於玩家”已開啓。
When ON (default), AI lords are also blocked from recruiting in opposed-alignment settlements. When OFF, AI recruits freely (you are still gated if 'Apply To Player' is on).
開啓時（默認），AI領主也不能在立場對立的聚落招募。關閉後，AI可以自由招募；如果“應用於玩家”開啓，你仍受限制。
When ON (default), AI lords are blocked from marrying across the Free/Evil line. When OFF, AI marries freely (you are still gated if 'Apply To Player' is on).
默認開啓：AI 領主不能跨自由人民與邪惡陣營結婚。關閉後，AI 可以自由結婚；若“應用於玩家”開啓，你仍受限制。

When ON (default), AI lords look for a partner among compatible clans instead of drawing uniformly from every clan in the world. Vanilla's draw wastes the day whenever it lands on a blocked clan, which would make Free factions (Gondor, Rohan, Dale) marry far less often and run short of heirs. Turn OFF to keep the block but restore vanilla's draw.
默認開啓：AI 領主從陣營兼容的家族中尋找配偶，不再從全世界家族等概率抽取。原版若抽到被禁止的家族就會浪費當天的機會，使剛鐸、洛汗、河谷邦等自由人民勢力更少結婚、缺少繼承人。關閉後保留陣營限制，但恢復原版抽取方式。
When ON (default), AI lords' parties and garrisons also shed opposed-alignment troops. When OFF, only the player is affected (if 'Apply To Player' is on).
開啓時（默認），AI領主的部隊和駐軍也會失去立場對立的士兵。關閉後，只有玩家受影響，前提是“應用於玩家”已開啓。
When ON (default), AI lords' parties can also sail. When OFF, only the player sails and AI stays on land — the conservative option if AI naval routing looks odd.
開啓時（默認），AI領主的部隊也可以航行。關閉後，只有玩家可以航行，AI仍留在陸地上。若AI航線選擇表現異常，這是較保守的選項。

When ON (default), YOU are blocked from recruiting in opposed-alignment settlements. When OFF, you may recruit anyone regardless of alignment (AI lords are still gated if 'Apply To AI Lords' is on). The master 'Enable Recruitment Alignment Block' toggle off disables the whole feature for everyone.
開啓時（默認），你不能在立場對立的聚落招募。關閉後，你可以不受立場限制地招募任何人；如果“應用於AI領主”開啓，AI領主仍受限制。關閉“啓用招募立場限制”總開關，會對所有人停用此功能。
When ON (default), YOU pay no morale for same-side prisoners. When OFF, you pay the vanilla cost (AI lords still get the waiver if 'Apply To AI Lords' is on).
開啓時（默認），你招募同陣營俘虜不消耗士氣。關閉後，你需要支付原版的士氣消耗；如果“應用於AI領主”開啓，AI領主仍可獲得減免。

When ON (default), YOUR clan is also held to the rule — you and your siblings/children cannot marry across the Free/Evil line. When OFF, the player clan marries freely (AI lords are still gated if 'Apply To AI Lords' is on).
默認開啓：你的家族也受限制，你和兄弟姐妹、子女不能跨自由人民與邪惡陣營結婚。關閉後，玩家家族可以自由結婚；若“應用於 AI 領主”開啓，AI 仍受限制。
When ON (default), YOUR party and garrisons shed opposed-alignment troops. When OFF, you may keep mixed-alignment troops (AI is still affected if 'Apply To AI Lords' is on).
開啓時（默認），你的部隊和駐軍會失去立場對立的士兵。關閉後，你可以保留混合立場的士兵；如果“應用於AI領主”開啓，AI仍會受影響。
When ON (default), YOUR party can sail. When OFF, you stay land-bound (AI still sails if 'Apply To AI Lords' is on). The master 'Enable Naval Travel' toggle off disables sailing for everyone.
開啓時（默認），你的部隊可以航行。關閉後，你只能在陸地行進；如果“應用於AI領主”開啓，AI仍可航行。關閉“啓用水上航行”總開關，會對所有人禁用航行。
When ON (default), lords' field parties (including army members) shed opposed troops. When OFF, only garrisons are affected (if 'Apply To Garrisons' is on).
開啓時（默認），領主的野外部隊，包括加入軍團的部隊，會失去立場對立的士兵。關閉後，僅駐軍受影響，前提是“應用於駐軍”已開啓。
When ON (default), settlement garrisons shed opposed troops (e.g. a conquered fief's old-culture defenders leave). When OFF, only mobile parties are affected (if 'Apply To Mobile Parties' is on).
開啓時（默認），聚落駐軍會失去立場對立的士兵，例如被征服封地原有文化的守軍會離開。關閉後，僅移動部隊受影響，前提是“應用於移動部隊”已開啓。

When Saruman's forces pushed across the Isen, the Rohirrim line buckled at the center. You were among those who held the ford long enough for the retreat to become a withdrawal rather than a rout. The Marshal mentioned you in his account of the battle.
薩茹曼軍隊越過艾森河時，洛希爾陣線中央開始彎折。你是守住渡口的人之一，讓撤退變成有序後撤，而不是潰敗。元帥在戰鬥記錄中提到了你。

When a Dunlending envoy came under a white cloth to speak with the captain, I shot him from the barrow-top before he said a word. I judged that anything from that country carried a lie. The captain disowned me before the other rangers, for breaking a truce was not our way.
有個黑蠻地使者舉着白布，要來和隊長談話。他一句話還沒說，我就從古冢頂上一箭射死了他。我認定那地方來的東西，開口就是謊話。隊長當着其他遊民的面把我逐了出去，說破壞停戰不是我們的做法。

When a Gundabad envoy came under a white cloth to speak with the captain, I shot him from the rocks before he said a word. I judged that anything from that country carried a lie. The captain disowned me before the other rangers, for breaking a truce was not our way.
有個貢達巴德使者舉着白布，要來和隊長談話。他一句話還沒說，我就從岩石間一箭射死了他。我認定那地方來的東西，開口就是謊話。隊長當着其他遊民的面把我逐了出去，說破壞停戰不是我們的做法。

When a Gundabad warband hit our shield wall at dawn, I felt the ranks tremble and ran. I left the man beside me, a friend from home, still holding his place. I heard later the line held another hour and he did not come back.
一天黎明，貢達巴德戰團撞上我們的盾牆，我感覺隊列一陣動搖，就跑了。我把身旁那個同鄉朋友留在原地，他還守着自己的位置。後來聽說，陣線又撐了一個時辰，他卻沒回來。

When a Gundabad warband struck our shield wall at first light, I felt the ranks shake and I ran. I left the man beside me, a boy from my own valley, still holding his place. I heard later the line stood another hour and he never came home.
天剛亮，貢達巴德戰團撞上我們的盾牆，我感覺隊列一陣動搖，就跑了。我把身旁那個來自同一山谷的年輕人留在原地，他還守着自己的位置。後來聽說，陣線又撐了一個時辰，他卻再沒回家。

When a Ranger patrol was cut off among the troll-holes of the Trollshaws, you led them out by a path no troll had found, losing not a single man. Their captain clasped your arm and named you a friend of the Dúnedain.
一支遊民巡邏隊在食人妖森林的洞穴之間被截斷退路時，你沿着一條食人妖沒發現過的小路，把他們全部帶了出來，沒有損失一人。隊長握住你的手臂，稱你是杜內丹人的朋友。
When a Ranger patrol was cut off in the Ettenmoors, you led them out by a path no orc scout knew, losing not a single man. Their captain clasped your arm and named you a friend of the Dúnedain.
一支遊民巡邏隊在埃滕荒原被截斷退路時，你沿着一條奧克斥候不知道的小路，把他們全部帶了出來，沒有損失一人。隊長握住你的手臂，稱你是杜內丹人的朋友。
When a Wainrider host came up the eastern plain and the line wavered at its centre, you rode into the charge and held your place until the host broke. The riders of Vidugard still speak of it.
戰車民大軍沿東方平原而來，己方陣線的中央開始動搖。你騎馬加入衝鋒，始終守住自己的位置，直到敵軍潰敗。維杜加德的騎兵至今還在談論這件事。
When a battle's deployment ends, your view goes into the Seat at the camera you were using, with no blend, instead of back to your hero. Press the key to return to your hero. Default: off.
戰前部署結束後，直接從當前攝像機位置進入觀望之椅，不做視角過渡，也不切回英雄。按對應按鍵即可返回英雄。默認：關閉。

When a goblin band broke and ran for the hills, I led the chase against orders. We ran down every one, even those who threw away their blades, but two of my own fell in a gully I never scouted. The sergeant took my spear in front of the whole ford.
一夥半獸人潰敗，往山裏逃，我違令帶人追了上去。我們一個沒放過，連丟了武器的也殺了，可我沒探清一條溝裏的情況，自己人也死了兩個。軍士當着渡口全體守軍的面，收走了我的長矛。

When a goblin host from Blue Craig pushed into the lower gates, you anchored your section of the shieldwall while others buckled, buying the counterattack time to form. The captain of the Broadbeams noted your name in the battle record, which is the closest a Dwarf gets to poetry.
藍巖半獸人大軍攻入下層城門時，別人的防線開始動搖，你卻穩住了自己那段盾牆，爲組織反擊爭取了時間。寬梁族隊長把你的名字記進戰報，對矮人來說，這已經和詩歌差不多了。

When a host of orcs came up from Dol Guldur to force the Forest Gate, you stood in the passage with the king's spearmen until the woodwards came round through the trees. Your name was spoken in the hall that night.
奧克大軍從多古爾都前來強攻森林之門時，你與國王的矛兵堅守通道，直到林道守衛從樹叢間繞過來。當晚，大廳裏的人談起了你的名字。

When a mission behavior, a module's mission-start callback or a mission object throws in one of the six start calls of Mission.AfterStart while a mission is loading, log it, show a short message, cut that call short and let the mission start, instead of the game loading the mission again every frame for ever. A throw elsewhere in the load, such as a behavior's OnMissionScreenPreLoad, is not covered. Enable Crash Capture does not affect this setting. When off, the exception passes straight through as in the vanilla game. Takes effect immediately. Default ON.
任務加載時，如果任務行爲、模塊的任務啓動回調或任務對象在Mission.AfterStart的六次啓動調用之一拋出異常，就記錄日誌、顯示簡短提示、中斷這次調用，並讓任務繼續啓動，避免引擎每幀無限重複加載任務。加載過程其他位置拋出的異常不在此範圍，例如行爲的OnMissionScreenPreLoad。是否啓用崩潰捕獲，不影響本設置。關閉後，異常像原版一樣直接向外拋出。立即生效。默認：開啓。

When a patrol of barrow-wardens was cut off under the eaves of the Old Forest, you led them out by a path no outlaw knew, losing not a single man. Their captain clasped your arm and named you a friend of the Dúnedain.
一支古冢看守巡邏隊在老林子邊緣被截斷退路時，你沿着一條法外之徒不知道的小路，把他們全部帶了出來，沒有損失一人。隊長握住你的手臂，稱你是杜內丹人的朋友。
When a raiding band came across the ice one winter, I froze. The lads on either side of me did not. Two never came back, and I was crouched behind a woodpile when they fell.
一個冬天，劫掠者踏着冰面殺來，我嚇得動不了。身邊的小夥子們可沒有。其中兩個再沒回來，他們倒下的時候，我正蹲在柴堆後頭。
When a raiding band came out of the trees one winter night, I froze. The lads on either side of me did not. Two never came back, and I was crouched behind a woodpile when they fell.
一個冬夜，一夥劫掠者從樹叢裏殺出，我嚇得動不了。身邊的小夥子們可沒有。其中兩個再沒回來，他們倒下的時候，我正蹲在柴堆後頭。
When a raiding band came up out of the reeds in a morning fog, I froze. The lads on either side of me did not. Two never came back, and I was crouched behind a net-rack when they fell.
一天清晨，一夥劫掠者從霧中的蘆葦叢裏殺出，我嚇得動不了。身邊的小夥子們可沒有。其中兩個再沒回來，他們倒下的時候，我正蹲在網架後頭。

When a war-band came out of the eastern steppe and rode at the walls of Sunwall, you held the gate with the king's guard until the riders of Vineholm came round their flank. Your name was spoken in the hall that night.
東方草原的戰團騎馬衝向日牆的城牆時，你與國王衛隊守住城門，直到葡萄洲騎兵繞到敵人側翼。當晚，大廳裏的人談起了你的名字。
When a wolf-rider band crossed the shallows one winter night, I froze. The lads on either side of me did not. Two never came back, and I was crouched behind a drying rack when they fell.
一個冬夜，一隊狼騎兵穿過淺灘殺來，我嚇得動不了。身邊的小夥子們可沒有。其中兩個再沒回來，他們倒下的時候，我正蹲在晾曬架後頭。

When a woodward patrol was cut off in a hollow under the Emyn Duir, you led them out by a deer-trail no spider watched, losing not a single man. Their captain clasped your arm and named you a friend of the woodwards.
一支林道巡邏隊在埃敏杜伊爾山下的山坳裏被截斷退路時，你沿一條沒有蜘蛛監視的鹿徑，把他們全部帶了出來，沒有損失一人。隊長握住你的手臂，稱你是林道守衛們的朋友。

When an Angmar emissary came under a white cloth to speak with the captain, I shot him from the rocks before he said a word. I judged that anything from that country carried a lie. The captain disowned me before the other rangers, for breaking a truce was not our way.
有個安格瑪使者舉着白布，要來和隊長談話。他一句話還沒說，我就從岩石間一箭射死了他。我認定那地方來的東西，開口就是謊話。隊長當着其他遊民的面把我逐了出去，說破壞停戰不是我們的做法。

When an Angmar warband hit our shield wall at dawn, I felt the ranks tremble and ran. I left the man beside me, a friend from home, still holding his place. I heard later the line held another hour and he did not come back.
一天黎明，安格瑪戰團撞上我們的盾牆，我感覺隊列一陣動搖，就跑了。我把身旁那個同鄉朋友留在原地，他還守着自己的位置。後來聽說，陣線又撐了一個時辰，他卻沒回來。
When an early winter fell on the high pastures, you gathered the herders and drove every flock down to the valleys before the passes closed. The villages remember.
冬天提早降臨高地牧場時，你召集牧民，趕在隘口封閉前，把每一羣羊都帶下山谷。村裏的人都記着這件事。

When an orc band broke and fled along the river, I led the chase against orders. We ran down every one, even those who threw down their blades, but two of my own fell in a bog I never scouted. The captain stripped me of my place before the whole watch.
一夥奧克潰敗，沿河逃走，我違令帶人追了上去。我們一個沒放過，連丟了武器的也殺了，可我沒探清一片沼澤的情況，自己人也死了兩個。隊長當着全體守衛的面，撤了我的職。
When charging, cavalry will reroute around friendly infantry on the charge line. Off = vanilla collision behavior (cavalry trample friendly).
衝鋒時，騎兵會繞開衝鋒路線上己方的步兵。關閉後使用原版碰撞方式，騎兵會衝撞己方部隊。
When disabled, the two swaps above never touch a fief your clan owns, so a garrison you stacked by hand survives the conversion. AI fiefs still swap, and your fief still changes culture. Default: on.
關閉後，上面兩項替換不會影響你家族的領地，手動編入的駐軍會在文化轉換後保留。AI 領地仍會替換，你的領地也仍會轉換文化。默認：開啓。

When drought threatened the outer farms, you arranged terms with merchant houses from as far as Pelargir to keep the city's granaries full through a hard winter. The Steward's chamberlain noted your name for future service.
乾旱威脅外部農場時，你與遠至佩拉基爾的商人家族談妥條款，讓城市糧倉撐過艱難冬季。宰相的內務官記下了你的名字，以備日後任用。

When enabled (default), AI lords marching past an enemy fort are slowed (disorganized) too, at a lower chance than yours, and lose nothing else. Turn it off to protect the campaign pace: the effect then stays on your own party and the army you lead (AI lords marching with your army still take their share). Does nothing while Enable Watchful Holds is off.
開啓後，經過敵方城池的AI領主也會因襲擾而減速，進入隊形混亂狀態，但觸發概率低於玩家，且不會承受其他損失。若擔心影響戰役節奏，可以關閉；效果將只作用於你的部隊和你率領的軍團，但隨你軍團行進的AI領主仍會分擔損失。關閉“啓用城防襲擾”時，本項無效。默認：開啓。

When enabled (default), a captured lord can be asked to join your kingdom, in a conversation or from the party screen, and serves it instead of being ransomed. The lord must hold a clan of another kingdom (not its ruler, and not a mercenary or minor clan), must be held by your party or in a settlement your clan owns, and must not be a lord who can never be captured, such as Sauron and the Nazgul. A Free Peoples lord is never asked to join an Evil realm, and an Evil lord is never asked to join a Free one. The base game's blood feud rule still applies. When off, the base game's rules apply: only a kingdom's ruler can recruit a captured lord, through its 'join us, and be set free' line, which checks no realm. When on, both lines pass this check, and the ruler-only line also needs the lord held by your party or in your clan's dungeon. Applies at once, no restart.

開啓後，你可以通過對話或部隊界面，邀請被俘領主加入本國，讓其轉而效力，不再等待贖回。對方必須是另一個國家的家族領袖，不能是國家統治者、傭兵家族或小家族；還必須由你的部隊或你家族的定居點關押，且不能是索隆、那茲古爾等本就不可被俘的領主。不會邀請自由人民領主加入邪惡國家，也不會邀請邪惡領主加入自由人民國家。原版的血仇規則仍然有效。關閉後使用原版規則：只有國家統治者能通過“加入我們，就放你自由”的對話招降，且不檢查陣營。開啓後，兩種招降對話都必須通過陣營檢查，統治者專屬選項也要求俘虜關在你的部隊或你家族的地牢中。立即生效，無需重啓。默認：開啓。

When enabled (default), a castle or town whose realm is at war with yours harasses a lord party that marches within a few map units of its walls, if the fort is not besieged and holds enough troops (30 by default). Your party is slowed (disorganized: it moves slower, and its troops start a battle with lower morale until it wears off) and loses a few men, some food and morale. An army you lead loses cohesion, but never below 10, and each party marching with you takes its own losses. When off, forts never harass anyone. Applies at once, no restart.
開啓後，與你的國家交戰的城堡或城鎮，會襲擾行經城牆附近數個地圖單位範圍內的領主部隊；條件是城池未被圍攻，且駐軍足夠，默認至少30人。你的部隊會減速並進入隊形混亂狀態，在效果消退前行軍更慢、開戰時士氣更低；還會損失少量士兵、糧食和士氣。你率領的軍團會損失凝聚力，但不會低於10；隨軍各部隊也會分別承受損失。關閉後，城池不再襲擾任何人。立即生效，無需重啓。默認：開啓。

When enabled (default), a host that rides against your kingdom sends an envoy a day or two later, if your clan owns villages and you are not enlisted. The envoy asks for gold, at a price that grows with your villages and with each envoy you have seized. Pay and the host raids none of your clan's villages and never attacks your party; haggle once (a Charm roll) when the tribute is large; ask for time; refuse; or seize the envoy, after which that side's next host rides against your kingdom first. Shown only while the map is free. When off, no envoy is scheduled or shown. Single player only. Applies at once, no restart.

開啓後，劫掠軍隊出動進攻你的國家一兩天後，如果你的家族擁有村莊，且你沒有參軍服役，就會派來使者。使者會索要金錢，金額隨你的村莊數量和扣押過的使者人數增加。你可以付錢，換取該軍隊不劫掠你家族的村莊，也不攻擊你的部隊；貢金較高時，可以進行一次魅力判定來討價還價；還可以請求寬限、拒絕，或扣押使者。扣押後，該陣營的下一支劫掠軍隊會優先進攻你的國家。只在地圖處於可自由操作狀態時顯示。關閉後，不再安排或顯示使者。僅限單人模式。立即生效，無需重啓。默認：開啓。

When enabled (default), an AI lord stops running from an army that besieges a settlement when the lord, with its army if it leads one or is attached to it, is at least half as strong as the entire siege camp (0.5 by default, unlooked_for_aid.json). Lords can then pass a siege or gather near it. A lord shut inside a besieged settlement is never fled from, whatever the strengths. A weaker lord still flees, so it is not caught when the siege lifts beside it. At a siege you lead, AI lords keep the base game behaviour. Caravans, villagers, bandits, patrols and garrisons are unchanged. When off, lords flee exactly as in the base game. Applies at once, no restart.

開啓後，如果AI領主的實力至少達到整座圍城營地的一半，就不再逃避正在圍攻定居點的軍團；領主率領軍團或加入軍團時，會合並計算軍團實力。默認比例爲0.5，設在unlooked_for_aid.json中。領主因此可以經過圍城地點，或在附近集結。對於被困在被圍定居點內的領主，無論雙方實力如何，都不會觸發逃避行爲。實力不足的領主仍會避開，以免圍城軍隊突然撤圍時被抓住。你親自指揮的圍城中，AI領主仍遵循原版行爲。商隊、村民、匪徒、巡邏隊和駐軍不變。關閉後，領主完全按原版逃避規則行動。立即生效，無需重啓。默認：開啓。

When enabled (default), lords keep to their side of the war. An AI clan of the Free Peoples never joins, defects to or serves as mercenaries for an Evil realm, and an Evil clan never does so for a Free realm. Neutral clans and realms may deal with either side. A new campaign also starts with no friendships between Free and Evil lords: each one becomes enmity of the same strength. Your own clan and a realm you lead keep the base game's rules. Clans that already serve a realm of the other side stay where they are. When off, the base game's rules apply. Applies at once, no restart; the friendships part applies to new campaigns only.
開啓後，領主會堅守自己的戰爭立場。自由人民的AI家族不會加入、叛投邪惡國家，或爲其充當傭兵，邪惡家族也不會爲自由人民國家這樣做。中立家族和國家可以與雙方往來。新戰役開始時，自由人民與邪惡領主之間原有的友好關係也會改爲同等程度的敵意。你自己的家族和你統治的國家仍使用原版規則；已經效力於對立陣營國家的家族不會被強制轉移。關閉後恢復原版規則。立即生效，無需重啓；關係初始化隻影響新戰役。默認：開啓。

When enabled (default), raiding hosts ride once the War of the Ring is in Full War, or from day 89 when the War of the Ring is switched off. They ride out of their homelands to burn the villages of the opposed side: Orcs of Gundabad, Easterlings of Rhûn, Haradrim, Dunlendings and the Blacklocks of Erebor against the Free Peoples; outlaw bands of Gondor and Mirkwood against the Shadow; Corsairs of Umbar against either. A host raids the villages of the strongest enemy realm, fights weaker parties of that realm it meets, and goes home after its quota. When off, no host rides and a host already out is sent away at its next hourly tick; one still fighting is sent away once its battle ends. Single player only. Applies at once, no restart.

開啓後，魔戒大戰進入全面戰爭階段時，會有劫掠軍隊出動；如果關閉了魔戒大戰，則從第89天開始。它們離開故土，焚燬敵對陣營的村莊：貢達巴德奧克、魯恩東夷、哈拉德人、黑蠻地人和孤山黑髮族進攻自由人民；剛鐸和黑森林的亡命徒進攻暗影；烏姆巴爾海盜雙方都可能進攻。劫掠軍隊會襲擊最強敵國的村莊，沿途攻擊該國較弱的部隊，完成定額後返回故土。關閉後，不再派出劫掠軍隊；已經出動的軍隊會在下次每小時結算時離開，仍在戰鬥的則等戰鬥結束後離開。僅限單人模式。立即生效，無需重啓。默認：開啓。

When enabled (default), recruiting a prisoner of your own faction or your own side of the war costs no morale — an Isengard captor loses nothing taking on Mordor, Gundabad or Dunland troops, since all serve Sauron. Alignment comes from execution/alignment.json. Neutral factions (Khand, Umbar) only waive their own culture, not each other. When off, prisoner morale is vanilla (-1 per troop, -2 per bandit).
開啓時（默認），招募來自本勢力或戰爭中同一陣營的俘虜，不會消耗士氣。例如，艾森加德招募魔多、貢達巴德或黑蠻地士兵時不會損失士氣，因爲他們都爲索隆效力。立場來自 execution/alignment.json。可汗德、烏姆巴爾等中立勢力只對本文化免除消耗，彼此之間不免除。關閉後使用原版規則，每名普通士兵消耗1點士氣，每名強盜消耗2點。

When enabled (default), the Army Management screen works during a siege you lead as the besieger: you can call parties into your army and release them while the siege goes on, at the usual influence cost. The base game's other limits still apply (a party that is fighting, too weak, disbanding, too far away or at sea is refused, and so is a party already at the siege outside your army). Defending a siege, having no army and being in a map event keep the base game block. Singleplayer only: in a co-op session this does nothing. When off, the block is exactly the base game's. Takes effect the next time the screen opens, no restart.
開啓後，你作爲攻方親自指揮圍城時，仍可使用軍團管理界面，按正常影響力費用召集或釋放部隊，無需停止圍城。原版的其他限制仍然有效：正在戰鬥、實力過低、正在解散、距離過遠或位於海上的部隊不能加入；已在該圍城現場、但不屬於你軍團的部隊也不能召集。作爲守方、沒有軍團或正在地圖事件中時，仍保留原版限制。僅限單人模式，合作聯機中無效。關閉後，恢復原版的圍城界面限制。下次打開界面時生效，無需重啓。默認：開啓。
When enabled (default), the Corsair Host of Umbar may ride against Free or Shadow realms. Does nothing while Enable Fire and Tribute is off.
開啓後，烏姆巴爾海盜軍隊可以出動，進攻自由人民或暗影國家。關閉“啓用劫掠與貢金”時，本項無效。默認：開啓。
When enabled (default), the hosts of Gundabad, Rhûn, Harad and Dunland, and the Blacklocks of Erebor, may ride against the Free Peoples' realms. Does nothing while Enable Fire and Tribute is off.
開啓後，貢達巴德、魯恩、哈拉德和黑蠻地的軍隊，以及孤山黑髮族，可以出動進攻自由人民國家。關閉“啓用劫掠與貢金”時，本項無效。默認：開啓。
When enabled (default), the outlaw bands of Gondor and Mirkwood may ride against the Shadow's realms. Does nothing while Enable Fire and Tribute is off.
開啓後，剛鐸和黑森林的亡命徒可以出動，進攻暗影國家。關閉“啓用劫掠與貢金”時，本項無效。默認：開啓。
When enabled, AI armies stick to their current target rather than re-optimising every 3 hours. Reduces army thrashing and improves siege follow-through.
開啓後，AI軍團會堅持當前目標，不再每3小時重新選擇最優目標。減少軍團來回折返，讓它們更有可能堅持完成圍城。
When enabled, AI lord parties also score, travel to, and recruit volunteers from castles like they do from towns. Requires Enable Castle Recruitment.
開啓後，AI領主部隊也會像對待城鎮一樣，評估城堡、前往城堡並招募志願兵。需要先開啓城堡招募。

When enabled, a Free-aligned hero cannot marry an Evil-aligned one (no Gondorian weds an orc). Alignment comes from execution/alignment.json, keyed by the hero's CULTURE. Neutral cultures (Khand, Umbar, Shaghana, Abanissa) marry anyone; Dunland is Evil. When off, marriage is vanilla.
開啓後，自由人民陣營的英雄不能與邪惡陣營的英雄結婚，例如剛鐸人不能迎娶奧克。陣營依據execution/alignment.json中的英雄文化確定。中立文化，包括可汗德、烏姆巴爾、沙加納和阿巴尼薩，可以與任何陣營通婚；黑蠻地屬於邪惡陣營。關閉後使用原版婚姻規則。
When enabled, a conquered fief only converts once its loyalty is high enough (configured in culture_conversion_config.json), so a city in unrest never flips. Default: off.
開啓後，被征服的封地只有在忠誠度達到 culture_conversion_config.json 中設定的要求時，纔會轉變文化。因此，動盪中的城市不會轉變。默認：關閉。

When enabled, a conversation with a lord who leads a party offers a line to gift him troops through a donate-style party screen. The lord must not be in your clan or kingdom, not at war with you, and not on the opposite side of the Free/Evil divide (a Neutral lord may receive). Troops move from you to him only. The gift is paid by Bonds of Battle's hand-over rule (half the influence the gift is worth, at most 10 relation a day per relation owner), so the relation needs Bonds of Battle and its Troop Gifts Win Lords' Favour switch on; with either off the gift is still accepted but earns nothing. When off, the line does not appear.

開啓後，與率領部隊的領主交談時，可以通過類似捐兵的部隊界面向其贈送士兵。對方不能與你同屬一個家族或國家，不能與你交戰，也不能位於自由人民與邪惡勢力的對立一方；中立領主可以接受。士兵只能從你這裏交給對方。關係獎勵按戰友情誼的移交規則計算，爲所贈士兵影響力價值的一半，每個關係歸屬對象每天最多增加10點關係。因此，必須同時開啓戰友情誼及其“贈送士兵贏得領主好感”選項，纔有關係獎勵；關閉其中任意一項，對方仍會收兵，但你不會得到獎勵。關閉本項後，不顯示贈兵對話。

When enabled, a lord held prisoner by your clan (in your party or in one of your settlements) can be questioned about his clan's or kingdom's lands, for a bribe or by force, and stripped of his arms and armour. Force and stripping cost relation, Honor and Mercy, and stripping costs renown. Each topic works once per captivity. When off, those conversation options do not appear.
開啓後，你可以審問自己家族關押的領主，詢問其家族或國家的領地，方式可以是賄賂或強迫，也可以剝走他的武器和護甲。俘虜可以關在你的部隊或定居點裏。強迫和剝奪裝備都會損失關係、榮譽和仁慈；剝奪裝備還會損失聲望。每個話題在同一次囚禁期間只能使用一次。關閉後不顯示這些對話選項。

When enabled, a notable of the settlement you stand in (an artisan, gang leader, merchant, rural notable or headman, but not a preacher) offers three lines in conversation: give men to the settlement (troops raise its militia, prisoners its hearth in a village or its prosperity in a town; a castle takes troops only), pay to be introduced to the other notables there, and pay to have the nearest towns and castles marked on your map. Single player only; all three lines are hidden during a messenger conversation. At war with the settlement's realm only the gift line is hidden: the introduction still works and the holds question is refused. The gift line is also hidden while a party screen is open or when you hold no regular troop or prisoner. Amounts are in notable_services.json. When off, none of the lines appear. Default: on.

開啓後，你所在定居點的要人會增加三項對話服務，包括工匠、幫派首領、商人、鄉村要人和村長，但不包括傳教士：向定居點贈送人手、花錢請其介紹當地其他要人，以及花錢在地圖上標記最近的城鎮和城堡。贈送士兵可增加民兵；贈送俘虜可增加村莊戶數或城鎮繁榮度，城堡只收士兵。僅限單人模式；信使對話期間隱藏這三項服務。與該定居點的國家交戰時，只隱藏贈送人手的選項；介紹要人仍可使用，詢問城鎮城堡則會遭到拒絕。部隊界面已打開，或你沒有普通士兵和俘虜時，也會隱藏贈送選項。數量設在notable_services.json中。關閉後不顯示這些對話選項。默認：開啓。

When enabled, a recruiter cannot recruit volunteers at a settlement controlled by an opposed-alignment kingdom (Free vs Evil). Alignment comes from execution/alignment.json, keyed by the kingdom you serve. Neutral factions (Umbar etc.) never block. When off, recruitment is vanilla.
開啓後，不能在對立陣營控制的聚落招募志願兵，即自由人民與黑暗勢力互相限制。立場來自 execution/alignment.json，按你效忠的王國判斷。烏姆巴爾等中立勢力不受此限制。關閉後恢復原版招募規則。
When enabled, a scripted war will escalate between Free Peoples and Dark Powers.
開啓後，自由人民與黑暗勢力之間的戰爭會按預設劇情逐步升級。

When enabled, a town/castle (and its villages) conquered by a different culture gradually adopts the new owner's culture — producing their troops, militia, and identity. Disabling stops NEW conversions; already-converted settlements stay converted.
開啓後，被不同文化的勢力征服的城鎮或城堡及其所屬村莊，會逐漸轉爲新統治者的文化，並採用對應的兵種、民兵和文化身份。關閉後只會阻止新的轉變，已經轉變的聚落不會恢復。

When enabled, a wanderer will not take service across the Free/Evil line: Free-culture wanderers (Gondor, Rohan, the Elves, Erebor and the rest) refuse a player who serves Sauron, and Evil-culture wanderers refuse a player on the Free side. Your side is the kingdom you serve (execution/alignment.json), falling back to your clan's culture when you serve no kingdom. Neutral cultures serve anyone and a Neutral player is refused by nobody. Companions already in your clan are never affected. When off, hiring is vanilla.
開啓後，流浪者不會跨自由人民與邪惡陣營效力：剛鐸、洛汗、精靈、孤山等自由人民文化的流浪者會拒絕效忠索隆的玩家，邪惡文化的流浪者會拒絕自由人民陣營的玩家。你的陣營取決於所效忠的王國（execution/alignment.json）；沒有王國時使用家族文化。中立文化爲任何人效力，中立玩家不會被任何陣營拒絕。已有同伴不受影響。關閉後恢復原版僱傭規則。
When enabled, castles gain notables with recruitable volunteers — the player can 'Recruit troops' at any accessible castle. Existing notables remain in the save if you later disable this.
開啓後，城堡會出現提供志願兵的要人，玩家可以在任何能夠進入的城堡中選擇“招募士兵”。之後即使關閉此項，已生成的要人也會保留在存檔中。

When enabled, conversion also replaces the settlement's notables with ones of the new culture (a Mordor-held Gondor town gets orc notables). Their workshops, alleys and caravans transfer to the newcomers; your relations with the old notables do not. Default: on.
開啓後，文化轉變也會把聚落要人替換爲新文化的要人。例如，魔多佔領的剛鐸城鎮會出現半獸人要人。原有工坊、小巷和商隊會轉交給新要人，但你與舊要人的關係不會轉移。默認：開啓。

When enabled, conversion also swaps the settlement's and its villages' existing militia to the new culture's militia troops. New militia already spawn in the new culture once the fief converts; this makes the standing militia catch up the same day instead of over many. Default: on.
開啓後，會把定居點及附屬村莊現有的民兵換成新文化的民兵。領地轉換文化後，新民兵本來就按新文化生成；此選項讓現有民兵也在當天完成轉換，不必等待多日。默認：開啓。

When enabled, conversion re-mans the fief's garrison with the new culture's troops, matching tier, battlefield role and head count (a Gondor tier-4 archer becomes a Mordor tier-4 archer). Without this a fief taken by gift, barter or a king's decision keeps its old culture's garrison forever. Default: on.
開啓後，領地轉換文化時，會把駐軍換成新文化的兵種，並匹配等級、戰場角色和人數（例如剛鐸4級弓兵變成魔多4級弓兵）。否則，通過贈送、交易或國王決策得到的領地，會一直保留舊文化的駐軍。默認：開啓。
When enabled, kingdoms favour enemies on their own front. Gondor prefers Mordor and Isengard over far northern targets. Weighting only: no war is ever forbidden.
開啓後，王國會優先對付自己戰線上的敵人。例如，剛鐸會優先進攻魔多和艾森加德，而不是遙遠北方的目標。此項只調整權重，不會禁止任何戰爭。

When enabled, the tavern keeper of a town offers three more lines: stand a round for your whole party (morale and a little Charm experience), stand a round for everyone in the tavern (renown and a little Charm experience), and pay to have the nearest towns and castles marked on your map. A round costs the town's price for the local drink for each head, capped, and the gold goes to the town. At most a few rounds a day, set in inn_rounds.json. Single player only; the lines are hidden during a messenger conversation. The map question is refused while the town's realm is at war with yours or its owner does not know you well enough. When off, none of the lines appear. Default: on.

開啓後，城鎮酒館老闆會增加三項對話：請全體部隊喝一輪，增加士氣和少量魅力經驗；請酒館內所有人喝一輪，增加聲望和少量魅力經驗；以及付費在地圖上標記最近的城鎮和城堡。每輪費用按當地酒水的城鎮價格和人數計算，但有上限；錢款歸城鎮所有。每天只能請有限的幾輪，設在inn_rounds.json中。僅限單人模式；信使對話期間隱藏這些選項。城鎮所屬國家與你交戰，或城鎮所有者不夠熟悉你時，會拒絕提供地圖消息。關閉後不顯示這些對話選項。默認：開啓。

When enabled, you can ask a free lord about his clan's holdings. A lord who knows you well enough names them and they are marked on your map; a lord who does not refuses, and a lord whose clan holds nothing says so, each at a small cost in relation. Lords at war with you and your own clan never answer. When off, the line does not appear.
開啓後，你可以向未被囚禁的領主詢問其家族的領地。對方足夠熟悉你時，會告知並在你的地圖上標記；不夠熟悉時會拒絕；沒有領地時也會如實回答，每種情況都會小幅損失關係。與你交戰的領主，以及你自己家族的領主，始終不會回答。關閉後不顯示此對話選項。
When enabled, you receive an event when a watched faction's settlement is besieged, with a timed window to help defend.
開啓後，受關注陣營的聚落遭到圍困時，你會收到事件通知，並有一段時間前去協助防守。

When families fleeing the burned farms along the Greyflood reached the capital by the hundreds, a lord argued the gates should close to save the stores. I wrote down their names, kept a ledger of who was sick and who was starving, and put it before the council. They called it sentiment and had me removed from my post.
灰水河沿岸的農莊被燒後，逃出來的百姓成百上千地湧到都城。一位領主主張關城門，省下存糧。我記下每個人的名字，列明誰病了、誰快餓死了，把賬冊送到議事會面前。他們說我感情用事，把我的職撤了。

When families fleeing the burned hill villages reached the tower town by the hundreds, a lord argued the gates should close to save the stores. I wrote down their names, kept a ledger of who was sick and who was starving, and laid it before the council. They called it sentiment and had me removed from my post.
山村被燒後，逃出來的百姓成百上千地湧到塔下的城鎮。一位領主主張關城門，省下存糧。我記下每個人的名字，列明誰病了、誰快餓死了，把賬冊送到議事會面前。他們說我感情用事，把我的職撤了。

When families fleeing the burned villages of the North Downs reached the capital by the hundreds, a clan lord argued the gates should close to save the stores. I wrote down their names, kept a ledger of who was sick and who was starving, and put it before the council. They called it sentiment and had me removed from my post.
北崗的村莊被燒後，逃出來的百姓成百上千地湧到都城。一位家族領主主張關城門，省下存糧。我記下每個人的名字，列明誰病了、誰快餓死了，把賬冊送到議事會面前。他們說我感情用事，把我的職撤了。
When frost came a month early to the terraces, you gathered the pickers and brought the grapes in within three days. The villages remember.
梯田上的霜比往常提前一個月到來，你召集採摘工，在三天內把葡萄收了回來。村裏的人都記着這件事。

When goblins from Blue Craig came down on our post, I counted the odds and slipped away before the gate fell. I told myself the arithmetic was sound. The post held for an hour after I left; I heard it from the hills.
藍巖的半獸人襲擊我們的哨所時，我算了算形勢，城門還沒破，就溜了。我對自己說，這筆賬算得沒錯。我走後，哨所又撐了一個小時，我在山上聽着。

When iron ran short in Fornost's forges, you rode west to the Ered Luin and bargained with the Dwarves until the ore carts rolled east again. The King's treasurer does not forget who kept the forges lit.
佛諾斯特的鍛爐缺鐵時，你騎馬西行，前往埃瑞德路因與矮人談判，直到運礦車再次向東駛去。國王的財務官不會忘記，是誰讓鍛爐繼續燒着。

When iron ran short in the forges of Caras Gorthad, you rode west to the Ered Luin and bargained with the Dwarves until the ore carts rolled east again. The King's treasurer does not forget who kept the forges lit.
卡拉斯戈沙德的鍛爐缺鐵時，你騎馬西行，前往埃瑞德路因與矮人談判，直到運礦車再次向東駛去。國王的財務官不會忘記，是誰讓鍛爐繼續燒着。

When off, your team is immune and dread only touches the AI. Left on, an enemy wraith weakens your soldiers so they rout sooner in combat, and routed troops are LOST from your party. Your own character is always immune either way: the engine gives player-controlled agents no morale component at all.
關閉後，你的一方免疫恐懼，只有AI受到影響。開啓時，敵方戒靈會削弱你的士兵，使他們更早潰逃，而潰逃的士兵會從你的部隊中丟失。無論如何設置，你親自控制的角色始終免疫，因爲引擎根本沒有爲玩家控制的單位提供士氣組件。
When on, AI lords buy claims, usurp the titles they claim, form vacant titles their side holds and restore thrones, each week. When off, only you do; claims they already hold stay. Default: on.
開啓後，AI領主每週會購買宣稱、奪取已有宣稱的頭銜、在本陣營掌握的領土上設立空缺頭銜，以及恢復王位。關閉後，只有你能進行這些操作；AI已經擁有的宣稱仍然保留。默認：開啓。

When on, AI lords hand lesser titles to their grown children. When off, they keep them; titles already handed down stay, and so do the grants made when a campaign starts, such as Boromir's West Osgiliath. Default: on.
開啓後，AI領主會把較低級的頭銜授予成年子女。關閉後，他們會保留這些頭銜；已經授予的頭銜不會收回，開局時預設的分封也會保留，例如波洛米爾的西歐斯吉利亞斯。默認：開啓。

When on, a Neutral realm can join the War of the Ring for good. In Full War, the side that is far behind on the war meter (25 points or more) calls on a Neutral realm that leans its way: Khand, Rhudaur, Umbar, Shaghana and Abanissa lean to the Shadow, Cardolan and Dorwinion to the Free Peoples. The realm then goes to war with every realm of the other side, and that war cannot end in peace while the War of the Ring lasts. One realm joins at a time, 30 days apart unless war_pledge.json says otherwise, and never a realm that a player rules. Needs Momentum Tracking on. Off stops new joins by the AI; a realm that has joined stays joined. Default: on.

開啓後，中立國家可以正式加入魔戒大戰，並一直參戰。全面戰爭期間，戰局條上落後至少25點的一方會號召傾向自己的中立國家參戰：可汗德、魯道爾、烏姆巴爾、沙加納和阿巴尼薩傾向暗影，卡多藍和多溫尼安傾向自由人民。參戰國會向另一方的全部國家宣戰，而且只要魔戒大戰仍在繼續，這些戰爭就不能以議和結束。每次只有一個國家加入，默認間隔30天，除非war_pledge.json另有規定；玩家統治的國家絕不會被自動拉入。需要開啓戰局優勢統計。關閉後，AI不再吸納新的參戰國，但已經加入的國家不會退出。默認：開啓。
When on, a creature's normal hit only staggers a soldier and only a critical hit knocks him down. When off, any hit of 30 or more knocks down, as the ridden spider's do.
開啓時，怪物的普通攻擊只會讓士兵踉蹌，只有暴擊纔會擊倒。關閉時，任何至少30點傷害的命中都能擊倒，與被騎乘蜘蛛的規則相同。
When on, a lord who holds the title of a town or castle that another clan owns likes its owner a little less each week, and the town loses a little loyalty. Default: on.
開啓後，如果某位領主持有一座城鎮或城堡的頭銜，但實際領地歸另一家族所有，他每週都會降低對實際所有者的好感，城鎮也會小幅損失忠誠度。默認：開啓。

When on, a settlement project that finishes grants no Steward XP, which the game otherwise gives 1000 of each time. This covers every settlement, yours included. In a co-op session only the host skips the grant; while a co-op mod TAOM cannot probe (such as BannerlordTogether) is enabled, the game's grant is left alone. Default: off.
開啓後，定居點建築項目完工時，不再獎勵原版每次給予的1000點管理技能經驗。作用於全部定居點，包括你自己的。合作聯機時，只有主機端跳過獎勵；啓用了TAOM無法識別的合作聯機MOD，例如BannerlordTogether時，不改動原版獎勵。默認：關閉。
When on, a vassal of another clan likes the holder of their liege title a little more each week, up to a relation of 30. Default: on.
開啓後，封臣與宗主分屬不同家族時，封臣每週都會小幅增加對宗主頭銜持有者的好感，最多升至30點關係。默認：開啓。

When on, great deeds against the enemy draw a hunter: a Free player is hunted by one of the Nine with a host of Mordor (of Dol Guldur for its four wraiths), an Evil player by Glorfindel with a host of the Eldar. Only while your kingdom is at war with the hunter's. Single-player only. Default: on.
開啓後，你對敵人立下的戰功會引來追獵者：自由人民陣營的玩家會被九戒靈之一率領的魔多大軍追獵，其中多古爾都的四名戒靈率領多古爾都軍隊；邪惡陣營的玩家則會被格羅芬德爾率領的埃爾達大軍追獵。只有你的國家與追獵者的國家交戰時纔會觸發。僅限單人模式。默認：開啓。

When on, lord parties and the name above a conversation carry the lord's style and title, such as Steward Denethor of Gondor. When off, they show the plain name; the encyclopedia still lists every title. Party names change within an in-game hour. Default: on.
開啓後，領主部隊名稱和對話上方的姓名會帶有領主的稱謂與頭銜，例如“剛鐸宰相德內梭爾”。關閉後只顯示姓名，但百科仍會列出全部頭銜。部隊名稱會在一個遊戲小時內更新。默認：開啓。
When on, the emissary option is hidden at settlements whose owner faction has no special resource. When off, the option still appears but is disabled with an explanatory hint.
開啓後，若聚落所屬陣營沒有特殊資源，就隱藏使者選項。關閉後，選項仍會出現，但無法使用，並顯示原因提示。
When on, the war cannot end until you have fought in enough momentum events yourself. Default: on.
開啓後，只有你親自參加了足夠多影響戰局優勢的戰鬥，戰爭纔可能結束。默認：開啓。
When on, you can manage any owned fief from anywhere via F6 or the Fiefs button on the map bar. When off, the Manage option is disabled unless you are physically at the selected fief. Default: true.
開啓後，你可以在任何地方通過F6或地圖欄的“封地”按鈕，管理自己擁有的任意封地。關閉後，只有親自到達選中的封地，才能使用管理選項。默認：開啓。

When on, your OWN caravans also range further, trade cross-war, and buy fuller baskets (they may enter contested territory and risk attack). Off scopes the selection re-weight + basket diversity off your clan's caravans. Note: the wider distance ceiling is engine-global (shared by all caravans) and the war-trade gate scopes at your whole faction, so those two levers aren't fully isolated to non-player caravans — but with this off your caravans still route by vanilla's nearest-first selection.
開啓後，你自己的商隊也會走得更遠、進行戰時貿易，並採購更豐富的貨物，但可能進入爭奪中的地區，面臨襲擊風險。關閉後，不對你的家族商隊調整目的地選擇權重和採購多樣性。注意：更遠的行程上限由引擎全局共享，戰時貿易限制則作用於整個陣營，因此這兩項不能完全排除玩家商隊。不過，關閉此項後，你的商隊仍會按照原版的就近優先規則選擇路線。

When on, your troops cost no special resource to upgrade, recruit or keep, and none of them desert for lack of it. Gold and wages still apply. The Elite Emissary sells for gold, to a buyer of its own resource group only. You still earn the resource, and the armoury still takes it. When you turn this off, the charges return, and elite troops desert again at a zero balance. Default: off.
開啓後，你的士兵升級、招募和維持都不再消耗特殊資源，也不會因缺少特殊資源而逃跑。金幣費用和軍餉仍然保留。精銳招募使者改收金幣，但仍只向同一資源陣營的買家出售。你仍會獲得特殊資源，軍械庫也仍會消耗資源。關閉後，恢復資源收費，精銳士兵也會在資源餘額爲0時再次逃跑。默認：關閉。
When orcs and hill-trolls came down out of the Ettenmoors in force, you held your line in the Ettendale until the King's men came. Your name was spoken in the hall at Cameth Brin.
奧克和山地食人妖從埃滕荒原大舉南下時，你在埃滕谷堅守陣線，直到國王的軍隊趕到。你的名字因此傳進了卡梅斯布林的大廳。
When raiders burned the farms of Eastbank, you gathered the neighbours, raised the barns before the first frost and kept watch on the fields until the harvest was in. The villages remember.
劫掠者燒燬東岸的農場後，你召集鄰居，趕在初霜前建起穀倉，並守着田地，直到莊稼收完。村裏的人都記着這件事。
When raiders came, our village had no riding company to protect it. I rallied the young riders and we drove them off ourselves. Word spread, and the Marshal offered me a place in the muster.
劫掠者來時，我們村沒有騎兵隊保護。我召集年輕騎手，自己把他們趕跑了。事情傳開，元帥邀我加入徵召的隊伍。
When raiders came, our village had no éored to protect it. I rallied the young riders and we drove them off ourselves. Word spread, and the Marshal offered me a place in the muster.
劫掠者來時，我們的村莊沒有伊奧雷德騎兵隊保護。我召集年輕騎手，靠自己把敵人趕走。消息傳開後，元帥便邀請我加入集結的軍隊。
When raiders fired the farms of the Eastmarch and the families fled west, you led them along dry ravines no rider had scouted, and lost not one child. The king gave you his hand.
劫掠者放火焚燒東境農場，人們向西逃亡。你帶他們穿過騎兵沒有偵察過的乾燥溝谷，一個孩子也沒丟。國王握住了你的手。

When raiding parties came out of the Ephel Duath, you coordinated the local levies to protect the harvesters and brought in the crop before the season broke. The village heads still talk about the year someone actually got it done.
劫掠隊從埃斐爾度阿斯山中出沒時，你協調當地徵召兵保護收割者，並趕在季節崩壞前把莊稼收了進來。村長們至今還會談起那一年，終於有人把事辦成了。

When she was ready to sail into the West, I had my berth. But a friend of mine had buried her husband, a mortal, and could no longer bear the shores of Middle-earth. I gave her my place and watched the ship pass beyond the lamps.
它要向西方啓航時，我本來有個船位。可我的一位朋友剛埋葬丈夫，那是個凡人，她再也受不了中洲的海岸。我把位置讓給她，看着船駛過燈火，消失在遠處。

When the Blue Craig host came south one winter, the lord of the Wardens ordered us back to guard the mine-heads. That left the hill steadings of Men to the goblins, folk I had sworn to defend. I marched to the steadings instead, and we held them. My lord said a captain who chooses his own orders cannot keep his command.
有年冬天，藍巖大軍南下，守望者領主命我們撤回去保護礦口。這就把山裏的人類農莊留給了半獸人，可我發誓要保護那些人。我帶隊去了農莊，並守住了它們。領主說，自己挑命令聽的隊長，就別想繼續帶兵。
When the Dunlendings came north over the Greyflood in force, you held your line at Sarn Ford until the King's riders came. Your name was spoken in the hall at Caras Gorthad.
黑蠻地人大舉跨過灰水河向北而來時，你在薩恩渡口堅守陣線，直到國王的騎兵趕到。你的名字因此傳進了卡拉斯戈沙德的大廳。

When the Dwarves on the East Road wanted a safe crossing of the Hoarwell, you bargained with them until their caravans paid tolls at the Last Bridge and their iron came to Cameth Brin. The King's treasurer does not forget who filled his chests.
走東大道的矮人想要安全渡過蒼泉河，你和他們談妥條件，讓商隊在最後大橋繳納過橋費，也讓他們的鐵運進了卡梅斯布林。國王的財務官不會忘記，是誰裝滿了他的錢箱。

When the Easterling raids went quiet, the caravan master tried to cut my wage and said there was no danger left to pay for. Quiet was my work. I took my maps and left him to find his own way, and two carts were lost that season.
東夷的劫掠消停後，商隊首領想砍我的工錢，說已經沒有危險，不值得再花錢。可一路平安，本來就是我的功勞。我帶着地圖走了，讓他自己找路，那一季他們丟了兩輛貨車。

When the Orc host pushed into the lower gates, you anchored your section of the shieldwall while others buckled, buying the counterattack time to form. Dain's captain noted your name in the battle record, which is the closest a Dwarf gets to poetry.
奧克大軍衝入下層大門時，你在其他地段動搖之際穩住自己負責的盾牆，爲反擊爭取了成形時間。戴因的隊長把你的名字記進戰鬥記錄；對矮人來說，這已經很接近詩了。

When the exhausted laborers put down their tools and refused to move, you stepped in alone, identified the three instigators, and handled the situation before the overseers noticed the delay. The gang went back to work. The instigators did not cause further trouble.
疲憊勞工放下工具拒絕動彈時，你獨自介入，找出三個煽動者，並在監工注意到延誤前處理完局面。工隊回去幹活，那幾個煽動者也沒再惹麻煩。

When the food in the stores, not counting the herd, lasts fewer days than this, the slaughter order turns livestock into meat, a head at a time, until it lasts this long again. Between 1 and 30. Default: 3.
不計牲畜時，現有糧食可供給的天數低於此值，宰殺指令就會逐頭宰殺牲畜，直到儲糧重新足夠維持此天數。範圍：1至30。默認：3。
When the forest crept back over the abandoned clearings of Thornhold, you led the farmers in with fire and spears, cleared the nests and brought in a harvest where none had grown in a generation.
森林重新覆蓋了荊棘堡廢棄的開墾地，你帶領農民拿着火把和長矛進入林間，清除巢穴，讓一代人沒有長出莊稼的土地重新有了收成。
When the hill-men of Rhudaur came over the Weather Hills under Angmar's banners, you held your line on the slopes until the King's riders came. Your name was spoken in the hall at Fornost.
魯道爾山民打着安格瑪的旗幟翻過風雲丘陵時，你堅守山坡上的陣線，直到國王的騎兵趕到。你的名字因此傳進了佛諾斯特的大廳。

When the line broke in a border war against the Haradrim, I shot until the horns blew, then dropped my bow and ran. Better to live as a coward than to die as a corpse, I told myself, and I have told myself that every night since.
跟哈拉德人打邊境戰爭時，我們陣線崩了。我一直射到號角響起，接着丟弓就跑。我告訴自己，活着當膽小鬼，總比死了當屍首強，從那以後，每天夜裏我都這樣對自己說。

When the orc raids went quiet, the party's master tried to cut my wage and said there was no danger left to pay for. Quiet was my work. I took my maps and left him to find his own way, and two carts were lost that season.
奧克的劫掠消停後，商隊頭領想砍我的工錢，說已經沒有危險，不值得再花錢。可一路平安，本來就是我的功勞。我帶着地圖走了，讓他自己找路，那一季他們丟了兩輛貨車。

When the patrol was cut off east of the Anduin, you led them through a track no Orc scout had mapped, losing not a single man. Faramir's lieutenant clasped your arm when you came in and said nothing more needed to be said.
巡邏隊在安都因河東岸被切斷時，你帶他們走過一條沒有奧克斥候標記的小路，一個人也沒損失。你回來時，法拉米爾的副官握住你的手臂，只說已經不用多說了。
When the rivers rose early in a hard autumn, you gathered the farmers' levies to bring the harvest in and raised the dykes before the Greyflood broke them. The villages remember.
一個艱難的秋天，河水提早上漲。你召集應徵的農民收割莊稼，並趕在灰水河沖垮堤壩之前加高了河堤。村裏的人都記着這件事。
When the shadow in the south grew and Woodmen families fled north through the trees, you led them across the river by paths no orc scout knew, and lost not one child. Grimbeorn gave you his hand.
南方的陰影日益擴張，林中居民的家庭紛紛穿過樹林向北逃。你沿着奧克斥候不知道的小路帶他們渡河，一個孩子也沒丟。格里姆貝奧恩握住了你的手。

When the spiders went quiet on the road, the party's master tried to cut my wage and said there was no danger left to pay for. Quiet was my work. I took my maps and left him to find his own way, and two carts were lost that season.
路上的蜘蛛沒動靜了，商隊頭領就想砍我的工錢，說已經沒有危險，不值得再花錢。可一路平安，本來就是我的功勞。我帶着地圖走了，讓他自己找路，那一季他們丟了兩輛貨車。
When the stores run low, slaughter some of the herd.
儲糧不夠時，就宰幾頭牲畜。

When the warden of Hammerdeep died I asked for his command, and the council gave it to a cousin twice my age. I told them what I thought of him in front of the whole hall. My father said I could apologize or leave Nogrod until I had learned some manners.
深錘堡的守將死後，我申請接他的職位，議事會卻給了一個年紀是我兩倍的堂親。我當着整個廳堂的人，說了自己對那人的看法。父親說，要麼道歉，要麼離開諾格羅德，等學會禮貌再回來。
When wolves and orcs came down from the north in a hard autumn, you gathered the farmers' levies to guard the fields and brought the harvest in before the snow. The villages remember.
一個艱難的秋天，狼羣和奧克從北方南下。你組織應徵的農民守衛田地，趕在落雪前收回莊稼。村裏的人都記着這件事。

When you beat them, they escape the field as fugitives instead of going to your dungeon, and return with a new army within days. This does NOT make them immortal: one of the Nine can still die in a battle he could not be captured in. Edit uncapturable_heroes_config.json to change who this covers.
擊敗他們後，他們會以逃亡者身份離開戰場，不會進入你的地牢，並在數日內帶着新軍隊回來。這並不意味着他們不會死亡：九戒靈中的一員即使無法被俘，仍可能在戰鬥中死去。可修改 uncapturable_heroes_config.json，調整此規則適用的人物。

When you hand troops to another lord on the Donate Troops screen, that lord gains relation with you: half of the influence the gift is worth, at most 10, give or take one. A gift worth less than 2 earns nothing. Hand-overs stop paying a lord once 10 relation has landed with him that day; the Done that reaches 10 asks only for what is left, and Charm can raise it. A lord gains at most 10 a day from hand-overs, however the gift is split (Charm can raise the last Done). The same rule pays for troops given to a lord through a Lord Courtesies gift. Default: on.

通過捐贈士兵界面向其他領主移交士兵時，會提高與該領主的關係，按所贈士兵影響力價值的一半計算，上限10點，可能有約1點浮動。價值不足2點的贈送沒有獎勵。同一位領主當天從移交士兵中累計獲得10點關係後，不再獲得獎勵；達到10點的那次點擊“完成”時，只補足剩餘額度，魅力加成可能進一步提高實際增幅。無論拆成多少次贈送，每位領主每天的額度都是10點，最後一次結算仍可能受魅力加成影響。通過領主往來的贈兵對話移交士兵，也使用相同規則。默認：開啓。

When you take over a lord, adds the starting gold your created character was given on top of the lord's own treasury. An adopted wanderer starts with a new character's gold either way, and an Advanced Start type other than the default sets its own gold. Off by default: an established lord is already funded, so stacking a startup package on them is a balance change rather than a fix.
接管領主時，把所創建角色獲得的初始金幣加到領主原有財產上。接管流浪者時，無論此項如何都會獲得新角色初始金幣；非默認的高級開局類型使用自己的金幣設置。默認關閉：現有領主本來就有資金，額外疊加開局禮包屬於平衡調整，不是錯誤修復。

When your company stops at a town, castle or village, ask whether you want a few hours to yourself. The popup exists because the wait menu runs at full speed: a lord's stop is a few campaign hours, which is about two real seconds, and the 'Take leave in the settlement' menu option appears and vanishes inside it. Turn this off and that menu option still works. Takes effect immediately; no restart. Default ON.
部隊停在城鎮、城堡或村莊時，詢問你是否想抽出幾個小時自由活動。之所以彈出詢問，是因爲等待菜單會全速推進時間：領主停留的幾小時遊戲時間，現實中大約只有兩秒，“在聚落休假”的菜單選項會在這段時間裏迅速出現又消失。關閉此項後，該菜單選項仍可使用。立即生效，無需重啓。默認開啓。
他的巡邏隊在哪裏活動？
Where do they lie in wait?
Where do they run their goods?

Where the waters of the Running River meet the shadow of the Lonely Mountain, stands Dale. The City of Men had been rebuilt from ruin in the aftermath of the Battle of the Five Armies. Once a place of music and merriment, of trade and golden market halls, Dale prospered under the protection of Erebor. Its merchants sailed swift boats down the Celduin, its streets rang with laughter, and its people knew peace. But peace was shattered when the dragon came. Smaug, the winged death from the North, descended upon Erebor in flame and fury, and Dale was the first to suffer. The city burned, her people fled, and for nearly two centuries, the proud, domed towers stood silent and broken, a monument to sorrow. Yet ruin is not the end of Dale's tale. With the death of the dragon, Bard the Bowman raised his banner once more and called his people home. From ash and stone rose Dale again, not as it once was, but greater. Under King Bard and his son Bain, the city thrives anew, her walls strong, her people proud, and her gaze ever vigilant. The Men of Dale are not mighty in number, nor ancient in magic, but they are steadfast and true.

奔流河與孤山的陰影交匯之處，坐落着河谷城。五軍之戰後，這座人類城市從廢墟中重建。它曾充滿音樂與歡笑，貿易在金色的市場大廳裏興盛起來。在孤山的庇護下，商人駕着快船沿凱爾都因河而下，街道上笑聲不斷，人們享受着和平。但巨龍到來後，一切都變了。北方巨龍斯毛格如同長着翅膀的死神，帶着火焰和狂怒襲擊孤山，河谷城最先遭殃。城市在烈火中燃燒，人們四散逃亡。此後近兩個世紀裏，曾經雄偉的圓頂高塔破敗無聲，成了悲傷的紀念。然而，廢墟並不是河谷城故事的終點。巨龍死後，“神箭手”巴德再次舉起旗幟，召喚人們回家。河谷城從灰燼與碎石中重新崛起，甚至比從前更加壯麗。在巴德國王和他的兒子巴因治下，城市再度繁榮，城牆堅固，人民自豪，也始終保持警惕。河谷城人數量不多，也沒有古老的魔法，卻堅定而忠誠。

Whether YOUR clan's lord parties get the same size scaling as AI lords. 'Taken-over lords only' (default) applies it when you started as an existing lord via Player Switcher, whose clan was given AI-sized rosters at world generation and would otherwise shed thousands of men. Detected from the player clan's id, so it survives save/load. 'Always' also applies it to an ordinary campaign start. 'Never' is the pre-2026-09-01 behaviour. Food and wage relief are never granted to your clan either way.
決定你的家族所屬領主部隊，是否獲得與AI領主相同的人數調整。“僅接管的領主”（默認）只在你通過角色切換功能選擇現有領主開局時生效：這些家族在世界生成時擁有AI規模的兵力，否則會流失數千名士兵。判斷依據是玩家家族的ID，因此保存並讀檔後仍有效。“始終”也會應用於普通開局。“從不”等同於2026-09-01之前的表現。無論選擇哪項，你的家族都不會獲得糧食和軍餉減免。

Whether spider broods keep spawning around Mirkwood and Dol Guldur on the campaign map (one a day, up to twenty). Off stops new broods; broods already on the map stay. Broods exist only in a campaign started with v2.0.32 or later.
是否在戰役地圖的黑森林與多古爾都附近繼續生成蜘蛛羣，每天一羣，最多20羣。關閉後停止生成新羣，地圖上的現有蜘蛛羣保留。蜘蛛羣只存在於 v2.0.32 或之後版本開始的戰役。

Whether wild troll bands keep spawning on the campaign map, about one per kingdom near its towns, castles and villages (one new band a day, two to four trolls each). Trolls are never taken prisoner or recruited. Off stops new bands; bands already on the map stay. Troll bands need a new campaign. The options below tune the spiders only.
是否繼續在戰役地圖上生成野生食人妖羣，約在各王國的城鎮、城堡和村莊附近各有一羣。每天新生成一羣，每羣2到4只。食人妖不能被俘虜或招募。關閉後停止生成新羣，現有羣體保留。食人妖羣需要新開戰役。下方選項只調整蜘蛛。

Which towns caravans may trade with despite the war. Vanilla = war blocks trade (the cause of the shuttle). Same Side + Neutral = trade with same-alignment or neutral factions but not the enemy side (default, lore-friendly). Ignore War = trade anywhere non-besieged.
決定戰爭期間商隊可以前往哪些城鎮貿易。“原版”會禁止與交戰方貿易，也是商隊反覆短途往返的原因。“同陣營與中立方”允許與立場相同或中立的勢力貿易，但不包括敵對陣營，這是符合背景設定的默認選項。“忽略戰爭”允許前往任何未被圍困的城鎮貿易。

While others played, you lingered in the market, watching merchants haggle over prices and tally profits. You were fascinated by the craft of trade, often imagining yourself as a steward of Gondor or a dwarven craftsman counting gems.
別人在玩鬧時，你常待在集市裏，看商人討價還價、計算利潤。你迷上了貿易這門手藝，常想像自己像剛鐸宰相管理賬目，或像矮人工匠清點寶石。

While you are in the Seat and the order panel is open, a cursor shows and orders land where it points. Hold the middle mouse button to look around with the cursor hidden. A click on one of the panel's buttons does not press it yet: it gives a Move order on the ground behind it. Default: on.
使用觀望之椅且命令面板打開時，顯示鼠標指針，命令落在指針指向的位置。按住鼠標中鍵可隱藏指針、轉動視角。目前點擊面板按鈕還不能觸發按鈕，而是會對其後方的地面下達移動命令。默認：開啓。

While you are in the Seat in a battle, your hero fights on with the company, driven by the game's AI, and you get the controls back when you leave. It acts the next time you take the Seat. Not in an online session. Default: off.
戰鬥中使用觀望之椅時，你的英雄由遊戲AI控制，繼續隨部隊作戰；退出觀望後，控制權歸還給你。下次進入觀望之椅時生效。在線聯機中無效。默認：關閉。

While you are in the Seat, the order panel opens again after an order. Closing it yourself (Escape, the right mouse button, or the panel key) keeps it closed. With the game option that slows time (on by default) while orders are given, the whole stay in the Seat runs at quarter speed apart from one frame per order. Default: off.
使用觀望之椅時，下令後會重新打開命令面板。你主動用Escape、鼠標右鍵或面板按鍵關閉後，它會保持關閉。如果開啓了下令時減慢時間的遊戲選項，默認就是開啓，那麼整個觀望期間幾乎都會以四分之一速度進行，每次下令只有一幀例外。默認：關閉。
Whip your trolls into a frenzy — boosts +15% melee damage and +10% damage reduction to allies within 50m for 8s.
鞭策你的食人妖陷入狂暴：50 米內的盟友獲得 +15% 近戰傷害和 +10% 傷害減免，持續 8 秒。
Will you answer the call to defend? You have {days} days to reach the settlement.
你願意響應號召，前往支援守軍嗎？你必須在{days}天內趕到。
Win a tournament and make my wager pay. Take the prize and I'll see you well rewarded from the winnings.
贏下一場競技大賽，讓我的賭注賺到錢。拿下冠軍，我會從贏來的錢裏好好酬謝你。
Win a tournament bearing my favour and the honour is ours both. You will be rewarded for the victory.
佩戴我的信物贏得競技大賽，榮耀就屬於我們兩人。你會因爲這場勝利得到獎賞。
在安都因河沿岸贏得聲望
Win some hard fights and teach my retainers the trade of war. Toughen them and you will be paid for the teaching.
打贏幾場硬仗，教會我的扈從怎麼作戰。把他們練得堅強些，你就能拿到這份教學的報酬。
Winning a town's tournament earns relation with the owner's clan leader (unless your clan owns the town) and with every notable in the town. Default: on.
贏得城鎮競技大會後，會增加與城鎮所有者家族領袖的關係，自己家族擁有的城鎮除外；也會增加與城內每位要人的關係。默認：開啓。
卡拉斯加拉松的睿智精靈
Wise leadership reaps greater influence from victory
睿智領導能從勝利中獲得更多影響力
Wise. The Wood has little patience for the loud, and less for the stubborn. Show us what you carry.[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
明智。林子對吵鬧的人沒多少耐心，對固執的人就更少。讓我們看看你帶了什麼。[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
Wise. We remember every road tax the valley lords ever took from us, so we take a little back. Name a price, and make it a kind one.[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
這才明智。谷地那些領主收過我們多少過路錢，我們都記着，現在不過拿回一點。開個價，可別太小氣。[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
With its fief: the town or castle passes to their clan.
連同封地：城鎮或城堡將歸受封者的家族所有。

With keen eyes that missed no movement and quick feet that outran most, you were often the first to spot a deer trail or the glint of a hidden trinket. Your friends likened you to the rangers of the north, silent and observant.
你的眼睛敏銳，不會放過任何動靜，腳步也比大多數人更快。你常常最先發現鹿的蹤跡，或看見藏起來的小飾物反出的一點光。朋友們說你像北方遊民一樣安靜而警覺。
With the titles below it that you hold.
連同你持有的下屬頭銜一併授予。

With your view on your hero in third person and the order panel open, the view lifts (7 metres in a field battle, 3 in a siege or a sally out) so you can see over the ranks, and it sinks when the panel closes. The lift drops the target lock, and no new lock starts until the view has sunk. Under a roof the view rises through it. The Seat itself does not use this. It works with the Seat turned off too. Default: off.
第三人稱跟隨英雄時，打開命令面板會抬高視角，讓你越過隊列觀察戰場；野戰抬高7米，攻城或突圍出擊抬高3米，關閉面板後降回。抬升會取消目標鎖定，降回前也不能重新鎖定。在屋頂下，視角會穿過屋頂。觀望之椅本身不使用此效果，即使關閉觀望之椅功能，此項也能單獨生效。默認：關閉。
Within the tribal longhouses of Dunland, you learned tactics and the art of command, planning raids and defenses for your clan.
在黑蠻地部族長屋裏，你學習戰術和指揮之道，爲氏族計劃襲擊與防禦。
Wolves and worse have thinned our flocks to nothing, traveller. Without beasts to breed, the village will not see another fat winter.
旅人，狼和更可怕的東西幾乎害光了我們的牲畜。沒有種畜繁育，村子以後就別想過上糧食充足的冬天了。
Won't find me wallowing in gore-pits when summoned. No bribing overseers for brawls en route.
需要我時，你不會發現我在血坑裏打滾。路上我也不會爲了打架去賄賂監工。
Woodcutters of Mirkwood's eaves take up the boar-spear when the watch calls. Not all of us stand when the shouting starts.
守衛隊一招呼，黑森林邊緣的伐木工就拿起獵豬矛。可喊殺聲響起來時，我們不是人人都站得住。
Woodland militia habits carry over: 50% less forest speed penalty + 15% sight range and +20% chance for veteran militia in towns; -10% construction speed.
保留林地民兵的習慣：森林減速懲罰降低50%，視野範圍增加15%，城鎮民兵成爲老兵的概率增加20%；建築施工速度降低10%。
Word came of orcs near our clearings, and I led six lads out to meet them without waiting for the garrison. I never counted the enemy, and there were forty. Three of the six came home.
聽說奧克到了我們林間空地附近，我沒等駐軍，就帶着六個小夥子出發迎戰。我壓根沒數敵人有多少，它們足有四十個。六個小夥子，只有三個回了家。
Word came of orcs near our hills, and I led six lads out to meet them without waiting for the garrison. I never counted the enemy, and there were forty. Three of the six came home.
聽說奧克到了附近山裏，我沒等駐軍，就帶着六個小夥子出發迎戰。我壓根沒數敵人有多少，它們足有四十個。六個小夥子，只有三個回了家。
Word came of raiders from Rhun near our hills, and I led six lads out to meet them without waiting for the garrison. I never counted the enemy, and there were forty. Three of the six came home.
聽說魯恩劫掠者到了附近山裏，我沒等駐軍，就帶着六個小夥子出發迎戰。我壓根沒數敵人有多少，他們足有四十人。六個小夥子，只有三個回了家。
Word came of raiders from Rhûn near our hills, and I led six lads out to meet them without waiting for the garrison. I never counted the enemy, and there were forty. Three of the six came home.
聽說魯恩劫掠者到了附近山裏，我沒等駐軍，就帶着六個小夥子出發迎戰。我壓根沒數敵人有多少，他們足有四十人。六個小夥子，只有三個回了家。
Word reaches them in time to matter.
消息及時送到，還能派上用場。
Word spreads that pay is late again, and the men are grumbling.
軍餉又遲發的消息傳開了，士兵們滿腹牢騷。
Words can prevent wars, but sometimes steel speaks clearer...
言語能阻止戰爭，但有時武器表達得更清楚……

Worked in Orthanc itself, carrying messages between Saruman and his agents. Trusted position, I saw correspondence with Mordor, with the Dunlendings, with corrupt officials throughout Rohan. Learned valuable secrets about troop movements, alliances, planned operations. Knowledge is power, and I accumulated plenty.
我在歐爾桑克內部辦事，負責在薩茹曼和他的密探之間傳遞消息。那是受信任的位置，所以我看見了他同魔多、同黑蠻地人、同洛汗各地腐敗官員的往來信件。我知道了許多值錢的祕密：部隊調動、聯盟關係、計劃中的行動。知識就是力量，而我積累了很多。
在荊棘堡周圍的開墾地幹活。
Worked the deep mines of the Lonely Mountain.
Worked the forge and the woodcarving bench.
在熔爐和木雕臺邊工作。
Worked the forge in a Ranger settlement.
Worked the iron mines of Mount Dolmed.
在多米德山的鐵礦幹活。
Worked the oasis fields in the heart of Harad.
在哈拉德中心綠洲田地勞作。
Worked the terraces above the Redwater.
在紅水河上方的梯田幹活。
Worked the valley farms near the Sea of Rhun.
在魯恩內海附近山谷農場勞作。
Worked the wine barges of the Redwater.
在紅水河的運酒駁船上幹活。

Working alone and over multiple seasons, you built a complete picture of Thranduil's southern border dispositions. The map that resulted gave Dol Guldur's planners something they had never had before: certainty. The Necromancer's agents used it for two years.
你獨自工作，跨越多個季節，完整掌握了瑟蘭杜伊南部邊境佈防。最終形成的地圖給了多古爾都策劃者前所未有的東西：確定性。死靈法師的代理人用了它兩年。
Wormtongue has destroyed many good men.
格里馬·佞舌毀掉了許多好人。
Would you show me Erebor's deep halls one day?
以後能帶我看看孤山深處的廳堂嗎？
Wove and crafted in the mallorn-city.
在瑁瓏樹城中織造和製作。

Write a [Doctrine] status line to the TAOM log every 5 seconds of battle time: each team's current tactic and every formation's active behaviour and arrangement. The console command taom.tactic_status prints the same line on demand. Nothing is drawn on the HUD.
每5秒戰鬥時間向 TAOM 日誌寫入一條 [Doctrine] 狀態：各隊伍當前戰術，以及各編隊正在執行的行爲和陣型。控制台命令 taom.tactic_status 可以隨時輸出同樣的信息。HUD 上不顯示。

Write a detailed [FieldCommission] trace to the TAOM debug log — which battles counted, which troops earned merit, which offers were raised, and every completed promotion. Turn this on before reproducing a promotion problem so the log you send answers it. Real faults are logged regardless of this setting. Off by default.
將詳細的 [FieldCommission] 信息寫入TAOM調試日誌，包括哪些戰鬥符合條件、哪些兵種獲得功績、提出了哪些晉升建議，以及每次已完成的晉升。請在復現晉升問題前開啓，以便提交的日誌能幫助排查。真正的故障不受此開關影響，始終會記錄。默認關閉。
Write diagnostic [FiefManagement] messages to the TAOM file log. Off = silent.
將 [FiefManagement] 診斷消息寫入TAOM日誌文件。關閉後不記錄。

Write the war elephant howdah's and the mumakil war tower's diagnostics to the TAOM log: why a rider did or did not get a howdah, each platform's layout and floor clearance over its beast, a status line every 5 seconds per platform (beast speed against its walking speed, platform drift, how many archers are seated and how many can reach a target) and a battle summary. Diagnostic only, changes no gameplay. On by default while the platforms are being tested.
把戰象象背戰臺和猛獁戰塔的診斷信息寫入 TAOM 日誌：騎手是否獲得戰臺及其原因、各戰臺的佈局與相對獸背的離地高度、每個戰臺每5秒的狀態（巨獸速度與步行速度的對比、戰臺漂移、弓手就位人數和能攻擊目標的人數），以及戰鬥總結。只用於診斷，不改變玩法。戰臺測試期間默認開啓。
Writes a [FellFoes] line each second something is stopped, held or sent off, and whether held archers really are aiming at you. For checking the feature; leave off in normal play. Default: off.
發生攔停、持續瞄準或清退時，每秒寫入一條[FellFoes]日誌，並記錄持續瞄準的弓兵是否確實在瞄準你。用於檢查功能，正常遊玩時請關閉。默認：關閉。

Writes a [MissionPerf] line to the TAOM debug log every 5 seconds while a mission runs: frames, fps, average / p95 / max frame time in ms, agent and formation counts, garbage collections, and the engine's main-thread and render-thread busy times (mainMs, renderMs). This is the in-mission counterpart of [MemSample] and the measurement an AI or content change is judged against. Cost is one timestamp and one GetMainFps read per frame. Default ON.
任務運行期間，每5秒向TAOM調試日誌寫入一條[MissionPerf]記錄，包括幀數、幀率、平均/P95/最大幀耗時（毫秒）、單位與編隊數量、垃圾回收次數，以及引擎主線程和渲染線程的忙碌時間mainMs、renderMs。它相當於任務內的[MemSample]，也是評估AI或內容改動的性能依據。開銷爲每幀一次時間戳和一次GetMainFps讀取。默認：開啓。

Writes an [AnimMem] line to the TAOM debug log every 5 seconds while a mission runs: how much on-demand animation clip data the engine holds against its 12 MiB budget, whether a clip is loading from disk at the moment of a sample, and how often the total fell between one-second samples (a sign that clips were evicted), plus a summary when the mission ends. Read-only: it finds the two engine values once per game session by a signature check, then once a second reads the clip byte total and asks the engine whether a clip is loading; if the check fails on this game version it turns itself off and says why in the log. Takes effect at the next mission start. Default ON.
任務運行時每5秒寫一條 [AnimMem]：引擎按需加載的動畫數據佔用其12 MiB預算的情況、採樣時是否正從磁盤加載片段，以及每秒採樣之間總佔用下降的次數（表示片段被移出緩存）；任務結束時寫總結。只讀取數據：每次遊戲會話通過特徵碼定位兩個引擎數值，然後每秒讀取片段總字節數，並詢問引擎是否正在加載。若當前遊戲版本校驗失敗，會自動關閉並在日誌中說明。下次任務起生效。默認：開啓。

Writes memory telemetry to the TAOM debug log: a periodic [MemSample] line (process private/working-set MB, managed heap, system commit use/limit, available RAM), a one-shot WARN when system commit headroom runs low, and a [MemStation] line each time a screen opens or closes so growth can be attributed to a screen. This ONE switch governs all three. Independent of the master Battle Load Diagnostics toggle: this is session-wide crash forensics, not battle-load phase logging. Default ON.
向TAOM調試日誌寫入內存數據：定期記錄 [MemSample]，包括進程專用內存和工作集MB、託管堆、系統已提交內存用量和上限、可用物理內存；系統可提交內存餘量不足時記錄一次WARN；每次打開或關閉界面時記錄 [MemStation]，以便定位哪個界面導致內存增長。此開關同時控制以上三項。它獨立於戰鬥加載診斷總開關，用於整個遊戲運行期間的崩潰排查，而不只是記錄戰鬥加載階段。默認開啓。
Writes one [ScreenOpen] line per screen open to taom_debug.log, naming the screen, the phase and the milliseconds it took. Use it to compare a Fast Open switch off against on. Default OFF.
每次打開界面時，向taom_debug.log寫入一條[ScreenOpen]記錄，註明界面名稱、階段及耗時毫秒數。可用於對比快速打開功能開關前後的表現。默認：關閉。

Writes one log line for every wave of abilities and every phase change (active, spent, ready). Off, the log still gets a summary every 30 s of activity and at the end of each battle. For checking that the abilities work; leave off in normal play.
每波能力和每次階段切換（生效、已消耗、就緒）都寫一條日誌。關閉後仍會在活躍期間每30秒和戰鬥結束時寫總結。用於檢查能力是否正常，平時遊玩建議關閉。

Writes the detailed load-time lines to the TAOM debug log: one [PatchApply] line per Harmony patch group with its apply time (written at game initialization), [LoadPhase] steps of TAOM's game start and game initialization, and [Lifecycle] lines timing every campaign handler of a new game, a loaded save and the session start (a line for each handler taking 10 ms or more, and a total per event). The per-type [LoadXml] lines, the patch phase totals and one [Lifecycle] dispatch line per campaign dispatch are always written. Costs a few microseconds per handler while a campaign loads and nothing during play. Default OFF.

向 TAOM 調試日誌寫詳細加載耗時：遊戲初始化時，每個 Harmony 補丁組一條 [PatchApply]；TAOM 遊戲啓動和初始化各階段的 [LoadPhase]；新遊戲、載入存檔和會話開始時，每個至少耗時10毫秒的戰役處理器一條 [Lifecycle]，並記錄各事件總耗時。按類型的 [LoadXml]、補丁階段總耗時，以及每次戰役事件派發的一條 [Lifecycle] 始終都會記錄。加載戰役時，每個處理器增加幾微秒開銷，遊玩期間無開銷。默認：關閉。
Writes two diagnostic lines, the auto-assigned default layout and the cycled layout, to the TAOM log file. Nothing is shown on the HUD.
向TAOM日誌寫入兩條診斷記錄，分別記錄自動分配的默認編隊方案和切換後的方案。不會在戰鬥界面上顯示任何內容。
Wulf Celmunding leads riders of the northern valleys.
伍爾夫·凱爾蒙丁率領北部山谷的騎手。
Wulfwynn is daughter of Marhath, a skilled rider.
伍爾夫溫是馬爾哈思的女兒，也是一名熟練騎手。
懷恩德里·德阿弗林加斯
威蘇因訓練年輕的瓦里亞格騎手。
瓦爾伯格是埃勒的妻子。
Yagûl carries word between Barad-dur and the Morgul Vale, and has seen the inside of the Tower more than once.
雅古爾往返於巴拉督爾和魔古爾山谷之間傳遞消息，已不止一次進過邪黑塔。
Yamina is wife to the archer commander.
雅米娜是弓手統領的妻子。
Yana is a noble of Gûrtilm's host.
雅那是古爾提姆軍中的一位貴族。
Years at isolated posts forge you like iron. +5 health.
多年駐守偏遠哨所，讓你變得像鋼鐵一樣堅韌。+5 生命值。
Years of lonely watch service make you tough as old wood. +6 health.
多年孤獨的守望，讓你像老樹一樣堅韌。+6 生命值。
Yesugen of House Kalkian is a proud woman of the Easterlings, mistress of hearth and granary and no stranger to the horse and the bow.
卡爾基安家族的也速幹是一位驕傲的東夷女子。她掌管家務和糧倉，對騎馬和射箭也不陌生。
Yesum is heir to the Amdûrid holdings.
也蘇木是阿姆杜裏德家族領地的繼承人。

Yet its spirit endures through those who remember. In Rivendell's forges, I learned to blend ancient techniques with new purpose. Every blade I craft carries the legacy of Gondolin - beauty and function united, as Glorfindel once taught.
但它的精神仍由記得它的人延續。在幽谷的熔爐中，我學會把古老技藝與新的目標結合。每一柄我打造的刀劍都承載着剛多林的遺產，美與實用合而爲一，正如格羅芬德爾曾教導的那樣。
Yosma of House Kalkian is a proud woman of the Easterlings, mistress of hearth and granary and no stranger to the horse and the bow.
卡爾基安家族的約斯瑪是一位驕傲的東夷女子。她掌管家務和糧倉，對騎馬和射箭也不陌生。
You accompanied Lindon's loremasters on their journeys, learning diplomacy, persuasion, and the art of leadership among the free peoples.
你陪同林頓的博學者四處旅行，學習外交、說服他人的技巧，以及如何領導自由人民。
You accompanied Rivendell's loremasters on their journeys, learning diplomacy, persuasion, and the art of leadership among the free peoples.
你陪同幽谷學識大師遠行，在自由人民之間學習外交、說服和領導之道。

You accompanied the Elven wardens on their long circuits around the valley's hidden paths, learning to read the forest and loose an arrow before your quarry heard you coming. The valley's peace was hard-won and you helped keep it.
你陪同精靈守衛沿山谷隱祕小徑進行漫長巡邏，學習讀懂森林，並在獵物聽見你之前放箭。山谷的和平來之不易，而你也幫忙守住了它。
You accompanied trading caravans between Erebor and Dale, learning the ways of commerce and the art of defending valuable cargo.
你護送往來孤山與河谷邦之間的商隊，學習貿易門道，也學習如何保護貴重貨物。
You adapted western farming methods to the valley settlement and tripled its yield.
你把西方耕作方法用於山谷聚落，使產量增加到三倍。
You aim for the gaps in every enemy's armour. +10% armour penetration.
你瞄準每個敵人護甲上的縫隙。+10% 破甲。
You already carry the best kit my stores can issue.
你現在帶着的，已經是我的庫存能發放的最好裝備了。
You already field as many heroes as you may.
你派出的英雄數量已達上限。
You already have your orders. See them done first.
你已經領到命令了，先把它辦完。
You and your horse move 15 percent faster.
你和坐騎的移動速度提高15%。
You answered the call! +{influence} influence, +{relation} relation.
你響應了號召！影響力+{influence}，關係+{relation}。
You appear where least expected. +10% stealth bonus.
你會出現在敵人最想不到的地方。+10% 潛行加成。

You apprenticed among the healers of Lothlórien, gathering athelas and learning the lore of herb and wound under the instruction of those who had practiced the art for centuries. The Lady's grace touched all healing within those borders.
你在洛絲羅瑞恩醫者身邊當學徒，採集阿夕拉斯，並向已經行醫數百年的師長學習草藥和傷口知識。在這片邊境之內，夫人的恩典觸及每一次醫治。

You apprenticed in the workshops of Dale, famous for metalwork and the fine articles that traders carried far south. A craftsman's hands and a craftsman's pride became yours, along with a blade sharp enough to keep them.
你在河谷邦工坊當學徒；這裏以金屬工藝和被商人帶往南方的精美物件聞名。工匠的雙手和工匠的驕傲成了你的東西，也有一把足夠鋒利的刀保護它們。
You are a mountain that walks. +6 health.
你就像一座會行走的山。+6 生命值。
You are able to control your warg again!
You are always first to strike and first to vanish. +5% movement speed.
你總是第一個出手，也總是第一個消失。+5% 移動速度。
You are away on orders — ride to him yourself.
你正奉命在外，請自己騎馬去找他。
You are bleeding on the road. I know a wound when I see one, and a lost cause too...
你一路都在滴血。我看得出傷勢，也看得出還有沒有救……
You are bound to military service.
You are camped before the walls with {COMMANDER}'s company.
你與{COMMANDER}的部隊在城牆前紮營。
You are found asleep at your post. It is noted.
你在崗上睡覺被人發現，已經記了一筆。
You are introduced to {COUNT} more {?IS_PLURAL}notables{?}notable{\?} here.
有人將你介紹給本地另外{COUNT}{?IS_PLURAL}位要人{?}位要人{\?}。
You are now {HERO}, but part of the handover did not finish. See the log.
你現在開始扮演{HERO}，但角色交接未能全部完成。詳情請查看日誌。
You are the finest shot in all of Rhovanion. +9 health.
你是整個羅瓦尼安最出色的射手。生命值+9。
You are the finest shot in all of Rohan. +9 health.
你是洛汗全境最優秀的射手。+9 生命值。
You are the last line between civilisation and darkness. River Navigator radius +5.
你是文明與黑暗之間的最後一道防線。河道巡守作用範圍 +5。
You are the last line between civilisation and darkness. Stand Fast radius +5.
你是文明與黑暗之間的最後一道防線。堅守不退作用範圍+5。
You are too badly wounded to review the host.
你的傷勢太重，無法檢閱部隊。
You are wounded. The column fights on without you, and no one will hold it against you.
你受傷了，隊伍會繼續作戰，不會有人因此責怪你。
You ask me to betray my whole people. I will name no fortress of my realm.
你要我背叛自己的人民。我不會告訴你本國任何一座要塞的位置。
You ask me to sell my own blood. I will name no hall of my kin.
你要我出賣自己的親人。我不會告訴你他們任何一處廳堂的位置。

You assisted in tallying Erebor's vast wealth from an early age, learning to manage ledgers and understand the logistics of supplying a mountain kingdom. The work made you methodical and gave you a strategist's eye for resources.
你從小協助清點孤山龐大財富，學會管理賬冊，也理解供養山中王國所需的後勤。這樣的工作讓你做事有條理，也給了你以資源看待局勢的戰略眼光。
You attack from concealment for maximum effect. +13% stealth bonus.
你從隱蔽處發動攻擊，給敵人最沉重的打擊。+13% 潛行加成。
You balanced the hoard-reckoning after years of discrepancy.
你理清了多年對不上的寶庫賬目。
You balanced the treasury accounts after years of discrepancy.
你平衡了多年不符的寶庫賬目。
You barely need a reason to smash. Hammer Down charge cost -30.
你幾乎不需要理由就會開砸。重錘壓頂充能消耗 -30。
You barely need to unleash the rage -- it is ever-present. Bloodrage charge cost -30.
你幾乎不用主動釋放怒火，因爲它始終都在。嗜血狂怒充能消耗 -30。
You barred the gate on your own people and called it arithmetic.
把自己的百姓關在門外，也叫算賬？
You beat your own and lost the forge. Fine work.
打自己人，丟了鍛坊，真是好本事。
You became a Shadow Skirmisher, harassing the enemy with thrown weapons and quick strikes before melting back into the darkness.
你成爲陰影散兵，用投擲武器和快速襲擊騷擾敵人，然後再退回黑暗之中。
You became a member of Isengard's formidable pikemen, learning to fight in tight formations that could break any cavalry charge.
你成爲艾森加德強悍長槍兵的一員，學會在緊密陣形中作戰，足以擊破任何騎兵衝鋒。
You became a warden of the trees, defending the heart of Lothlorien with spear and sword in the ancient Elven tradition.
你成爲樹木守衛，按照古老精靈傳統，用長矛和刀劍保衛洛絲羅瑞恩的核心。
You became one of the Spear Brothers of Dunland, learning to fight in tight formations with spear and shield.
你成爲黑蠻地長矛兄弟之一，學習在緊密陣形中持矛盾作戰。
You break through plate with sheer violence. +5% armour penetration.
你用純粹的暴力撕開板甲。+5% 破甲。
You bring them back to the column. Most of them walking.
你把他們帶回了部隊，大多數人還能自己走。
You broke a Dunlending raid that struck the Westfold in early autumn.
你擊潰了一場初秋襲擊西伏爾德的黑蠻地劫掠。
You broke a Wainrider raid that struck the Northmark in early autumn.
你擊退了初秋襲擊北境的戰車民。
You broke a band of fences working the Forest Road.
你搗毀了在密林路上活動的銷贓團伙。
You broke a company to feed your own vengeance.
爲了報你自己的仇，你毀了一整隊人。
You broke a guest's jaw over a word about your steel.
客人說了你們的鋼一句，你就打斷了他的下巴。
You broke a ring of goblin fences at the Old Ford.
你搗毀了老渡口的一個半獸人銷贓團伙。
You broke a truce. What is your word worth now?
你毀了停戰約定，如今你的承諾還值什麼？
You broke through the Elven outer watch and took a prisoner for questioning.
你突破精靈外圍守望，抓回一名囚犯審問。
You broke your company to feed your own revenge.
爲了報你自己的仇，你毀了一整隊人。
You broke your council's word for a doomed cause.
你爲了一場註定失敗的事業，違抗議會。

You brought Beornings, Woodmen and the Elves of Mirkwood to one table and settled the tolls at the Old Ford, so that honey and timber crossed the river without a quarrel. Grimbeorn's steward does not forget who filled the storehouses.
你讓貝奧恩一族、林中居民和黑森林精靈坐到同一張桌前，談妥老渡口的通行費用，讓蜂蜜和木材能順利過河，不再爲此爭吵。格里姆貝奧恩的總管不會忘記，是誰裝滿了倉庫。
You brought a woodward patrol out of a spider-hollow.
你把一支林道巡邏隊帶出了蜘蛛盤踞的山坳。
You brought in the harvest of Minhiriath before the floods.
你趕在洪水前收回了明希瑞亞斯的莊稼。
You brought in the harvest of the North Downs under threat of wolves.
你頂着狼羣的威脅，收回了北崗的莊稼。
You brought the flocks down from the fells before the snows.
你趕在落雪前，把羊羣從高地帶了下來。
You built the clan hall that replaced the one burned by Rohirrim.
你建起了取代被洛希爾人燒燬舊廳的新氏族大廳。
You built the great press of Vineholm.
你建造了葡萄洲的大型壓榨機。
You can take 35 percent more punishment before you fall.
你在倒下前能多承受35%的傷害。

只有當前控制的角色倒下後，才能接管士兵。

狂怒尚未平息，無法進入觀望之椅。
