就爲了個外號，你讓幾個孩子去打四十個奧克。

You toiled from dawn to dusk in the rich farmland outside the city walls, hauling sheaves and driving oxen across the Pelennor. When the levy was called you were handed a spear and drilled in formation by a gruff veteran of the border wars.
你從清晨到黃昏都在城牆外肥沃農田中勞作，搬運禾捆，趕着公牛穿過佩蘭諾。徵召令下達時，你被塞進一支長矛，在一名粗聲粗氣的邊境戰爭老兵手下操練陣形。
You took another choice on this path.
你已經在這條路線上選擇了其他選項。
You took another keystone in this tier.
你已經在這一層選擇了其他核心技能。
You took the axe among the household men of Beorn's Hall, learning to fight shoulder to shoulder with spear and blade in the yard under the chieftain's eye.
你在貝奧恩大廳的親隨中拿起戰斧，在酋長的注視下，於院場中學習用矛和刀劍並肩作戰。
You took the spear in the household guard of Woodmen-town, learning to stand shoulder to shoulder in the narrow ways between the trees, where a line of spears stops what a charge cannot.
你在林中居民鎮的親衛中拿起長矛，學會在樹木之間的狹道上並肩站穩。在那裏，一排長矛能擋住單靠衝鋒擋不住的敵人。
You took your place among the Spear Guard of the Woodland Realm, learning to fight in disciplined formations beneath the forest canopy.
你在林地王國槍衛中站穩位置，學會在森林樹冠下以嚴整陣形作戰。
You took your place in Dale's shieldwall, learning to stand firm with spear and shield against any enemy that threatened the city.
你在河谷邦盾牆中站穩位置，學習用長矛和盾牌堅定抵禦任何威脅城市的敵人。
You took your place in the spear-line of Vinewatch, learning to stand firm with spear and shield against the riders who come up out of the east.
你站進葡萄哨站的長矛陣線，學會用矛和盾穩穩守住陣地，抵擋從東方而來的騎兵。
You track prey for days without rest. +5 health.
你能連續數日追蹤獵物而不休息。+5 生命值。
You tracked a Dwarven scouting party for four days and brought back their maps.
你追蹤一支矮人偵察隊四天，並帶回他們的地圖。
You tracked a band of orcs on the Dwarf-road back to its lair.
你沿矮人路追蹤一羣奧克，找到了他們的巢穴。
You tracked an Orc raiding band back to its lair and marked it for the guard.
你追蹤一支奧克劫掠隊找到巢穴，並標記給守軍。
You tracked and destroyed an Orc warband that had been preying on the North Downs settlements.
你追蹤並摧毀了長期襲擊北崗聚落的奧克戰幫。
You tracked and killed a deserter that three patrols had failed to find.
你追蹤並殺死一個三支巡邏隊都沒找到的逃兵。

You tracked prey across the blasted volcanic flats of Gorgoroth, learning to read ash-trails and navigate by the glow of distant fires. There was little to hunt, and what little there was fought back. You came home lean and sharp-eyed.
你在戈堝洛斯被毀壞的火山平地上追蹤獵物，學會讀懂灰燼中的蹤跡，也學會靠遠方火光辨認方向。那裏沒什麼可獵，而僅有的獵物也會反擊。你回來時更瘦，也更目光銳利。
You tracked the Isengard scouts that were mapping Helm's Deep approaches.
你追蹤到正在測繪海爾姆深谷入口的艾森加德斥候。
You tracked the scouts mapping the approaches to Westmark.
你追蹤到了測繪通往西境路線的斥候。

You tracked through the corrupted undergrowth of southern Mirkwood, killing any creature that came too close to the fortress and learning to move without making a sound in a forest that twisted every trail. Your eyes adjusted to a world without sunlight.
你穿過黑森林南部腐化灌木追蹤，殺掉任何靠近要塞的生物，並學會在每條小路都會扭曲的森林中無聲行動。你的眼睛適應了沒有陽光的世界。
You trained a company of raw recruits into a disciplined infantry unit.
你把一隊新兵訓練成紀律嚴明的步兵。
You trained alongside Harad's mighty war elephants, learning to ride and fight from their towering backs under the blazing southern sun.
你與哈拉德強大的戰象一同訓練，在灼熱南方太陽下學習騎乘這些巨獸並從高背上作戰。

You trained among the banner-warriors of the Black Serpent's household, learning to fight from horseback and wield the heavy blade in the heat of the southern sun. Every drill ended with the promise of the north, and the glory that awaited Harad's warriors there.
你在黑蛇家中的旗幟戰士之間訓練，學習在南方烈日下騎馬作戰並使用重刃。每次操練結束，都會有人許諾北方和等待哈拉德戰士的榮耀。
You trained as a rider for Saruman's forces, learning to control Wargs and strike with devastating speed across the plains.
你作爲薩茹曼軍隊的騎手受訓，學會控制座狼，並在平原上以毀滅性的速度發起打擊。

You trained as a war-rider of Rhun, learning mounted combat in the wide steppe tradition from elders whose fathers had ridden against Gondor under the red dawn banner. The great eastern plains were your practice ground and the horse your most trusted weapon.
你作爲魯恩戰騎手受訓，向父輩曾在紅色黎明旗幟下對剛鐸出征的長者學習廣闊草原傳統中的騎戰。東方大平原是你的練武場，馬是你最信任的武器。
You trained as part of Erebor's vanguard, mastering the two-handed axe and polearm in the disciplined dwarven battle formations.
你作爲孤山先鋒接受訓練，在紀律嚴明的矮人戰陣中掌握雙手斧和長柄武器。

You trained in the close-quarters style of the Broadbeams of Belegost, learning to brace a shield and swing an axe in tight tunnel formations. Your short stride was an advantage in the corridors where taller folk stumbled.
你接受貝烈戈斯特寬梁族的近戰訓練，學會在狹窄隧道的緊密隊形裏撐穩盾牌、揮動斧頭。那些高個子在走廊裏容易磕絆，你步子小，反倒佔了便宜。

You trained in the disciplined close-quarters style of Dain Ironfoot's warriors, learning to brace a shield and swing an axe in tight tunnel formations. Your short stride was an advantage in the corridors where taller folk stumbled.
你接受鐵足戴因戰士紀律嚴明的近身戰訓練，學會在狹窄隧道陣形中穩住盾牌並揮斧。你的短步幅在高個子容易絆倒的走廊裏反而成了優勢。

You trained in the disciplined spear formations that served under the Black Serpent banner, learning to hold position in the merciless desert heat and advance in step with warriors sworn to carry the war into the north.
你在黑蛇旗幟下服役的紀律長矛陣列中受訓，學會在無情沙漠酷熱中堅守位置，並與那些誓要把戰爭帶往北方的戰士整步推進。

You trained in the lightless courtyards of the Necromancer's fortress, learning to fight with halberd and great blade under the eye of hooded overseers. The shadow that lay across the place seeped into your bones and sharpened your instincts for violence.
你在死靈法師要塞無光庭院中訓練，在兜帽監工眼下學習用戟和巨刃作戰。籠罩此地的陰影滲進你的骨頭，也磨利了你對暴力的本能。

You trained in the punishing heat of the southern deserts, learning to hold formation with axe and spear in the relentless fashion of the Haradrim footmen. Endurance under the sun was prized above all other qualities.
你在南方沙漠懲罰般的酷熱中訓練，學習像哈拉德步兵那樣以斧和矛保持陣形。能在烈日下堅持，比其他一切品質都更受重視。
You trained in the vanguard of the Broadbeams, mastering the long spear and the two-handed axe in the close formations of the dwarven host.
你在寬梁族先鋒中訓練，在矮人大軍的緊密隊形裏，練熟長矛和雙手斧。
You trained with the Warg riders of Mount Gundabad, learning to control the savage beasts through the treacherous mountain passes and to strike with lance and spear from their backs.
你與貢達巴德山的座狼騎手一同訓練，學會在險惡山口中控制兇暴野獸，並從它們背上用騎槍和長矛發動攻擊。
You trained with the Warg riders of the Ered Luin, learning to control the savage beasts through the treacherous mountain passes and to strike with lance and spear from their backs.
你與埃瑞德路因的座狼騎手一同受訓，學會駕馭這些兇獸穿越險惡的山口，並從狼背上用騎槍和長矛發動攻擊。
You trained with the Warg riders of the High Pass, learning to control the savage beasts through the treacherous mountain passes and to strike with lance and spear from their backs.
你與高隘口的座狼騎手一同受訓，學會駕馭這些兇獸穿越險惡的山口，並從狼背上用騎槍和長矛發動攻擊。
You trained with the Warg riders of the Misty Mountains, learning to control the savage beasts through the treacherous mountain passes and to strike with lance and spear from their backs.
你與迷霧山脈的座狼騎手一同受訓，學會駕馭這些兇獸穿越險惡的山口，並從狼背上用騎槍和長矛發動攻擊。
You trained with the famed archers of Lothlorien, learning to send arrows with deadly precision from the platforms among the mallorn trees.
你與洛絲羅瑞恩著名弓手一同訓練，學習從瑁瓏樹間的平臺上以致命精準射出箭矢。
You trained with the ferocious Uruk-hai, learning their brutal close-quarters fighting style and building endurance through grueling drills.
你與兇悍的烏魯克一同訓練，學習他們殘酷的近身戰法，並在艱苦操練中錘鍊耐力。

You trained with the lake-shore militia, learning to fight with thrown weapons and sword in defense of the settlements that straddled the trade route between Dale and the south. Commerce and combat were equally part of daily life.
你與湖岸民兵一同訓練，學習用投擲武器和刀劍保衛橫跨河谷邦與南方貿易路線的聚落。貿易和戰鬥同樣是日常生活的一部分。
You trained with the levy of the vineyards, learning to hurl javelins from between the vines and to close with the sword when raiders broke through the rows.
你隨葡萄園的徵召軍訓練，學習從葡萄藤之間投擲標槍；劫掠者衝破一排排葡萄藤時，就拔劍近戰。

You trained with the young warriors of the Woodland King's household, learning to move and fight among the great beeches beneath the mountain halls. The court was demanding, and you were expected to be as sharp with words as with your blade.
你與林地王家中的年輕戰士一同訓練，學習在山中廳堂下方的巨大山毛櫸之間移動和戰鬥。王庭要求嚴苛，你既要刀劍鋒利，也要言辭鋒利。

You traveled the blazing caravan routes of Harad, bartering exotic goods at the desert market towns and learning the art of persuasion from hard-bitten merchants who had crossed the Sunlands many times. The road taught you more than any hall could.
你走過哈拉德熾熱的商隊路線，在沙漠集鎮上交換異域貨物，也從多次穿越太陽地的老練商人那裏學會說服之道。道路教你的東西比任何大廳都多。

You traveled the commerce routes between the Sea of Rhun and the western lands, learning to deal with merchants of many peoples and to charm your way through disputes. The eastern roads were dangerous and your tongue had to be sharper than any sword.
你行走在魯恩內海與西方土地之間的貿易路線，學會與許多民族的商人打交道，也學會靠談吐化解爭端。東方道路危險，你的舌頭必須比任何劍都鋒利。

You traveled with the wandering tribes, learning to navigate by stars and read the subtle signs of the desert. Your bow was your most reliable tool, and the vast open Sunlands taught you to sight a target long before it sighted you.
你與遊蕩部族同行，學習靠星辰辨路，也學習讀懂沙漠細微跡象。弓是你最可靠的工具，而遼闊開闊的太陽地教會你在目標發現你之前先看見它。
You turned a Rohirrim spy into a double agent working for Isengard.
你把一名洛希爾間諜策反成艾森加德雙面間諜。
You turned a losing supply route into the most profitable road in the Dark Land.
你把一條虧損補給線變成黑暗之地最賺錢的道路。
You uncovered a band of barrow-robbers working out of Bree.
你查出了一個以布理爲據點的盜墓團伙。
You uncovered a band of barrow-robbers working out of Tharbad.
你查出了一個以沙巴德爲據點的盜墓團伙。
You uncovered a band of troll-hoard robbers working out of the Last Bridge.
你查出了一個以最後大橋爲據點、偷盜食人妖寶藏的團伙。
You uncovered a smuggling ring operating out of the lower city.
你查出一個從下城區活動的走私團伙。
You united three feuding clans against a Rohirrim punitive expedition.
你聯合三個互相爭鬥的氏族，共同抵禦洛希爾懲罰遠征。
You use every fold of ground to your advantage. +13% stealth bonus.
你能利用每一處地形起伏。+13% 潛行加成。
You vanish into Mordor's dark. Sneak-Creeping radius +3.
你消失在魔多的黑暗之中。潛行突進作用範圍 +3。
You ventured into the wild lands around Erebor, tracking Orcs and wolves and safeguarding the mountain's approaches.
你深入孤山周邊荒野，追蹤奧克和狼，守護通往山中的道路。
You wait for the perfect moment to strike. +6% ranged damage.
你會等待最完美的出手時機。+6% 遠程傷害。
You walk the old drovers' road, and the old drovers' road is ours. Coin, or your blood in the heather. Choose quickly, the weather is turning.
你走的是趕牲口的老路，這條路歸我們管。要麼交錢，要麼把血灑在石楠叢裏。快選，天要變了。

You walked the outer marches of Lothlórien, learning to spot the signs of Orc incursion at the Dimrill Dale passes. Long days of silent observation followed by sudden action shaped you into a hunter as patient as the wood and as quick as the arrow.
你行走在洛絲羅瑞恩外圍邊境，學習在黯溪谷山口發現奧克入侵的跡象。漫長沉默觀察之後的突然行動，把你塑造成像森林一樣耐心、像箭一樣迅捷的獵手。
You wandered the open grass without clan or hold to call your own, learning to live by wit and trade, and to read a stranger before he reached your fire.
你在開闊草原上游蕩，沒有可歸屬的家族，也沒有自己的要塞。你學會靠頭腦與買賣謀生，也學會在陌生人走到你的火堆前，就看出對方是什麼人。

You wandered the wild grasslands of the Wold without clan or hold to call your own, learning to survive on what the plains offered and occasionally on what other people had not hidden well enough. Cunning kept you fed when luck would not.
你沒有可稱爲自家的氏族或領地，在北高原荒草地中游蕩，學習靠平原賜予的一切活下去，有時也靠別人沒藏好的東西活下去。運氣不幫你時，狡猾能讓你喫上飯。
You want an axe that will not shatter at the first blow? Good. Most do not know to ask.
想要一把砍第一下就不會碎的斧頭？好，多數人連問都不知道問。
You want me to win the tourney?
你想讓我贏下競技大賽？
You want the truth of it? Few do. But I have never learned to lie comfortably, so listen.
你想聽真話？很少有人想聽。但我一直不擅長舒服地撒謊，所以聽好。
你想讓他們見識真正的戰鬥？
You warned Imladris of a Troll encampment before it threatened the Ford.
你在食人妖營地威脅渡口前向伊姆拉綴斯示警。
You warned Mithlond of a Troll encampment before it threatened the Ford.
你在食人妖營地威脅到渡口之前，就向米斯瀧德發出了警告。
You went after your own. Few captains would.
你去救自己人，沒幾個隊長肯這樣做。
You went up and down the Anduin with the river-traders, minding boats and cargo, and learned how to pass a toll, a watchman and a doubtful stranger.
你隨河上商人沿安都因河往返，照看船隻與貨物，學會應付過路費、守衛，還有心存疑慮的陌生人。
You went up and down the Forest Road with a pack of knives, thread and honey-cakes, and learned how to pass a hungry stranger, a toll-warden and a doubtful bargain.
你揹着小刀、線和蜜餅，沿密林路往返，學會應付飢餓的陌生人、收路費的守衛，以及拿不準的買賣。
You went up and down the Redwater and across the Sea of Rhûn with the wine barges, minding casks and learning how to pass a toll, a watchman and a doubtful buyer.
你隨運酒駁船沿紅水河往返，駛過魯恩內海，照看酒桶，也學會應付過路費、守衛和心存疑慮的買家。

You went with the caravans that moved between Dale, Erebor, and the southern kingdoms, learning the arts of commerce, survival on the road, and the opportunism that made some traders very successful and others very sorry.
你隨往來河谷邦、孤山和南方諸國的商隊行動，學習貿易、路上求生，以及讓有些商人發達、有些商人後悔不已的投機手段。

You were admitted to the court of Thranduil, learning the diplomatic arts and the songs of the Woodland Elves under the tutelage of those who had sung since the first age of stars. The Elvenking's hall demanded as much from the tongue as from the sword-arm.
你獲准進入瑟蘭杜伊的王庭，跟隨那些從羣星初升時就開始歌唱的精靈，學習外交技巧和森林精靈的歌謠。在精靈王的殿堂裏，口才和劍術同樣重要。
You were among the berserkers of Blue Craig, learning to fight with reckless fury and overwhelming force.
你曾是藍巖狂戰士中的一員，學會用不顧生死的狂怒和壓倒性的蠻力作戰。
You were among the berserkers of Goblin-town, learning to fight with reckless fury and overwhelming force.
你曾是半獸人鎮狂戰士中的一員，學會用不顧生死的狂怒和壓倒性的蠻力作戰。
You were among the berserkers of Gundabad, learning to fight with reckless fury and overwhelming force.
你曾是貢達巴德狂戰士之一，學習以不顧一切的怒火和壓倒性力量作戰。
You were among the berserkers of the Misty Mountains, learning to fight with reckless fury and overwhelming force.
你曾是迷霧山脈狂戰士中的一員，學會用不顧生死的狂怒和壓倒性的蠻力作戰。

You were among the hunters tasked with keeping the great spiders from the Woodland Realm's heart, learning to lay snares and ambushes in the dark undergrowth and to strike with knife and hurled blade before the creatures could close with you.
你曾是負責阻止巨蛛接近林地王國核心的獵手之一，學會在黑暗灌木中設置繩套和伏擊，也學會在那些怪物逼近前用短刀和飛刃先發制人。

You were apprenticed to one of the Dunedain healers who kept the knowledge of Westernesse alive in the north, learning to identify plants and treat wounds with the resources the wild lands offered. Wisdom and practical knowledge were equally revered.
你拜一位杜內丹醫者爲師；他們在北方保存着西方之地的知識。你學習辨認植物，也學習用荒野能提供的資源治療傷口。智慧和實用知識同樣受尊重。

You were blooded in the torch-lit training halls of the mountain stronghold, learning to ride hard and swing heavy weapons in the tradition of the northern Orc clans. Status came to those who could prove themselves in the pit before their elders.
你在山中堡壘火把照亮的訓練廳裏見了血，按照北方奧克氏族傳統學習猛騎和揮舞重型武器。能在長輩面前先於鬥坑中證明自己的人，才配得到地位。
You were born to this saddle. +9 health.
你是天生的騎手。+9 生命值。

You were cast out or wandered off, spending your formative years on the margins of Dunlending society, picking up work and trouble in equal measure. You learned that a well-aimed throw or a convincing lie could open doors that no clan-badge would.
你被驅逐，或自己離開，在黑蠻地社會邊緣度過成長歲月，工作和麻煩都撿了不少。你學會一記準準的投擲或一個可信的謊言，能打開氏族徽記打不開的門。
You were chosen to train with the elite Warg Riders of Mordor, learning to control the fearsome beasts and strike terror into the hearts of the enemy.
你被選中與魔多精銳座狼騎手一同訓練，學會控制這些可怕野獸，把恐懼打進敵人心裏。

You were given a club and a corner of the yard and told to keep the work gangs in line. You learned fast how to read a crowd and where to hit to get compliance without killing. Strategy and brutality became second nature.
你被塞了一根棍子和院子一角，命令你把工隊管住。你很快學會如何看懂人羣，也學會打哪裏既能讓人服從，又不至於把人打死。謀略和殘暴成了你的本能。

You were neither soldier nor slave, moving on the shadowed margins of Mordor's great army — stealing what you could, trading information, and learning which officers were bribeable and which were better avoided. Cunning was the only currency you trusted.
你既不是士兵，也不是奴隸，而是在魔多大軍陰影邊緣活動。你偷能偷的東西，交易情報，也學會分辨哪些軍官可以收買，哪些最好繞着走。你唯一信得過的貨幣就是狡猾。

You were put to work in the pits as soon as you were strong enough, breaking rock and hauling spoil to feed Saruman's endless construction. The work built your endurance past what most men's bodies could bear.
你剛有力氣就被送進深坑幹活，破石、搬渣，供養薩茹曼無休止的建設。這樣的工作把你的耐力推到多數人身體承受不了的程度。

You were quick-fingered and clever enough to be used as a courier and informant in the grey world of Saruman's spy networks. You learned how much a secret was worth and how much pain it cost to keep one.
你手快又聰明，因此被薩茹曼的間諜網絡當作信使和線人使用。你學會一個祕密值多少錢，也學會保守祕密要付出多少痛苦。
You were right to hold the maker responsible.
造劍的人也該負責，你沒做錯。
You were right, and they should have listened.
你說得對，他們該聽你的。

You were run through brutal drills in the packed-earth yards of Isengard, learning to wield halberd and two-hander under the eyes of Uruk-hai sergeants. Saruman's forces trained without mercy, and softness was driven out of you fast.
你在艾森加德踩實的泥土操場上經歷殘酷操練，在烏魯克軍士眼下學習使用戟和雙手武器。薩茹曼的軍隊訓練毫不留情，軟弱很快就被你身上剝離。

You were schooled in the martial arts of Dale, learning to ride and wield heavy weapons under the instruction of Brand's household guard. The rebuilt city was prosperous and proud, and its soldiers were expected to match its reputation.
你在布蘭德家中衛隊指導下學習河谷邦武藝，練習騎乘和使用重型武器。重建後的城市繁榮而自豪，它的士兵也被要求配得上這份名聲。
You were sent as a scout and spy, ranging across the lands to gather intelligence for Saruman's war machine.
你作爲斥候和間諜被派往各地，爲薩茹曼的戰爭機器收集情報。

You were sent into the twisted undergrowth of southern Mirkwood to track and eliminate those who strayed near the Necromancer's domain, learning to stalk quarry through corrupted forest without making a sound or leaving a print.
你被派進黑森林南部扭曲的灌木深處，追蹤並清除靠近死靈法師領地的人，學會在腐化森林中無聲追獵，不留下腳印。
You were spotted by {ENEMY} before you could strike - attack anyway?
你還沒動手就被{ENEMY}發現了，仍要進攻嗎？
You were stationed at Orthanc, manning the crossbows and defending the breeding pits from any who would oppose Saruman's will.
你駐守歐爾桑克，操作弩弓，守衛育兵深坑，抵擋任何反對薩茹曼意志的人。

You were stationed on the watchtowers and walls of Mordor's black fortresses, scanning the horizon for movement and directing fire on any who approached. The post suited those who could think as well as shoot.
你駐守在魔多黑色要塞的瞭望塔和城牆上，盯着地平線尋找動靜，並指揮火力打擊任何接近者。這個崗位適合既會思考也會射擊的人。

You were taken in hand by the Rangers of the North while still young, learning to move through the wild lands of Eriador in silence and track enemies across ruined Arnor. The Rangers asked little and demanded everything, and you learned to give it.
你年紀還小時，就被北方遊民帶在身邊，學習在埃利阿多荒野中悄無聲息地行進，在阿爾諾的廢墟間追蹤敵人。遊民們不向你索取太多東西，要求的卻是你全心全意的付出。你也學會了這麼做。

You were taken into the company of the Dunedain Rangers, learning to ride hard through the ruins of Arnor and fight with the disciplined ferocity of the Heirs of Isildur. The Rangers rode far and told little to any they met on the road.
你被納入杜內丹遊俠隊伍，學會在阿爾諾廢墟中疾馳，並以伊熙爾杜後裔的嚴明和兇猛作戰。遊俠騎得很遠，卻很少對路上遇見的人多說什麼。

You were taken to sea young, learning to hand a sail and fight with the cutlass and boarding axe of the Corsair tradition. The deck of a warship was your training ground, and the Anduin Delta was your proving ground.
你年紀很小時就被帶上海，學習掌帆，也學習海盜傳統中的彎刀和登船斧。戰船甲板是你的訓練場，安都因三角洲則是你的試煉地。

You were thrown into the pit-fighting yards of the Dark Tower as soon as you could hold a weapon. The older warriors showed no mercy, and you learned quickly that hesitation meant pain. Pain taught you to strike first and strike hard.
你剛能握住武器，就被丟進邪黑塔的鬥坑訓練場。年長戰士毫不留情，你很快學會猶豫就意味着疼痛。疼痛教會你先出手，而且要下狠手。

You were used as a courier and agent in the Necromancer's network, carrying messages through the dark wood and delivering them to contacts who never showed their faces. You learned that shadows were your armor and silence your best weapon.
你被死靈法師的網絡當作信使和代理人使用，穿過黑暗森林傳遞消息，交給從不露面的聯繫人。你學會陰影就是甲冑，沉默就是最好的武器。
You were wounded and stayed back while the column fought.
你因受傷沒有參加隊伍的戰鬥。
You won the Dwarves of the Blue Mountains as partners in trade.
你促成了與藍色山脈矮人的貿易合作。
You won the Dwarves of the Iron Hills as partners in trade.
你促成了與鐵丘陵矮人的貿易合作。
You won the Great Mountain Tournament and were named a warchief's retainer.
你贏下大山比武，被任命爲戰酋隨從。
You worked from dawn to dusk among the hives and herds below the Carrock, hauling water and mending fences. When the levy was called you were handed a spear and taught to hold a line.
你曾在卡爾巖下的蜂箱和牛羣間從早忙到晚，挑水、修籬笆。徵召開始時，別人遞給你一杆長矛，教你守住陣線。

You worked from dawn to dusk in the clearings around Thornhold, hauling stumps and driving cattle out of the shadow of the trees. When the levy was called you were handed a spear and taught to hold a line.
你曾在荊棘堡周圍的林間空地從早幹到晚，搬走樹樁，把牛羣趕出樹蔭。徵召開始時，別人遞給你一杆長矛，教你守住陣線。
You worked from dawn to dusk on the cold farms below Fornost, hauling stone and driving sheep across the downs. When the levy was called you were handed a spear and taught to hold a line.
你曾在佛諾斯特下方寒冷的農場，從早到晚搬石頭、趕羊羣走過丘崗。徵召開始時，別人遞給你一杆長矛，教你守住陣線。
You worked from dawn to dusk on the farms between the rivers, hauling grain and driving cattle to the fords. When the levy was called you were handed a spear and taught to hold a line.
你曾在兩河之間的農場從早幹到晚，搬運糧食，趕着牛羣去渡口。徵召開始時，別人遞給你一杆長矛，教你守住陣線。

You worked from dawn to dusk on the high fells, driving flocks between the summer and winter pastures and keeping the wolves off them. When the levy was called you were handed an axe and taught to hold a line.
你曾在高地從早幹到晚，趕着羊羣往返於夏牧場和冬牧場，提防狼來捕食。徵召開始時，別人遞給你一把斧頭，教你守住陣線。

You worked the black-iron forges of Dol Guldur, learning to shape weapons under conditions that would break a lesser youth. The materials were dark and the methods darker, and you left with knowledge that few would admit to having.
你在多古爾都黑鐵熔爐中工作，在足以壓垮普通年輕人的條件下學習塑造武器。材料黑暗，手段更黑暗，而你帶着很少有人願意承認擁有的知識離開。

You worked the terraced gardens of Imladris, learning patience and diligence from Elves who had tended those same beds for an age. Between rows you practiced swordplay, finding that tending living things gave you an instinct for measured force.
你在伊姆拉綴斯的梯田花園中勞作，向照料這些苗牀已有一個紀元之久的精靈學習耐心和勤勉。你也在田壟之間練劍，並發現照看生命會讓人懂得何時用力、用多大力。

You worked the terraced gardens of Mithlond, learning patience and diligence from Elves who had tended those same beds for an age. Between rows you practiced swordplay, finding that tending living things gave you an instinct for measured force.
你在米斯瀧德層層鋪開的花園中勞作，向那些照料同一片園地多年的精靈學習耐心和勤勉。你也會在花畦間練習劍術，照料花草的經驗讓你逐漸學會恰到好處地運用力道。

You worked your family's pastures in the Westfold, learning to handle horses almost before you could walk, and were pressed into levy service as soon as you were tall enough for the spear. The rolling plains of western Rohan were your school.
你在西伏爾德自家牧場勞作，幾乎剛會走路就開始接觸馬匹，等長到能握住長矛時便被徵召服役。洛汗西部起伏平原就是你的學校。
You worked your family's pastures on the Northmark, learning to handle horses almost before you could walk. When the levy was called you took a spear and a place in the line.
你在北境的家族牧場幹活，幾乎還沒學會走路，就開始學習照料馬匹。徵召開始時，你拿起長矛，站進隊伍。
You would have me fight in the lists?
你想讓我替你出戰比武場？
You would leave a lord in rags, before his own people's eyes? Think what it will cost you.
你要讓一位領主穿着破衣爛衫，出現在自己的人民面前？想想你要付出什麼代價。
You wove a ceremonial cloak that the Lady of the Wood presented as a gift.
你織出一件森林夫人用作贈禮的儀式斗篷。

You'd be surprised how battles turn on knowing the land. Every scene I craft teaches me terrain, sightlines, and strategic advantage. The Wold bred warriors who read the earth itself. Shall I ride with you?
你會驚訝於戰局多麼依賴對地形的理解。我塑造的每個場景，都教會我地勢、視線與戰略優勢。北高原養出了能讀懂大地的戰士。我可以與你並騎嗎？

You'd be surprised. My eye for structure reveals weak points in any wall, and my knowledge of spaces gives tactical advantage. Besides, this hammer serves in battle as well as creation. Will you have me?
你會驚訝的。我對結構的眼光能看出任何牆體的弱點，對空間的理解也能帶來戰術優勢。況且，這把錘子能用於創造，也同樣能用於戰鬥。你願意讓我加入嗎？
You're right - Gondor retreats too easily.
你說得對，剛鐸人不該這麼輕易就撤走的。
You, your clan and your vassals must hold more than half of its lands.
你本人、你的家族與封臣必須持有其半數以上土地。
Young Uruk from Isengard, driven from the Black Guard by jealous rivals. Seeks glory untainted by politics.
來自艾森加德的年輕烏魯克，被嫉妒他的對手趕出黑衛隊。他追求不受權謀玷污的榮耀。
Young blood seeks glory, but finds only shadow...
年輕人追尋榮耀，找到的卻只有陰影……
年輕，卻已經證明過自己，這是危險的組合。
Young dwarf seeking glory outside Erebor's safe walls. The world will be my testing ground.
年輕矮人，離開孤山安全的城牆尋找榮耀。世界會成爲我的試煉場。
Young dwarves dream of glory their fathers already won...
年輕矮人夢想着父輩早已贏得的榮耀……
Young eyes can mistake shadows for substance.
年輕人的眼睛，也會把影子當成實物。
Young riders of Vidugard are raised on tales of great charges. Some of us learn early that the real enemy leaves no banner.
維杜加德的年輕騎手，都是聽着壯烈衝鋒的故事長大的。我們有些人早早就懂得，真正的敵人並不打旗號。
Young spearmen of Dale grow up on the story of the dragon's fall. Some of us go looking for a fight that big.
河谷城的年輕矛手，都是聽着屠龍的故事長大的。我們有些人，總想找一場同樣轟轟烈烈的仗。
Young spearmen of Dorwinion grow up on the tale of Ostmar the Warden. Some of us go looking for a fight that big.
多溫尼安的年輕矛手，都是聽着守望者奧斯特馬爾的故事長大的。我們有些人，總想找一場同樣轟轟烈烈的仗。
Young spearmen of the Vales grow up on the tales of Beorn. Some of us go looking for a fight that big.
河谷的年輕矛手，都是聽着貝奧恩的故事長大的。我們有些人，總想找一場同樣轟轟烈烈的仗。
Young spearmen of the Woodmen grow up on the tales of the spiders of Emyn Duir. Some of us go looking for a fight that big.
林中居民的年輕矛手，都是聽着埃敏杜伊爾蜘蛛的故事長大的。我們有些人，總想找一場同樣轟轟烈烈的仗。
Young, eager, and well-trained, I'll prove my worth through deeds, not lineage.
我年輕、急切，也受過良好訓練。我會用行動證明價值，而不是靠血統。
Younger sons of the Dúnedain lords of the Angle grow up with a sword and no land. Some of us write our own legends to make up for it.
河角地杜內丹領主的幼子們，從小有劍卻沒土地。我們有些人只好自己編點英雄事蹟，彌補一下。
Younger sons of the old Dúnedain houses grow up with a sword and no land. Some of us write our own legends to make up for it.
杜內丹古老家族的幼子們，從小有劍卻沒土地。我們有些人只好自己編點英雄事蹟，彌補一下。

Youngest of seven brothers, I was always the smallest, the quickest. While they swung hammers, I learned the crossbow and the art of silence. Became lead scout for the eastern patrols, tracking orc movements through the Grey Mountains. My reports saved many lives.
我是七兄弟裏最小的，一直也是最矮、最快的那個。他們揮錘時，我學會了弩和沉默的本事。後來我成了東部巡邏隊的首席斥候，在灰色山脈追蹤奧克動向。我的報告救過許多命。
Your Career Ability lasts 8 seconds longer and reaches 20 meters further.
職業能力持續時間延長8秒，作用範圍擴大20米。

你已針對{ENEMY}佈下埋伏，現在動手嗎？
Your archers aim 20 percent truer and draw 10 percent faster.
你的弓兵準度提高20%，開弓速度提高10%。
Your archers cover every advance. +4% troop damage.
你的弓手會掩護每一次推進。+4% 部隊傷害。
Your archers darken the sky. +6% troop damage.
你的弓手射出的箭矢遮天蔽日。+6% 部隊傷害。
Your archers draw 20 percent faster and reload 15 percent faster.
你的弓兵開弓速度提高20%，裝填速度提高15%。
Your archers loose with mechanical perfection. +4% troop damage.
你的弓手放箭精準得像機械一樣。+4% 部隊傷害。
你的弓兵裝填速度降低10%。
Your archers take 10 percent more damage.
你的弓兵受到的傷害增加10%。
Your armour is as a river's current -- relentless. +10% resistance to ranged.
你的護甲像河流一樣堅韌不息。+10% 遠程抗性。
Your arms and armour are mine now.
你的武器和盔甲現在歸我了。
Your arrival steadies the warhost. +3% troop morale.
你的到來能穩住戰團。+3% 部隊士氣。
Your arrows carry vile toxins. Voice of the One radius +3.
你的箭矢帶有惡毒毒素。至尊魔戒之聲作用範圍 +3。
Your arrows fly without deviation. +6% ranged damage.
你的箭矢飛行毫無偏差。+6% 遠程傷害。
Your beast keeps its legs in the hardest fights. +10% horse health.
你的坐騎在最艱苦的戰鬥中也不會輕易倒下。+10% 坐騎生命值。
Your blade will find plenty of work out here.
你的刀在外面會有很多活兒可幹。
Your blow lands with the force of a battering ram. +10% melee damage.
你的重擊有攻城錘般的力量。+10% 近戰傷害。
Your blows carry the fury of the Dark Lord. +12% melee damage.
你的攻擊帶着黑暗魔君的怒火。+12% 近戰傷害。
Your blows shatter guard formations. +5% swing speed.
你的重擊能砸碎敵人的防禦陣型。+5% 揮砍速度。
Your blows shatter shields and men alike. +6% melee damage.
你的重擊會砸碎盾牌和敵人。+6% 近戰傷害。
Your body endures the harshest rides. +5 health.
你的身體經得住最艱苦的奔襲。+5 生命值。
Your body shrugs off wounds that would kill smaller folk. +10% resistance to ranged.
足以殺死矮小種族的傷口，你的身體也能硬扛過去。+10% 遠程抗性。
Your campaign begins without a camp: {REASON}
己方佔領進度正在回退：{PERCENT}%
Your career was redesigned, so your career choices were refunded.
你的職業經過重新設計，已退還職業選項。
Your caution was bought dearly, and so was your bow.
你這份謹慎和弓術，都是付過大代價才換來的。
你的騎兵造成的傷害提高8%。
Your cavalry gain 15 experience each day.
你的騎兵每天獲得15點經驗。
你的騎兵受到的傷害降低12%。
Your chants unsettle the enemy. +10% troop resistance.
你的詠唱會動搖敵人。+10% 部隊抗性。
Your charge breaks enemy formations. +13% horse charge damage.
你的衝鋒會衝散敵軍陣型。+13% 坐騎衝鋒傷害。
Your charge cannot be stopped. +15% horse charge damage.
你的衝鋒無法阻擋。+15% 坐騎衝鋒傷害。
Your charge devastates all in its path. +15% horse charge damage.
你的衝鋒會摧毀沿途的一切。+15% 坐騎衝鋒傷害。
Your charge shatters enemy formations. +13% horse charge damage.
你的衝鋒會衝散敵軍陣型。+13% 坐騎衝鋒傷害。
Your charge shatters shield walls. +8% melee damage.
你的衝鋒會撞碎盾牆。+8% 近戰傷害。
Your clan already holds the most refuges it can support ({LIMIT}).
你的家族已達到可維持的避難所數量上限（{LIMIT}）。
Your clan fights for blood, not coin. -4% troop wages.
你的氏族爲鮮血而戰，不是爲金幣而戰。-4% 部隊工資。
Your clan fights for honour, not gold. -4% troop wages.
你的氏族爲榮譽而戰，不是爲金幣而戰。-4% 部隊工資。
Your clan must hold its fief first.
你的家族必須先擁有其封地。
你的家族支付了{AMOUNT}影響力。
Your clan stands alone. {KINGDOM} would take your oath and your banner. Join them now?
你的家族目前保持獨立。{KINGDOM}願意接受你的效忠，讓你的旗幟加入他們的行列。現在加入嗎？
Your clan supplies enough arrows for a siege. +13% ammo.
你的氏族提供了足夠打一場圍城戰的箭矢。+13% 彈藥。
Your class sets the weapons you carry into the fight. Cavalry also sets your armour and puts you on a horse; the other classes leave your armour as it is.
兵種決定你帶入戰鬥的武器。騎兵還會更換盔甲並配上一匹馬，其他兵種保留你現有的盔甲。
無法聯繫上你的指揮官。
Your commander holds you to your oath — {DAYS} more days are owed. Leaving now is desertion: you forfeit the pay still owed to you, and your commander will not forget it.
指揮官要求你遵守誓言，你還需要服役{DAYS}天。現在離開就算逃兵：你會失去尚未補發的軍餉，指揮官也不會忘記這件事。
Your commander is fighting a battle your oath keeps you out of.
指揮官正在作戰，但你的誓約不允許你參加這場戰鬥。
Your commander will not take your oath again for a time, and this term will count for nothing if you return.
你的指揮官會在一段時間內拒絕你再次宣誓效忠，即使你回來，這期服役也不算數。
Your commission is ended. Return to the ranks.
撤去你的軍官任命，回到士兵隊伍吧。
Your company clears the burnt timbers of {SETTLEMENT} and raises new walls.
你的部隊清理{SETTLEMENT}燒燬的木料，重新築起牆壁。
Your company has stopped at {SETTLEMENT}. Your sergeant will look the other way if you want a few hours to yourself.
你的部隊已在{SETTLEMENT}停駐。如果你想抽幾個小時自由活動，軍士會睜一隻眼閉一隻眼。
Your company holds position while the refuge is raised. It can march once the work is done.
修建避難所期間，你的部隊會留在原地，工程完成後才能繼續行軍。
Your company labours on the {BUILDING} of {SETTLEMENT}.
Your company swells with volunteers. +4 party size.
志願者不斷加入你的隊伍。部隊人數上限+4。
部隊參與勞動，加快了{BUILDING}的施工。
Your cry heartens the host. +3% troop morale.
你的呼喊能鼓舞整支軍勢。+3% 部隊士氣。
Your cult fighters unleash devastating salvos. +4% troop damage.
你的教團戰士能用齊射重創敵人。+4% 部隊傷害。
Your dedication to the community is legendary.
你對社羣的投入已經成了傳奇。

Your deeds are known. A master armourer, at a level {LORD} armoury, will now fit you with your {PIECE}.
你的功績已經傳開。現在可以到{LORD}級軍械庫，請鑄甲大師爲你打造{PIECE}。
Your deeds are sung in the dark halls of Mordor. +14% battle renown gain.
你的事蹟在魔多黑暗廳堂中傳唱。+14% 戰鬥聲望獲取。
Your deeds bring glory to Aldburg. +12% battle renown gain.
你的事蹟爲奧德堡帶來榮耀。+12% 戰鬥聲望獲取。
Your deeds bring glory to Rhovanion. +12% battle renown gain.
你的事蹟爲羅瓦尼安帶來榮耀。+12%戰鬥聲望獲取。
Your deeds bring glory to Westmark. +12% battle renown gain.
你的事蹟爲西境帶來榮耀。+12%戰鬥聲望獲取。
Your deeds bring glory to the Mark. +12% battle renown gain.
你的事蹟爲馬克帶來榮耀。+12% 戰鬥聲望獲取。
Your elite troops cost no daily upkeep in your realm's special resource.
你的精銳部隊不再每日消耗本國專屬資源作爲維持費。
Your experiences have set you on a path. Choose the career that will define your legend.
過去的經歷讓你走到了今天。選擇一個職業，譜寫屬於你的傳奇。

Your family belonged to one of Gondor's noble houses, sworn to defend the White Tree. Your father was a knight who fought bravely in service to the Steward, while your mother managed the family's lands and affairs.
你的家族屬於剛鐸的貴族之一，宣誓守護白樹。你的父親是爲宰相英勇作戰的騎士，母親則打理家族土地和事務。

Your family belonged to one of the Dúnedain houses of the Angle, between the Hoarwell and the Loudwater, whose blood runs back to Eärendur's youngest son. Your father rode in the King's host from Cameth Brin, while your mother kept the family's hill lands and its long memory.
你的家族屬於蒼泉河與響水河之間、河角地的杜內丹貴族，血統可以追溯到埃雅仁都爾的幼子。父親曾從卡梅斯布林出發，騎馬隨國王的軍隊出征，母親則照管家族在山中的田產，記着那些久遠的往事。

Your family belonged to one of the old houses of Arthedain, whose blood runs back to the Númenóreans who came north with Elendil. Your father rode in the King's host at Fornost, while your mother kept the family's thinning lands and its long memory.
你的家族屬於阿塞丹的古老貴族，血統可以追溯到隨埃蘭迪爾來到北方的努門諾爾人。父親曾在佛諾斯特隨國王的大軍騎馬出征，母親則打理着日漸縮小的田產，守着家族那些久遠的記憶。

Your family belonged to one of the old houses of Cardolan, whose fathers lie in the royal barrows of Tyrn Gorthad. Your father rode in the King's host from Caras Gorthad, while your mother kept the family's lands along the Greenway and its long memory.
你的家族屬於卡多藍的古老貴族，先輩長眠在提殞戈沙德的王家古冢裏。父親曾從卡拉斯戈沙德出發，騎馬隨國王的軍隊出征，母親則照管綠大道沿線的田產，記着家族那些久遠的往事。
Your family conducted trade across the seas, often smuggling goods to fund the Corsairs' endeavors.
你的家族在海上從事貿易，也常走私貨物，爲海盜的事業籌措資金。
Your family conducted trade along the southern roads, bringing exotic goods and spices to the markets of Harad.
你的家族沿南方道路經商，把異域貨物和香料帶到哈拉德市場。
Your family constructed the vessels that carried the Corsairs to war, crafting ships of speed and stealth.
你的家族建造將海盜送上戰場的船隻，打造速度快、善於隱蔽的戰船。
Your family crafted tools and weapons within the shadow of Orthanc, forging instruments of Saruman's will.
你的家族在歐爾桑克陰影下打造工具和武器，鍛成執行薩茹曼意志的器具。
Your family descended from the noble houses of the Woodland Realm, serving as close advisors and protectors of King Thranduil's court.
你的家族出自林地王國的貴族家族，曾在瑟蘭杜伊王庭中擔任親近顧問和守護者。
Your family drifted across the Wold, the wild grasslands between Rohan and the Brown Lands. They survived by their wits and occasional service as scouts.
你的家族漂泊在北高原上，也就是洛汗與褐地之間的荒草原。他們靠機敏求生，有時也會爲人充當斥候。
Your family drifted across the open plains south of the forest, following the herds, taking what work they could find and sometimes what they could not.
你的家人在森林南方的開闊平原上漂泊，追隨畜羣，能找到什麼活就幹什麼，有時也會弄些不該拿的東西。
Your family drifted along the Gladden and the banks of the Anduin, trading what they found, taking what they could, and learning that a ferryman hears more than he says.
你的家人沿金鳶尾河與安都因河岸漂泊，找到什麼就賣什麼，拿得到的也不會放過。他們明白，擺渡人聽到的事，總比說出來的多。
Your family farmed the rich land between the Carrock and the Gladden, keeping cattle, bees and a spear by the door, for wolves and goblins came down from the Misty Mountains more often than the rain.
你家在卡爾巖與金鳶尾河之間的肥沃土地上耕作，養牛、養蜂，門邊還備着一杆長矛，因爲狼和半獸人從迷霧山脈下來的次數，比這裏下雨還勤。
Your family forged legendary arms in Erebor's blazing halls, crafting blades and armor coveted across Middle-earth, and traded them for wealth.
你的家族在孤山熾熱的大廳中打造傳奇兵器，鍛造中洲各地都渴望得到的刀劍和甲冑，並以此換取財富。
Your family forged weapons and armor imbued with the dark magic of Dol Guldur, equipping its armies for conquest.
你的家族打造灌注多古爾都黑暗魔法的武器和甲冑，爲它的軍隊征服四方提供裝備。
Your family fought against Orcs and other threats in the Grey Mountains, upholding the honor of their kin.
你的家族在灰色山脈中與奧克和其他威脅作戰，維護族人的榮耀。
Your family fought among the Broadbeams of Belegost, mastering axe and shield and holding the mountain gates when the goblins of Blue Craig came down from the north.
你的家人曾在貝烈戈斯特的寬梁族中作戰，精通斧盾。當藍巖的半獸人從北方南下時，他們堅守山門。
Your family fought with Dain Ironfoot's warriors, mastering axe and shield and wielding crossbows to hold Erebor's gates.
你的家族曾與鐵足戴因的戰士並肩作戰，精通斧盾，也會使用弩弓守住孤山大門。
Your family guarded Erebor's vast treasuries, managing its riches and planning defenses to protect the mountain's wealth from foes.
你的家族守護孤山龐大的寶庫，管理財富，並規劃防務，防止敵人染指山中的珍寶。

Your family held sway as chieftains among the Dunlending clans, commanding respect through lineage and strength. Your father rallied warriors in times of conflict, while your mother managed the clan's affairs.
你的家族曾在黑蠻地氏族中擔任酋長，憑血脈和力量贏得尊敬。衝突爆發時，你的父親會召集戰士，母親則打理氏族事務。
Your family hunted across the vast steppes of Khand, tracking game and guarding the herds from predators.
你的家族在可汗德廣闊草原上狩獵，追蹤獵物，也保護畜羣不受猛獸侵擾。
Your family hunted along the southern eaves of Mirkwood, skilled with the bow and watchful of whatever crept out from under the trees.
你的家人在黑森林南部邊緣打獵，擅長用弓，也留意着從樹下爬出來的各種東西。
Your family hunted the eaves of Mirkwood east of the river, taking deer and boar and keeping watch on the trees for spiders and the servants of Dol Guldur.
你的家人在河東的黑森林邊緣打獵，獵取鹿和野豬，也留意林間的蜘蛛和多古爾都僕從。
Your family hunted the reed-beds and river-woods along the River Running, taking fowl and deer for the markets of Seagate and keeping a sharp eye on the water.
你的家人在奔流河沿岸的蘆葦叢和河邊樹林中打獵，捕捉禽鳥和鹿，送往海門集市，也始終留意水面上的動靜。
Your family hunted the twisted creatures of the forest and tracked those who dared trespass into the Necromancer's domain.
你的家族獵殺森林中的扭曲生物，也追蹤膽敢闖入死靈法師領地的人。

Your family kept a forge in Nogrod, where the Firebeards have worked iron since the Elder Days. Their blades and mail went west to the Elves of Lindon and east along the Dwarf-road, and every piece fetched its price.
你家在諾格羅德經營鍛爐，火須族從遠古時代起就在這裏打鐵。家裏打造的刀劍和鎖子甲，向西賣給林頓精靈，向東則沿矮人路運走，每一件都能賣出價錢。

Your family kept a trading house at the Old Ford, where the road from the High Pass meets the river. Honey, hides and timber went across to the Woodmen and the Elves of Mirkwood, and every cart paid its due.
你家在老渡口經營商行，從高隘口下來的道路就在這裏與河流相接。蜂蜜、獸皮和木材運過河，賣給林中居民與黑森林精靈，每輛貨車都得交費。

Your family kept a trading house in Bree, where the Great East Road meets the Greenway. Dwarves from the Blue Mountains, Hobbits from the Shire and Men of the Bree-land all passed through their doors, and every one of them paid.
你家在布理經營商行，東西大道與綠大道就在這裏交匯。藍色山脈的矮人、夏爾的霍比特人，還有布理地區的人類都會登門，個個都得掏錢。

Your family kept a trading house in Tharbad, where the North-South Road crosses the Greyflood. Barges from the coast, wool from the downs and Dwarvish iron from the west all passed through their warehouses, and every bale paid its toll.
你家在沙巴德經營商行，南北大道在這裏跨過灰水河。海岸來的駁船、丘崗上的羊毛，還有西方矮人的鐵，都要經過你家的倉庫，每一捆貨物都得付費。
Your family kept a trading house in Woodmen-town, where timber, furs and honey came in from the clearings and went out along the Forest Road, and where every load paid its toll.
你家在林中居民鎮經營商行。木材、毛皮和蜂蜜從林間空地運來，再沿密林路運走，每批貨物都得交費。

Your family kept a trading post at the Last Bridge, where the Great East Road crosses the Hoarwell. Dwarves on the road to the Iron Hills, hill-men with furs and Elves from the hidden valley all passed their doors, and every one of them paid.
你家在最後大橋經營商站，東西大道在這裏跨過蒼泉河。趕往鐵丘陵的矮人、帶着毛皮的山民，還有隱祕山谷來的精靈都會登門，個個都得掏錢。
Your family kept a wine-house at Redwater, shipping casks down the river and across the Sea of Rhûn, and every cask paid its toll before it left the quay.
你家在紅水經營酒行，把酒桶順河運走，再運過魯恩內海，每隻酒桶離開碼頭前都得交費。
Your family kept the hoards and storehouses of Thorin's Halls, reckoning the kingdom's wealth and planning how a mountain hold is supplied and defended through a hard winter.
你的家人看管梭林大廳的寶庫和倉庫，清點王國財富，籌劃如何爲山中要塞準備補給和防務，熬過嚴冬。
Your family labored deep within the caverns of Dol Guldur, extracting resources to feed its war machine.
你的家族在多古爾都洞窟深處勞作，開採資源以供養它的戰爭機器。
Your family lived among the quays of Seagate, working the boats for coin and learning that a harbour-master hears more than he says.
你的家人在海門的碼頭間討生活，替船上幹活賺錢，也明白港務官聽到的事，總比說出來的多。
Your family lived among the ruins of Osgiliath, surviving through cunning and resourcefulness. They scavenged what they could and occasionally served under Gondor's banners as irregular troops.
你的家族生活在歐斯吉利亞斯廢墟中，靠機敏和應變求生。他們搜撿一切能用的東西，有時也會在剛鐸旗幟下充當非正規部隊。
Your family lived off the wild lands of Dunland, hunting game and gathering herbs in the dense forests that bordered the Misty Mountains.
你的家族靠黑蠻地荒野爲生，在毗鄰迷霧山脈的密林中狩獵野獸、採集草藥。

Your family lived on the edges, drifting between the Trollshaws, the Last Bridge and the empty country around Weathertop. They traded what they found, took what they could, and learned that a stranger's purse was often looser than his tongue.
你家在邊緣地帶討生活，往來於食人妖森林、最後大橋，以及風雲頂周圍荒無人煙的地方。找到什麼就賣什麼，拿得到的也不會放過。他們明白，陌生人的嘴再緊，錢袋也未必那麼緊。
Your family lived on the fringes of Blue Craig's society, surviving through cunning and ruthlessness in the unforgiving mountain passes.
你的家族生活在藍巖社會的邊緣，靠狡詐和狠辣在環境惡劣的山口間求生。
Your family lived on the fringes of Goblin-town's society, surviving through cunning and ruthlessness in the unforgiving mountain passes.
你的家族生活在半獸人鎮社會的邊緣，靠狡詐和狠辣在環境惡劣的山口間求生。
Your family lived on the fringes of Gundabad's society, surviving through cunning and ruthlessness in the unforgiving mountain passes.
你的家族生活在貢達巴德社會邊緣，在無情山口中靠狡詐和狠勁活下來。
Your family lived on the fringes of the Misty Mountains's society, surviving through cunning and ruthlessness in the unforgiving mountain passes.
你的家族生活在迷霧山脈社會的邊緣，靠狡詐和狠辣在環境惡劣的山口間求生。
Your family lived on the fringes of the Woodland Realm, cultivating the land and gathering what little the shadowed forest provided.
你的家族生活在林地王國邊緣，耕種土地，也採集這片被陰影籠罩的森林仍能提供的少量資源。
Your family lived on the margins of society in Dale, surviving through odd jobs and sometimes less reputable means.
你的家族生活在河谷邦社會邊緣，靠零活過日子，有時也會做些名聲不太好的勾當。

Your family lived on the roads, drifting between Bree, the borders of the Shire and the ruined towns of fallen Cardolan. They traded what they found, took what they could, and learned that a stranger's purse was often looser than his tongue.
你家以道路爲家，在布理、夏爾邊境和已經衰落的卡多藍城鎮廢墟之間漂泊。找到什麼就賣什麼，拿得到的也不會放過。他們明白，陌生人的嘴再緊，錢袋也未必那麼緊。

Your family lived on the roads, drifting between Tharbad, Sarn Ford and the edge of the Old Forest. They traded what they found, took what they could, and learned that a stranger's purse was often looser than his tongue.
你家以道路爲家，在沙巴德、薩恩渡口和老林子邊緣漂泊。找到什麼就賣什麼，拿得到的也不會放過。他們明白，陌生人的嘴再緊，錢袋也未必那麼緊。
Your family lived on the thorny edges of the Thornhold marches, taking what the forest and the road gave, and learned that a stranger's purse was often looser than his tongue.
你的家人住在荊棘堡邊境長滿荊棘的地帶，靠從森林和路上弄來的東西過活。他們明白，陌生人的嘴再緊，錢袋也未必那麼緊。
Your family managed trade and supplies within Mordor, ensuring the armies of Sauron were equipped for war. Their dealings were shadowed by intrigue and violence.
你的家族管理魔多內部的貿易和補給，確保索隆的軍隊備戰充足。他們的交易總被陰謀和暴力籠罩。
Your family moved in the shadows, smuggling goods and information vital to the survival of the Corsairs.
你的家族在陰影中行動，走私貨物和情報；這些東西對海盜的生存至關重要。
Your family operated in the shadows, gathering intelligence and undermining the enemies of Saruman.
你的家族在陰影中行動，收集情報，暗中削弱薩茹曼的敵人。
Your family patrolled the borders of Lothlorien, guarding the passes and defending against Orcs and other intruders.
你的家族巡守洛絲羅瑞恩邊境，守衛山口，抵禦奧克和其他入侵者。
Your family patrolled the wilds around Erebor, tracking Orcs and firing bows to safeguard the Lonely Mountain's borders.
你的家族巡守孤山周邊荒野，追蹤奧克，以弓箭守護孤山邊境。
Your family protected the sacred Mallorn trees, ensuring the splendor of Lothlorien endured against any threat.
你的家族守護神聖的瑁瓏樹，確保洛絲羅瑞恩的壯美能夠抵禦任何威脅，長久延續。
Your family roamed the lands beyond Lothlorien, aiding allies and spreading word of the Golden Wood's splendor.
你的家族遊歷洛絲羅瑞恩之外的土地，援助盟友，也把金色森林的美名傳播出去。
Your family roamed the vast deserts, following ancient paths between water sources and trading with settled peoples.
你的家族在遼闊沙漠中遷徙，沿着水源之間的古老道路行進，並與定居者貿易。
Your family roamed the volcanic plains of Gorgoroth, hunting and tracking prey to sustain the armies of Mordor. Their skill in the wilderness was unmatched.
你的家族遊蕩在戈堝洛斯的火山平原上，狩獵並追蹤獵物，以供養魔多軍隊。他們在荒野中的本領無人能及。
Your family served as overseers for the Uruk-hai legions, enforcing discipline and maintaining order within Sauron's ranks.
你的家族擔任烏魯克軍團的督管，在索隆的隊伍中執行紀律、維持秩序。
Your family served as rangers, patrolling the wilds around Blue Craig and safeguarding its borders from harm.
你的家人都是巡山者，負責巡視藍巖周邊的荒野，保護邊界不受侵擾。
Your family served as rangers, patrolling the wilds around Goblin-town and safeguarding its borders from harm.
你的家人都是巡山者，負責巡視半獸人鎮周邊的荒野，保護邊界不受侵擾。
Your family served as rangers, patrolling the wilds around Gundabad and safeguarding its borders from harm.
你的家族擔任遊俠，巡守貢達巴德周邊荒野，保護邊境不受侵害。
Your family served as rangers, patrolling the wilds around the Misty Mountains and safeguarding its borders from harm.
你的家人都是巡山者，負責巡視迷霧山脈周邊的荒野，保護邊界不受侵擾。
Your family served as rangers, protecting the borders of the Woodland Realm and guarding the forest paths from intruders and threats alike.
你的家族擔任遊俠，保護林地王國邊境，守衛森林道路，抵禦入侵者和各種威脅。
Your family served as scouts and guardians, patrolling the borders of Imladris and ensuring the valley remained a sanctuary free from evil.
你的家族擔任斥候和守護者，巡邏伊姆拉綴斯邊境，確保山谷不受邪惡侵擾，始終是一處庇護之地。
Your family served as scouts and guardians, patrolling the borders of Mithlond and ensuring the valley remained a sanctuary free from evil.
你的家人擔任斥候和守衛，巡視米斯瀧德的邊境，確保這片山谷始終是一個不受邪惡侵擾的庇護所。
Your family served as scouts and outriders for the Easterling host, ranging far ahead of the main force to gather intelligence.
你的家族擔任東夷大軍的斥候和前驅騎手，遠離主力偵察情報。
Your family served directly under the Necromancer, performing his dark bidding and enforcing his will across the region.
你的家族直接侍奉死靈法師，執行他的黑暗命令，並在整個地區推行他的意志。
Your family served directly under the command of the Dark Tower. Your father was a brutal enforcer, while your mother worked to instill the will of Sauron among the lesser folk.
你的家族直接聽命於邪黑塔。你的父親是殘暴的執行者，母親則負責把索隆的意志灌輸給地位更低的人。
Your family served directly under the court of the King of Dale, managing the affairs of the kingdom and defending its people.
你的家族直接侍奉河谷邦國王的宮廷，管理王國事務，保衛王國人民。
Your family served directly under the guidance of Lady Galadriel and Lord Celeborn, defending the heart of Lothlorien with unwavering dedication.
你的家族直接接受加拉德瑞爾夫人與凱勒博恩領主的指引，以堅定忠誠保衛洛絲羅瑞恩的心臟。
Your family served the marshals of the Riddermark, riding with them in defense of Rohan's borders. Your father was a skilled horseman and warrior.
你的家族侍奉裏德馬克的元帥，隨他們騎馬出征，保衛洛汗邊境。你的父親是一名出色的騎手和戰士。
Your family survived on the fringes of Haradrim society, raiding caravans and living by their cunning in the endless sands.
你的家族在哈拉德社會邊緣求生，劫掠商隊，靠狡詐在無盡沙海中活下去。
Your family tended the fertile fields of Lindon, ensuring its people and guests were well-fed and sustained in their peaceful haven.
你的家人耕作林頓肥沃的田地，爲這片安寧港灣裏的居民和來客提供充足的食物。
Your family tended the fertile fields of Rivendell, ensuring its people and guests were well-fed and sustained in their peaceful haven.
你的家族照料幽谷肥沃的田地，確保這裏的居民和客人都能在和平庇護所中得到充足食物。
Your family tended to the wounded and preserved the ancient wisdom of healing within the Golden Wood.
你的家族照料傷者，並在金色森林中保存古老的醫治智慧。
Your family tended vines and orchards on the sunlit slopes above the Redwater, with a spear by the door, for raiders from the east came up the shore more often than the frost.
你家照料紅水河上方朝陽山坡上的葡萄園與果園，門邊總備着長矛，因爲東來的劫掠者沿岸而來的次數，比這裏落霜還勤。
Your family tilled the rich soil of the Pelennor Fields, providing sustenance for Minas Tirith. They also served as levy soldiers, standing in defense of the city during times of war.
你的家族耕種佩蘭諾平野的肥沃土地，爲米那斯提力斯供應糧食。戰時，他們也會作爲徵召兵上陣，保衛這座城市。
Your family toiled in Erebor's deepest mines, unearthing mithril and gems, and learned to fortify the mountain against invaders.
你的家族在孤山最深處的礦脈中勞作，開採祕銀和寶石，也學會了如何加固山體、抵禦入侵者。
Your family toiled in the deep pits of Isengard, extracting stone and ore to fuel Saruman's ambitions.
你的家族在艾森加德深坑中勞作，開採石料和礦石，供養薩茹曼的野心。
Your family traded along the eastern routes, bringing goods from distant lands to the markets of Rhun.
你的家族沿東方商路貿易，把遠方土地的貨物帶到魯恩市場。
Your family traded goods between the Dunlending clans and the outside world. Their knowledge of the land and its people brought prosperity to your household.

Your relation with a lord stays with that lord instead of passing to his clan leader, so a friendship with Faramir is not a friendship with Denethor. Affects only your own relations: relations between AI lords stay vanilla. Single player only: in a co-op session or on a dedicated server it stays vanilla. A save made before this was on is seeded once: on the first day this is on, each living lord whose personal relation with you is 0 takes his clan leader's value, and it is seeded again when this has been off for at least one in-game day. Off restores vanilla. Default: on.

你與某位領主的關係歸其本人所有，不再轉給其家族領袖；因此，與法拉米爾交好，不等於與德內梭爾交好。隻影響你自己的關係，AI領主之間仍使用原版規則。僅限單人模式；合作聯機和專用服務器仍使用原版規則。此前未開啓此功能的存檔，會在首次開啓的第一天初始化一次：所有仍在世、且與你個人關係爲0的領主，會繼承其家族領袖與你的關係值。若關閉此功能至少一個遊戲日後重新開啓，也會再次初始化。關閉後恢復原版。默認：開啓。

Recommended: {RAGDOLLS} 5, {CORPSES} {LOW}. A setting already lower is kept. Apply now? You can change them back at any time in Options, {PERFORMANCE}. Yrla Ghostpelt wears the skin of a white wolf, said to grant her protection in battle.
“鬼皮”伊爾拉披着一張白狼皮，據說它能在戰鬥中保護她。
Yrsa the Winter Boar leads raids during the harshest seasons when enemies least expect attack.
冬野豬伊爾莎專在最嚴酷的季節發動劫掠，那時敵人最不會料到襲擊。
Yumruk of House Adekig rides at the head of the clan's lancers, a hard-handed kinsman whose banner is feared across the plains of Rhûn.
阿德基格家族的尤姆魯克率領着家族的槍騎兵。他手段強硬，魯恩平原上的人都畏懼他的旗幟。

Yurzal Vazevian, a charismatic orator of Rhûn, rallies the masses to Sauron's banner in the Third Age. His speeches ignite passion for conquest. Yurzal's rhetoric transforms reluctant tribes into fervent warriors.
尤爾扎爾·瓦澤維安是魯恩富有魅力的演說者，在第三紀元號召民衆聚集到索隆旗幟之下。他的演說點燃征服熱情。尤爾扎爾的辭令能把猶豫的部族變成狂熱戰士。
Zafar is a chieftain of the golden banner tribes.
扎法爾是金旗部族的酋長。
Zagarkhôr, the Sword-Lord, holds Cirith Nargil for the Dark Tower. His house kept the Adunaic tongue when the rest of Middle-earth let it go, and he will correct anyone who names him in Elvish.
“劍之主”扎加爾霍爾替邪黑塔守衛奇立斯納爾吉爾。當中洲其他地方早已不用阿督耐克語時，他的家族仍保留着這門語言。誰用精靈語稱呼他，他都會糾正。
Zanuwa is a skilled archer of the tribe.
扎努瓦是部族中技藝嫺熟的弓手。

Zargoth, the ferocious warlord, leads his Uruk-hai with a savage intensity that terrifies all who face him. His absolute loyalty to Saruman drives his relentless pursuit of victory, his troops a devastating force honed by his brutal leadership. Zargoth's lack of mercy and keen tactical mind make him a scourge on the battlefield, his victories piling corpses at Isengard's gates. With every enemy crushed, he strengthens the Black Maw's fearsome reputation, serving Saruman's dark vision without hesitation.
扎爾戈斯是兇暴的軍閥，以令人膽寒的野性強度統率烏魯克。對薩茹曼的絕對忠誠驅使他不停追求勝利，他的部隊則是在殘酷統率下磨成的毀滅力量。扎爾戈斯毫無憐憫，又有敏銳的戰術頭腦，是戰場上的災星；他的勝利在艾森加德城門前堆起屍體。每當一個敵人被碾碎，黑顎的可怖名聲就更進一步，而他也毫不猶豫地服務於薩茹曼的黑暗願景。
Zargra, a poison mistress, brews venoms, enhancing the clan's deadly arsenal.
扎爾格拉是毒液女主人，調製毒劑，強化氏族致命的武器庫。
Zarkash, a fell beast handler, commands winged horrors from Dol Guldur, evoking the dread steeds of the Ringwraiths in lore, scouting and assaulting from the skies.
扎爾卡什是兇惡巨獸的馴養者，統御來自多古爾都的有翼恐怖。它們讓人想起傳說中戒靈的可怖坐騎，從天空偵察並發動襲擊。
Zarlug, an arcane warden, erects barriers of shadow, protecting Dol Guldur as the Necromancer's illusions in the books.
扎爾盧格是祕法守衛，豎起陰影屏障，像書中死靈法師的幻象那樣保護多古爾都。
Zaya of House Bozorganith is a proud woman of the Easterlings, mistress of hearth and granary and no stranger to the horse and the bow.
博佐加尼思家族的扎雅是一位驕傲的東夷女子。她掌管家務和糧倉，對騎馬和射箭也不陌生。
Zena serves the dark masters of Mordor.
澤娜侍奉魔多的黑暗主人。
Zhamik Zhamian, Loke-Khan of Rhun, rules the Golden Realm of the Easterlings. His ancestors served Sauron, and he continues that dark alliance, dreaming of conquering the lands of the West.
扎米克·扎米安是魯恩的洛克可汗，統治東夷的黃金國度。他的祖先曾侍奉索隆，而他延續了這份黑暗盟約，夢想征服西方諸地。
Zigûrbêl is heir to Cirith Nargil and trained in the dark arts. His name means Lover of the Wizard, which is what Numenor called Sauron before it learned what he was.
齊古爾貝爾是奇立斯納爾吉爾的繼承人，學過黑暗法術。他的名字意爲“敬愛巫師的人”。努門諾爾人還不知道索隆的真面目時，曾稱他爲“巫師”。
Zimrabêth speaks for her husband's house at the Black Gate, and speaks rather better than he does. The Mouth of Sauron has found her useful more than once.
辛拉貝絲在黑門代表丈夫的家族發言，而且口才遠勝於丈夫。索隆之口已經不止一次發現她很有用。
Zimraphel, a descendant of the Black Númenóreans, commands the Corsair fleet with cunning and grace. Her knowledge of the sea and its treacherous currents is unrivaled among the captains of Umbar.
辛拉斐爾是黑努門諾爾人的後裔，以狡黠與優雅指揮海盜艦隊。她對海洋和兇險海流的瞭解，在烏姆巴爾諸位船長中無人能及。
Zimrazîn is the second child of the Sword-Lord and the more dangerous of the two. She has her mother's talents and none of her patience.
辛拉辛是“劍之主”的第二個孩子，也是兩個孩子中更危險的那個。她繼承了母親的天賦，卻半點耐心也沒繼承。

Zorgath, a ferocious orc berserker, channels the raw fury of Tolkien's orc legions that clashed at the Battle of Five Armies. In Gundabad, he charges into the fray with reckless abandon, inspiring fear in enemies and respect among allies, all in service to Azgar's vision of orc supremacy.
佐爾加斯是兇猛的奧克狂戰士，承載着托爾金筆下奧克軍團在五軍之戰中爆發出的原始怒火。在貢達巴德，他不顧一切衝入亂戰，讓敵人恐懼，也讓盟友敬畏，一切都服務於阿茲加爾讓奧克稱霸的願景。

Zorgha serves as a shamanic orc advisor, echoing the dark rituals hinted at in Tolkien's orc culture. His omens and curses bolster the clan's morale, invoking the spirits of ancient evils to aid in their conquests.
佐爾加是貢達巴德的薩滿顧問，呼應托爾金奧克文化中隱約出現的黑暗儀式。他的預兆和詛咒能鼓舞氏族士氣，也召引古老邪惡的靈影來幫助他們征服。
Zorgrul, an animating sorcerer, revives fallen warriors, his craft akin to Sauron's dominion over death.
佐爾格魯爾是驅屍術士，能讓倒下的戰士重新行動。他的技藝近似索隆對死亡的支配。

Zorlag, a cunning and relentless warlord of the White Hand, drives Isengard's Uruk-hai with a fierce blend of strategy and savagery. His loyalty to Saruman is absolute, and his sharp mind ensures that every maneuver serves the White Wizard's grand designs. Zorlag's calculating nature makes him a master of exploiting enemy weaknesses, while his harsh leadership inspires both fear and obedience in his ranks. With a cold disdain for mercy, he crushes opposition with brutal precision, cementing his reputation as a formidable commander whose victories bolster Isengard's growing dominion.
佐爾拉格是白手麾下狡詐而執着的軍閥，以戰略與野性的猛烈結合驅策艾森加德的烏魯克。他對薩茹曼絕對忠誠，敏銳的頭腦確保每一次行動都服務於白袍巫師的宏大計劃。佐爾拉格善於算計，是利用敵人弱點的高手；他嚴酷的統率讓部下既恐懼又服從。他冷漠地蔑視憐憫，以殘忍而精準的手段粉碎反抗，因此成爲一名威名赫赫的指揮官，他的勝利也不斷壯大艾森加德的勢力。
Zrsa Blackfang is heir to the Ironhand, eager to prove herself worthy of her father's legacy.
“黑牙”茲爾莎是“鐵手”的繼承人，渴望證明自己配得上父親留下的傳承。
Zuad is a young merchant in training.
祖阿德是正在受訓的年輕商人。
Zulaika trains with the frontier garrison.
祖萊卡隨邊境守軍受訓。

Zulgara, a shrewd orc overseer, reflects the harsh survival instincts of orc females in lore. She manages the clan's breeding pits, ensuring a constant supply of warriors for the impending shadow wars.
祖爾加拉是精明的奧克監工，體現傳說中奧克女性嚴酷的生存本能。她管理氏族的育種坑，確保即將到來的陰影戰爭有源源不斷的戰士。
Zulgor, a wing breeder, hatches fell eggs, expanding Khamûl's airborne dominion.
祖爾戈是一名翼獸繁育者，通過孵化兇惡巨獸的卵來擴大可哈穆爾的空中勢力。
Zulgora, a shade weaver, crafts illusions, deceiving foes as Sauron's deceptions in the tales.
祖爾戈拉是影紗編織者，製造幻象迷惑敵人，如同故事中索隆的欺騙手段。
Zulgoth acts as a ritualist orc, performing sacrifices to dark powers as hinted in orc customs. His rites invoke strength for the clan's endeavors.
祖爾戈斯是奧克儀式師，會按照奧克習俗中暗示的做法向黑暗力量獻祭。他的儀式爲氏族的行動祈求力量。
Zulkhan commands a fortress on the northern frontier.
祖爾汗指揮着北部邊疆的一座要塞。
